`ml/src/corvus_ml/jobs/api.py`:

```py
"""The control-plane API as a job sees it: a small port plus a stdlib HTTP adapter.

Jobs authenticate with ``Authorization: Bearer $CORVUS_API_TOKEN`` and identify themselves with
``X-Corvus-Job-Id``. Tests use a fake implementation of :class:`JobApi`.

Assumed shape of the snapshot endpoints (see docs/reference/ml-jobs.md):

* ``GET /api/v1/snapshots/{id}`` returns the snapshot with its ``manifest``
  (``files.events[].key`` are object keys in the lake bucket);
* ``GET /api/v1/snapshots/{id}/files`` returns ``{"items": [...], "raw": [...]}`` (entries with
  ``key``); ``raw`` is absent on older APIs;
* ``GET /api/v1/snapshots/{id}/sessions?exclude_erased=true`` returns a page
  ``{"items": [...], "next_cursor": ...}`` of sessions, each with ``session_id`` (hex),
  ``pseudonym`` (hex), ``started_at``, ``client_protocol``, ``segments``
  (``[{"segment", "game_context"}]``) and
  optionally ``labels`` (``[{"label", "source", "confidence", "valid_from", "valid_to"}]``).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from collections.abc import Callable, Iterator
from typing import Any, Protocol

from corvus_ml.jobs.context import ApiSettings

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

JOB_STATUSES = ("running", "succeeded", "failed")


class ApiError(RuntimeError):
    """An API call failed. The text never contains request headers or the token."""

    def __init__(self, message: str, status: int | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status = status


class ArtifactInvalidated(ApiError):  # noqa: N818 - a domain event rather than a failure
    """``409``: an erasure invalidated the snapshot's raw-derived artefacts after the job began."""

    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(message, 409)


class JobApi(Protocol):
    def update_job(
        self,
        job_id: str,
        status: str,
        message: str | None = None,
        result: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """``PATCH /jobs/{id}``: status ``running|succeeded|failed``, message, result JSON."""

    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]: ...

    def get_snapshot_files(self, snapshot_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """``GET /snapshots/{id}/files``: ``items`` (events) and, on current APIs, ``raw``."""

    def iter_snapshot_sessions(self, snapshot_id: str) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Sessions of the snapshot, erased players excluded."""

    def register_artifact(self, job_id: str, kind: str, s3_prefix: str, contains_raw: bool) -> None:
        """``POST /jobs/{job_id}/artifacts`` (201 new, 200 repeated).

        Raises :class:`ArtifactInvalidated` on ``409``.
        """

    def register_model(self, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """``POST /models`` (stage ``registered``)."""


class HttpApiClient:
    """:class:`JobApi` over HTTP using only the standard library."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        settings: ApiSettings,
        job_id: str,
        *,
        timeout: float = 30.0,
        retries: int = 3,
        page_size: int = 200,
        opener: Callable[..., Any] = urllib.request.urlopen,
        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
    ) -> None:
        self._base = f"{settings.url}/api/v1"
        self._token = settings.token
        self._job_id = job_id
        self._timeout = timeout
        self._retries = max(1, retries)
        self._page_size = page_size
        self._open = opener
        self._sleep = sleep

    # --- port --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def update_job(
        self,
        job_id: str,
        status: str,
        message: str | None = None,
        result: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if status not in JOB_STATUSES:
            raise ValueError(f"status must be one of {JOB_STATUSES}")
        body: dict[str, Any] = {"status": status}
        if message is not None:
            body["message"] = message
        if result is not None:
            body["result"] = result
        self._call("PATCH", f"/jobs/{job_id}", body=body, retry=True)

    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._call("GET", f"/snapshots/{snapshot_id}", retry=True)

    def get_snapshot_files(self, snapshot_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._call("GET", f"/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/files", retry=True)

    def register_artifact(self, job_id: str, kind: str, s3_prefix: str, contains_raw: bool) -> None:
        body = {"kind": kind, "s3_prefix": s3_prefix, "contains_raw": contains_raw}
        try:  # idempotent per (snapshot, prefix), so a retry is safe
            self._call("POST", f"/jobs/{job_id}/artifacts", body=body, retry=True)
        except ApiError as exc:
            if exc.status == 409:
                raise ArtifactInvalidated(str(exc)) from None
            raise

    def iter_snapshot_sessions(self, snapshot_id: str) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
        cursor: str | None = None
        while True:
            query = {"exclude_erased": "true", "limit": str(self._page_size)}
            if cursor:
                query["cursor"] = cursor
            page = self._call("GET", f"/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/sessions", query=query, retry=True)
            yield from page.get("items", [])
            cursor = page.get("next_cursor")
            if not cursor:
                return

    def register_model(self, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        # Not retried: a repeated POST after a lost response would be a 409 duplicate.
        return self._call("POST", "/models", body=payload, retry=False)

    # --- transport ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _call(
        self,
        method: str,
        path: str,
        *,
        query: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        body: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        retry: bool,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        url = self._base + path + (f"?{urllib.parse.urlencode(query)}" if query else "")
        data = None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode()
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self._token}",
            "X-Corvus-Job-Id": self._job_id,
            "Accept": "application/json",
        }
        if data is not None:
            headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
        attempts = self._retries if retry else 1
        for attempt in range(1, attempts + 1):
            request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method, headers=headers)
            try:
                with self._open(request, timeout=self._timeout) as response:
                    raw = response.read()
                return json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
                transient = exc.code in (429, 500, 502, 503, 504)
                if not transient or attempt == attempts:
                    raise ApiError(
                        f"{method} {path} failed with HTTP {exc.code}{_problem(exc)}", exc.code
                    ) from None
            except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, ConnectionError) as exc:
                if attempt == attempts:
                    raise ApiError(f"{method} {path} failed: {type(exc).__name__}") from None
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                raise ApiError(f"{method} {path} returned invalid JSON") from None
            log.warning("%s %s failed, retrying (%d/%d)", method, path, attempt, attempts)
            self._sleep(min(2.0 ** (attempt - 1), 10.0))
        raise AssertionError("unreachable")


def _problem(exc: urllib.error.HTTPError) -> str:
    """The ``title`` / ``detail`` of an RFC 9457 problem response, if there is one."""
    try:
        problem = json.loads(exc.read())
        text = " - ".join(str(problem[k]) for k in ("title", "detail") if problem.get(k))
    except (ValueError, OSError, AttributeError, TypeError):
        return ""
    return f": {text[:300]}" if text else ""

```

`ml/src/corvus_ml/jobs/artifacts.py`:

```py
"""Registering what a job wrote, and the ``needs_rebuild`` guard.

A prefix is registered right after it was written, so that erasure and the raw retention can find
and delete it. ``409`` means an erasure invalidated raw-derived artefacts after the job started:
the prefix is deleted again and the job fails, so that nothing derived from erased data stays.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any

from corvus_ml.jobs.api import ArtifactInvalidated
from corvus_ml.jobs.context import JobContext
from corvus_ml.jobs.lifecycle import JobEnv, JobError

log = logging.getLogger("corvus.job.artifacts")


def register_prefix(
    ctx: JobContext, env: JobEnv, kind: str, prefix: str, *, contains_raw: bool
) -> None:
    """Register ``prefix`` (an object key prefix, with or without ``/``) of this job."""
    s3_prefix = prefix.rstrip("/") + "/"
    try:
        env.api.register_artifact(ctx.job_id, kind, s3_prefix, contains_raw)
    except ArtifactInvalidated:
        env.store.delete_prefix(s3_prefix.rstrip("/"))
        raise JobError(
            "an erasure invalidated the raw-derived artefacts of this snapshot while the job "
            f"ran; {s3_prefix} was deleted. Start a new job to rebuild"
        ) from None


def check_needs_rebuild(snapshot: dict[str, Any], *, strict: bool) -> None:
    """``needs_rebuild``: erasure deleted raw-derived artefacts of the snapshot.

    Building anew is usually what the caller wants, so this only logs; with ``strict`` it refuses.
    """
    if not snapshot.get("needs_rebuild"):
        return
    if strict:
        raise JobError("the snapshot needs a rebuild (erasure removed derived artefacts); refused")
    log.warning("the snapshot is flagged needs_rebuild; building anyway (set strict to refuse)")

```

`ml/src/corvus_ml/jobs/cli.py`:

```py
"""``corvus-job <build_features|evaluate|train>``: entry point of the control plane's jobs."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import logging
import os
import signal
import sys
import tempfile
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
from pathlib import Path

from corvus_ml.jobs import features_job, model_jobs
from corvus_ml.jobs.api import HttpApiClient, JobApi
from corvus_ml.jobs.context import (
    JOB_TYPES,
    ApiSettings,
    ContractError,
    JobContext,
    S3Settings,
    Secrets,
)
from corvus_ml.jobs.lifecycle import Handler, JobEnv, JobTerminated, run_job
from corvus_ml.jobs.params import ParamError
from corvus_ml.jobs.storage import ObjectStore, s3_store

HANDLERS: dict[str, Handler] = {
    "build_features": features_job.build_features,
    "evaluate": model_jobs.evaluate,
    "train": model_jobs.train,
}

log = logging.getLogger("corvus.job")


def _on_sigterm(signum: int, frame: object) -> None:
    raise JobTerminated("terminated")


def main(
    argv: list[str] | None = None,
    environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
    *,
    api_factory: Callable[[ApiSettings, str], JobApi] = HttpApiClient,
    store_factory: Callable[[S3Settings], ObjectStore] = s3_store,
) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="corvus-job", description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("job_type", nargs="?", choices=JOB_TYPES, help="default: CORVUS_JOB_TYPE")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    env = os.environ if environ is None else environ
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(name)s %(message)s")
    secrets = Secrets.from_env(env)
    try:
        ctx = JobContext.from_env(env, args.job_type)
        api_settings = ApiSettings.from_env(env)
    except ContractError as exc:
        print(f"corvus-job: {secrets.scrub(str(exc))}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    api = api_factory(api_settings, ctx.job_id)
    scratch_root = env.get("CORVUS_JOB_SCRATCH_DIR") or None
    previous = signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _on_sigterm)
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="corvus-job-", dir=scratch_root) as tmp:
            job_env = JobEnv(
                api=api,
                store=store_factory(S3Settings.from_env(env)),
                scratch=Path(tmp),
                secrets=secrets,
            )
            return run_job(ctx, job_env, _checked(HANDLERS[ctx.job_type]))
    finally:
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, previous)


def _checked(handler: Handler) -> Handler:
    """Turn parameter errors into plain failures with their message."""

    def run(ctx: JobContext, env: JobEnv):
        try:
            return handler(ctx, env)
        except ParamError as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"invalid params: {exc}") from None

    return run


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```

`ml/src/corvus_ml/jobs/context.py`:

```py
"""The job contract: environment and secrets as the control plane's runners provide them.

The runner passes the job type as the command argument and ``CORVUS_JOB_ID``,
``CORVUS_JOB_TYPE``, ``CORVUS_JOB_SNAPSHOT_ID`` and ``CORVUS_JOB_PARAMS`` (a JSON object) in the
environment. Credentials for the API and for S3 come from the environment as well; the values are
collected in :class:`Secrets` so that no message, log line or error text can carry them.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from uuid import UUID

JOB_TYPES = ("build_features", "evaluate", "train")
MAX_MESSAGE = 500


class ContractError(ValueError):
    """The environment does not satisfy the job contract."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class JobContext:
    job_id: str
    job_type: str
    snapshot_id: str
    params: dict

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls, environ: Mapping[str, str], job_type: str | None = None) -> JobContext:
        """Read the contract; ``job_type`` is the command-line argument (checked against env)."""
        env_type = environ.get("CORVUS_JOB_TYPE")
        chosen = job_type or env_type
        if chosen not in JOB_TYPES:
            raise ContractError(f"job type must be one of {JOB_TYPES}")
        if env_type and env_type != chosen:
            raise ContractError("job type argument and CORVUS_JOB_TYPE disagree")
        raw_params = environ.get("CORVUS_JOB_PARAMS") or "{}"
        try:
            params = json.loads(raw_params)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            raise ContractError(f"CORVUS_JOB_PARAMS is not valid JSON: {exc.msg}") from None
        if not isinstance(params, dict):
            raise ContractError("CORVUS_JOB_PARAMS must be a JSON object")
        return cls(
            job_id=_uuid(environ, "CORVUS_JOB_ID"),
            job_type=chosen,
            snapshot_id=_uuid(environ, "CORVUS_JOB_SNAPSHOT_ID"),
            params=params,
        )


def _uuid(environ: Mapping[str, str], name: str) -> str:
    value = environ.get(name, "")
    try:
        return str(UUID(value))
    except ValueError:
        raise ContractError(f"{name} must be a UUID") from None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ApiSettings:
    url: str
    token: str = field(repr=False)

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls, environ: Mapping[str, str]) -> ApiSettings:
        url, token = environ.get("CORVUS_API_URL", ""), environ.get("CORVUS_API_TOKEN", "")
        if not url or not token:
            raise ContractError("CORVUS_API_URL and CORVUS_API_TOKEN are required")
        return cls(url.rstrip("/"), token)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class S3Settings:
    """Same variable names as the services (``corvus_services.config``)."""

    endpoint_url: str | None
    access_key: str | None = field(repr=False)
    secret_key: str | None = field(repr=False)
    bucket: str = "corvus-lake"
    region: str = "us-east-1"

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls, environ: Mapping[str, str]) -> S3Settings:
        return cls(
            endpoint_url=environ.get("CORVUS_S3_ENDPOINT_URL") or None,
            access_key=environ.get("CORVUS_S3_ACCESS_KEY") or None,
            secret_key=environ.get("CORVUS_S3_SECRET_KEY") or None,
            bucket=environ.get("CORVUS_S3_BUCKET") or "corvus-lake",
            region=environ.get("CORVUS_S3_REGION") or "us-east-1",
        )


class Secrets:
    """Scrubs known secret values and bearer tokens from text before it leaves the process."""

    _BEARER = re.compile(r"(?i)\bbearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+")

    def __init__(self, *values: str | None) -> None:
        # Longest first so that a secret containing another one is replaced as a whole.
        self._values = sorted({v for v in values if v and len(v) >= 4}, key=len, reverse=True)

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls, environ: Mapping[str, str]) -> Secrets:
        return cls(
            environ.get("CORVUS_API_TOKEN"),
            environ.get("CORVUS_S3_SECRET_KEY"),
            environ.get("CORVUS_S3_ACCESS_KEY"),
            environ.get("CORVUS_KEK"),
            environ.get("CORVUS_PG_DSN"),
            environ.get("PGPASSWORD"),
        )

    def scrub(self, text: str, limit: int = MAX_MESSAGE) -> str:
        for value in self._values:
            text = text.replace(value, "***")
        text = self._BEARER.sub("Bearer ***", text)
        return text if len(text) <= limit else text[: limit - 3] + "..."

```

`ml/src/corvus_ml/jobs/features_job.py`:

```py
"""``build_features``: windows and tokens of a snapshot, written to ``features/<snapshot_id>/``.

Inputs: the snapshot's ``events`` files (from the manifest) and its sessions with segments
(``game_context``), pseudonyms and labels (from the API). Sessions of erased players are never
read. The build is bounded in memory (a few sessions per task, Arrow batches) and uses at most the
CPUs of the cgroup limit.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.parquet as pq

from corvus_ml.cgroup import default_workers
from corvus_ml.features.config import DEFAULT_DT_EDGES_MS, FeatureConfig
from corvus_ml.features.pipeline import build
from corvus_ml.features.reader import EventFiles
from corvus_ml.features.schema import SESSION_ID_TYPE
from corvus_ml.features.segments import SegmentMap
from corvus_ml.jobs import layout
from corvus_ml.jobs.artifacts import check_needs_rebuild, register_prefix
from corvus_ml.jobs.context import JobContext
from corvus_ml.jobs.lifecycle import JobEnv, JobError, JobOutcome
from corvus_ml.jobs.params import Params

log = logging.getLogger("corvus.job.features")

_TS = pa.timestamp("us", tz="UTC")
LABELS_SCHEMA = pa.schema(
    [
        ("session_id", pa.string()),
        ("label", pa.string()),
        ("source", pa.string()),
        ("confidence", pa.float64()),
        ("valid_from", _TS),
        ("valid_to", _TS),
    ]
)
SESSIONS_SCHEMA = pa.schema(
    [("session_id", pa.string()), ("pseudonym", pa.string()), ("started_at", _TS)]
)


def _timestamp(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
    if value in (None, ""):
        return None
    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(str(value).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    return parsed if parsed.tzinfo else parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)


def _protocol(value: Any) -> int | None:
    if value is None or isinstance(value, bool):
        return None
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def _hex_id(value: Any, length: int, what: str) -> str:
    try:
        raw = bytes.fromhex(str(value).removeprefix("\\x").replace("-", ""))
    except ValueError:
        raise JobError(f"the API returned a malformed {what}") from None
    if len(raw) != length:
        raise JobError(f"the API returned a {what} of {len(raw)} bytes, expected {length}")
    return raw.hex()


class Selection:
    """Sessions of the snapshot that are used: segments, sessions table and labels table."""

    def __init__(self, contexts: list[str] | None) -> None:
        self._contexts = set(contexts) if contexts else None
        self.segments: list[tuple[bytes, int, str]] = []
        self.sessions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.labels: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.erased_skipped = 0
        self.outside_snapshot = 0

    def add(self, item: dict[str, Any], allowed: set[str] | None) -> None:
        if item.get("erased"):  # the API filters already; never rely on that alone
            self.erased_skipped += 1
            return
        sid = _hex_id(item.get("session_id"), 16, "session id")
        if allowed is not None and sid not in allowed:
            self.outside_snapshot += 1
            return
        kept = [
            (int(s["segment"]), str(s["game_context"]))
            for s in item.get("segments") or []
            if s.get("game_context")
            and (self._contexts is None or s["game_context"] in self._contexts)
        ]
        if not kept:
            return
        self.segments += [(bytes.fromhex(sid), seg, ctx) for seg, ctx in kept]
        pseudonym = item.get("pseudonym")
        self.sessions.append(
            {
                "session_id": sid,
                "pseudonym": _hex_id(pseudonym, 32, "pseudonym") if pseudonym else None,
                "started_at": _timestamp(item.get("started_at")),
                # Optional in the API response; only the raw-byte build uses it (protocol token).
                "client_protocol": _protocol(item.get("client_protocol")),
            }
        )
        for lab in item.get("labels") or []:
            self.labels.append(
                {
                    "session_id": sid,
                    "label": str(lab["label"]),
                    "source": str(lab.get("source") or ""),
                    "confidence": float(lab.get("confidence", 1.0)),
                    "valid_from": _timestamp(lab.get("valid_from")),
                    "valid_to": _timestamp(lab.get("valid_to")),
                }
            )

    def segment_map(self) -> SegmentMap:
        return SegmentMap.from_table(
            pa.table(
                {
                    "session_id": pa.array([s[0] for s in self.segments], SESSION_ID_TYPE),
                    "segment": pa.array([s[1] for s in self.segments], pa.uint32()),
                    "game_context": pa.array([s[2] for s in self.segments], pa.string()),
                }
            )
        )


def _write_tables(sel: Selection, out: Path) -> None:
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pq.write_table(pa.Table.from_pylist(sel.sessions, SESSIONS_SCHEMA), out / layout.SESSIONS_FILE)
    if sel.labels:
        pq.write_table(pa.Table.from_pylist(sel.labels, LABELS_SCHEMA), out / layout.LABELS_FILE)


KINDS = ("aggregate", "raw_bytes", "train_tokenizer")


def build_features(ctx: JobContext, env: JobEnv) -> JobOutcome:
    kind = Params(ctx.params).string("kind", "aggregate")
    if kind not in KINDS:
        raise JobError(f"kind must be one of {KINDS}")
    if kind != "aggregate":
        from corvus_ml.jobs import raw_job

        return raw_job.build_raw(ctx, env, kind)
    p = Params(ctx.params)
    p.string("kind")
    strict = p.boolean("strict", False)
    contexts = p.game_contexts()
    cfg = FeatureConfig(
        window=p.integer("window", 256, 1, 100_000),
        overlap=p.number("overlap", 0.5, 0.0, 0.99),
        max_duration_s=p.number("max_duration_s", 30.0, 0.001, 86_400.0),
        min_frames=p.integer("min_frames", 16, 1, 100_000),
        dt_edges_ms=tuple(p.numbers("dt_edges_ms", list(DEFAULT_DT_EDGES_MS)) or ()),
    )
    group_size = p.integer("group_size", 4, 1, 1000)
    cap = default_workers()
    workers = min(p.integer("workers", cap, 1, 256), cap)
    p.done()

    snapshot = env.api.get_snapshot(ctx.snapshot_id)
    check_needs_rebuild(snapshot, strict=strict)
    manifest = snapshot.get("manifest") or {}
    keys = [f["key"] for f in (manifest.get("files") or {}).get("events") or []]
    if not keys:
        raise JobError("the snapshot manifest lists no events files")
    allowed = {str(s) for s in manifest["sessions"]} if manifest.get("sessions") else None

    sel = Selection(contexts)
    for item in env.api.iter_snapshot_sessions(ctx.snapshot_id):
        sel.add(item, allowed)
    segmap = sel.segment_map()
    if not segmap.by_session:
        raise JobError("no sessions selected: the snapshot has none in the requested game contexts")
    log.info(
        "snapshot %s: %d sessions, %d event files, %d erased skipped",
        ctx.snapshot_id, len(segmap.by_session), len(keys), sel.erased_skipped,
    )  # fmt: skip

    out = env.scratch / "features"
    events = EventFiles(tuple(env.store.path(k) for k in keys), env.store.filesystem)
    stats = build(events, segmap, out, cfg, workers, group_size)
    _write_tables(sel, out)

    prefix = layout.features_prefix(ctx.snapshot_id)
    result = {
        "features_prefix": prefix,
        "sessions": sum(s.sessions for s in stats),
        "frames": sum(s.frames for s in stats),
        "windows": sum(s.windows for s in stats),
        "event_files": len(keys),
        "labels": len(sel.labels),
        "game_contexts": sorted({s[2] for s in sel.segments}),
        "erased_sessions_skipped": sel.erased_skipped,
        "workers": workers,
    }
    # Replace an earlier build completely (fewer groups would leave stale parts), marker last.
    env.store.delete_prefix(prefix)
    env.store.upload_dir(prefix, out)
    env.store.put_bytes(
        f"{prefix}/{layout.BUILD_FILE}",
        json.dumps({**result, "job_id": ctx.job_id, "built_at": env.clock().isoformat()}).encode(),
    )
    for name, kind_name in (("windows", "window_features"), ("window_tokens", "window_tokens")):
        if env.store.list_keys(f"{prefix}/{name}"):
            register_prefix(ctx, env, kind_name, f"{prefix}/{name}", contains_raw=False)
    return JobOutcome(
        f"built {result['windows']} windows from {result['sessions']} sessions", result
    )

```

`ml/src/corvus_ml/jobs/layout.py`:

```py
"""Object keys of the artefacts the jobs write (relative to the lake bucket)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re

FEATURES_ROOT = "features"
MODELS_ROOT = "models"
REPORTS_ROOT = "reports"

SESSIONS_FILE = "sessions.parquet"
LABELS_FILE = "labels.parquet"
BUILD_FILE = "build.json"  # written last: its presence marks a complete feature build

MODEL_FILE = "model.onnx"
CALIBRATION_FILE = "calibration.json"
MODEL_CARD_FILE = "model_card.json"
EVALUATION_FILE = "evaluation.json"

_UNSAFE = re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+")


def features_prefix(snapshot_id: str) -> str:
    return f"{FEATURES_ROOT}/{snapshot_id}"


def reports_prefix(snapshot_id: str, job_id: str) -> str:
    return f"{REPORTS_ROOT}/{snapshot_id}/{job_id}"


def model_prefix(name: str, version: str) -> str:
    return f"{MODELS_ROOT}/{name}/{version}"


def safe_name(text: str) -> str:
    """A name usable as a path segment and registry name."""
    return _UNSAFE.sub("_", text).strip("._-") or "model"
```

`ml/src/corvus_ml/jobs/lifecycle.py`:

```py
"""Job lifecycle: ``running`` -> ``succeeded`` | ``failed``, reported to the control plane.

Whatever the handler does, the final status is reported exactly once and its message passes
through :class:`~corvus_ml.jobs.context.Secrets`, so credentials never reach the API or the logs.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import math
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from corvus_ml.jobs.api import ApiError, JobApi
from corvus_ml.jobs.context import JobContext, Secrets
from corvus_ml.jobs.storage import ObjectStore

log = logging.getLogger("corvus.job")


class JobError(RuntimeError):
    """A failure with a message that is safe and useful to show in the UI."""


class JobTerminated(RuntimeError):  # noqa: N818 - reads better than JobTerminatedError
    """The process was asked to stop (SIGTERM, e.g. the Kubernetes deadline)."""


def json_safe(value: Any) -> Any:
    """Recursively drop non-finite floats (JSON has no NaN) and convert numpy scalars."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): json_safe(v) for k, v in value.items() if json_safe(v) is not None}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [json_safe(v) for v in value]
    if hasattr(value, "item") and not isinstance(value, (str, bytes)):
        value = value.item()
    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
        return None
    return value


@dataclass
class JobEnv:
    """Collaborators of a running job; everything the handlers touch is injected."""

    api: JobApi
    store: ObjectStore
    scratch: Path
    secrets: Secrets
    clock: Callable[[], datetime] = lambda: datetime.now(UTC)
    # Source of the player DEKs for raw-byte jobs (``corvus_ml.raw.keys.DekProvider``); None =
    # read ``corvus.player_keys`` with CORVUS_PG_DSN and unwrap with CORVUS_KEK.
    deks: Any = None


@dataclass
class JobOutcome:
    message: str
    result: dict[str, Any]


Handler = Callable[[JobContext, JobEnv], JobOutcome]


def run_job(ctx: JobContext, env: JobEnv, handler: Handler) -> int:
    """Run ``handler`` and report the lifecycle. Exit code: 0 succeeded, 1 failed."""
    try:
        env.api.update_job(ctx.job_id, "running", message=f"{ctx.job_type} started")
    except ApiError as exc:
        log.error("cannot report the job as running: %s", env.secrets.scrub(str(exc)))
        return 2
    try:
        outcome = handler(ctx, env)
    except JobTerminated:
        return _fail(ctx, env, "terminated before it finished")
    except Exception as exc:  # report every failure; the process exit code carries it too
        return _fail(ctx, env, _describe(exc))
    try:
        env.api.update_job(
            ctx.job_id,
            "succeeded",
            message=env.secrets.scrub(outcome.message),
            result=json_safe(outcome.result),
        )
    except ApiError as exc:
        log.error("cannot report success: %s", env.secrets.scrub(str(exc)))
        return 2
    log.info("job %s succeeded: %s", ctx.job_id, env.secrets.scrub(outcome.message))
    return 0


def _describe(exc: Exception) -> str:
    # Messages of our own errors are written for the UI; anything else gets its type name.
    if isinstance(exc, (JobError, ValueError, ApiError)):
        return str(exc) or type(exc).__name__
    return f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"


def _fail(ctx: JobContext, env: JobEnv, text: str) -> int:
    message = env.secrets.scrub(text)
    log.error("job %s failed: %s", ctx.job_id, message)
    try:
        env.api.update_job(ctx.job_id, "failed", message=message)
    except ApiError as exc:
        log.error("cannot report the failure: %s", env.secrets.scrub(str(exc)))
    return 1

```

`ml/src/corvus_ml/jobs/model_jobs.py`:

```py
"""``evaluate`` and ``train``: run the evaluation harness on a snapshot's feature build.

``evaluate`` writes the reports to ``reports/<snapshot_id>/<job_id>/``. ``train`` does the same and
then, per game context, takes the best candidate, uploads its calibrated ONNX graph, the
``feature_spec.json``, ``calibration.json`` and ``model_card.json`` to
``models/<name>/<version>/`` and registers the model (stage ``registered``) with the metrics the
quality gate reads.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import json
import logging
import math
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.compute as pc
import pyarrow.parquet as pq

from corvus_ml.features.spec import SPEC_FILE, FeatureSpec
from corvus_ml.jobs import layout
from corvus_ml.jobs.context import JobContext
from corvus_ml.jobs.lifecycle import JobEnv, JobError, JobOutcome, json_safe
from corvus_ml.jobs.params import Params

log = logging.getLogger("corvus.job.model")

DEFAULT_CANDIDATES = ("isolation_forest", "gradient_boosting")
DEFAULT_SELECT_BY = "recall@fpr0.1pct"
DEFAULT_DOMAIN = "general"
# Registered with a candidate type of its own: the graph has the single output ``score`` and is
# already calibrated, unlike the raw sklearn graphs the scorer special-cases by candidate type.
CANDIDATE_TYPE_SUFFIX = "_calibrated"


def metric_key(name: str) -> str:
    """Harness name -> gate name: ``recall@fpr0.1pct`` becomes ``recall_at_fpr_0_1pct``."""
    return name.replace("@fpr", "_at_fpr_").replace(".", "_")


def registry_metrics(candidate: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The metrics registered with a model, named like the quality gate expects them."""
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    renames = {"n_windows": "test_windows", "n_cheat_windows": "test_cheat_windows"}
    for key, value in (candidate.get("test") or {}).items():
        out[renames.get(key, metric_key(key))] = value
    bench = candidate.get("bench") or {}
    for key, name in (
        ("latency_p50_ms", "p50_latency_ms"),
        ("latency_p99_ms", "p99_latency_ms"),
        ("latency_mean_ms", "mean_latency_ms"),
        ("batch_throughput_wps", "batch_throughput_wps"),
        ("peak_rss_mb", "peak_rss_mb"),
        ("file_size_kb", "model_size_kb"),
    ):
        if key in bench:
            out[name] = bench[key]
    out["n_params"] = candidate.get("n_params")
    out["fit_seconds"] = candidate.get("fit_seconds")
    return json_safe(out)


def choose_candidate(candidates: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], select_by: str) -> str | None:
    """Best usable candidate: highest ``select_by`` on test, ties by lower p99 latency."""

    def sort_key(item: tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[float, float]:
        _, c = item
        metric = (c.get("test") or {}).get(select_by)
        metric = -math.inf if metric is None or math.isnan(metric) else float(metric)
        p99 = (c.get("bench") or {}).get("latency_p99_ms")
        return metric, -(p99 if p99 is not None else math.inf)

    usable = [
        (n, c)
        for n, c in candidates.items()
        if c.get("status") == "ok" and (c.get("onnx") or {}).get("parity_ok")
    ]
    return max(usable, key=sort_key)[0] if usable else None


RAW_WINDOW_KEYS = ("window_seconds", "stride_seconds", "max_packets", "overflow", "min_packets")


def _candidate_names(params: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    raw = params.get("candidates", list(DEFAULT_CANDIDATES))
    if isinstance(raw, list):
        return [n for n in raw if isinstance(n, str)]
    return [str(n) for n in raw] if isinstance(raw, dict) else []


def wants_raw(params: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """True if the requested candidates read raw packet bytes (they need the ``raw/`` build)."""
    from corvus_ml.eval import candidates as cand_pkg

    kinds = {
        cand_pkg.REGISTRY[n].input_kind == "raw_bytes"
        for n in _candidate_names(params)
        if n in cand_pkg.REGISTRY
    }
    if len(kinds) > 1:
        raise JobError("raw-byte candidates need their own job: do not mix them with others")
    return kinds == {True}


def _tune_params(p: Params) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """``tune``: false / absent = off, true = defaults, an object = ``[tune]`` settings."""
    raw = p.raw("tune", False)
    if raw is False or raw is None:
        return None
    if raw is True:
        return {}
    if isinstance(raw, dict):
        return dict(raw)
    raise JobError("tune must be true, false or an object")


def _read_params(
    ctx: JobContext, spec: FeatureSpec, train: bool, raw_mode: bool = False
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from corvus_ml.eval.config import BenchConfig

    p = Params(ctx.params)
    raw = p.raw("candidates", list(DEFAULT_CANDIDATES))
    if isinstance(raw, list) and all(isinstance(n, str) for n in raw):
        candidates = {n: {} for n in raw}
    elif isinstance(raw, dict) and all(isinstance(v, dict) for v in raw.values()):
        candidates = {str(n): dict(v) for n, v in raw.items()}
    else:
        raise JobError("candidates must be a list of names or an object name -> parameters")
    if not candidates:
        raise JobError("candidates must not be empty")
    bench_raw = p.mapping("benchmark")
    known = {f.name for f in dataclasses.fields(BenchConfig)}
    if set(bench_raw) - known:
        raise JobError(f"unknown benchmark keys: {sorted(set(bench_raw) - known)}")
    out: dict[str, Any] = {
        "candidates": candidates,
        "contexts": p.game_contexts() or [],
        "unlabelled": p.string("unlabelled", "exclude"),
        "label_sources": p.strings("label_sources"),
        "min_confidence": p.number("min_confidence", 0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
        "seed": p.integer("seed", 1337, 0, 2**31 - 1),
        "threads": p.integer("threads", 1, 1, 8),
        "seq_len": p.integer("seq_len", spec.seq_len, 1, 100_000),
        "split": tuple(p.numbers("split", [0.6, 0.2, 0.2]) or ()),
        "fpr_targets": tuple(p.numbers("fpr_targets", [0.01, 0.001]) or ()),
        "learning_curve": tuple(p.numbers("learning_curve", []) or ()),
        "calibration": p.string("calibration", "auto"),
        "select_by": p.string("select_by", DEFAULT_SELECT_BY),
        "benchmark": BenchConfig(**bench_raw),
        "tune": _tune_params(p),
    }
    if raw_mode:
        macro = p.raw("macro_window_seconds")
        if macro is not None and (isinstance(macro, bool) or not isinstance(macro, (int, float))):
            raise JobError("macro_window_seconds must be a number")
        window: dict[str, Any] = {}  # only what the job sets overrides the build's window
        if p.has("window_seconds"):
            window["window_seconds"] = p.number("window_seconds", 10.0, 0.01, 86_400.0)
        if p.has("stride_seconds"):
            window["stride_seconds"] = p.number("stride_seconds", 5.0, 0.01, 86_400.0)
        if p.has("max_packets"):
            window["max_packets"] = p.integer("max_packets", 1024, 1, 100_000)
        if p.has("overflow"):
            window["overflow"] = p.string("overflow", "recent")
        if p.has("min_packets"):
            window["min_packets"] = p.integer("min_packets", 8, 1, 100_000)
        if macro is not None:
            window["macro_window_seconds"] = float(macro)
        out["raw_window"] = window
        out["max_windows"] = p.integer("max_windows", 200_000, 1, 10_000_000)
    if train:
        out["model_name"] = p.string("model_name")
        out["version"] = p.string("version")
        out["domain"] = p.string("domain", DEFAULT_DOMAIN)
    p.done()
    if out["unlabelled"] not in ("exclude", "assume_legit"):
        raise JobError("unlabelled must be 'exclude' or 'assume_legit'")
    if out["calibration"] == "none":
        raise JobError("jobs always calibrate: calibration 'none' is only for corvus-eval")
    if len(out["split"]) != 3 or abs(sum(out["split"]) - 1.0) > 1e-6:
        raise JobError("split must be three fractions that add up to 1")
    return out


def _filtered_labels(path: Path, sources: list[str] | None, min_confidence: float) -> Path | None:
    """Labels restricted to the requested sources and confidence; None if nothing remains."""
    if not path.is_file():
        return None
    table = pq.read_table(path)
    mask = pc.greater_equal(table["confidence"], pa.scalar(min_confidence))
    if sources:
        mask = pc.and_(mask, pc.is_in(table["source"], pa.array(sources, pa.string())))
    table = table.filter(mask)
    if table.num_rows == 0:
        return None
    target = path.with_name("labels.selected.parquet")
    pq.write_table(table, target)
    return target


def _tune_config(raw: dict[str, Any] | None):
    from corvus_ml.eval.config import TuneConfig

    if raw is None:
        return TuneConfig()
    known = {f.name for f in dataclasses.fields(TuneConfig)}
    if set(raw) - known:
        raise JobError(f"unknown tune keys: {sorted(set(raw) - known)}")
    return TuneConfig(**raw)


def _eval_config(
    ctx: JobContext, opts: dict[str, Any], features: Path, labels: Path | None, raw_mode=False
):
    from corvus_ml.eval.config import EvalConfig, RawEvalConfig

    if raw_mode:
        window = dict(opts["raw_window"])
        return EvalConfig(
            name=f"job-{ctx.job_id[:8]}",
            seed=opts["seed"],
            threads=opts["threads"],
            seq_len=opts["seq_len"],
            unlabelled=opts["unlabelled"],
            calibration=opts["calibration"],
            contexts=opts["contexts"],
            split=opts["split"],
            fpr_targets=opts["fpr_targets"],
            min_confidence=opts["min_confidence"],
            learning_curve=opts["learning_curve"],
            labels=labels,
            raw=RawEvalConfig(
                dir=features, window_overrides=window, max_windows=opts["max_windows"]
            ),
            candidates=opts["candidates"],
            bench=opts["benchmark"],
            tune=_tune_config(opts["tune"]),
        )
    tokens = features / "window_tokens"
    return EvalConfig(
        name=f"job-{ctx.job_id[:8]}",
        seed=opts["seed"],
        threads=opts["threads"],
        seq_len=opts["seq_len"],
        unlabelled=opts["unlabelled"],
        calibration=opts["calibration"],
        contexts=opts["contexts"],
        split=opts["split"],
        fpr_targets=opts["fpr_targets"],
        min_confidence=opts["min_confidence"],
        learning_curve=opts["learning_curve"],
        windows=features / "windows",
        tokens=tokens if tokens.is_dir() else None,
        sessions=features / layout.SESSIONS_FILE,
        labels=labels,
        candidates=opts["candidates"],
        bench=opts["benchmark"],
        tune=_tune_config(opts["tune"]),
    )


def _summary(info: dict[str, Any], chosen: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tuned = {
        name: {k: t[k] for k in ("n_trials", "n_complete", "n_pruned", "best_value", "best_params")}
        for name, t in (info.get("tune") or {}).items()
    }
    return {
        **({"tune": tuned} if tuned else {}),
        "chosen": chosen,
        "windows": info["windows"],
        "players": info["players"],
        "candidates": {
            name: (
                {"status": "ok", **registry_metrics(c)}
                if c["status"] == "ok"
                else {"status": c["status"], "reason": c.get("reason")}
            )
            for name, c in info["candidates"].items()
        },
    }


def _evaluate_and_maybe_train(ctx: JobContext, env: JobEnv, train: bool) -> JobOutcome:
    try:
        from corvus_ml.eval import candidates as cand_pkg
        from corvus_ml.eval.report import write_report
        from corvus_ml.eval.runner import run
    except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
        raise JobError(f"the eval dependencies are missing from this image: {exc.name}") from None

    raw_mode = wants_raw(ctx.params)
    prefix = layout.features_prefix(ctx.snapshot_id)
    if raw_mode:
        prefix = f"{prefix}/raw"
    if not env.store.exists(f"{prefix}/{layout.BUILD_FILE}"):
        kind = ' with kind "raw_bytes"' if raw_mode else ""
        raise JobError(
            f"no complete feature build for this snapshot: run build_features{kind} first"
        )

    spec_bytes = env.store.get_bytes(f"{prefix}/{SPEC_FILE}")
    features = env.scratch / "features"
    features.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (features / SPEC_FILE).write_bytes(spec_bytes)
    opts = _read_params(ctx, FeatureSpec.read(features / SPEC_FILE), train, raw_mode)
    unknown = sorted(set(opts["candidates"]) - set(cand_pkg.REGISTRY))
    if unknown:
        raise JobError(f"unknown candidates {unknown}; known: {sorted(cand_pkg.REGISTRY)}")
    need_seq = any(cand_pkg.REGISTRY[n].input_kind == "seq" for n in opts["candidates"])
    env.store.download_dir(
        prefix, features, skip=lambda rel: rel.startswith("window_tokens/") and not need_seq
    )
    if raw_mode:
        FeatureSpec.load(features / SPEC_FILE, require_tokenizer=True)  # hash of tokenizer.json
    labels = _filtered_labels(
        features / layout.LABELS_FILE, opts["label_sources"], opts["min_confidence"]
    )

    cfg = _eval_config(ctx, opts, features, labels, raw_mode)
    out = env.scratch / "eval"
    report = run(cfg, out, tune=opts["tune"] is not None)
    if not report["contexts"]:
        raise JobError("no windows in the requested game contexts")
    json_path, md_path = write_report(report, out)
    report_prefix = layout.reports_prefix(ctx.snapshot_id, ctx.job_id)
    env.store.put_file(f"{report_prefix}/report.json", json_path)
    env.store.put_file(f"{report_prefix}/report.md", md_path)

    chosen = {
        c: choose_candidate(info["candidates"], opts["select_by"])
        for c, info in report["contexts"].items()
    }
    result: dict[str, Any] = {
        "report_prefix": report_prefix,
        "features_prefix": prefix,
        "calibration": opts["calibration"],
        "select_by": opts["select_by"],
        "contexts": {c: _summary(i, chosen[c]) for c, i in report["contexts"].items()},
    }
    if not train:
        names = ", ".join(f"{c}: {n or 'none'}" for c, n in chosen.items())
        return JobOutcome(
            f"evaluated {len(report['contexts'])} game context(s); best {names}", result
        )

    models = []
    for context, name in chosen.items():
        if name is None:
            log.warning("context %s: no usable candidate, nothing registered", context)
            continue
        models.append(
            _publish(
                ctx, env, opts, context, name, report["contexts"][context], out / "onnx" / context
            )
        )
    if not models:
        raise JobError("no candidate produced a usable model in any game context")
    result["models"] = models
    return JobOutcome(
        "registered " + ", ".join(f"{m['name']} {m['version']}" for m in models), json_safe(result)
    )


def _publish(
    ctx: JobContext,
    env: JobEnv,
    opts: dict[str, Any],
    context: str,
    candidate: str,
    info: dict[str, Any],
    onnx_dir: Path,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from corvus_ml.eval import candidates as cand_pkg

    res = info["candidates"][candidate]
    cls = cand_pkg.REGISTRY[candidate]
    name = layout.safe_name(f"{opts.get('model_name') or candidate}-{context}")
    version = layout.safe_name(opts.get("version") or f"{ctx.snapshot_id[:8]}-{ctx.job_id[:8]}")
    prefix = layout.model_prefix(name, version)
    metrics = registry_metrics(res)
    calibration = json.loads((onnx_dir / f"{candidate}.calibration.json").read_text())

    meaning = (
        "calibrated estimate of P(cheating | window), fitted on the validation split"
        if cls.supervised
        else "share of legit validation windows with a lower raw score (empirical CDF): "
        "0.99 means higher than 99 % of legit windows"
    )
    card = json_safe(
        {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "name": name,
            "version": version,
            "candidate": candidate,
            "candidate_type": candidate + CANDIDATE_TYPE_SUFFIX,
            "game_context": context,
            "domain": opts["domain"],
            "snapshot_id": ctx.snapshot_id,
            "job_id": ctx.job_id,
            "created_at": env.clock().isoformat(),
            "input": cls.input_kind,
            "input_kind": cls.input_kind,
            "feature_spec": SPEC_FILE,
            **_raw_card(onnx_dir, info),
            "calibration": {
                k: calibration[k] for k in ("method", "kind", "n_fit", "fit_on") if k in calibration
            },
            "output_semantics": {
                "onnx_output": "score",
                "dtype": "float32",
                "range": [0.0, 1.0],
                "higher_means": "more likely cheating",
                "calibrated": True,
                "meaning": meaning,
                "post_processing": "none: the graph output is final, do not rescale or clip-map it",
            },
            "metrics": metrics,
        }
    )
    uploads = {
        "model.onnx": onnx_dir / f"{candidate}.onnx",
        SPEC_FILE: onnx_dir / SPEC_FILE,
        layout.CALIBRATION_FILE: onnx_dir / f"{candidate}.calibration.json",
    }
    if cls.input_kind == "raw_bytes":
        uploads["tokenizer.json"] = onnx_dir / "tokenizer.json"
    for target, source in uploads.items():
        env.store.put_file(f"{prefix}/{target}", source)
    env.store.put_bytes(f"{prefix}/{layout.MODEL_CARD_FILE}", json.dumps(card, indent=2).encode())
    env.store.put_bytes(
        f"{prefix}/{layout.EVALUATION_FILE}", json.dumps(json_safe(res), indent=2).encode()
    )

    onnx_key = f"{prefix}/{layout.MODEL_FILE}"
    registered = env.api.register_model(
        {
            "name": name,
            "version": version,
            "candidate_type": card["candidate_type"],
            "game_context": context,
            "domain": opts["domain"],
            "snapshot_id": ctx.snapshot_id,
            "metrics": metrics,
            "onnx_key": onnx_key,
        }
    )
    return {
        "id": registered.get("id"),
        "name": name,
        "version": version,
        "game_context": context,
        "candidate": candidate,
        "onnx_key": onnx_key,
    }


def _raw_card(onnx_dir: Path, info: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """``model_card.json`` fields of a raw-byte model: tokenizer hash and window configuration."""
    spec = FeatureSpec.read(onnx_dir / SPEC_FILE).raw_bytes
    if spec is None:
        return {}
    return {
        "tokenizer": {"file": spec.tokenizer_file, "sha256": spec.tokenizer_sha256},
        "window": spec.window.__dict__,
        "packet": spec.packet.__dict__,
        "scorer_contract": "docs/reference/raw-byte-tokenizer.md",
    }


def evaluate(ctx: JobContext, env: JobEnv) -> JobOutcome:
    return _evaluate_and_maybe_train(ctx, env, train=False)


def train(ctx: JobContext, env: JobEnv) -> JobOutcome:
    return _evaluate_and_maybe_train(ctx, env, train=True)

```

`ml/src/corvus_ml/jobs/params.py`:

```py
"""Strict reading of the free-form ``CORVUS_JOB_PARAMS`` object."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


class ParamError(ValueError):
    """A job parameter is unknown or has the wrong type or range."""


class Params:
    """Typed accessors over the params dict; ``done()`` rejects keys nobody asked for."""

    def __init__(self, raw: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self._raw = dict(raw)
        self._seen: set[str] = set()

    def has(self, name: str) -> bool:
        return name in self._raw

    def raw(self, name: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
        self._seen.add(name)
        return self._raw.get(name, default)

    def string(self, name: str, default: str | None = None) -> str | None:
        value = self.raw(name, default)
        if value is not None and not isinstance(value, str):
            raise ParamError(f"{name} must be a string")
        return value

    def integer(self, name: str, default: int, low: int = 1, high: int = 1_000_000) -> int:
        value = self.raw(name, default)
        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or not low <= value <= high:
            raise ParamError(f"{name} must be an integer in [{low}, {high}]")
        return value

    def number(self, name: str, default: float, low: float, high: float) -> float:
        value = self.raw(name, default)
        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            raise ParamError(f"{name} must be a number")
        if not low <= value <= high:
            raise ParamError(f"{name} must be in [{low}, {high}]")
        return float(value)

    def boolean(self, name: str, default: bool) -> bool:
        value = self.raw(name, default)
        if not isinstance(value, bool):
            raise ParamError(f"{name} must be true or false")
        return value

    def strings(self, name: str, default: list[str] | None = None) -> list[str] | None:
        value = self.raw(name, default)
        if value is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(value, list) or not all(isinstance(v, str) and v for v in value):
            raise ParamError(f"{name} must be a list of non-empty strings")
        return value

    def numbers(self, name: str, default: list[float] | None = None) -> list[float] | None:
        value = self.raw(name, default)
        if value is None:
            return None
        ok = isinstance(value, list) and all(
            isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool) for v in value
        )
        if not ok:
            raise ParamError(f"{name} must be a list of numbers")
        return [float(v) for v in value]

    def mapping(self, name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        value = self.raw(name, {})
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ParamError(f"{name} must be an object")
        return value

    def done(self) -> None:
        extra = sorted(set(self._raw) - self._seen)
        if extra:
            raise ParamError(f"unknown params: {extra}")

    def game_contexts(self) -> list[str] | None:
        """``game_contexts`` (list) or ``game_context`` (one name); None = every context."""
        many, one = self.strings("game_contexts"), self.string("game_context")
        if many and one:
            raise ParamError("use either game_context or game_contexts")
        return many or ([one] if one else None)

```

`ml/src/corvus_ml/jobs/raw_job.py`:

```py
"""``build_features`` with ``kind = raw_bytes`` (and the ``train_tokenizer`` step on its own).

Reads the snapshot's ``events`` and ``raw`` files, decrypts the payloads with the players' DEKs
(sessions of erased players have none and are skipped), trains the byte-level BPE tokenizer on a
sample of the payloads (streaming, bounded memory) and writes the tokenized packet table to
``features/<snapshot_id>/raw/``. Windows are cut from it later, by ``evaluate`` / ``train``.

Needs: read access to ``corvus.player_keys`` (``CORVUS_PG_DSN``, ``PGPASSWORD``) and ``CORVUS_KEK``;
see docs/reference/raw-byte-tokenizer.md.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.parquet as pq

from corvus_ml.features.reader import EventFiles, open_dataset
from corvus_ml.features.spec import SPEC_FILE, FeatureSpec
from corvus_ml.jobs import layout
from corvus_ml.jobs.artifacts import check_needs_rebuild, register_prefix
from corvus_ml.jobs.context import JobContext
from corvus_ml.jobs.lifecycle import JobEnv, JobError, JobOutcome
from corvus_ml.jobs.params import Params
from corvus_ml.raw.layout import DEFAULT_PROTOCOLS, TokenLayout
from corvus_ml.raw.pipeline import tokenize_sessions, train_tokenizer
from corvus_ml.raw.reader import RawReader, ReadStats, SessionInfo
from corvus_ml.raw.spec import TOKENIZER_FILE, PacketConfig, WindowConfig
from corvus_ml.raw.tokenizer import RawTokenizer, TokenizerConfig

log = logging.getLogger("corvus.job.raw")

RAW_DIR = "raw"
TOKENIZERS_ROOT = "tokenizers"
RAW_LAKE_ROOT = "lake/raw"
_TS = pa.timestamp("us", tz="UTC")
RAW_SESSIONS_SCHEMA = pa.schema(
    [
        ("session_id", pa.string()),
        ("pseudonym", pa.string()),
        ("started_at", _TS),
        ("client_protocol", pa.int32()),
    ]
)


def raw_prefix(snapshot_id: str) -> str:
    return f"{layout.features_prefix(snapshot_id)}/{RAW_DIR}"


def tokenizer_prefix(snapshot_id: str, job_id: str) -> str:
    return f"{TOKENIZERS_ROOT}/{snapshot_id}/{job_id}"


def _deks(env: JobEnv):
    if env.deks is not None:
        return env.deks
    from corvus_ml.raw.keys import PgDekProvider

    try:
        return PgDekProvider.from_env(os.environ)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise JobError(f"raw-byte jobs cannot read the player keys: {exc}") from None


def _raw_files(
    env: JobEnv, snapshot_id: str, manifest: dict[str, Any], sessions: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> list[str]:
    """Keys of the ``raw`` files: ``raw`` of ``GET /snapshots/{id}/files``.

    Only an API that does not send the field (older version) is served by the fallback: the
    manifest's list, else the lake's date partitions of the sessions' start dates. An empty
    ``raw`` list is an answer (no raw files), not a reason to scan.
    """
    files = env.api.get_snapshot_files(snapshot_id)
    if "raw" in files:
        return [f["key"] for f in files["raw"] or []]
    log.warning(
        "the API lists no raw files (older version): falling back to the manifest / a scan of %s",
        RAW_LAKE_ROOT,
    )
    listed = [f["key"] for f in (manifest.get("files") or {}).get("raw") or []]
    if listed:
        return listed
    dates = {s["started_at"].date().isoformat() for s in sessions if s.get("started_at")}
    keys = [k for k in env.store.list_keys(RAW_LAKE_ROOT) if k.endswith(".parquet")]
    if dates:
        keys = [k for k in keys if any(f"/date={d}/" in k for d in dates)]
    return keys


def _infos(sel) -> list[SessionInfo]:
    out = []
    for s in sel.sessions:
        pseudonym = s["pseudonym"]
        out.append(
            SessionInfo(
                bytes.fromhex(s["session_id"]),
                bytes.fromhex(pseudonym) if pseudonym else None,
                s.get("client_protocol"),
            )
        )
    return sorted(out, key=lambda i: i.session_id)


def _sample(infos: list[SessionInfo], limit: int) -> list[SessionInfo]:
    """Evenly spaced sessions (deterministic) for the tokenizer training."""
    if len(infos) <= limit:
        return infos
    step = len(infos) / limit
    return [infos[int(i * step)] for i in range(limit)]


def _read_params(ctx: JobContext, kind: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    p = Params(ctx.params)
    p.string("kind")
    protocols = p.numbers("protocols", [float(v) for v in DEFAULT_PROTOCOLS]) or []
    macro = p.raw("macro_window_seconds")
    if macro is not None and (isinstance(macro, bool) or not isinstance(macro, (int, float))):
        raise JobError("macro_window_seconds must be a number")
    out: dict[str, Any] = {
        "strict": p.boolean("strict", False),
        "contexts": p.game_contexts(),
        "group_size": p.integer("group_size", 4, 1, 1000),
        "tokenizer_sessions": p.integer("tokenizer_sessions", 2000, 1, 1_000_000),
        "tokenizer_prefix": p.string("tokenizer_prefix"),
        "tokenizer": TokenizerConfig(
            vocab_size=p.integer("vocab_size", 4096, 1, 32767),
            min_frequency=p.integer("min_frequency", 2, 1, 1_000_000),
            train_bytes_per_payload=p.integer("train_bytes_per_payload", 256, 1, 4096),
            max_train_payloads=p.integer("max_train_payloads", 2_000_000, 1, 10**9),
            max_train_bytes=p.integer("max_train_bytes", 256 * 1024 * 1024, 1, 2**40),
            layout=TokenLayout(
                dt_buckets=p.integer("dt_buckets", 16, 2, 256),
                dt_min_ms=p.number("dt_min_ms", 0.5, 1e-6, 1e9),
                dt_max_ms=p.number("dt_max_ms", 5000.0, 1e-6, 1e9),
                protocols=tuple(int(v) for v in protocols),
                packet_type_max=p.integer("packet_type_max", 255, 1, 4095),
            ),
        ),
        "packet": PacketConfig(
            max_tokens_per_packet=p.integer("max_tokens_per_packet", 48, 8, 512),
            proto_mode=p.string("proto_mode", "first") or "first",
        ),
        "window": WindowConfig(
            window_seconds=p.number("window_seconds", 10.0, 0.01, 86_400.0),
            stride_seconds=p.number("stride_seconds", 5.0, 0.01, 86_400.0),
            max_packets=p.integer("max_packets", 1024, 1, 100_000),
            overflow=p.string("overflow", "recent") or "recent",
            min_packets=p.integer("min_packets", 8, 1, 100_000),
            macro_window_seconds=None if macro is None else float(macro),
        ),
    }
    p.done()
    return out


def _train_or_load_tokenizer(
    ctx: JobContext, env: JobEnv, opts: dict[str, Any], reader: RawReader, infos, out: Path
) -> RawTokenizer:
    prefix = opts["tokenizer_prefix"]
    if prefix:
        for name in (TOKENIZER_FILE, SPEC_FILE):
            (out / name).write_bytes(env.store.get_bytes(f"{prefix.rstrip('/')}/{name}"))
        spec = FeatureSpec.load(out / SPEC_FILE, require_tokenizer=True).raw_bytes
        assert spec is not None
        opts["packet"] = spec.packet  # the model input layout comes from the tokenizer's spec
        log.info("reusing the tokenizer of %s", prefix)
        return RawTokenizer.load(out, spec)
    sample = _sample(infos, opts["tokenizer_sessions"])
    log.info("training the tokenizer on %d of %d sessions", len(sample), len(infos))
    tok = train_tokenizer(reader.iter_sessions(sample, opts["group_size"]), opts["tokenizer"])
    tok.save(out)
    return tok


def _write_tables(sel, out: Path) -> None:
    sessions = [
        {**s, "client_protocol": s.get("client_protocol")} for s in sel.sessions
    ]  # started_at is a datetime already
    pq.write_table(pa.Table.from_pylist(sessions, RAW_SESSIONS_SCHEMA), out / layout.SESSIONS_FILE)
    if sel.labels:
        from corvus_ml.jobs.features_job import LABELS_SCHEMA

        pq.write_table(pa.Table.from_pylist(sel.labels, LABELS_SCHEMA), out / layout.LABELS_FILE)


def build_raw(ctx: JobContext, env: JobEnv, kind: str) -> JobOutcome:
    from corvus_ml.jobs.features_job import Selection

    opts = _read_params(ctx, kind)
    snapshot = env.api.get_snapshot(ctx.snapshot_id)
    check_needs_rebuild(snapshot, strict=opts["strict"])
    manifest = snapshot.get("manifest") or {}
    event_keys = [f["key"] for f in (manifest.get("files") or {}).get("events") or []]
    if not event_keys:
        raise JobError("the snapshot manifest lists no events files")
    allowed = {str(s) for s in manifest["sessions"]} if manifest.get("sessions") else None

    sel = Selection(opts["contexts"])
    for item in env.api.iter_snapshot_sessions(ctx.snapshot_id):
        sel.add(item, allowed)
    infos = _infos(sel)
    if not infos:
        raise JobError("no sessions selected: the snapshot has none in the requested game contexts")
    raw_keys = _raw_files(env, ctx.snapshot_id, manifest, sel.sessions)
    if not raw_keys:
        raise JobError("no raw files for the snapshot (short retention: are they still there?)")
    without_protocol = sum(1 for i in infos if i.protocol is None)
    if without_protocol:
        log.warning(
            "%d sessions have no client_protocol from the API: they get [PROTO_OTHER]",
            without_protocol,
        )

    deks = _deks(env)
    events = open_dataset(
        EventFiles(tuple(env.store.path(k) for k in event_keys), env.store.filesystem)
    )
    raw = open_dataset(EventFiles(tuple(env.store.path(k) for k in raw_keys), env.store.filesystem))
    out = env.scratch / "raw-features"
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    train_reader = RawReader(events, raw, deks)
    tok = _train_or_load_tokenizer(ctx, env, opts, train_reader, infos, out)
    spec = tok.spec(out, opts["packet"], opts["window"])
    FeatureSpec.current(raw_bytes=spec).write(out)
    tok_stats = train_reader.stats

    if kind == "train_tokenizer":
        prefix = tokenizer_prefix(ctx.snapshot_id, ctx.job_id)
        for name in (TOKENIZER_FILE, SPEC_FILE):
            env.store.put_file(f"{prefix}/{name}", out / name)
        register_prefix(ctx, env, "tokenizer", prefix, contains_raw=False)
        result = {
            "tokenizer_prefix": prefix,
            "tokenizer_sha256": spec.tokenizer_sha256,
            "vocab_size": spec.vocab_size,
            "sessions_read": tok_stats.sessions_read,
            "sessions_crypto_shredded": tok_stats.sessions_erased,
        }
        return JobOutcome(f"trained a tokenizer with {spec.vocab_size} tokens", result)

    contexts: dict[bytes, dict[int, str]] = {}
    for sid, segment, game_context in sel.segments:
        contexts.setdefault(sid, {})[segment] = game_context
    reader = RawReader(events, raw, deks)
    packets = 0
    sink = out / "packets"
    sink.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    size = opts["group_size"]
    for index in range(0, len(infos), size):
        sessions = reader.read_group(infos[index : index + size])
        tables = list(tokenize_sessions(sessions, tok, opts["packet"], contexts))
        if not tables:
            continue
        table = pa.concat_tables(tables)
        packets += table.num_rows
        pq.write_table(
            table,
            sink / f"part-{index // size:06d}.parquet",
            compression="zstd",
            compression_level=3,
        )
    if packets == 0:
        stats = reader.stats
        raise JobError(
            "no packets could be tokenized: "
            f"{stats.sessions_erased} sessions without a key (erased), "
            f"{stats.sessions_no_pseudonym} without pseudonym, {stats.sessions_read} read"
        )
    _write_tables(sel, out)

    stats: ReadStats = reader.stats
    prefix = raw_prefix(ctx.snapshot_id)
    result = {
        "features_prefix": prefix,
        "tokenizer_sha256": spec.tokenizer_sha256,
        "vocab_size": spec.vocab_size,
        "sessions": stats.sessions_read,
        "packets": packets,
        "frames": stats.frames,
        "frames_with_payload": stats.frames_with_payload,
        "event_files": len(event_keys),
        "raw_files": len(raw_keys),
        "labels": len(sel.labels),
        "erased_sessions_skipped": sel.erased_skipped,
        "sessions_crypto_shredded": stats.sessions_erased,
        "sessions_without_pseudonym": stats.sessions_no_pseudonym,
        "sessions_without_protocol": without_protocol,
        "decrypt_failures": stats.decrypt_failures,
        "tokenizer_trained_on_sessions": None
        if opts["tokenizer_prefix"]
        else tok_stats.sessions_read,
    }
    env.store.delete_prefix(prefix)
    env.store.upload_dir(prefix, out)
    env.store.put_bytes(
        f"{prefix}/{layout.BUILD_FILE}",
        json.dumps({**result, "job_id": ctx.job_id, "built_at": env.clock().isoformat()}).encode(),
    )
    register_prefix(ctx, env, "raw_features", prefix, contains_raw=True)
    return JobOutcome(f"tokenized {packets} packets of {stats.sessions_read} sessions", result)

```

`ml/src/corvus_ml/jobs/storage.py`:

```py
"""Object storage for jobs: a bucket (or a local directory in tests) behind a pyarrow filesystem.

Production uses :func:`s3_store` (path-style addressing, the variables the services use); tests
inject a ``pyarrow.fs.LocalFileSystem`` rooted in ``tmp_path``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import posixpath
import shutil
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse

import pyarrow.fs as pafs

from corvus_ml.jobs.context import S3Settings

_CHUNK = 1 << 20


class ObjectStore:
    """Keys below ``root`` of a pyarrow filesystem (``root`` is the bucket for S3)."""

    def __init__(self, filesystem: pafs.FileSystem, root: str) -> None:
        self.filesystem = filesystem
        self.root = root.rstrip("/")

    def path(self, key: str) -> str:
        return posixpath.join(self.root, key.lstrip("/"))

    def put_bytes(self, key: str, data: bytes) -> None:
        self._ensure_parent(key)
        with self.filesystem.open_output_stream(self.path(key)) as out:
            out.write(data)

    def put_file(self, key: str, source: Path) -> None:
        self._ensure_parent(key)
        with open(source, "rb") as src, self.filesystem.open_output_stream(self.path(key)) as out:
            shutil.copyfileobj(src, out, _CHUNK)

    def get_bytes(self, key: str) -> bytes:
        with self.filesystem.open_input_stream(self.path(key)) as stream:
            return stream.read()

    def exists(self, key: str) -> bool:
        return self.filesystem.get_file_info(self.path(key)).type == pafs.FileType.File

    def list_keys(self, prefix: str) -> list[str]:
        """Keys of all files below ``prefix`` (sorted, relative to the store root)."""
        base = self.path(prefix.rstrip("/"))
        infos = self.filesystem.get_file_info(
            pafs.FileSelector(base, allow_not_found=True, recursive=True)
        )
        keys = [posixpath.relpath(i.path, self.root) for i in infos if i.type == pafs.FileType.File]
        return sorted(keys)

    def delete_prefix(self, prefix: str) -> None:
        base = self.path(prefix.rstrip("/"))
        if self.filesystem.get_file_info(base).type == pafs.FileType.Directory:
            self.filesystem.delete_dir_contents(base)

    def upload_dir(self, prefix: str, source: Path) -> list[str]:
        """Copy every file below ``source`` to ``prefix/<relative path>``; returns the keys."""
        keys = []
        for file in sorted(p for p in source.rglob("*") if p.is_file()):
            key = posixpath.join(prefix.rstrip("/"), file.relative_to(source).as_posix())
            self.put_file(key, file)
            keys.append(key)
        return keys

    def download_dir(
        self, prefix: str, dest: Path, skip: Callable[[str], bool] = lambda rel: False
    ) -> list[Path]:
        """Copy files below ``prefix`` into ``dest``; ``skip(relative path)`` leaves some out."""
        written = []
        for key in self.list_keys(prefix):
            rel = posixpath.relpath(key, prefix.rstrip("/"))
            if skip(rel):
                continue
            target = dest / rel
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with (
                self.filesystem.open_input_stream(self.path(key)) as src,
                open(target, "wb") as out,
            ):
                shutil.copyfileobj(src, out, _CHUNK)
            written.append(target)
        return written

    def _ensure_parent(self, key: str) -> None:
        parent = posixpath.dirname(self.path(key))
        if parent:
            self.filesystem.create_dir(parent, recursive=True)


def s3_filesystem(settings: S3Settings) -> pafs.S3FileSystem:
    """Path-style S3 (MinIO) or AWS S3 from the ``CORVUS_S3_*`` variables."""
    kwargs: dict[str, object] = {
        "region": settings.region,
        "access_key": settings.access_key,
        "secret_key": settings.secret_key,
    }
    if settings.endpoint_url:
        parsed = urlparse(settings.endpoint_url)
        kwargs["endpoint_override"] = parsed.netloc or settings.endpoint_url
        kwargs["scheme"] = parsed.scheme or "https"
        kwargs["force_virtual_addressing"] = False
    return pafs.S3FileSystem(**kwargs)


def s3_store(settings: S3Settings) -> ObjectStore:
    return ObjectStore(s3_filesystem(settings), settings.bucket)


def local_store(root: Path) -> ObjectStore:
    """A store in a local directory (tests)."""
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return ObjectStore(pafs.LocalFileSystem(), str(root))

```

`ml/src/corvus_ml/model.py`:

```py
"""Mergeable aggregation results. Everything here is small and picklable."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from corvus_ml.privacy import PrivacyFindings

UNASSIGNED = "unassigned"


@dataclass
class Counters:
    queue_full: int = 0
    privacy: int = 0
    listener_errors: int = 0

    def add(self, other: Counters) -> None:
        self.queue_full += other.queue_full
        self.privacy += other.privacy
        self.listener_errors += other.listener_errors

    def maxed(self, other: Counters) -> Counters:
        return Counters(
            max(self.queue_full, other.queue_full),
            max(self.privacy, other.privacy),
            max(self.listener_errors, other.listener_errors),
        )

    def minus(self, other: Counters) -> Counters:
        return Counters(
            self.queue_full - other.queue_full,
            self.privacy - other.privacy,
            self.listener_errors - other.listener_errors,
        )


@dataclass
class GapStats:
    """Sequence-number anomalies: gaps (events), frames missing inside them, and reordering."""

    events: int = 0
    missing_frames: int = 0
    out_of_order: int = 0

    def add(self, other: GapStats) -> None:
        self.events += other.events
        self.missing_frames += other.missing_frames
        self.out_of_order += other.out_of_order


@dataclass
class Agg:
    """Frame statistics for one segment, context or the whole run."""

    frames_ds: Counter = field(default_factory=Counter)  # (direction, state) -> frames
    bytes_ds: Counter = field(default_factory=Counter)  # (direction, state) -> payload bytes
    packets: Counter = field(default_factory=Counter)  # (direction, state, type, wire) -> frames
    packet_bytes: Counter = field(default_factory=Counter)
    events: Counter = field(default_factory=Counter)  # decoded event name -> frames
    payload_frames: int = 0  # frames that carry a recorded payload
    payload_truncated: int = 0  # of those, frames whose payload was cut to max_payload_bytes
    counters: Counters = field(default_factory=Counters)
    gaps: GapStats = field(default_factory=GapStats)

    def merge(self, other: Agg) -> None:
        self.frames_ds.update(other.frames_ds)
        self.bytes_ds.update(other.bytes_ds)
        self.packets.update(other.packets)
        self.packet_bytes.update(other.packet_bytes)
        self.events.update(other.events)
        self.payload_frames += other.payload_frames
        self.payload_truncated += other.payload_truncated
        self.counters.add(other.counters)
        self.gaps.add(other.gaps)

    @property
    def frames(self) -> int:
        return sum(self.frames_ds.values())

    @property
    def bytes(self) -> int:
        return sum(self.bytes_ds.values())

    def by_direction(self, counter: Counter) -> dict[str, int]:
        out: Counter = Counter()
        for (direction, _state), n in counter.items():
            out[direction] += n
        return dict(out)


@dataclass
class SegmentSummary:
    """One player in one game context; the unit for per-player rate distributions."""

    session_id: str
    segment: int
    context: str
    duration_s: float
    frames: int
    bytes: int


@dataclass
class ContextAgg:
    agg: Agg = field(default_factory=Agg)
    player_seconds: float = 0.0
    segments: list[SegmentSummary] = field(default_factory=list)

    def merge(self, other: ContextAgg) -> None:
        self.agg.merge(other.agg)
        self.player_seconds += other.player_seconds
        self.segments.extend(other.segments)


@dataclass
class SessionSummary:
    session_id: str
    file: str
    client_protocol: int
    observed_protocol: int
    plugin_version: str
    contexts: list[str]
    brands: list[str]
    duration_s: float
    complete: bool
    agg: Agg
    end_counters: Counters | None


@dataclass
class FileResult:
    """Aggregation of one capture file; merged pairwise into the run result."""

    files: int = 0
    envelopes: int = 0
    truncated_files: int = 0
    corrupt_files: int = 0
    sessions: list[SessionSummary] = field(default_factory=list)
    contexts: dict[str, ContextAgg] = field(default_factory=dict)
    versions: Counter = field(default_factory=Counter)  # (client, observed) -> sessions
    privacy: PrivacyFindings = field(default_factory=PrivacyFindings)
    denylist_active: bool = False

    def merge(self, other: FileResult) -> None:
        self.files += other.files
        self.envelopes += other.envelopes
        self.truncated_files += other.truncated_files
        self.corrupt_files += other.corrupt_files
        self.sessions.extend(other.sessions)
        for name, ctx in other.contexts.items():
            self.contexts.setdefault(name, ContextAgg()).merge(ctx)
        self.versions.update(other.versions)
        self.privacy.merge(other.privacy)
        self.denylist_active = self.denylist_active or other.denylist_active
```
