```py
    return small_tokenizer(syn)


def test_every_byte_value_survives_the_text_mapping():
    data = bytes(range(256))
    assert text_to_bytes(bytes_to_text(data)) == data


def test_arbitrary_bytes_round_trip_through_encode_and_decode(tok):
    rng = random.Random(5)
    samples = [rng.randbytes(n) for n in (1, 2, 17, 255, 2048)]
    samples += [bytes(range(256)), b"\x00" * 64, b"", b"[PAD][SEP][MASK]\x00[PKT_1]"]

    for data in samples:
        assert tok.decode(tok.encode(data)) == data, f"{data[:16]!r}"


def test_payload_bytes_never_produce_reserved_tokens(tok):
    ids = tok.encode(b"[PAD][SEP][CLS][TRUNC][DT_3]")

    assert min(ids) >= tok.layout.n_special, "literal token names inside a payload stay bytes"


def test_reserved_tokens_have_the_ids_the_layout_promises(tok):
    layout = tok.layout
    names = layout.special_tokens()

    assert names[:5] == ["[PAD]", "[MASK]", "[CLS]", "[SEP]", "[UNK]"]
    assert (L.PAD_ID, L.MASK_ID, L.CLS_ID, L.SEP_ID, L.UNK_ID) == (0, 1, 2, 3, 4)
    assert tok._tok.token_to_id("[TRUNC]") == L.TRUNC_ID
    assert tok._tok.token_to_id("[NOPAYLOAD]") == L.NOPAYLOAD_ID
    assert tok._tok.token_to_id("[DIR_SB]") == L.DIR_SB_ID
    assert tok._tok.token_to_id("[DIR_CB]") == L.DIR_CB_ID
    assert tok._tok.token_to_id(f"[PKT_{27}]") == layout.pkt_id(27)
    assert tok._tok.token_to_id("[PROTO_768]") == layout.proto_id(768)
    assert tok._tok.token_to_id("[DT_0]") == layout.dt_base
    assert layout.pkt_id(0) == L.PKT_OTHER_ID
    assert layout.pkt_id(layout.packet_type_max + 1) == L.PKT_OTHER_ID
    assert layout.proto_id(999) == L.PROTO_OTHER_ID
    assert layout.proto_id(None) == L.PROTO_OTHER_ID
    assert tok.vocab_size == SMALL_VOCAB


def test_one_token_per_corvus_packet_type_up_to_the_maximum():
    layout = L.TokenLayout()
    ids = {layout.pkt_id(i) for i in range(1, 229)}  # vocabulary.json holds ids 1..228

    assert len(ids) == 228
    assert layout.n_special == layout.pkt_base + 255


def test_delta_t_buckets_are_log_spaced_and_cover_everything():
    layout = L.TokenLayout(dt_buckets=8, dt_min_ms=1.0, dt_max_ms=1000.0)
    edges = layout.dt_edges_ms()

    assert len(edges) == 7
    assert edges[0] == pytest.approx(1.0)
    assert edges[-1] == pytest.approx(1000.0)
    ratios = [b / a for a, b in zip(edges, edges[1:], strict=False)]
    assert ratios == pytest.approx([ratios[0]] * 6)
    assert layout.dt_id(0.0) == layout.dt_base
    assert layout.dt_id(1e9) == layout.dt_base + 7
    assert layout.dt_id(None) == L.DT_NONE_ID


def test_training_is_deterministic(syn, tmp_path):
    a, b = small_tokenizer(syn), small_tokenizer(syn)
    a.save(tmp_path / "a")
    b.save(tmp_path / "b")

    assert (tmp_path / "a/tokenizer.json").read_bytes() == (
        tmp_path / "b/tokenizer.json"
    ).read_bytes()


def test_training_learns_merges_for_repeated_structure(tok):
    flags_and_zeros = b"\x00" * 24

    assert len(tok.encode(flags_and_zeros)) < 24


def test_training_data_is_bounded_by_payload_count_bytes_and_prefix_length():
    payloads = [bytes([i]) * 100 for i in range(50)]
    cfg = TokenizerConfig(
        vocab_size=700, train_bytes_per_payload=10, max_train_payloads=7, max_train_bytes=10_000
    )
    texts = list(bounded_payloads(iter(payloads), cfg))
    assert len(texts) == 7
    assert all(len(t) == 10 for t in texts)

    by_bytes = list(
        bounded_payloads(
            iter(payloads),
            TokenizerConfig(vocab_size=700, train_bytes_per_payload=10, max_train_bytes=35),
        )
    )
    assert len(by_bytes) == 4


def test_vocabulary_must_leave_room_for_the_byte_alphabet():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="vocab_size"):
        TokenizerConfig(vocab_size=100)


def _frames(payloads, original_sizes, *, offsets, segments=None, types=None, direction=1):
    n = len(payloads)
    return SessionPackets(
        session_id=bytes(16),
        protocol=768,
        segment=np.array(segments or [0] * n, dtype=np.uint32),
        seq=np.arange(n, dtype=np.uint64),
        offset_nanos=np.array(offsets, dtype=np.uint64),
        direction=np.full(n, direction, dtype=np.uint8),
        state=np.full(n, 5, dtype=np.uint8),
        packet_type=np.array(types or [12] * n, dtype=np.uint32),
        payload_original_size=np.array(original_sizes, dtype=np.uint32),
        payloads=list(payloads),
    )


def _rows(tok, sp, packet=None, proto=None):
    packet = packet or PacketConfig()
    table = session_packet_table(sp, tok, packet, {0: "pvp", 1: "pvp"})
    stream = next(streams_from_table(table, packet))
    return stream, stream.rows(tok.layout, packet.max_tokens_per_packet, proto, None)


def test_packet_row_layout_with_payload(tok):
    sp = _frames([b"\x01\x02\x03\x04"], [4], offsets=[0])
    stream, rows = _rows(tok, sp)
    layout = tok.layout
    row = rows[0].tolist()

    assert row[0] == L.DIR_SB_ID
    assert row[1] == layout.pkt_id(12)
    assert row[2] == L.DT_NONE_ID
    payload = row[3 : row[3:].index(L.SEP_ID) + 3]
    assert tok.decode(payload) == b"\x01\x02\x03\x04"
    assert L.TRUNC_ID not in row
    assert L.NOPAYLOAD_ID not in row
    assert row[row.index(L.SEP_ID) + 1 :] == [0] * (48 - row.index(L.SEP_ID) - 1)


def test_frames_without_payload_get_nopayload_and_keep_their_header(tok):
    sp = _frames([None, b""], [0, 0], offsets=[0, 5_000_000], types=[27, 27])
    _, rows = _rows(tok, sp)
    layout = tok.layout

    for row in rows.tolist():
        assert row[:3] == [L.DIR_SB_ID, layout.pkt_id(27), row[2]]
        assert row[3:5] == [L.NOPAYLOAD_ID, L.SEP_ID]
    assert rows[1, 2] == layout.dt_id(5.0)


def test_payload_cut_by_the_ring_buffer_is_marked_trunc(tok):
    # payload_original_size says 3000 bytes existed, only 40 were recorded
    sp = _frames([bytes(range(40))], [3000], offsets=[0])
    _, rows = _rows(tok, sp)
    row = rows[0].tolist()
    sep = row.index(L.SEP_ID)

    assert row[sep - 1] == L.TRUNC_ID


def test_payload_longer_than_the_token_cap_is_cut_and_marked_trunc(tok):
    packet = PacketConfig(max_tokens_per_packet=16)
    data = random.Random(3).randbytes(200)
    sp = _frames([data], [200], offsets=[0])
    _, rows = _rows(tok, sp, packet)
    row = rows[0].tolist()

    assert len(row) == 16
    assert row[row.index(L.SEP_ID) - 1] == L.TRUNC_ID
    assert payload_cap(packet) == 11


def test_protocol_token_goes_after_the_header_and_shifts_the_payload(tok):
    sp = _frames([b"\x01\x02\x03\x04"], [4], offsets=[0])
    _, plain = _rows(tok, sp)
    _, with_proto = _rows(tok, sp, proto=tok.layout.proto_id(768))

    assert with_proto[0, 3] == tok.layout.proto_id(768)
    assert plain[0, 3] != tok.layout.proto_id(768)
    assert tok.decode(with_proto[0, 4 : list(with_proto[0]).index(L.SEP_ID)].tolist()) == bytes(
        [1, 2, 3, 4]
    )


def test_delta_t_restarts_with_each_segment(tok):
    sp = _frames(
        [b"\x01", b"\x01", b"\x01"], [1, 1, 1],
        offsets=[0, 10_000_000, 20_000_000], segments=[0, 0, 1],
    )  # fmt: skip
    _, _ = _rows(tok, sp)
    table = session_packet_table(sp, tok, PacketConfig(), {0: "pvp", 1: "pvp"})

    dt = table["dt_id"].to_pylist()
    assert dt[0] == L.DT_NONE_ID
    assert dt[1] == tok.layout.dt_id(10.0)
    assert dt[2] == L.DT_NONE_ID


def test_frames_in_segments_without_a_game_context_are_dropped(tok):
    sp = _frames([b"\x01", b"\x01"], [1, 1], offsets=[0, 1_000_000], segments=[0, 3])

    table = session_packet_table(sp, tok, PacketConfig(), {0: "pvp"})

    assert table.num_rows == 1


def test_assemble_rows_marks_unknown_packet_types_and_directions():
    layout = L.TokenLayout(packet_type_max=10)
    rows = assemble_rows(
        layout, 16, np.array([2, 9]), np.array([3, 500]), np.array([20, 20]),
        np.zeros((2, 4), dtype=np.int16), np.zeros(2, dtype=np.int64),
        np.zeros(2, dtype=bool), np.ones(2, dtype=bool),
    )  # fmt: skip

    assert rows[0, 0] == L.DIR_CB_ID
    assert rows[1, 0] == L.DIR_OTHER_ID
    assert rows[1, 1] == L.PKT_OTHER_ID


# --- feature spec (kind raw_bytes) -------------------------------------------------------------


@pytest.fixture
def saved(tok, tmp_path):
    tok.save(tmp_path)
    spec = tok.spec(tmp_path, PacketConfig(), WindowConfig())
    FeatureSpec.current(raw_bytes=spec).write(tmp_path)
    return tmp_path, spec


def test_raw_bytes_spec_round_trips_and_is_version_2(saved):
    directory, spec = saved

    loaded = FeatureSpec.load(directory, require_tokenizer=True)

    assert loaded.raw_bytes == spec
    assert loaded.version == FEATURE_SPEC_RAW_VERSION == 2


def test_changed_tokenizer_file_is_refused_on_load(saved):
    directory, _ = saved
    (directory / "tokenizer.json").write_text((directory / "tokenizer.json").read_text() + " ")

    with pytest.raises(FeatureSpecMismatch, match="tokenizer hash"):
        FeatureSpec.load(directory)


def test_missing_tokenizer_file_is_an_error_when_required(saved):
    directory, _ = saved
    (directory / "tokenizer.json").unlink()

    FeatureSpec.load(directory)  # tolerated unless the caller needs the tokenizer
    with pytest.raises(FeatureSpecError, match="missing"):
        FeatureSpec.load(directory, require_tokenizer=True)


def test_tokenizer_loader_checks_hash_and_layout(saved, tok):
    directory, spec = saved

    assert RawTokenizer.load(directory, spec).vocab_size == spec.vocab_size

    other = tiny_synthetic(seed=9)
    small_tokenizer(other, vocab_size=SMALL_VOCAB + 10).save(directory)
    with pytest.raises(FeatureSpecMismatch, match="hash"):
        RawTokenizer.load(directory, spec)


def test_loader_rejects_a_tokenizer_that_does_not_follow_the_layout(saved):
    directory, spec = saved
    from dataclasses import replace

    wrong = replace(spec, layout=L.TokenLayout(packet_type_max=63))

    with pytest.raises(FeatureSpecMismatch):
        RawTokenizer.load(directory, replace(wrong))


def test_a_scorer_without_raw_support_refuses_the_spec(saved):
    directory, _ = saved
    raw = FeatureSpec.read(directory)
    aggregate_only = FeatureSpec.current(raw.window, raw.seq_len)

    with pytest.raises(FeatureSpecMismatch, match="version"):
        raw.require_compatible(aggregate_only)


def test_window_differences_are_ignored_only_when_asked(saved):
    directory, spec = saved
    from dataclasses import replace

    other = replace(spec, window=WindowConfig(window_seconds=20.0, stride_seconds=10.0))
    mine = FeatureSpec.current(raw_bytes=spec)
    theirs = FeatureSpec.current(raw_bytes=other)

    assert mine.differences(theirs, window=False) == []
    assert any("raw_bytes.window" in d for d in mine.differences(theirs))
```

`ml/tests/test_raw_windows.py`:

```py
"""Time windows: grid, stride, segment boundaries, caps, macro windows, model input layout."""

import numpy as np
import pytest

from corvus_ml.raw import layout as L
from corvus_ml.raw.spec import PacketConfig, WindowConfig
from corvus_ml.raw.windows import (
    PacketStream,
    build_windows,
    from_input,
    pick_packets,
    stream_windows,
    to_input,
    window_bounds,
)

LAYOUT = L.TokenLayout(packet_type_max=64)
PACKET = PacketConfig(max_tokens_per_packet=16)
NS = 1_000_000_000


def stream(times_s, segment=0, packet_type=12, protocol=768, session=b"s" * 16):
    n = len(times_s)
    cap = PACKET.max_tokens_per_packet - L.HEADER_LEN - 2
    return PacketStream(
        session_id=session,
        segment=segment,
        game_context="pvp",
        protocol=protocol,
        offset_ns=(np.asarray(times_s) * NS).astype(np.int64),
        direction=np.ones(n, dtype=np.uint8),
        packet_type=np.full(n, packet_type, dtype=np.uint32),
        dt_id=np.full(n, LAYOUT.dt_base, dtype=np.int16),
        trunc=np.zeros(n, dtype=bool),
        nopayload=np.ones(n, dtype=bool),
        payload=np.zeros((n, cap), dtype=np.int16),
        payload_len=np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64),
    )


def cfg(**kw):
    return WindowConfig(**({"window_seconds": 10.0, "stride_seconds": 5.0, "min_packets": 1} | kw))


def starts(bounds):
    return [b[3] / NS for b in bounds]


def test_windows_follow_the_stride_grid_anchored_at_the_first_packet():
    times = np.arange(100.0, 130.0, 0.1)

    bounds = window_bounds((times * NS).astype(np.int64), cfg())

    assert starts(bounds) == [100.0, 105.0, 110.0, 115.0, 120.0]
    assert [b[0] for b in bounds] == [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]


def test_consecutive_windows_overlap_by_window_minus_stride():
    times = np.arange(0.0, 30.0, 0.1)

    (_, lo0, hi0, _), (_, lo1, hi1, _) = window_bounds((times * NS).astype(np.int64), cfg())[:2]

    assert (hi0 - lo0, hi1 - lo1) == (100, 100)
    assert lo1 - lo0 == 50, "stride 5 s = 50 packets"


def test_stride_equal_to_the_window_gives_disjoint_windows():
    times = np.arange(0.0, 30.0, 0.1)

    bounds = window_bounds((times * NS).astype(np.int64), cfg(stride_seconds=10.0))

    assert [(lo, hi) for _, lo, hi, _ in bounds] == [(0, 100), (100, 200), (200, 300)]


def test_a_tail_window_is_kept_only_if_it_holds_packets_no_other_window_saw():
    # packets up to 12 s: windows [0,10) and [5,15) (partial, sees 10..12); [10,20) adds nothing
    times = np.arange(0.0, 12.0, 0.5)

    bounds = window_bounds((times * NS).astype(np.int64), cfg())

    assert starts(bounds) == [0.0, 5.0]


def test_a_segment_shorter_than_one_window_still_yields_one_window():
    bounds = window_bounds((np.arange(0.0, 4.0, 0.5) * NS).astype(np.int64), cfg())

    assert len(bounds) == 1


def test_sparse_windows_below_min_packets_are_dropped():
    times = np.concatenate([np.arange(0.0, 10.0, 0.5), [40.0, 41.0]])

    kept = window_bounds((times * NS).astype(np.int64), cfg(stride_seconds=10.0, min_packets=5))

    assert starts(kept) == [0.0]


def test_empty_input_has_no_windows():
    assert window_bounds(np.zeros(0, dtype=np.int64), cfg()) == []


def test_windows_never_cross_a_segment():
    a = stream(np.arange(0.0, 20.0, 0.2), segment=0, packet_type=11)
    b = stream(np.arange(20.0, 40.0, 0.2), segment=1, packet_type=13)

    rw = build_windows([a, b], LAYOUT, PACKET, cfg())

    pkt_a, pkt_b = LAYOUT.pkt_id(11), LAYOUT.pkt_id(13)
    for i in range(len(rw)):
        types = set(rw.ids[i, 0, :, 1][rw.ids[i, 0, :, 0] != 0].tolist())
        assert types in ({pkt_a}, {pkt_b}), "a window holds packets of one segment only"
        assert rw.segment[i] in (0, 1)
    assert set(rw.segment.tolist()) == {0, 1}


def test_time_channel_is_seconds_since_the_window_start():
    s = stream(np.arange(50.0, 62.0, 0.5))

    rw = build_windows([s], LAYOUT, PACKET, cfg())

    first = rw.time_s[0, 0]
    assert first[0] == 0.0
    assert first[1] == pytest.approx(0.5)
    assert rw.time_s[1, 0, 0] == pytest.approx(0.0), (
        "second window starts at 55 s, its packet at 55"
    )
    assert rw.start_offset_nanos.tolist()[:2] == [50 * NS, 55 * NS]


def test_packet_cap_keeps_the_most_recent_packets():
    s = stream(np.arange(0.0, 10.0, 0.05))  # 200 packets in one window

    rw = build_windows([s], LAYOUT, PACKET, cfg(max_packets=50, stride_seconds=10.0))

    assert rw.ids.shape[2] == 50
    assert rw.time_s[0, 0, 0] == pytest.approx(7.5), "the newest 50 of 200 start at 150 * 0.05"
    assert rw.time_s[0, 0, -1] == pytest.approx(9.95)


def test_packet_cap_uniform_subsamples_across_the_whole_window():
    picked = pick_packets(100, 300, 5, "uniform")

    assert len(picked) == 5
    assert picked[0] == 100
    assert picked[-1] == 299
    assert np.all(np.diff(picked) > 0)


def test_windows_below_the_cap_keep_all_packets():
    assert pick_packets(10, 20, 50, "recent").tolist() == list(range(10, 20))


def test_token_cap_bounds_every_packet_row():
    s = stream(np.arange(0.0, 10.0, 0.5))

    rw = build_windows([s], LAYOUT, PACKET, cfg())

    assert rw.ids.shape[-1] == PACKET.max_tokens_per_packet


def test_protocol_token_is_on_the_first_packet_of_each_window_by_default():
    s = stream(np.arange(0.0, 12.0, 0.5), protocol=768)

    rw = build_windows([s], LAYOUT, PACKET, cfg())

    for i in range(len(rw)):
        col = rw.ids[i, 0, :, 3]
        assert col[0] == LAYOUT.proto_id(768)
        assert LAYOUT.proto_id(768) not in col[1:][rw.ids[i, 0, 1:, 0] != 0]


def test_protocol_token_modes_every_and_none():
    s = stream(np.arange(0.0, 6.0, 0.5), protocol=770)

    every = build_windows(
        [s], LAYOUT, PacketConfig(max_tokens_per_packet=16, proto_mode="every"), cfg()
    )
    none = build_windows(
        [s], LAYOUT, PacketConfig(max_tokens_per_packet=16, proto_mode="none"), cfg()
    )

    real = every.ids[0, 0, :, 0] != 0
    assert (every.ids[0, 0, real, 3] == LAYOUT.proto_id(770)).all()
    assert (none.ids[0, 0, :, 3] != LAYOUT.proto_id(770)).all()


def test_unknown_protocol_gets_the_other_token():
    s = stream(np.arange(0.0, 6.0, 0.5), protocol=12345)

    rw = build_windows([s], LAYOUT, PACKET, cfg())

    assert rw.ids[0, 0, 0, 3] == L.PROTO_OTHER_ID


def test_macro_windows_group_consecutive_windows_and_pad_gaps():
    # 10 s windows without overlap; nothing between 10 and 20 s -> the middle window is missing
    times = np.concatenate([np.arange(0.0, 10.0, 0.5), np.arange(20.0, 40.0, 0.5)])
    macro = cfg(stride_seconds=10.0, macro_window_seconds=30.0)

    rw = build_windows([stream(times)], LAYOUT, PACKET, macro)

    assert macro.macro_windows == 3
    assert len(rw) == 2, "windows 0..2 and 3 form two macro windows"
    first_real = (rw.ids[0, :, :, 0] != 0).any(axis=1)
    assert first_real.tolist() == [True, False, True], "the gap stays padding"
    assert rw.ids.shape[1] == 3


def test_macro_windows_need_stride_equal_to_window():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="stride"):
        WindowConfig(window_seconds=10.0, stride_seconds=5.0, macro_window_seconds=60.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="macro_window_seconds"):
        WindowConfig(window_seconds=10.0, stride_seconds=10.0, macro_window_seconds=5.0)


def test_input_layout_round_trip_and_macro_axis():
    s = stream(np.arange(0.0, 40.0, 0.5))
    plain = build_windows([s], LAYOUT, PACKET, cfg(stride_seconds=10.0))
    grouped = build_windows(
        [s], LAYOUT, PACKET, cfg(stride_seconds=10.0, macro_window_seconds=20.0)
    )

    x = to_input(plain.ids, plain.time_s, 1)
    xm = to_input(grouped.ids, grouped.time_s, 2)

    assert x.dtype == np.float32
    assert x.ndim == 3
    assert x.shape[-1] == 17
    assert xm.ndim == 4
    assert xm.shape[1] == 2
    ids, t = from_input(x)
    assert np.array_equal(ids, plain.ids[:, 0])
    assert np.array_equal(t, plain.time_s[:, 0])


def test_stream_windows_record_how_many_packets_the_cap_dropped():
    s = stream(np.arange(0.0, 10.0, 0.05))

    (w,) = stream_windows(s, LAYOUT, PACKET, cfg(max_packets=20, stride_seconds=10.0))

    assert w.n_packets == 200
    assert len(w.time_s) == 20
```

`ml/tests/test_reader.py`:

```py
import io
import logging

from builders import batch, delimited, frame, session_end, session_start
from corvus_ml.reader import ReadStats, iter_envelopes


def read(data: bytes):
    stats = ReadStats()
    return list(iter_envelopes(io.BytesIO(data), stats)), stats


def test_round_trip_returns_envelopes_in_order():
    sent = [session_start(), batch([frame(1)]), session_end()]

    got, stats = read(delimited(*sent))

    assert got == sent
    assert stats.envelopes == 3
    assert not stats.truncated
    assert not stats.corrupt


def test_empty_stream_yields_nothing():
    got, stats = read(b"")

    assert got == []
    assert not stats.truncated


def test_truncated_last_message_is_counted_and_earlier_messages_survive(caplog):
    data = delimited(session_start(), batch([frame(1)]))
    caplog.set_level(logging.WARNING)

    got, stats = read(data[:-3])

    assert len(got) == 1
    assert stats.truncated
    assert "truncated last message" in caplog.text


def test_truncated_length_prefix_is_counted_as_truncated():
    got, stats = read(delimited(session_start()) + b"\x80")

    assert len(got) == 1
    assert stats.truncated


def test_oversized_length_prefix_is_flagged_corrupt_without_allocating():
    huge = b"\xff\xff\xff\xff\x0f"  # varint for 4 GiB - 1

    got, stats = read(huge)

    assert got == []
    assert stats.corrupt


def test_undecodable_body_is_flagged_corrupt():
    got, stats = read(b"\x03\xff\xff\xff")

    assert got == []
    assert stats.corrupt
```

`plugin/VOCABULARY.md`:

```md
# Corvus packet vocabulary

`CorvusPacket` maps PacketEvents `PacketType` constants to a stable `uint32` that is written to
`Frame.packet_type`. It is the version-independent key the analyzers and models use; the wire packet id
changes between Minecraft versions, this id does not.

Rules:

- Ids are **append-only**. Never renumber, never reuse an id, never delete an entry. If PacketEvents drops a
  packet type, keep the id reserved and remove only the mapping in code (leave a comment).
- `0` means "unmapped" (the frame is still recorded, with its wire id and raw payload).
- Ranges: `1-99` serverbound play, `100-199` clientbound play, `200-299` configuration. New entries take the
  next free number in their range.
- Privacy-dropped types (chat, commands, signing, player lists; see `PrivacyFilter`) also have ids. The frames
  are never recorded; the ids exist so the analyzer can deny them. Every type in `PrivacyFilter`, in the
  payload-stripped set and in the clientbound payload allowlist (see `PayloadPolicy`) must have an id; a unit
  test enforces this.
- Packet types that are not in the vocabulary are recorded with id `0`, and their payload is only kept in
  `capture.raw_payloads = "all"` (fail closed).

## Machine-readable export

`proto/corvus/capture/v1/vocabulary.json` lists every id with `name`, `direction`, `state`, `private` (frame is
never recorded) and `payload_policy` (`frame_dropped`, `stripped`, `default`, `all_only`). The pilot analyzer
loads it as its privacy denylist and payload policy. `VocabularyJsonTest` fails when the file and the Java
vocabulary, `PrivacyFilter` or `PayloadPolicy` disagree. After an intended change regenerate it with
`./gradlew :plugin:test --tests '*VocabularyJsonTest' -PupdateVocabulary` and commit the result.

```

`plugin/build.gradle.kts`:

```kts
plugins {
    `java-library`
    id("com.gradleup.shadow") version "9.6.1"
}

java {
    toolchain { languageVersion = JavaLanguageVersion.of(25) }
}

val velocityVersion = "4.2.0"
val packetEventsVersion = "2.14.0"
val nettyVersion = "4.2.19.Final"

val generateTemplates = tasks.register<Copy>("generateTemplates") {
    val version = project.version.toString()
    inputs.property("version", version)
    from("src/main/templates")
    into(layout.buildDirectory.dir("generated/sources/templates"))
    expand("version" to version)
}

sourceSets.main {
    java.srcDir(generateTemplates.map { it.destinationDir })
}

dependencies {
    implementation(project(":proto-java"))
    // Public API for other plugins: shaded into the plugin jar unrelocated (see shadowJar below).
    implementation(project(":api"))
    implementation("io.nats:jnats:2.26.4")
    implementation("com.moandjiezana.toml:toml4j:0.7.2") {
        exclude(group = "com.google.code.gson")
    }

    compileOnly("com.velocitypowered:velocity-api:$velocityVersion")
    annotationProcessor("com.velocitypowered:velocity-api:$velocityVersion")
    compileOnly("com.github.retrooper:packetevents-api:$packetEventsVersion")
    // Velocity ships Gson (toml4j relies on it too).
    compileOnly("com.google.code.gson:gson:2.14.0")
    compileOnly("io.netty:netty-buffer:$nettyVersion")
    compileOnly("io.netty:netty-transport:$nettyVersion")

    testImplementation("com.velocitypowered:velocity-api:$velocityVersion")
    testImplementation("com.github.retrooper:packetevents-api:$packetEventsVersion")
    testImplementation("io.netty:netty-buffer:$nettyVersion")
    testImplementation("com.google.code.gson:gson:2.14.0")
    testImplementation(platform("org.junit:junit-bom:6.1.3"))
    testImplementation("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter")
    testRuntimeOnly("org.junit.platform:junit-platform-launcher")
}

val vocabularyJson = rootProject.file("proto/corvus/capture/v1/vocabulary.json")

tasks.test {
    useJUnitPlatform()
    maxParallelForks = 1
    // The committed vocabulary export is checked against the Java vocabulary. Regenerate it with
    //   ./gradlew :plugin:test --tests '*VocabularyJsonTest' -PupdateVocabulary
    inputs.files(vocabularyJson)
    val pilotConfig = rootProject.file("deploy/pilot/proxy/corvus-config.toml")
    inputs.files(pilotConfig)
    systemProperty("corvus.pilot.config", pilotConfig.absolutePath)
    systemProperty("corvus.vocabulary.json", vocabularyJson.absolutePath)
    systemProperty("corvus.vocabulary.update", providers.gradleProperty("updateVocabulary").isPresent.toString())
}

tasks.shadowJar {
    archiveBaseName = "corvus-velocity"
    archiveClassifier = ""
    mergeServiceFiles()
    relocate("com.google.protobuf", "net.onelitefeather.corvus.shaded.protobuf")
    relocate("com.moandjiezana.toml", "net.onelitefeather.corvus.shaded.toml")
    relocate("io.nats", "net.onelitefeather.corvus.shaded.nats")
    relocate("org.bouncycastle", "net.onelitefeather.corvus.shaded.bouncycastle")
    relocate("org.jspecify", "net.onelitefeather.corvus.shaded.jspecify")
    // net.onelitefeather.corvus.api is deliberately NOT relocated: other plugins compile against it.
}

tasks.build { dependsOn(tasks.shadowJar) }
```

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.blocklist;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Set;

/** Fetches the blocked pseudonyms (lower-case hex) from the control plane. Blocking. */
public interface BlocklistClient {

    Set<String> fetchBlocked() throws IOException;
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/blocklist/HttpBlocklistClient.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.blocklist;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonParseException;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URI;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * {@code GET <base>/api/v1/plugin/blocklist} with {@code Authorization: Bearer <token>}. The feed is one document
 * {@code {"version", "blocked": [hex...], "allowed": [hex...]}} and is not paged. Only {@code blocked} is used.
 */
public final class HttpBlocklistClient implements BlocklistClient {

    public static final String PATH = "/api/v1/plugin/blocklist";

    private final URI uri;
    private final String token;
    private final Duration timeout;
    private final HttpTransport transport;

    public HttpBlocklistClient(String baseUrl, String token, Duration timeout, HttpTransport transport) {
        String base = baseUrl.endsWith("/") ? baseUrl.substring(0, baseUrl.length() - 1) : baseUrl;
        this.uri = URI.create(base + PATH);
        this.token = token;
        this.timeout = timeout;
        this.transport = transport;
    }

    @Override
    public Set<String> fetchBlocked() throws IOException {
        HttpTransport.Response response = transport.get(uri,
                Map.of("Authorization", "Bearer " + token, "Accept", "application/json"), timeout);
        if (response.status() != 200) {
            throw new IOException("blocklist feed answered HTTP " + response.status());
        }
        JsonElement blocked;
        try {
            blocked = JsonParser.parseString(response.body()).getAsJsonObject().get("blocked");
        } catch (JsonParseException | IllegalStateException e) {
            throw new IOException("blocklist feed is not a JSON object", e);
        }
        if (blocked == null || !blocked.isJsonArray()) {
            throw new IOException("blocklist feed has no 'blocked' array");
        }
        JsonArray array = blocked.getAsJsonArray();
        Set<String> out = new HashSet<>(Math.max(16, array.size() * 2));
        for (JsonElement e : array) {
            if (!e.isJsonPrimitive()) {
                throw new IOException("blocklist feed has a non-string entry");
            }
            String hex = e.getAsString().trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (!hex.isEmpty()) {
                out.add(hex);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/blocklist/JdkHttpTransport.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.blocklist;

import javax.net.ssl.SSLContext;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.Map;

/** {@link HttpTransport} on {@code java.net.http.HttpClient}. Only call it from the dedicated sync thread. */
public final class JdkHttpTransport implements HttpTransport {

    private final HttpClient client;

    public JdkHttpTransport(Duration connectTimeout) {
        this(connectTimeout, null);
    }

    /** {@code sslContext} null = JVM default trust. */
    public JdkHttpTransport(Duration connectTimeout, SSLContext sslContext) {
        HttpClient.Builder builder = HttpClient.newBuilder().connectTimeout(connectTimeout)
                .followRedirects(HttpClient.Redirect.NEVER);
        if (sslContext != null) {
            builder.sslContext(sslContext);
        }
        this.client = builder.build();
    }

    @Override
    public Response get(URI uri, Map<String, String> headers, Duration timeout) throws IOException {
        HttpRequest.Builder request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(uri).timeout(timeout).GET();
        headers.forEach(request::header);
        try {
            HttpResponse<String> response = client.send(request.build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString());
            return new Response(response.statusCode(), response.body());
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new IOException("interrupted", e);
        }
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/blocklist/SyncedBlocklist.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.blocklist;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score.RateLimitedLog;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.InstantSource;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * The blocked pseudonyms last fetched from the control plane. Reads are lock-free; {@link #syncOnce()} runs on
 * the dedicated sync thread. A failed sync keeps the last good set; before the first success the set is empty,
 * so only the config lists apply.
 */
public final class SyncedBlocklist {

    private final BlocklistClient client;
    private final InstantSource clock;
    private final RateLimitedLog log;
    private final Runnable onChange;

    private volatile Set<String> blocked = Set.of();
    private volatile Instant lastSuccess;
    private volatile String lastResult = "never synced";

    /** @param onChange runs after every successful sync that changed the set. */
    public SyncedBlocklist(BlocklistClient client, InstantSource clock, RateLimitedLog log, Runnable onChange) {
        this.client = client;
        this.clock = clock;
        this.log = log;
        this.onChange = onChange;
    }

    /** @param pseudonymHex lower-case hex pseudonym */
    public boolean contains(String pseudonymHex) {
        Set<String> current = blocked;
        return !current.isEmpty() && current.contains(pseudonymHex);
    }

    public int size() {
        return blocked.size();
    }

    /** Never throws. */
    public void syncOnce() {
        Instant attempt = clock.instant();
        try {
            Set<String> fetched = Set.copyOf(client.fetchBlocked());
            boolean changed = !fetched.equals(blocked);
            blocked = fetched;
            lastSuccess = attempt;
            lastResult = "ok";
            if (changed) {
                onChange.run();
            }
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException e) {
            lastResult = "failed at " + attempt + ": " + e.getMessage();
            log.warn("Blocklist sync failed, keeping the last good list (" + blocked.size() + " entries): "
                    + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    /** One line for {@code /corvus stats}. */
    public String status() {
        return "blocklist_size=" + blocked.size()
                + " blocklist_last_sync=" + (lastSuccess == null ? "never" : lastSuccess.toString())
                + " blocklist_last_result=\"" + lastResult + "\"";
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/blocklist/TokenLoader.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.blocklist;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.util.function.Function;

/** Loads the plugin API token from env var CORVUS_PLUGIN_API_TOKEN or a token file. The token is never logged. */
public final class TokenLoader {

    public static final String ENV_VAR = "CORVUS_PLUGIN_API_TOKEN";

    private TokenLoader() {
    }

    public static Optional<String> load(Function<String, String> env, String tokenFile, Path dataDir,
                                        Consumer<String> warn) {
        String token = env.apply(ENV_VAR);
        if (token == null || token.isBlank()) {
            if (tokenFile == null || tokenFile.isBlank()) {
                warn.accept("blocklist_sync.enabled but no token (set " + ENV_VAR
                        + " or blocklist_sync.token_file). Blocklist sync is DISABLED.");
                return Optional.empty();
            }
            try {
                token = Files.readString(dataDir.resolve(tokenFile), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                warn.accept("Cannot read blocklist_sync.token_file (" + e.getClass().getSimpleName()
                        + "). Blocklist sync is DISABLED.");
                return Optional.empty();
            }
        }
        token = token.trim();
        if (token.isEmpty()) {
            warn.accept("blocklist_sync token is empty. Blocklist sync is DISABLED.");
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return Optional.of(token);
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/ByteBoundedQueue.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;

/** Unbounded-count, byte-bounded, lock-free multi-producer queue with a single consumer. */
public final class ByteBoundedQueue implements CaptureSink {

    private record Entry(WriteItem item, long size) {
    }

    private final ConcurrentLinkedQueue<Entry> queue = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
    private final AtomicLong bytes = new AtomicLong();
    private final long maxBytes;

    public ByteBoundedQueue(long maxBytes) {
        this.maxBytes = maxBytes;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean offer(WriteItem item) {
        long size = item.sizeBytes();
        if (bytes.addAndGet(size) > maxBytes) {
            bytes.addAndGet(-size);
            return false;
        }
        queue.add(new Entry(item, size));
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void offerControl(WriteItem item) {
        long size = item.sizeBytes();
        bytes.addAndGet(size);
        queue.add(new Entry(item, size));
    }

    /** Single consumer only. */
    public WriteItem poll() {
        Entry e = queue.poll();
        if (e == null) {
            return null;
        }
        bytes.addAndGet(-e.size);
        return e.item;
    }

    public long bytes() {
        return bytes.get();
    }

    public long maxBytes() {
        return maxBytes;
    }
}

```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/CaptureEngine.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import com.google.protobuf.ByteString;
import com.google.protobuf.UnsafeByteOperations;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PayloadMode;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PayloadPolicy;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PlayerFilter;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PrivacyFilter;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.Pseudonymizer;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.time.NanoClock;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.vocab.CorvusPacket;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.ConnectionState;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Envelope;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Frame;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.SegmentStart;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.SessionStart;

import java.time.InstantSource;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.util.function.Supplier;

/**
 * Core capture logic, independent of PacketEvents' runtime. Everything in {@link #onPacket} runs on a Netty
 * event loop: it does at most one payload copy and non-blocking queue offers, and it never throws.
 */
public final class CaptureEngine {

    public record Settings(PayloadMode payloadMode, int maxPayloadBytes, String proxyId, String pluginVersion) {
    }

    private final Settings settings;
    private final PayloadPolicy payloadPolicy;
    private final Pseudonymizer pseudonymizer; // null: fail closed, nothing is captured
    private final PlayerFilter playerFilter;
    private final GameContextMapper contexts;
    private final CaptureSink sink;
    private final NanoClock nanoClock;
    private final InstantSource wallClock;
    private final Supplier<byte[]> sessionIds;
    private final Metrics metrics;
    private final Consumer<String> info;
    private final Map<UUID, SessionState> sessions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private volatile boolean shutdown;

    public CaptureEngine(Settings settings, Pseudonymizer pseudonymizer, PlayerFilter playerFilter,
                         GameContextMapper contexts, CaptureSink sink, NanoClock nanoClock, InstantSource wallClock,
                         Supplier<byte[]> sessionIds, Metrics metrics, Consumer<String> info) {
        this.settings = settings;
        this.payloadPolicy = new PayloadPolicy(settings.payloadMode());
        this.pseudonymizer = pseudonymizer;
        this.playerFilter = playerFilter;
        this.contexts = contexts;
        this.sink = sink;
        this.nanoClock = nanoClock;
        this.wallClock = wallClock;
        this.sessionIds = sessionIds;
        this.metrics = metrics;
        this.info = info;
    }

    public boolean isCapturing() {
        return pseudonymizer != null && !shutdown;
    }

    public int activeSessions() {
        return sessions.size();
    }

    /** Never throws. */
    public void onPacket(PacketView view) {
        try {
            handle(view);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            UUID player = null;
            try {
                player = view.playerId();
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                // the failure may be the view itself
            }
            recordListenerError(player);
        }
    }

    /** Counts a listener failure, attributed to the player's session if known. Never throws. */
    public void recordListenerError(UUID player) {
        metrics.listenerErrors.increment();
        if (player != null) {
            SessionState s = sessions.get(player);
            if (s != null) {
                s.addListenerError();
            }
        }
    }

    private void handle(PacketView view) {
        if (!isCapturing()) {
            return;
        }
        UUID player = view.playerId();
        if (player == null) {
            metrics.ignoredNoPlayer.increment();
            return;
        }
        if (!playerFilter.allows(player)) {
            return;
        }
        SessionState session = sessions.computeIfAbsent(player, p -> openSession(p, view));
        Object channel = view.channelKey();
        if (session.channelKey() != channel && session.markMultiChannelLogged()) {
            metrics.sessionsWithMultipleChannels.increment();
            info.accept("session " + session.idHex() + " is fed by more than one channel: PacketEvents "
                    + "also sees another connection of this player (backend side?)");
        }

        ConnectionState state = view.state();
        if (PrivacyFilter.isPrivate(view.packetType(), state)) {
            session.addDroppedPrivacy();
            metrics.droppedPrivacy.increment();
            return;
        }

        Frame.Builder frame = Frame.newBuilder()
                .setSeq(session.nextSeq())
                .setOffsetNanos(Math.max(0L, nanoClock.nanoTime() - session.startNanos()))
                .setDirection(view.direction())
                .setState(state)
                .setWirePacketId(view.wirePacketId())
                .setPacketType(CorvusPacket.idOf(view.packetType()));
        if (payloadPolicy.recordsPayload(view.packetType(), view.direction(), state)) {
            frame.setPayload(UnsafeByteOperations.unsafeWrap(view.copyPayload(settings.maxPayloadBytes())));
            frame.setPayloadOriginalSize(view.payloadSize());
        }
        try {
            view.decodeEvent(frame);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            // keep the frame (raw bytes are still valuable), but make the failure visible
            recordListenerError(player);
            frame.clearEvent();
        }

        WriteItem.FrameItem item = new WriteItem.FrameItem(session, session.segment(), frame.build());
        if (sink.offer(item)) {
            metrics.framesCaptured.increment();
            metrics.bytesCaptured.add(item.sizeBytes());
        } else {
            session.addDroppedQueueFull();
            metrics.droppedQueueFull.increment();
        }
    }

    private SessionState openSession(UUID player, PacketView view) {
        PacketView.SessionInfo sessionInfo = view.sessionInfo();
        SessionState session = new SessionState(sessionIds.get(), nanoClock.nanoTime(),
                wallClock.millis(), view.channelKey());
        SessionStart start = SessionStart.newBuilder()
                .setSessionId(session.idBytes())
                .setPlayerPseudonym(ByteString.copyFrom(pseudonymizer.pseudonym(player)))
                .setPseudonymKeyId(pseudonymizer.keyId())
                .setClientProtocolVersion(sessionInfo.clientProtocolVersion())
                .setObservedProtocolVersion(sessionInfo.observedProtocolVersion())
                .setProxyId(settings.proxyId())
                .setPluginVersion(settings.pluginVersion())
                .setStartedAtUnixMillis(session.startedAtMillis())
                .build();
        sink.offerControl(new WriteItem.Start(session, Envelope.newBuilder().setSessionStart(start).build()));
        metrics.sessionsStarted.increment();
        if (sessionInfo.viaBeforePacketEvents()) {
            metrics.sessionsViaBeforePacketEvents.increment();
        }
        info.accept("session " + session.idHex() + " started: client_protocol=" + sessionInfo.clientProtocolVersion()
                + " observed_protocol=" + sessionInfo.observedProtocolVersion()
                + (sessionInfo.clientProtocolVersion() == sessionInfo.observedProtocolVersion()
                ? " (observed == client)" : " (observed != client: frames are NOT in the client's native version)")
                + " via_before_packetevents=" + sessionInfo.viaBeforePacketEvents()
                + " " + sessionInfo.diagnostics());
        return session;
    }

    /** A player connected to (or switched to) a backend server. Never throws. */
    public void onBackendConnected(UUID player, String serverName, String clientBrand) {
        try {
            SessionState session = sessions.get(player);
            if (session == null || !isCapturing()) {
                return;
            }
            SegmentStart segment = SegmentStart.newBuilder()
                    .setSessionId(session.idBytes())
                    .setSegment(session.nextSegment())
                    .setBackendServer(serverName == null ? "" : serverName)
                    .setGameContext(contexts.contextFor(serverName))
                    .setClientBrand(clientBrand == null ? "" : clientBrand)
                    .setStartedAtUnixMillis(wallClock.millis())
                    .build();
            sink.offerControl(new WriteItem.Segment(session, Envelope.newBuilder().setSegmentStart(segment).build()));
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            recordListenerError(player);
        }
    }

    /** The player disconnected: ends the session. Never throws. */
    public void onDisconnect(UUID player) {
        try {
            SessionState session = sessions.remove(player);
            if (session != null) {
                endSession(session);
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            metrics.listenerErrors.increment();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Ends the session of every online player the filter no longer allows (the blocklist changed). Later frames of
     * these players are ignored by the filter. Never throws.
     *
     * @return the number of sessions ended
     */
    public int endBlockedSessions() {
        int ended = 0;
        try {
            for (UUID player : sessions.keySet()) {
                if (!playerFilter.allows(player)) {
                    SessionState session = sessions.remove(player);
                    if (session != null) {
                        endSession(session);
                        ended++;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            metrics.listenerErrors.increment();
        }
        return ended;
    }

    /** Stops capturing and ends all sessions. */
    public void shutdown() {
        shutdown = true;
        for (UUID player : sessions.keySet()) {
            onDisconnect(player);
        }
    }

    private void endSession(SessionState session) {
        session.close();
        sink.offerControl(new WriteItem.End(session, wallClock.millis()));
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/CaptureSink.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

/** Port between the capture engine (Netty threads) and the writer. Must never block. */
public interface CaptureSink {

    /** Offers a frame; false means the bound was hit and the frame must be dropped. */
    boolean offer(WriteItem item);

    /** Offers a small lifecycle item (start/segment/end); it is accepted even if the queue is full. */
    void offerControl(WriteItem item);
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/CaptureWriter.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.time.NanoClock;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.CaptureBatch;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Envelope;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Frame;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.SessionEnd;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

/**
 * Drains the queue, batches frames per session and hands the resulting {@link Envelope}s to an
 * {@link EnvelopeTransport}. Not thread-safe: exactly one writer thread (or a test) calls it.
 */
public final class CaptureWriter {

    private static final class Target {
        final SessionState session;
        boolean opened;
        boolean failed;
        final List<Frame> pending = new ArrayList<>();
        int pendingSegment;
        long lastFlushNanos;

        Target(SessionState session) {
            this.session = session;
        }
    }

    private final EnvelopeTransport transport;
    private final ByteBoundedQueue queue;
    private final int batchSize;
    private final long flushIntervalNanos;
    private final NanoClock clock;
    private final Metrics metrics;
    private final Consumer<String> warn;
    private final Map<SessionState, Target> targets = new HashMap<>();

    /** File sink: one {@code .cvc} file per session below {@code capturesDir}. */
    public CaptureWriter(Path capturesDir, ByteBoundedQueue queue, int batchSize, long flushIntervalMillis,
                         NanoClock clock, Metrics metrics, Consumer<String> warn) {
        this(new FileTransport(capturesDir), queue, batchSize, flushIntervalMillis, clock, metrics, warn);
    }

    public CaptureWriter(EnvelopeTransport transport, ByteBoundedQueue queue, int batchSize,
                         long flushIntervalMillis, NanoClock clock, Metrics metrics, Consumer<String> warn) {
        this.transport = transport;
        this.queue = queue;
        this.batchSize = batchSize;
        this.flushIntervalNanos = flushIntervalMillis * 1_000_000L;
        this.clock = clock;
        this.metrics = metrics;
        this.warn = warn;
    }

    /** Processes up to {@code max} queued items. @return the number processed. */
    public int drain(int max) {
        int n = 0;
        WriteItem item;
        while (n < max && (item = queue.poll()) != null) {
            n++;
            try {
                handle(item);
            } catch (Throwable t) {
                fail(targetFor(item.session()), t);
                if (item instanceof WriteItem.End) {
                    targets.remove(item.session());
                }
            }
        }
        return n;
    }

    /** Flushes sessions whose oldest buffered frames have waited for the flush interval. */
    public void flushDue() {
        transport.poll();
        long now = clock.nanoTime();
        for (Target t : targets.values()) {
            if (!t.pending.isEmpty() && now - t.lastFlushNanos >= flushIntervalNanos) {
                try {
                    flushPending(t);
                } catch (Throwable e) {
                    fail(t, e);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /** Drains everything that is queued, flushes and closes all sessions and the transport. */
    public void closeAll() {
        while (drain(1024) > 0) {
            // keep draining
        }
        for (Iterator<Target> it = targets.values().iterator(); it.hasNext(); ) {
            Target t = it.next();
            try {
                flushPending(t);
            } catch (Throwable e) {
                fail(t, e);
            }
            close(t);
            it.remove();
        }
        transport.close();
    }

    private void handle(WriteItem item) throws IOException {
        Target t = targetFor(item.session());
        switch (item) {
            case WriteItem.Start s -> {
                transport.begin(t.session, s.envelope());
                t.opened = true;
                t.lastFlushNanos = clock.nanoTime();
            }
            case WriteItem.Segment s -> {
                flushPending(t);
                send(t, s.envelope(), 0);
            }
            case WriteItem.FrameItem f -> {
                if (t.failed) {
                    return;
                }
                if (!t.pending.isEmpty() && t.pendingSegment != f.segment()) {
                    flushPending(t);
                }
                if (t.pending.isEmpty()) {
                    t.pendingSegment = f.segment();
                }
                t.pending.add(f.frame());
                if (t.pending.size() >= batchSize) {
                    flushPending(t);
                }
            }
            case WriteItem.End e -> {
                flushPending(t);
                SessionEnd end = SessionEnd.newBuilder()
                        .setSessionId(e.session().idBytes())
                        .setEndedAtUnixMillis(e.endedAtMillis())
                        .setCounters(e.session().takeCounters())
                        .build();
                send(t, Envelope.newBuilder().setSessionEnd(end).build(), 0);
                close(t);
                targets.remove(e.session());
            }
        }
    }

    private Target targetFor(SessionState session) {
        return targets.computeIfAbsent(session, s -> {
            Target t = new Target(s);
            t.lastFlushNanos = clock.nanoTime();
            return t;
        });
    }

    private void send(Target t, Envelope envelope, int frameCount) throws IOException {
        if (t.failed || !t.opened) {
            return;
        }
        transport.send(t.session, envelope, frameCount);
    }

    private void flushPending(Target t) throws IOException {
        if (t.pending.isEmpty() || t.failed || !t.opened) {
            t.pending.clear();
            return;
        }
        CaptureBatch batch = CaptureBatch.newBuilder()
                .setSessionId(t.session.idBytes())
                .setSegment(t.pendingSegment)
                .addAllFrames(t.pending)
                .setCounters(t.session.takeCounters())
                .build();
        t.pending.clear();
        send(t, Envelope.newBuilder().setBatch(batch).build(), batch.getFramesCount());
        t.lastFlushNanos = clock.nanoTime();
    }

    private void fail(Target t, Throwable cause) {
        if (!t.failed) {
            t.failed = true;
            metrics.writerErrors.increment();
            warn.accept("Capture output of session " + t.session.idHex() + " failed, dropping the rest of it: "
                    + cause);
        }
        t.pending.clear();
        close(t);
    }

    private void close(Target t) {
        if (t.opened) {
            t.opened = false;
            transport.end(t.session);
        }
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/EnvelopePublisher.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletionStage;

/**
 * Port over the single publish call of the transport (JetStream async publish in production, a fake in tests).
 * Must never block: it returns immediately and completes the stage when the broker acknowledged the message, or
 * exceptionally when the publish failed or timed out.
 */
public interface EnvelopePublisher {

    CompletionStage<Void> publish(String subject, Map<String, String> headers, byte[] body);

    /** Flushes what is buffered, waiting at most {@code timeout}, then releases the connection. */
    /** True when a connection exists, so deferred lifecycle envelopes can be published. */
    boolean isReady();

    void close(Duration timeout);
}

```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/EnvelopeTransport.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Envelope;

import java.io.IOException;

/**
 * Where finished envelopes go (a file per session or NATS JetStream). Called only from the single writer
 * thread. The batching of frames stays in {@link CaptureWriter}; implementations only move envelopes.
 */
public interface EnvelopeTransport {

    /** Delivers the first envelope ({@code SessionStart}) of a session. */
    void begin(SessionState session, Envelope sessionStart) throws IOException;

    /**
     * Delivers a later envelope of a session.
     *
     * @param frameCount number of frames inside the envelope (0 unless it is a {@code CaptureBatch}); used to
     *                   account frames that could not be delivered
     */
    void send(SessionState session, Envelope envelope, int frameCount) throws IOException;

    /** Releases the per-session resources; no further envelopes follow for this session. */
    void end(SessionState session);

    /** Releases everything, waiting only a short bounded time for outstanding deliveries. */
    /** Called regularly by the writer thread; lets a transport retry deferred work. Default: nothing. */
    default void poll() {
    }

    void close();
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/FileTransport.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Envelope;

import java.io.BufferedOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/** Writes {@code captures/<yyyy-MM-dd>/<session-id-hex>.cvc} files (length-delimited {@link Envelope}s). */
public final class FileTransport implements EnvelopeTransport {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter DAY = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd").withZone(ZoneOffset.UTC);

    private final Path capturesDir;
    private final Map<SessionState, OutputStream> streams = new HashMap<>();

    public FileTransport(Path capturesDir) {
        this.capturesDir = capturesDir;
    }

    @Override
    public void begin(SessionState session, Envelope sessionStart) throws IOException {
        Path dir = capturesDir.resolve(DAY.format(Instant.ofEpochMilli(session.startedAtMillis())));
        Files.createDirectories(dir);
        OutputStream out = new BufferedOutputStream(
                Files.newOutputStream(dir.resolve(session.idHex() + ".cvc")), 64 * 1024);
        streams.put(session, out);
        send(session, sessionStart, 0);
    }

    @Override
    public void send(SessionState session, Envelope envelope, int frameCount) throws IOException {
        OutputStream out = streams.get(session);
        if (out == null) {
            return;
        }
        envelope.writeDelimitedTo(out);
        out.flush();
    }

    @Override
    public void end(SessionState session) {
        OutputStream out = streams.remove(session);
        if (out != null) {
            try {
                out.close();
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
                // nothing sensible left to do
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        for (SessionState s : List.copyOf(streams.keySet())) {
            end(s);
        }
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/GameContextMapper.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Maps backend server names to game-context tags. Lookup order: exact (lower-cased) name, then the name without one
 * trailing CloudNet instance suffix {@code -<digits>} (when enabled), then the default.
 */
public final class GameContextMapper {

    private static final Pattern INSTANCE_SUFFIX = Pattern.compile("-\\d+$");

    private final Map<String, String> servers;
    private final String defaultContext;
    private final boolean stripInstanceSuffix;

    public GameContextMapper(Map<String, String> servers, String defaultContext) {
        this(servers, defaultContext, true);
    }

    public GameContextMapper(Map<String, String> servers, String defaultContext, boolean stripInstanceSuffix) {
        this.servers = Map.copyOf(servers);
        this.defaultContext = defaultContext;
        this.stripInstanceSuffix = stripInstanceSuffix;
    }

    public String contextFor(String serverName) {
        if (serverName == null) {
            return defaultContext;
        }
        String name = serverName.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String exact = servers.get(name);
        if (exact != null) {
            return exact;
        }
        if (stripInstanceSuffix) {
            String task = INSTANCE_SUFFIX.matcher(name).replaceFirst("");
            if (!task.equals(name) && !task.isEmpty()) {
                return servers.getOrDefault(task, defaultContext);
            }
        }
        return defaultContext;
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/NatsTransport.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.time.NanoClock;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.CaptureBatch;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.CaptureCounters;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Envelope;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Frame;

import com.google.protobuf.CodedOutputStream;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

/**
 * Publishes envelopes to {@code <prefix>.<proxy_id>.<partition>} through an {@link EnvelopePublisher}, following the
 * contract in docs/reference/data-lake.md. Never blocks: when the in-flight byte budget is exhausted or a
 * publish fails, the envelope is dropped and its frames are counted as {@code dropped_transport}.
 */
public final class NatsTransport implements EnvelopeTransport {

    public static final String SCHEMA_HEADER = "Corvus-Schema";
    public static final String SCHEMA_VALUE = "capture.v1";
    public static final String MSG_ID_HEADER = "Nats-Msg-Id";
    /** Every serialized envelope stays below this size (the stream allows 1 MiB). */
    public static final int MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES = 512 * 1024;
    public static final Duration SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT = Duration.ofSeconds(3);
    public static final int DEFAULT_BACKLOG_MAX_COUNT = 50_000;
    public static final long DEFAULT_BACKLOG_MAX_BYTES = 8L * 1024 * 1024;

    private static final int ENVELOPE_OVERHEAD = 16;
    private static final long WARN_INTERVAL_NANOS = 60_000_000_000L;

    private final EnvelopePublisher publisher;
    private final String subjectBase;
    private final Partitioner partitioner;
    private final String proxyId;
    private final String subjectPrefix;
    private final long maxInFlightBytes;
    private final NanoClock clock;
    private final Metrics metrics;
    private final Consumer<String> warn;
    private final AtomicLong inFlightBytes = new AtomicLong();
    private final Map<SessionState, Sess> sessions = new HashMap<>();
    /** Lifecycle envelopes not yet handed to the publisher, oldest first. Writer thread only. */
    private final ArrayDeque<Lifecycle> backlog = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private long backlogBytes;
    /** Lifecycle envelopes whose publish failed; merged back into the backlog by the writer thread. */
    private final ConcurrentLinkedQueue<Lifecycle> retries = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
    private final int backlogMaxCount;
    private final long backlogMaxBytes;
    private boolean warned;
    private long lastWarnNanos;
    private long suppressedWarnings;

    /** Per-session transport state. */
    private static final class Sess {
        final String subject;
        long next;
        /** True once the SessionStart was handed to the publisher; reset when that publish fails. */
        volatile boolean startSent;

        Sess(String subject) {
            this.subject = subject;
        }
    }

    private enum Kind { START, SEGMENT, END }

    private record Lifecycle(SessionState session, Sess sess, Kind kind, long n, byte[] body) {
    }

    public NatsTransport(EnvelopePublisher publisher, String subjectPrefix, String proxyId, int partitions,
                         long maxInFlightBytes, NanoClock clock, Metrics metrics, Consumer<String> warn) {
        this(publisher, subjectPrefix, proxyId, partitions, maxInFlightBytes, DEFAULT_BACKLOG_MAX_COUNT,
                DEFAULT_BACKLOG_MAX_BYTES, clock, metrics, warn);
    }

    public NatsTransport(EnvelopePublisher publisher, String subjectPrefix, String proxyId, int partitions,
                         long maxInFlightBytes, int backlogMaxCount, long backlogMaxBytes, NanoClock clock, Metrics metrics,
                         Consumer<String> warn) {
        this.backlogMaxCount = backlogMaxCount;
        this.backlogMaxBytes = backlogMaxBytes;
        this.publisher = publisher;
        this.subjectPrefix = subjectPrefix;
        this.proxyId = proxyId;
        this.partitioner = new Partitioner(partitions);
        this.subjectBase = subjectPrefix + "." + proxyId + ".*";
        this.maxInFlightBytes = maxInFlightBytes;
        this.clock = clock;
        this.metrics = metrics;
        this.warn = warn;
    }

    public long inFlightBytes() {
        return inFlightBytes.get();
    }

    @Override
    public void begin(SessionState session, Envelope sessionStart) {
        Sess sess = newSess(session);
        sessions.put(session, sess);
        enqueueLifecycle(session, sess, Kind.START, sessionStart);
    }

    @Override
    public void send(SessionState session, Envelope envelope, int frameCount) {
        Sess sess = sessions.computeIfAbsent(session, this::newSess);
        if (!envelope.hasBatch()) {
            enqueueLifecycle(session, sess, envelope.hasSessionEnd() ? Kind.END : Kind.SEGMENT, envelope);
            return;
        }
        CaptureBatch batch = envelope.getBatch();
        List<CaptureBatch> parts = split(batch, MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES);
        for (int i = 0; i < parts.size(); i++) {
            CaptureBatch part = parts.get(i);
            // Only the first part carries the counters so they are not summed twice by ingest.
            CaptureCounters carried = i == 0 ? part.getCounters() : null;
            publishBatch(session, sess, Envelope.newBuilder().setBatch(part).build(), part.getFramesCount(),
                    carried);
        }
    }

    private Sess newSess(SessionState session) {
        return new Sess(partitioner.subject(subjectPrefix, proxyId, session.idBytes().toByteArray()));
    }

    @Override
    public void end(SessionState session) {
        // Queued lifecycle entries keep their own reference to the per-session state.
        sessions.remove(session);
    }

    @Override
    public void poll() {
        drainBacklog();
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        drainBacklog();
        publisher.close(SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT);
    }

    /** Lifecycle envelopes wait here until a connection exists; they are published first and in order. */
    private void enqueueLifecycle(SessionState session, Sess sess, Kind kind, Envelope envelope) {
        // The counter always advances, also for dropped envelopes: a timed-out publish may still have been
        // stored, and reusing its id would make JetStream discard the next real envelope as a duplicate.
        long n = sess.next++;
        byte[] body = envelope.toByteArray();
        backlog.addLast(new Lifecycle(session, sess, kind, n, body));
        backlogBytes += body.length;
        enforceBacklogBounds();
        drainBacklog();
    }

    /** Overflow policy: oldest SessionEnd first, then oldest SegmentStart; a SessionStart is never dropped. */
    private void enforceBacklogBounds() {
        while (backlog.size() > backlogMaxCount || backlogBytes > backlogMaxBytes) {
            Lifecycle victim = oldest(Kind.END);
            if (victim == null) {
                victim = oldest(Kind.SEGMENT);
            }
            if (victim == null) {
                return;
            }
            backlog.remove(victim);
            backlogBytes -= victim.body().length;
            metrics.lifecycleDropped.increment();
            warnThrottled("lifecycle backlog full, dropped a " + victim.kind() + " envelope", 0, null);
        }
    }

    private Lifecycle oldest(Kind kind) {
        for (Lifecycle l : backlog) {
            if (l.kind() == kind) {
                return l;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private void drainBacklog() {
        for (Lifecycle l; (l = retries.poll()) != null; ) {
            backlog.addFirst(l);
            backlogBytes += l.body().length;
        }
        while (!backlog.isEmpty() && publisher.isReady()) {
            Lifecycle l = backlog.pollFirst();
            backlogBytes -= l.body().length;
            publishLifecycle(l);
        }
    }

    private void publishLifecycle(Lifecycle l) {
        inFlightBytes.addAndGet(l.body().length);
        if (l.kind() == Kind.START) {
            l.sess().startSent = true;
        }
        try {
            publisher.publish(l.sess().subject, headers(l.session(), l.n()), l.body()).whenComplete((v, error) -> {
                inFlightBytes.addAndGet(-l.body().length);
                if (error != null) {
                    requeue(l, error);
                }
            });
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            inFlightBytes.addAndGet(-l.body().length);
            requeue(l, t);
        }
    }

    private void requeue(Lifecycle l, Throwable error) {
        if (l.kind() == Kind.START) {
            l.sess().startSent = false;
        }
        retries.add(l);
        warnThrottled("lifecycle publish failed, will retry", 0, error);
    }

    private void publishBatch(SessionState session, Sess sess, Envelope envelope, int frames,
                              CaptureCounters carried) {
        long n = sess.next++;
        byte[] body = envelope.toByteArray();
        if (!sess.startSent) {
            // Never send frames ahead of the SessionStart: ingest could not link them to a pseudonym.
            drop(session, frames, carried, "SessionStart not published yet", null);
            return;
        }
        if (body.length > MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES || !reserve(body.length, false)) {
            drop(session, frames, carried, body.length > MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES
                    ? "envelope larger than " + MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES + " bytes"
                    : "in-flight budget of " + maxInFlightBytes + " bytes exhausted", null);
            return;
        }
        try {
            publisher.publish(sess.subject, headers(session, n), body).whenComplete((v, error) -> {
                inFlightBytes.addAndGet(-body.length);
                if (error != null) {
                    drop(session, frames, carried, "publish failed", error);
                }
            });
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            inFlightBytes.addAndGet(-body.length);
            drop(session, frames, carried, "publish failed", t);
        }
    }

    private static Map<String, String> headers(SessionState session, long n) {
        return Map.of(MSG_ID_HEADER, session.idHex() + "-" + n, SCHEMA_HEADER, SCHEMA_VALUE);
    }

    private boolean reserve(long size, boolean control) {
        // Only frames are budgeted; lifecycle envelopes are small and bounded by their own backlog.
        if (!control && inFlightBytes.get() + size > maxInFlightBytes) {
            return false;
        }
        inFlightBytes.addAndGet(size);
        return true;
    }

    private void drop(SessionState session, int frames, CaptureCounters carried, String reason, Throwable error) {
        metrics.transportFailures.increment();
        if (frames > 0) {
            metrics.droppedTransport.add(frames);
            session.addDroppedTransport(frames);
        }
        if (carried != null) {
            session.restoreCounters(carried);
        }
        warnThrottled(reason, frames, error);
    }

    private synchronized void warnThrottled(String reason, int frames, Throwable error) {
        long now = clock.nanoTime();
        if (warned && now - lastWarnNanos < WARN_INTERVAL_NANOS) {
            suppressedWarnings++;
            return;
        }
        String cause = error == null ? "" : ": " + rootMessage(error);
        String hint = looksLikeMissingStream(error)
                ? " (does the JetStream stream CORVUS_CAPTURE with subject " + subjectBase + " exist? "
                + "ingest/ops own it, the plugin does not create it)"
                : "";
        warn.accept("NATS " + reason + cause + ", dropped " + frames + " frame(s) on " + subjectBase + hint
                + (suppressedWarnings > 0 ? " [" + suppressedWarnings + " more since the last warning]" : ""));
        warned = true;
        lastWarnNanos = now;
        suppressedWarnings = 0;
    }

    private static boolean looksLikeMissingStream(Throwable error) {
        for (Throwable t = error; t != null; t = t.getCause()) {
            String m = String.valueOf(t.getMessage()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
            if (m.contains("no responders") || m.contains("stream not found") || m.contains("503")
                    || m.contains("10059")) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static String rootMessage(Throwable error) {
        Throwable t = error;
        while (t.getCause() != null) {
            t = t.getCause();
        }
        return t.getClass().getSimpleName() + (t.getMessage() == null ? "" : " " + t.getMessage());
    }

    /**
     * Splits a batch so that each serialized envelope stays below {@code maxEnvelopeBytes}. Frames keep their
     * order; the counters stay on the first part only.
     */
    static List<CaptureBatch> split(CaptureBatch batch, int maxEnvelopeBytes) {
        if (batch.getSerializedSize() + ENVELOPE_OVERHEAD <= maxEnvelopeBytes) {
            return List.of(batch);
        }
        CaptureBatch empty = batch.toBuilder().clearFrames().build();
        long base = empty.getSerializedSize() + ENVELOPE_OVERHEAD;
        List<CaptureBatch> out = new ArrayList<>();
        CaptureBatch.Builder current = null;
        long size = 0;
        for (Frame f : batch.getFramesList()) {
            long cost = CodedOutputStream.computeMessageSize(CaptureBatch.FRAMES_FIELD_NUMBER, f);
            if (current != null && base + size + cost > maxEnvelopeBytes) {
                out.add(current.build());
                current = null;
            }
            if (current == null) {
                current = empty.toBuilder();
                if (!out.isEmpty()) {
                    current.clearCounters();
                }
                size = 0;
            }
            current.addFrames(f);
            size += cost;
        }
        if (current != null) {
            out.add(current.build());
        }
        return out;
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/Partitioner.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

/**
 * Maps a session to its partition, the last token of the publish subject
 * {@code <prefix>.<proxy_id>.<partition>} (docs/reference/data-lake.md, section 1).
 *
 * <p>partition = first 4 bytes of the session id as big-endian unsigned int, modulo the partition count. The
 * partition is written as decimal with at least two digits ({@code 00}..{@code 15} for the default 16); for more
 * than 100 partitions the width grows to the digits of the highest partition (128 gives {@code 000}..{@code 127}).
 * Scorers must use the same formatting in their filter subjects.
 */
public final class Partitioner {

    public static final int DEFAULT_PARTITIONS = 16;
    private static final int MIN_DIGITS = 2;

    private final int partitions;
    private final String format;

    public Partitioner(int partitions) {
        if (partitions < 1) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("partitions must be >= 1, got " + partitions);
        }
        this.partitions = partitions;
        int digits = Math.max(MIN_DIGITS, Integer.toString(partitions - 1).length());
        this.format = "%0" + digits + "d";
    }

    public int partitions() {
        return partitions;
    }

    /** Partition number of {@code sessionId}; ids shorter than 4 bytes are zero-padded on the right. */
    public int partition(byte[] sessionId) {
        long head = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            head = (head << 8) | (i < sessionId.length ? sessionId[i] & 0xffL : 0L);
        }
        return (int) (head % partitions);
    }

    /** The zero-padded subject token of {@code sessionId}. */
    public String token(byte[] sessionId) {
        return format.formatted(partition(sessionId));
    }

    /** The publish subject {@code <prefix>.<proxy_id>.<partition>} of {@code sessionId}. */
    public String subject(String subjectPrefix, String proxyId, byte[] sessionId) {
        return subjectPrefix + "." + proxyId + "." + token(sessionId);
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/PayloadCopier.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf;

/** Copies buffer content with absolute-index reads only; reader/writer index and refCnt are never touched. */
public final class PayloadCopier {

    private PayloadCopier() {
    }

    /** Copies the readable bytes (reader index to writer index), truncated to {@code maxBytes}. */
    public static byte[] copyReadable(ByteBuf buf, int maxBytes) {
        int length = Math.min(buf.readableBytes(), maxBytes);
        byte[] out = new byte[length];
        buf.getBytes(buf.readerIndex(), out);
        return out;
    }
}
```
