`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/SessionState.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import com.google.protobuf.ByteString;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.CaptureCounters;

import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;

/** Per-connection capture state. Counters are written by Netty threads and drained by the writer. */
public final class SessionState {

    private final byte[] id;
    private final String idHex;
    private final long startNanos;
    private final long startedAtMillis;
    private final Object channelKey;
    private final AtomicLong seq = new AtomicLong();
    private final AtomicLong droppedQueueFull = new AtomicLong();
    private final AtomicLong droppedPrivacy = new AtomicLong();
    private final AtomicLong listenerErrors = new AtomicLong();
    private final AtomicLong droppedTransport = new AtomicLong();
    private volatile int segment;
    private volatile boolean closed;
    private volatile boolean multiChannelLogged;

    SessionState(byte[] id, long startNanos, long startedAtMillis, Object channelKey) {
        this.id = id;
        this.idHex = HexFormat.of().formatHex(id);
        this.startNanos = startNanos;
        this.startedAtMillis = startedAtMillis;
        this.channelKey = channelKey;
    }

    public ByteString idBytes() {
        return ByteString.copyFrom(id);
    }

    public String idHex() {
        return idHex;
    }

    long startNanos() {
        return startNanos;
    }

    public long startedAtMillis() {
        return startedAtMillis;
    }

    Object channelKey() {
        return channelKey;
    }

    long nextSeq() {
        return seq.getAndIncrement();
    }

    int segment() {
        return segment;
    }

    int nextSegment() {
        return ++segment;
    }

    boolean isClosed() {
        return closed;
    }

    void close() {
        closed = true;
    }

    boolean markMultiChannelLogged() {
        if (multiChannelLogged) {
            return false;
        }
        multiChannelLogged = true;
        return true;
    }

    void addDroppedQueueFull() {
        droppedQueueFull.incrementAndGet();
    }

    void addDroppedPrivacy() {
        droppedPrivacy.incrementAndGet();
    }

    /** Adds frames the transport could not deliver; reported with the next batch or the session end. */
    public void addDroppedTransport(long frames) {
        droppedTransport.addAndGet(frames);
    }

    /** Gives counters back that were taken for an envelope which then could not be delivered. */
    public void restoreCounters(CaptureCounters c) {
        droppedQueueFull.addAndGet(c.getDroppedQueueFull());
        droppedPrivacy.addAndGet(c.getDroppedPrivacy());
        listenerErrors.addAndGet(c.getListenerErrors());
        droppedTransport.addAndGet(c.getDroppedTransport());
    }

    void addListenerError() {
        listenerErrors.incrementAndGet();
    }

    /** Returns the counters accumulated since the previous call and resets them. */
    public CaptureCounters takeCounters() {
        return CaptureCounters.newBuilder()
                .setDroppedQueueFull(droppedQueueFull.getAndSet(0))
                .setDroppedPrivacy(droppedPrivacy.getAndSet(0))
                .setListenerErrors(listenerErrors.getAndSet(0))
                .setDroppedTransport(droppedTransport.getAndSet(0))
                .build();
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/StatsReporter.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.time.NanoClock;

import java.util.Locale;

/** Formats the pilot metrics; rates are measured since the previous call of the same reporter instance. */
public final class StatsReporter {

    private final Metrics metrics;
    private final ByteBoundedQueue queue;
    private final CaptureEngine engine;
    private final NanoClock clock;
    private long lastNanos;
    private long lastFrames;
    private long lastBytes;

    public StatsReporter(Metrics metrics, ByteBoundedQueue queue, CaptureEngine engine, NanoClock clock) {
        this.metrics = metrics;
        this.queue = queue;
        this.engine = engine;
        this.clock = clock;
        this.lastNanos = clock.nanoTime();
    }

    public synchronized String sample() {
        long now = clock.nanoTime();
        long frames = metrics.framesCaptured.sum();
        long bytes = metrics.bytesCaptured.sum();
        double seconds = Math.max(1e-3, (now - lastNanos) / 1e9);
        double fps = (frames - lastFrames) / seconds;
        double bps = (bytes - lastBytes) / seconds;
        lastNanos = now;
        lastFrames = frames;
        lastBytes = bytes;
        double fill = queue.maxBytes() == 0 ? 0 : 100.0 * queue.bytes() / queue.maxBytes();
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT,
                "capturing=%s sessions=%d frames/s=%.1f bytes/s=%.0f queue=%.1f%% (%d/%d B) "
                        + "dropped_queue_full=%d dropped_privacy=%d dropped_transport=%d listener_errors=%d writer_errors=%d "
                        + "sessions_via_before_pe=%d sessions_multi_channel=%d frames_total=%d",
                engine.isCapturing(), engine.activeSessions(), fps, bps, fill, queue.bytes(), queue.maxBytes(),
                metrics.droppedQueueFull.sum(), metrics.droppedPrivacy.sum(), metrics.droppedTransport.sum(),
                metrics.listenerErrors.sum(),
                metrics.writerErrors.sum(), metrics.sessionsViaBeforePacketEvents.sum(),
                metrics.sessionsWithMultipleChannels.sum(), frames);
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/WriteItem.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Envelope;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Frame;

/** Unit of work handed from the Netty threads to the single writer thread. */
public sealed interface WriteItem {

    SessionState session();

    /** Approximate memory held by this item, used for the queue's byte bound. */
    long sizeBytes();

    record Start(SessionState session, Envelope envelope) implements WriteItem {
        @Override
        public long sizeBytes() {
            return 128;
        }
    }

    record Segment(SessionState session, Envelope envelope) implements WriteItem {
        @Override
        public long sizeBytes() {
            return 128;
        }
    }

    record FrameItem(SessionState session, int segment, Frame frame) implements WriteItem {
        @Override
        public long sizeBytes() {
            return 64L + frame.getPayload().size();
        }
    }

    record End(SessionState session, long endedAtMillis) implements WriteItem {
        @Override
        public long sizeBytes() {
            return 64;
        }
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/WriterThread.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import java.util.concurrent.locks.LockSupport;

/** The single background thread that runs a {@link CaptureWriter}. */
public final class WriterThread {

    private static final long IDLE_PARK_NANOS = 5_000_000L;

    private final CaptureWriter writer;
    private final Thread thread;
    private volatile boolean running = true;

    public WriterThread(CaptureWriter writer) {
        this.writer = writer;
        this.thread = new Thread(this::run, "corvus-writer");
        this.thread.setDaemon(true);
    }

    public void start() {
        thread.start();
    }

    /** Stops the thread after it has drained the queue and closed all files. */
    public void stop() {
        running = false;
        LockSupport.unpark(thread);
        try {
            thread.join(15_000L);
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        }
    }

    private void run() {
        while (running) {
            int processed;
            try {
                processed = writer.drain(1024);
                writer.flushDue();
            } catch (Throwable t) {
                processed = 0;
            }
            if (processed == 0) {
                LockSupport.parkNanos(IDLE_PARK_NANOS);
            }
        }
        writer.closeAll();
    }
}
```

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.config;

import com.moandjiezana.toml.Toml;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PayloadMode;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

/** Immutable plugin configuration, parsed from {@code plugins/corvus/config.toml}. */
public record CorvusConfig(
        String proxyId,
        String keyFile,
        String keyId,
        ListMode listMode,
        Set<UUID> allowlist,
        Set<UUID> blocklist,
        PayloadMode payloadMode,
        int maxPayloadBytes,
        long queueMaxBytes,
        int batchSize,
        long flushIntervalMillis,
        String defaultGameContext,
        Map<String, String> serverContexts,
        boolean stripInstanceSuffix,
        SinkType sinkType,
        Nats nats,
        Scores scores,
        BlocklistSync blocklistSync,
        Tls tls) {

    public enum ListMode { ALL, ALLOWLIST }

    public enum SinkType { FILE, NATS }

    /** Settings of the NATS JetStream sink; only used when {@code sink.type = "nats"}. */
    public record Nats(
            List<String> urls,
            String credsFile,
            String subjectPrefix,
            long maxInFlightBytes,
            long publishTimeoutMillis,
            long reconnectBufferBytes,
            int partitions) {

        public static final String DEFAULT_SUBJECT_PREFIX = "corvus.capture.v1";
        public static final int DEFAULT_PARTITIONS = 16;

        public Nats {
            urls = List.copyOf(urls);
        }
    }

    /** Settings of the online score subscription; connection settings come from {@link Nats}. */
    public record Scores(boolean enabled, String subject, int listenerThreads, int listenerQueueSize) {

        public static final String DEFAULT_SUBJECT = "corvus.score.v1.>";
    }

    /**
     * Optional periodic fetch of the blocked pseudonyms from the control plane
     * ({@code GET <url>/api/v1/plugin/blocklist}). The token comes from CORVUS_PLUGIN_API_TOKEN or token_file.
     */
    public record BlocklistSync(boolean enabled, String url, String tokenFile, int intervalSeconds,
                                int timeoutSeconds) {

        public static final int DEFAULT_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 300;
        public static final int DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10;
    }

    /**
     * Extra trust for the NATS and control-plane connections: a PEM CA bundle that is trusted in addition to the
     * JVM default CAs. Empty = JVM default only. Relative paths are resolved against the plugin directory.
     */
    public record Tls(String caFile) {
    }

    public static final String DEFAULT_TOML = """
            # Corvus capture plugin. The HMAC pseudonym key is read from the environment variable
            # CORVUS_PSEUDONYM_KEY (base64) or from key_file. Without a key nothing is captured.
            proxy_id = "proxy-1"

            [pseudonym]
            # Path to a file containing the base64 key (used when the environment variable is unset).
            key_file = ""
            key_id = "k1"

            [players]
            # "all" captures everybody except the blocklist; "allowlist" only captures the allowlist.
            mode = "all"
            allowlist = []
            blocklist = []

            [capture]
            # Raw packet bytes to store: "none", "serverbound" or "all" (true = serverbound, false = none).
            # "serverbound": serverbound play packets except text-bearing ones (signs, books, anvil names,
            # plugin messages, command blocks...) plus a few clientbound motion packets. Other clientbound
            # packets carry names and UUIDs of other players and never keep their payload.
            # "all" is for local debugging only and logs a warning at startup.
            raw_payloads = "serverbound"
            # Payloads longer than this are truncated (chunk data etc. are not useful and expensive).
            max_payload_bytes = 2048
            # Upper bound of the in-memory queue between the Netty threads and the writer thread.
            queue_max_bytes = 67108864
            batch_size = 200
            flush_interval_seconds = 5

            [sink]
            # "file" writes captures/<date>/<session>.cvc below the plugin directory (pilot).
            # "nats" publishes every envelope to NATS JetStream (see [nats]); the stream is owned by ops.
            type = "file"

            [nats]
            # Required when sink.type = "nats": one URL or a list. Connects in the background; an outage never
            # delays the proxy.
            url = ["nats://localhost:4222"]
            # Optional NATS credentials file (.creds); empty = no authentication.
            creds_file = ""
            # Envelopes go to <subject_prefix>.<proxy_id>.<partition>.
            subject_prefix = "corvus.capture.v1"
            # Number of partitions: first 4 bytes of the session id (big-endian, unsigned) mod partitions, written
            # with at least two digits (00..15). Must be identical on all proxies and match the scorers.
            partitions = 16
            # Unacknowledged bytes allowed in flight; further batches are dropped (dropped_transport).
            max_in_flight_bytes = 33554432
            # A publish without an acknowledgement after this long counts as failed.
            publish_timeout_seconds = 5
            # Bytes jnats buffers while reconnecting; beyond this publishes fail.
            reconnect_buffer_bytes = 8388608

            [scores]
            # Subscribe to the scores of the scoring service and expose them through the corvus-api. Defaults to
            # true when sink.type = "nats" and false otherwise; set it explicitly to override. Needs [nats] url
            # and the pseudonym key (scores are mapped to online players through their pseudonym).
            # enabled = true
            subject = "corvus.score.v1.>"
            # Worker threads and queue size (updates) for score listeners of other plugins; a full queue drops updates.
            listener_threads = 2
            listener_queue = 1024

            [blocklist_sync]
            # Fetch the blocklist of the control plane (GET <url>/api/v1/plugin/blocklist, proxy API token) and
            # never capture the listed pseudonyms. On failure the last good list is kept.
            enabled = false

            url = ""

            token_file = ""
            interval_seconds = 300
            timeout_seconds = 10

            # the JVM default CAs for [nats] (tls:// and wss://) and [blocklist_sync] (https://). Relative to the
            # plugin directory, or absolute. Empty = JVM default CAs only. The JVM truststore is not changed.
            # If the file cannot be read, the NATS sink, scores and blocklist sync are not started (ERROR logged).
            ca_file = ""

            default = "unknown"

            # 1. the exact server name, 2. the name without ONE trailing "-<digits>" (Lobby-2 -> lobby,
            # Team-Build-1 -> team-build), 3. default. Names are matched case-insensitively. Set to false to

            strip_instance_suffix = true

            # server name (or CloudNet task name) = game context tag

    public CorvusConfig {
        allowlist = Set.copyOf(allowlist);
        blocklist = Set.copyOf(blocklist);
        serverContexts = Map.copyOf(serverContexts);
    }

    public static CorvusConfig parse(String tomlText) {
        Toml toml = new Toml().read(tomlText);
        String mode = toml.getString("players.mode", "all").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        ListMode listMode = switch (mode) {
            case "all" -> ListMode.ALL;
            case "allowlist" -> ListMode.ALLOWLIST;
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("players.mode must be 'all' or 'allowlist', got: " + mode);
        };
        Map<String, String> contexts = new HashMap<>();
        Toml servers = toml.getTable("game_context.servers");
        if (servers != null) {
            for (Map.Entry<String, Object> e : servers.entrySet()) {
                contexts.put(e.getKey().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), String.valueOf(e.getValue()));
            }
        }
        String sink = toml.getString("sink.type", "file").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        SinkType sinkType = switch (sink) {
            case "file" -> SinkType.FILE;
            case "nats" -> SinkType.NATS;
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("sink.type must be 'file' or 'nats', got: " + sink);
        };
        int maxPayload = (int) Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE, toml.getLong("capture.max_payload_bytes", 2048L));
        return new CorvusConfig(
                toml.getString("proxy_id", "proxy-1"),
                toml.getString("pseudonym.key_file", ""),
                toml.getString("pseudonym.key_id", "k1"),
                listMode,
                uuids(toml.getList("players.allowlist")),
                uuids(toml.getList("players.blocklist")),
                PayloadMode.parse(rawPayloadsValue(toml)),
                Math.max(0, maxPayload),
                Math.max(1024L, toml.getLong("capture.queue_max_bytes", 64L * 1024 * 1024)),
                (int) Math.max(1L, toml.getLong("capture.batch_size", 200L)),
                Math.max(100L, toml.getLong("capture.flush_interval_seconds", 5L) * 1000L),
                toml.getString("game_context.default", "unknown"),
                contexts,
                toml.getBoolean("game_context.strip_instance_suffix", true),
                sinkType,
                parseNats(toml, sinkType),
                parseScores(toml, sinkType),
                parseBlocklistSync(toml),
                new Tls(toml.getString("tls.ca_file", "").trim()));
    }

    private static BlocklistSync parseBlocklistSync(Toml toml) {
        boolean enabled = toml.getBoolean("blocklist_sync.enabled", false);
        String url = toml.getString("blocklist_sync.url", "").trim();
        if (enabled && url.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("blocklist_sync.enabled = true requires blocklist_sync.url");
        }
        return new BlocklistSync(
                enabled,
                url,
                toml.getString("blocklist_sync.token_file", "").trim(),
                (int) Math.min(86_400L, Math.max(5L, toml.getLong("blocklist_sync.interval_seconds",
                        (long) BlocklistSync.DEFAULT_INTERVAL_SECONDS))),
                (int) Math.min(120L, Math.max(1L, toml.getLong("blocklist_sync.timeout_seconds",
                        (long) BlocklistSync.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS))));
    }

    private static Scores parseScores(Toml toml, SinkType sinkType) {
        Toml scores = toml.getTable("scores");
        Object rawEnabled = scores == null ? null : scores.toMap().get("enabled");
        boolean enabled = rawEnabled instanceof Boolean b ? b : sinkType == SinkType.NATS;
        String subject = toml.getString("scores.subject", Scores.DEFAULT_SUBJECT).trim();
        return new Scores(
                enabled,
                subject.isEmpty() ? Scores.DEFAULT_SUBJECT : subject,
                (int) Math.min(16L, Math.max(1L, toml.getLong("scores.listener_threads", 2L))),
                (int) Math.min(1_000_000L, Math.max(1L, toml.getLong("scores.listener_queue", 1024L))));
    }

    private static Nats parseNats(Toml toml, SinkType sinkType) {
        List<String> urls = new ArrayList<>();
        Toml nats = toml.getTable("nats");
        Object rawUrl = nats == null ? null : nats.toMap().get("url");
        if (rawUrl instanceof List<?> list) {
            for (Object o : list) {
                urls.add(String.valueOf(o).trim());
            }
        } else if (rawUrl != null) {
            urls.add(String.valueOf(rawUrl).trim());
        }
        urls.removeIf(String::isEmpty);
        Object rawScores = toml.getTable("scores") == null ? null : toml.getTable("scores").toMap().get("enabled");
        boolean scoresOn = rawScores instanceof Boolean b && b;
        if (urls.isEmpty() && (sinkType == SinkType.NATS || scoresOn)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "sink.type = \"nats\" or scores.enabled = true requires nats.url (one URL or a list)");
        }
        String prefix = toml.getString("nats.subject_prefix", Nats.DEFAULT_SUBJECT_PREFIX).trim();
        return new Nats(
                urls,
                toml.getString("nats.creds_file", "").trim(),
                prefix.isEmpty() ? Nats.DEFAULT_SUBJECT_PREFIX : prefix,
                Math.max(1024L, toml.getLong("nats.max_in_flight_bytes", 32L * 1024 * 1024)),
                Math.max(1L, toml.getLong("nats.publish_timeout_seconds", 5L)) * 1000L,
                Math.max(64L * 1024, toml.getLong("nats.reconnect_buffer_bytes", 8L * 1024 * 1024)),
                (int) Math.min(100_000L, Math.max(1L, toml.getLong("nats.partitions", (long) Nats.DEFAULT_PARTITIONS))));
    }

    private static Object rawPayloadsValue(Toml toml) {
        Toml capture = toml.getTable("capture");
        return capture == null ? null : capture.toMap().get("raw_payloads");
    }

    private static Set<UUID> uuids(List<Object> raw) {
        Set<UUID> out = new HashSet<>();
        if (raw != null) {
            for (Object o : raw) {
                out.add(UUID.fromString(String.valueOf(o)));
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/nats/JetStreamEnvelopePublisher.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.nats;

import io.nats.client.Connection;
import io.nats.client.ConnectionListener;
import io.nats.client.JetStream;
import io.nats.client.Nats;
import io.nats.client.Options;
import javax.net.ssl.SSLContext;
import io.nats.client.impl.Headers;
import io.nats.client.impl.NatsMessage;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.EnvelopePublisher;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.config.CorvusConfig;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletionStage;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

/**
 * {@link EnvelopePublisher} on the official jnats client. The connection is built on a background thread and
 * jnats keeps reconnecting forever with a bounded reconnect buffer, so an outage never delays the proxy and a
 * publish only ever completes exceptionally, never blocks. Until the first connection exists, isReady() is false
 * and the transport keeps lifecycle envelopes back. The stream is not created here.
 */
public final class JetStreamEnvelopePublisher implements EnvelopePublisher {

    private final long publishTimeoutMillis;
    private final Consumer<String> info;
    private final Consumer<String> warn;
    private volatile JetStream jetStream;
    private volatile Connection connection;
    private volatile boolean closed;

    public JetStreamEnvelopePublisher(CorvusConfig.Nats config, SSLContext sslContext, Consumer<String> info,
                                      Consumer<String> warn) {
        this.publishTimeoutMillis = config.publishTimeoutMillis();
        this.info = info;
        this.warn = warn;
        Thread t = new Thread(() -> connect(config, sslContext), "corvus-nats-connect");
        t.setDaemon(true);
        t.start();
    }

    private void connect(CorvusConfig.Nats config, SSLContext sslContext) {
        try {
            Options.Builder builder = new Options.Builder()
                    .servers(config.urls().toArray(new String[0]))
                    .connectionName("corvus-capture")
                    .maxReconnects(-1)
                    .reconnectBufferSize(config.reconnectBufferBytes())
                    .connectionListener((conn, type) -> onConnectionEvent(type))
                    .errorListener(new io.nats.client.ErrorListener() {
                        @Override
                        public void errorOccurred(Connection conn, String error) {
                            warn.accept("NATS error: " + error);
                        }

                        @Override
                        public void exceptionOccurred(Connection conn, Exception exp) {
                            warn.accept("NATS exception: " + exp);
                        }
                    });
            if (sslContext != null) {
                builder.sslContext(sslContext);
            }
            if (!config.credsFile().isEmpty()) {
                builder.credentialPath(config.credsFile());
            }
            Connection conn = Nats.connectReconnectOnConnect(builder.build());
            if (closed) {
                conn.close();
                return;
            }
            connection = conn;
            jetStream = conn.jetStream();
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            warn.accept("NATS sink could not be set up, capture batches are dropped: " + t);
        }
    }

    private void onConnectionEvent(ConnectionListener.Events type) {
        switch (type) {
            case CONNECTED -> info.accept("NATS connected");
            case RECONNECTED -> info.accept("NATS reconnected");
            case DISCONNECTED -> warn.accept("NATS disconnected, buffering while reconnecting");
            case CLOSED -> info.accept("NATS connection closed");
            default -> {
                // other events are not interesting
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public CompletionStage<Void> publish(String subject, Map<String, String> headers, byte[] body) {
        JetStream js = jetStream;
        if (js == null) {
            return CompletableFuture.failedFuture(new IllegalStateException("NATS connection is not set up yet"));
        }
        try {
            Headers h = new Headers();
            headers.forEach(h::put);
            NatsMessage message = NatsMessage.builder().subject(subject).headers(h).data(body).build();
            return js.publishAsync(message)
                    .orTimeout(publishTimeoutMillis, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                    .thenApply(ack -> null);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return CompletableFuture.failedFuture(t);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isReady() {
        Connection conn = connection;
        return jetStream != null && conn != null && conn.getStatus() == Connection.Status.CONNECTED;
    }

    @Override
    public void close(Duration timeout) {
        closed = true;
        Connection conn = connection;
        if (conn == null) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            conn.flush(timeout);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // bounded: whatever is still pending is lost, the shutdown must not hang
        }
        try {
            conn.close();
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // nothing sensible left to do
        }
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/nats/ScoreSubscriber.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.nats;

import io.nats.client.Connection;
import io.nats.client.ConnectionListener;
import io.nats.client.Dispatcher;
import io.nats.client.ErrorListener;
import io.nats.client.Nats;
import io.nats.client.Options;
import javax.net.ssl.SSLContext;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.config.CorvusConfig;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

/**
 * Core NATS subscription to the score subject (default {@code corvus.score.v1.>}). Scores are only interesting
 * while the player is online, so history is not replayed: a plain subscription is enough and needs no consumer
 * state. The connection is built on a background thread and reconnects forever; the handler runs on the jnats
 * dispatcher thread and must not block.
 */
public final class ScoreSubscriber {

    private final Consumer<byte[]> handler;
    private final Consumer<String> info;
    private final Consumer<String> warn;
    private volatile Connection connection;
    private volatile boolean closed;

    public ScoreSubscriber(CorvusConfig.Nats config, SSLContext sslContext, String subject, Consumer<byte[]> handler,
                           Consumer<String> info, Consumer<String> warn) {
        this.handler = handler;
        this.info = info;
        this.warn = warn;
        Thread t = new Thread(() -> connect(config, sslContext, subject), "corvus-nats-score-connect");
        t.setDaemon(true);
        t.start();
    }

    private void connect(CorvusConfig.Nats config, SSLContext sslContext, String subject) {
        try {
            Options.Builder builder = new Options.Builder()
                    .servers(config.urls().toArray(new String[0]))
                    .connectionName("corvus-scores")
                    .maxReconnects(-1)
                    .connectionListener((conn, type) -> onConnectionEvent(type))
                    .errorListener(new ErrorListener() {
                        @Override
                        public void errorOccurred(Connection conn, String error) {
                            warn.accept("NATS score subscription error: " + error);
                        }

                        @Override
                        public void exceptionOccurred(Connection conn, Exception exp) {
                            warn.accept("NATS score subscription exception: " + exp);
                        }
                    });
            if (sslContext != null) {
                builder.sslContext(sslContext);
            }
            if (!config.credsFile().isEmpty()) {
                builder.credentialPath(config.credsFile());
            }
            Connection conn = Nats.connectReconnectOnConnect(builder.build());
            if (closed) {
                conn.close();
                return;
            }
            Dispatcher dispatcher = conn.createDispatcher(message -> {
                try {
                    handler.accept(message.getData());
                } catch (Throwable t) {
                    warn.accept("Corvus score handler failed: " + t);
                }
            });
            dispatcher.subscribe(subject);
            connection = conn;
            info.accept("Corvus score subscription active on " + subject);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            warn.accept("Corvus score subscription could not be set up, scores are unavailable: " + t);
        }
    }

    private void onConnectionEvent(ConnectionListener.Events type) {
        switch (type) {
            case CONNECTED -> info.accept("NATS (scores) connected");
            case RECONNECTED -> info.accept("NATS (scores) reconnected");
            case DISCONNECTED -> warn.accept("NATS (scores) disconnected, reconnecting");
            default -> {
                // other events are not interesting
            }
        }
    }

    public void close(Duration timeout) {
        closed = true;
        Connection conn = connection;
        if (conn == null) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            conn.close();
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // shutdown must not hang
        }
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/pe/CorvusPacketListener.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.pe;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.PacketListenerAbstract;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.PacketListenerPriority;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.PacketReceiveEvent;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.PacketSendEvent;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.ProtocolPacketEvent;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.CaptureEngine;

/**
 * Passive MONITOR listener. Read-only: never cancels, never marks for re-encode, never touches the buffer
 * indices. Any failure is counted and swallowed so Corvus can never kick a player or break chat signing.
 */
public final class CorvusPacketListener extends PacketListenerAbstract {

    private final CaptureEngine engine;

    public CorvusPacketListener(CaptureEngine engine) {
        super(PacketListenerPriority.MONITOR);
        this.engine = engine;
    }

    @Override
    public void onPacketReceive(PacketReceiveEvent event) {
        handle(event);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPacketSend(PacketSendEvent event) {
        handle(event);
    }

    private void handle(ProtocolPacketEvent event) {
        try {
            engine.onPacket(new PacketEventsView(event));
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            try {
                engine.recordListenerError(null);
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                // nothing left that is safe to do on the Netty thread
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/pe/EventDecoder.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.pe;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.PacketReceiveEvent;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.PacketSendEvent;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.ProtocolPacketEvent;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketType;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketTypeCommon;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.DiggingAction;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.InteractionHand;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.Location;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.util.Vector3d;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.util.Vector3i;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.client.WrapperPlayClientAnimation;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.client.WrapperPlayClientAttack;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.client.WrapperPlayClientHeldItemChange;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.client.WrapperPlayClientInteractEntity;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.client.WrapperPlayClientPlayerBlockPlacement;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.client.WrapperPlayClientPlayerDigging;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.client.WrapperPlayClientPlayerFlying;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerEntityPositionSync;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerEntityRelativeMove;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerEntityRelativeMoveAndRotation;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerEntityTeleport;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerEntityVelocity;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerSpawnEntity;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerSpawnPlayer;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.DigEvent;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.EntityMotionEvent;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Frame;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.HeldItemEvent;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.InteractEntityEvent;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.MovementEvent;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.PlaceEvent;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.SwingEvent;

/**
 * Fills the decoded event of a frame. Wrappers are NEVER built from the original event: with PacketEvents'
 * default re-encode setting that would make the decoder re-write the packet. We decode on a clone (own
 * buffer indices, own lastUsedWrapper) and release it afterwards.
 */
final class EventDecoder {

    private EventDecoder() {
    }

    static void decode(ProtocolPacketEvent original, Frame.Builder target) {
        PacketTypeCommon type = original.getPacketType();
        if (!isDecodable(type)) {
            return;
        }
        ProtocolPacketEvent copy = original.clone();
        try {
            if (copy instanceof PacketReceiveEvent receive) {
                decodeServerbound(receive, type, target);
            } else if (copy instanceof PacketSendEvent send) {
                decodeClientbound(send, type, target);
            }
        } finally {
            copy.cleanUp();
        }
    }

    private static boolean isDecodable(PacketTypeCommon type) {
        return type == PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_POSITION
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_POSITION_AND_ROTATION
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_ROTATION
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_FLYING
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.INTERACT_ENTITY
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.ATTACK
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.ANIMATION
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_DIGGING
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_BLOCK_PLACEMENT
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.HELD_ITEM_CHANGE
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_RELATIVE_MOVE
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_RELATIVE_MOVE_AND_ROTATION
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_TELEPORT
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_POSITION_SYNC
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_VELOCITY
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_PLAYER;
    }

    private static void decodeServerbound(PacketReceiveEvent e, PacketTypeCommon type, Frame.Builder target) {
        if (type == PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_POSITION
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_POSITION_AND_ROTATION
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_ROTATION
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_FLYING) {
            WrapperPlayClientPlayerFlying w = new WrapperPlayClientPlayerFlying(e);
            Location l = w.getLocation();
            target.setMovement(MovementEvent.newBuilder()
                    .setHasPosition(w.hasPositionChanged())
                    .setHasRotation(w.hasRotationChanged())
                    .setX(l.getX()).setY(l.getY()).setZ(l.getZ())
                    .setYaw(l.getYaw()).setPitch(l.getPitch())
                    .setOnGround(w.isOnGround()));
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Client.INTERACT_ENTITY) {
            WrapperPlayClientInteractEntity w = new WrapperPlayClientInteractEntity(e);
            target.setInteractEntity(InteractEntityEvent.newBuilder()
                    .setEntityId(w.getEntityId())
                    .setAction(switch (w.getAction()) {
                        case INTERACT -> InteractEntityEvent.Action.ACTION_INTERACT;
                        case ATTACK -> InteractEntityEvent.Action.ACTION_ATTACK;
                        case INTERACT_AT -> InteractEntityEvent.Action.ACTION_INTERACT_AT;
                    })
                    .setSneaking(w.isSneaking().orElse(false))
                    .setOffHand(w.getHand() == InteractionHand.OFF_HAND));
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Client.ATTACK) {
            WrapperPlayClientAttack w = new WrapperPlayClientAttack(e);
            target.setInteractEntity(InteractEntityEvent.newBuilder()
                    .setEntityId(w.getEntityId())
                    .setAction(InteractEntityEvent.Action.ACTION_ATTACK));
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Client.ANIMATION) {
            WrapperPlayClientAnimation w = new WrapperPlayClientAnimation(e);
            target.setSwing(SwingEvent.newBuilder().setOffHand(w.getHand() == InteractionHand.OFF_HAND));
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_DIGGING) {
            WrapperPlayClientPlayerDigging w = new WrapperPlayClientPlayerDigging(e);
            Vector3i p = w.getBlockPosition();
            target.setDig(DigEvent.newBuilder()
                    .setStatus(digStatus(w.getAction()))
                    .setX(p.getX()).setY(p.getY()).setZ(p.getZ())
                    .setFace(w.getBlockFaceId()));
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_BLOCK_PLACEMENT) {
            WrapperPlayClientPlayerBlockPlacement w = new WrapperPlayClientPlayerBlockPlacement(e);
            Vector3i p = w.getBlockPosition();
            target.setPlace(PlaceEvent.newBuilder()
                    .setX(p.getX()).setY(p.getY()).setZ(p.getZ())
                    .setFace(w.getFaceId())
                    .setOffHand(w.getHand() == InteractionHand.OFF_HAND));
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Client.HELD_ITEM_CHANGE) {
            WrapperPlayClientHeldItemChange w = new WrapperPlayClientHeldItemChange(e);
            target.setHeldItem(HeldItemEvent.newBuilder().setSlot(w.getSlot()));
        }
    }

    private static void decodeClientbound(PacketSendEvent e, PacketTypeCommon type, Frame.Builder target) {
        if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_RELATIVE_MOVE) {
            WrapperPlayServerEntityRelativeMove w = new WrapperPlayServerEntityRelativeMove(e);
            target.setEntityMotion(motion(w.getEntityId(), EntityMotionEvent.Kind.KIND_RELATIVE,
                    w.getDeltaX(), w.getDeltaY(), w.getDeltaZ()));
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_RELATIVE_MOVE_AND_ROTATION) {
            WrapperPlayServerEntityRelativeMoveAndRotation w = new WrapperPlayServerEntityRelativeMoveAndRotation(e);
            target.setEntityMotion(motion(w.getEntityId(), EntityMotionEvent.Kind.KIND_RELATIVE,
                    w.getDeltaX(), w.getDeltaY(), w.getDeltaZ()));
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_TELEPORT) {
            WrapperPlayServerEntityTeleport w = new WrapperPlayServerEntityTeleport(e);
            Vector3d p = w.getPosition();
            target.setEntityMotion(motion(w.getEntityId(), EntityMotionEvent.Kind.KIND_TELEPORT,
                    p.getX(), p.getY(), p.getZ()));
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_POSITION_SYNC) {
            WrapperPlayServerEntityPositionSync w = new WrapperPlayServerEntityPositionSync(e);
            Vector3d p = w.getValues().getPosition();
            target.setEntityMotion(motion(w.getId(), EntityMotionEvent.Kind.KIND_TELEPORT,
                    p.getX(), p.getY(), p.getZ()));
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_VELOCITY) {
            WrapperPlayServerEntityVelocity w = new WrapperPlayServerEntityVelocity(e);
            Vector3d v = w.getVelocity();
            target.setEntityMotion(motion(w.getEntityId(), EntityMotionEvent.Kind.KIND_VELOCITY,
                    v.getX(), v.getY(), v.getZ()));
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY) {
            // position and entity id only: the entity UUID and all other fields are never read
            WrapperPlayServerSpawnEntity w = new WrapperPlayServerSpawnEntity(e);
            Vector3d p = w.getPosition();
            target.setEntityMotion(motion(w.getEntityId(), EntityMotionEvent.Kind.KIND_SPAWN,
                    p.getX(), p.getY(), p.getZ()));
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_PLAYER) {
            WrapperPlayServerSpawnPlayer w = new WrapperPlayServerSpawnPlayer(e);
            Vector3d p = w.getPosition();
            target.setEntityMotion(motion(w.getEntityId(), EntityMotionEvent.Kind.KIND_SPAWN,
                    p.getX(), p.getY(), p.getZ()));
        }
    }

    private static EntityMotionEvent.Builder motion(int entityId, EntityMotionEvent.Kind kind, double x, double y,
                                                    double z) {
        return EntityMotionEvent.newBuilder().setEntityId(entityId).setKind(kind).setX(x).setY(y).setZ(z);
    }

    /** Protocol status ids of the dig packet (version independent in practice). */
    static int digStatus(DiggingAction action) {
        return switch (action) {
            case START_DIGGING -> 0;
            case CANCELLED_DIGGING -> 1;
            case FINISHED_DIGGING -> 2;
            case DROP_ITEM_STACK -> 3;
            case DROP_ITEM -> 4;
            case RELEASE_USE_ITEM -> 5;
            case SWAP_ITEM_WITH_OFFHAND -> 6;
            default -> -1;
        };
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/pe/PacketEventsView.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.pe;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.PacketEvents;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.PacketReceiveEvent;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.ProtocolPacketEvent;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketTypeCommon;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.ClientVersion;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.User;
import com.velocitypowered.api.proxy.Player;
import io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf;
import io.netty.channel.Channel;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.PacketView;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.PayloadCopier;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.ConnectionState;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Direction;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Frame;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Adapter over a PacketEvents event. Strictly read-only: it never cancels, never marks for re-encode and never
 * builds a wrapper from the original event. The event's buffer is only read with absolute indices and is not
 * retained beyond the listener callback.
 */
final class PacketEventsView implements PacketView {

    private final ProtocolPacketEvent event;

    PacketEventsView(ProtocolPacketEvent event) {
        this.event = event;
    }

    @Override
    public Direction direction() {
        return event instanceof PacketReceiveEvent ? Direction.DIRECTION_SERVERBOUND : Direction.DIRECTION_CLIENTBOUND;
    }

    @Override
    public PacketTypeCommon packetType() {
        return event.getPacketType();
    }

    @Override
    public int wirePacketId() {
        return event.getPacketId();
    }

    @Override
    public ConnectionState state() {
        return switch (event.getConnectionState()) {
            case HANDSHAKING -> ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_HANDSHAKING;
            case STATUS -> ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_STATUS;
            case LOGIN -> ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_LOGIN;
            case CONFIGURATION -> ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_CONFIGURATION;
            case PLAY -> ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_PLAY;
        };
    }

    @Override
    public UUID playerId() {
        Object player = event.getPlayer();
        if (player instanceof Player p) {
            return p.getUniqueId();
        }
        return event.getUser().getUUID();
    }

    @Override
    public Object channelKey() {
        return event.getChannel();
    }

    @Override
    public byte[] copyPayload(int maxBytes) {
        return PayloadCopier.copyReadable((ByteBuf) event.getByteBuf(), maxBytes);
    }

    @Override
    public int payloadSize() {
        return ((ByteBuf) event.getByteBuf()).readableBytes();
    }

    @Override
    public void decodeEvent(Frame.Builder target) {
        EventDecoder.decode(event, target);
    }

    @Override
    public SessionInfo sessionInfo() {
        User user = event.getUser();
        Object player = event.getPlayer();
        int observed = protocolOf(event.getServerVersion().toClientVersion());
        int client = player instanceof Player p ? p.getProtocolVersion().getProtocol() : protocolOf(user.getClientVersion());

        boolean viaBeforePe = false;
        String pipelineText = "pipeline=n/a";
        String channelType = String.valueOf(event.getChannel().getClass().getSimpleName());
        if (user.getChannel() instanceof Channel channel) {
            List<String> names = channel.pipeline().names();
            int pe = indexOfPrefix(names, PacketEvents.DECODER_NAME == null ? "pe-decoder" : PacketEvents.DECODER_NAME);
            int via = indexOfContains(names, "via");
            viaBeforePe = pe >= 0 && via >= 0 && via < pe;
            pipelineText = "pipeline=" + names;
        }
        String diagnostics = "user=" + user.getClass().getSimpleName() + " channel=" + channelType
                + " pe_client_version=" + protocolOf(user.getClientVersion())
                + " decoder_state=" + user.getDecoderState() + " encoder_state=" + user.getEncoderState()
                + " first_event=" + (event instanceof PacketReceiveEvent ? "serverbound" : "clientbound")
                + " " + pipelineText;
        return new SessionInfo(client, observed, viaBeforePe, diagnostics);
    }

    private static int protocolOf(ClientVersion version) {
        return version == null ? -1 : version.getProtocolVersion();
    }

    private static int indexOfPrefix(List<String> names, String prefix) {
        for (int i = 0; i < names.size(); i++) {
            if (names.get(i).startsWith(prefix)) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private static int indexOfContains(List<String> names, String needle) {
        for (int i = 0; i < names.size(); i++) {
            if (names.get(i).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(needle)) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/privacy/KeyLoader.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.util.function.Function;

/** Loads the pseudonym key from env var CORVUS_PSEUDONYM_KEY (base64) or a key file. Fails closed. */
public final class KeyLoader {

    public static final String ENV_VAR = "CORVUS_PSEUDONYM_KEY";

    private KeyLoader() {
    }

    /** @return the key, or empty if none is configured or usable; the reason goes to {@code warn}. */
    public static Optional<PseudonymKey> load(
            Function<String, String> env, String keyFile, Path dataDir, String keyId, Consumer<String> warn) {
        String encoded = env.apply(ENV_VAR);
        String source = "environment variable " + ENV_VAR;
        if (encoded == null || encoded.isBlank()) {
            if (keyFile == null || keyFile.isBlank()) {
                warn.accept("No pseudonym key configured (set " + ENV_VAR + " or pseudonym.key_file). Capture is DISABLED.");
                return Optional.empty();
            }
            Path path = dataDir.resolve(keyFile);
            source = "key file " + path;
            try {
                encoded = Files.readString(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                warn.accept("Cannot read pseudonym key file (" + e.getClass().getSimpleName() + "). Capture is DISABLED.");
                return Optional.empty();
            }
        }
        try {
            return Optional.of(new PseudonymKey(Base64.getMimeDecoder().decode(encoded.trim()), keyId));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            warn.accept("Pseudonym key from " + source + " is invalid (base64, at least "
                    + PseudonymKey.MIN_KEY_BYTES + " bytes). Capture is DISABLED.");
            return Optional.empty();
        }
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/privacy/PayloadMode.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy;

import java.util.Locale;

/** Configured scope of raw payload recording ({@code capture.raw_payloads}). */
public enum PayloadMode {
    /** No payload bytes at all. */
    NONE,
    /** Payloads of serverbound play packets (minus text-bearing types) and of allowlisted motion packets. */
    SERVERBOUND,
    /** Every payload except privacy-dropped and always-stripped types. Local debugging only. */
    ALL;

    public static final PayloadMode DEFAULT = SERVERBOUND;

    /**
     * Parses the raw TOML value. Accepts the strings {@code none|serverbound|all} (case-insensitive) and, for
     * backward compatibility, the booleans {@code true} (serverbound) and {@code false} (none). {@code null}
     * yields the default.
     */
    public static PayloadMode parse(Object raw) {
        if (raw == null) {
            return DEFAULT;
        }
        if (raw instanceof Boolean b) {
            return b ? SERVERBOUND : NONE;
        }
        String text = String.valueOf(raw).trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return switch (text) {
            case "none" -> NONE;
            case "serverbound" -> SERVERBOUND;
            case "all" -> ALL;
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "capture.raw_payloads must be 'none', 'serverbound' or 'all' (or true/false), got: " + raw);
        };
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/privacy/PayloadPolicy.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketType;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketTypeCommon;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.vocab.CorvusPacket;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.ConnectionState;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Direction;

import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Pure decision: may the raw payload of a packet be written to the capture? Payloads of other players' packets
 * (names, UUIDs in scoreboard, teams, titles, spawn, boss bars...) and of text-bearing serverbound packets must
 * never reach the data lake.
 */
public final class PayloadPolicy {

    /** Per-type payload level; {@link #json()} is the value written to {@code vocabulary.json}. */
    public enum Level {
        /** The whole frame is dropped (chat, commands, player lists...), see {@link PrivacyFilter}. */
        FRAME_DROPPED("frame_dropped"),
        /** The frame is recorded but its payload is always stripped, in every mode. */
        STRIPPED("stripped"),
        /** Payload recorded in modes {@code serverbound} and {@code all}. */
        DEFAULT("default"),
        /** Payload recorded only in mode {@code all}. */
        ALL_ONLY("all_only");

        private final String json;

        Level(String json) {
            this.json = json;
        }

        public String json() {
            return json;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Serverbound play types that carry free text, item data with custom names, or other identifiers. Their
     * payload is stripped in every mode.
     */
    private static final Set<PacketTypeCommon> STRIPPED_SERVERBOUND = Set.of(
            PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_SIGN,
            PacketType.Play.Client.EDIT_BOOK,
            PacketType.Play.Client.NAME_ITEM,
            PacketType.Play.Client.PLUGIN_MESSAGE,
            PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_COMMAND_BLOCK,
            PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_COMMAND_BLOCK_MINECART,
            PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_STRUCTURE_BLOCK,
            PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_JIGSAW_BLOCK,
            // cookies are opaque server-defined data (tokens, identities)
            PacketType.Play.Client.COOKIE_RESPONSE,
            // test blocks and game rules carry free-text names/values
            PacketType.Play.Client.SET_TEST_BLOCK,
            PacketType.Play.Client.TEST_INSTANCE_BLOCK_ACTION,
            PacketType.Play.Client.SET_GAME_RULE,
            // custom click actions carry arbitrary payloads defined by the server
            PacketType.Play.Client.CUSTOM_CLICK_ACTION,
            // spectate carries the UUID of the target entity (a player)
            PacketType.Play.Client.SPECTATE,
            // inventory clicks carry item stacks, which can hold custom names, lore and skull owners
            PacketType.Play.Client.CLICK_WINDOW,
            PacketType.Play.Client.CREATIVE_INVENTORY_ACTION);

    /** Clientbound motion packets: entity ids and numbers only, no names or UUIDs. */
    private static final Set<PacketTypeCommon> CLIENTBOUND_ALLOWLIST = Set.of(
            PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_RELATIVE_MOVE,
            PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_RELATIVE_MOVE_AND_ROTATION,
            PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_ROTATION,
            PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_HEAD_LOOK,
            PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_TELEPORT,
            PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_VELOCITY,
            PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_POSITION_SYNC,
            PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_POSITION_AND_LOOK);

    private final PayloadMode mode;

    public PayloadPolicy(PayloadMode mode) {
        this.mode = mode;
    }

    public static Set<PacketTypeCommon> strippedServerboundTypes() {
        return STRIPPED_SERVERBOUND;
    }

    public static Set<PacketTypeCommon> clientboundAllowlist() {
        return CLIENTBOUND_ALLOWLIST;
    }

    /** The level of a packet type, independent of the configured mode. */
    public static Level levelOf(PacketTypeCommon type, Direction direction, ConnectionState state) {
        if (PrivacyFilter.isPrivate(type, state)) {
            return Level.FRAME_DROPPED;
        }
        if (state != ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_PLAY) {
            return Level.ALL_ONLY;
        }
        if (direction == Direction.DIRECTION_SERVERBOUND) {
            if (STRIPPED_SERVERBOUND.contains(type)) {
                return Level.STRIPPED;
            }
            // unknown (unmapped) serverbound types are not vetted for free text: fail closed
            return CorvusPacket.idOf(type) != 0 ? Level.DEFAULT : Level.ALL_ONLY;
        }
        return CLIENTBOUND_ALLOWLIST.contains(type) ? Level.DEFAULT : Level.ALL_ONLY;
    }

    /** True if the payload of this packet may be recorded under the configured mode. */
    public boolean recordsPayload(PacketTypeCommon type, Direction direction, ConnectionState state) {
        return switch (mode) {
            case NONE -> false;
            case SERVERBOUND -> levelOf(type, direction, state) == Level.DEFAULT;
            case ALL -> {
                Level level = levelOf(type, direction, state);
                yield level == Level.DEFAULT || level == Level.ALL_ONLY;
            }
        };
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/privacy/PlayerFilter.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.config.CorvusConfig;

import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.function.Predicate;

/**
 * UUID allow/blocklist from the config plus an optional dynamic blocklist (the synced pseudonyms), applied before
 * anything is captured. The blocklist always wins. The dynamic predicate runs on Netty threads: it must be cheap.
 */
public final class PlayerFilter {

    private final CorvusConfig.ListMode mode;
    private final Set<UUID> allowlist;
    private final Set<UUID> blocklist;
    private final Predicate<UUID> dynamicBlocked;

    public PlayerFilter(CorvusConfig.ListMode mode, Set<UUID> allowlist, Set<UUID> blocklist) {
        this(mode, allowlist, blocklist, uuid -> false);
    }

    public PlayerFilter(CorvusConfig.ListMode mode, Set<UUID> allowlist, Set<UUID> blocklist,
                        Predicate<UUID> dynamicBlocked) {
        this.mode = mode;
        this.allowlist = Set.copyOf(allowlist);
        this.blocklist = Set.copyOf(blocklist);
        this.dynamicBlocked = dynamicBlocked;
    }

    public boolean allows(UUID uuid) {
        if (blocklist.contains(uuid) || dynamicBlocked.test(uuid)) {
            return false;
        }
        return mode == CorvusConfig.ListMode.ALL || allowlist.contains(uuid);
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/privacy/PrivacyFilter.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketType;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketTypeCommon;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.ConnectionState;

import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Decides which packets must never be recorded. Chat, commands, signing, chat sessions, completions and
 * packets carrying other players' names/UUIDs are dropped before any byte is copied.
 */
public final class PrivacyFilter {

    private static final Set<PacketTypeCommon> PRIVATE_TYPES = Set.of(
            // serverbound: chat, commands, signing, acknowledgements, completions that echo typed text
            PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_PREVIEW,
            PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_MESSAGE,
            PacketType.Play.Client.TAB_COMPLETE,
            PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_COMMAND,
            PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_COMMAND_UNSIGNED,
            PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_ACK,
            PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_SESSION_UPDATE,
            // clientbound: system/player/disguised chat, previews, completions, command tree
            PacketType.Play.Server.CHAT_PREVIEW_PACKET,
            PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_CHAT_HEADER,
            PacketType.Play.Server.TAB_COMPLETE,
            PacketType.Play.Server.DECLARE_COMMANDS,
            PacketType.Play.Server.CHAT_MESSAGE,
            PacketType.Play.Server.SYSTEM_CHAT_MESSAGE,
            PacketType.Play.Server.DELETE_CHAT,
            PacketType.Play.Server.DISGUISED_CHAT,
            PacketType.Play.Server.DISPLAY_CHAT_PREVIEW,
            PacketType.Play.Server.CUSTOM_CHAT_COMPLETIONS,
            PacketType.Play.Server.SERVER_DATA,
            // clientbound: player lists carry names, UUIDs and chat session keys
            PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_INFO,
            PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_INFO_UPDATE,
            PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_INFO_REMOVE,
            // configuration state
            PacketType.Configuration.Server.RESET_CHAT);

    private PrivacyFilter() {
    }

    /** The packet types that are always dropped (play and configuration). */
    public static Set<PacketTypeCommon> privateTypes() {
        return PRIVATE_TYPES;
    }

    /** True if a frame of this type/state must not be recorded at all (counted as dropped_privacy). */
    public static boolean isPrivate(PacketTypeCommon type, ConnectionState state) {
        if (state != ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_PLAY && state != ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_CONFIGURATION) {
            // handshake (server address), status and login (name, UUID) never reach the data lake
            return true;
        }
        return type == null || PRIVATE_TYPES.contains(type);
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/privacy/PseudonymKey.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy;

import java.util.Arrays;

/** HMAC key plus its rotation identifier. The key material never leaves this package. */
public final class PseudonymKey {

    public static final int MIN_KEY_BYTES = 16;

    private final byte[] key;
    private final String keyId;

    public PseudonymKey(byte[] key, String keyId) {
        if (key == null || key.length < MIN_KEY_BYTES) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("pseudonym key must be at least " + MIN_KEY_BYTES + " bytes");
        }
        this.key = Arrays.copyOf(key, key.length);
        this.keyId = keyId;
    }

    public String keyId() {
        return keyId;
    }

    byte[] material() {
        return key;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "PseudonymKey[" + keyId + "]";
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/privacy/Pseudonymizer.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy;

import javax.crypto.Mac;
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.security.GeneralSecurityException;
import java.util.UUID;

/** Derives the player pseudonym: HMAC-SHA-256(key, uuid as 16 big-endian bytes). */
public final class Pseudonymizer {

    private static final String ALGORITHM = "HmacSHA256";

    private final PseudonymKey key;

    public Pseudonymizer(PseudonymKey key) {
        this.key = key;
    }

    public String keyId() {
        return key.keyId();
    }

    public byte[] pseudonym(UUID uuid) {
        try {
            Mac mac = Mac.getInstance(ALGORITHM);
            mac.init(new SecretKeySpec(key.material(), ALGORITHM));
            byte[] input = ByteBuffer.allocate(16)
                    .putLong(uuid.getMostSignificantBits())
                    .putLong(uuid.getLeastSignificantBits())
                    .array();
            return mac.doFinal(input);
        } catch (GeneralSecurityException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("HMAC-SHA-256 unavailable", e);
        }
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/score/PseudonymDirectory.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score;

import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.function.Function;

/**
 * Pseudonym to online player lookup. The pseudonym of a player is computed once on login with the capture HMAC
 * key and cached until the player disconnects, so a score is mapped with one hash lookup and no HMAC.
 */
public final class PseudonymDirectory {

    private final Function<UUID, byte[]> pseudonymOf;
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<UUID, String> byPlayer = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, UUID> byPseudonym = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public PseudonymDirectory(Function<UUID, byte[]> pseudonymOf) {
        this.pseudonymOf = pseudonymOf;
    }

    /** Computes and caches the pseudonym of a player that came online. */
    public void add(UUID player) {
        String pseudonym = HexFormat.of().formatHex(pseudonymOf.apply(player));
        String previous = byPlayer.put(player, pseudonym);
        if (previous != null && !previous.equals(pseudonym)) {
            byPseudonym.remove(previous, player);
        }
        byPseudonym.put(pseudonym, player);
    }

    /**
     * Lower-case hex pseudonym of a player, computed on first use (packets can arrive before the login event) and
     * cached until {@link #remove}.
     */
    public String hexOf(UUID player) {
        String cached = byPlayer.get(player);
        if (cached == null) {
            add(player);
            cached = byPlayer.get(player);
        }
        return cached;
    }

    /** Forgets a player that went offline. */
    public void remove(UUID player) {
        String pseudonym = byPlayer.remove(player);
        if (pseudonym != null) {
            byPseudonym.remove(pseudonym, player);
        }
    }

    public Optional<UUID> lookup(byte[] pseudonym) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(byPseudonym.get(HexFormat.of().formatHex(pseudonym)));
    }

    public int size() {
        return byPlayer.size();
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/score/RateLimitedLog.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.time.NanoClock;

import java.util.function.Consumer;

/** Forwards a warning at most once per interval and counts the suppressed ones. */
public final class RateLimitedLog {

    public static final long DEFAULT_INTERVAL_NANOS = 60_000_000_000L;

    private final NanoClock clock;
    private final Consumer<String> sink;
    private final long intervalNanos;
    private boolean emitted;
    private long lastNanos;
    private long suppressed;

    public RateLimitedLog(NanoClock clock, Consumer<String> sink, long intervalNanos) {
        this.clock = clock;
        this.sink = sink;
        this.intervalNanos = intervalNanos;
    }

    public synchronized void warn(String message) {
        long now = clock.nanoTime();
        if (emitted && now - lastNanos < intervalNanos) {
            suppressed++;
            return;
        }
        sink.accept(suppressed > 0 ? message + " [" + suppressed + " more since the last warning]" : message);
        emitted = true;
        lastNanos = now;
        suppressed = 0;
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/score/ScoreFormatter.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.api.PlayerScore;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

/** Text lines for {@code /corvus score <player>}. */
public final class ScoreFormatter {

    private ScoreFormatter() {
    }

    public static List<String> lines(String playerName, Collection<PlayerScore> scores, Instant now) {
        if (scores.isEmpty()) {
            return List.of("[corvus] no scores for " + playerName + " yet");
        }
        List<String> out = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        out.add("[corvus] scores for " + playerName + " (decision aids, Corvus never sanctions players)");
        scores.stream()
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(PlayerScore::gameContext).thenComparing(PlayerScore::domain))
                .forEach(s -> out.add(line(s, now)));
        return out;
    }

    static String line(PlayerScore s, Instant now) {
        long age = Math.max(0, Duration.between(s.scoredAt(), now).toSeconds());
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%s/%s: score %.3f, smoothed %.3f over %d windows, %s %s, %s, %ds ago",
                s.gameContext(), s.domain(), s.score(), s.smoothedScore(), s.windows(), s.modelName(),
                s.modelVersion(), s.stage(), age);
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/score/ScoreProcessor.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score;

import com.google.protobuf.InvalidProtocolBufferException;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.api.PlayerScore;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.api.ScoreStage;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.score.v1.Score;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.InstantSource;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLongArray;

/**
 * Decodes a {@code corvus.score.v1.Score} message and maps it to an online player. Cheap and non-blocking, so
 * it can run directly on the NATS dispatcher thread: listeners are fired by {@link ScoreRegistry} on its own
 * executor.
 */
public final class ScoreProcessor {

    public enum Outcome {
        /** Stored as the latest score and listeners were notified. */
        ACCEPTED,
        /** A newer score for the same (player, game context, domain) was already known. */
        STALE,
        /** Shadow (or unspecified) stage; never exposed. */
        IGNORED_STAGE,
        /** The pseudonym belongs to nobody online on this proxy. */
        IGNORED_OFFLINE,
        /** Undecodable message or out-of-range values. */
        INVALID
    }

    private final PseudonymDirectory directory;
    private final ScoreRegistry registry;
    private final InstantSource clock;
    private final RateLimitedLog log;
    private final AtomicLongArray counts = new AtomicLongArray(Outcome.values().length);

    public ScoreProcessor(PseudonymDirectory directory, ScoreRegistry registry, InstantSource clock,
                          RateLimitedLog log) {
        this.directory = directory;
        this.registry = registry;
        this.clock = clock;
        this.log = log;
    }

    public Outcome onMessage(byte[] body) {
        Outcome outcome = process(body);
        counts.incrementAndGet(outcome.ordinal());
        return outcome;
    }

    public long count(Outcome outcome) {
        return counts.get(outcome.ordinal());
    }

    private Outcome process(byte[] body) {
        Score message;
        try {
            message = Score.parseFrom(body);
        } catch (InvalidProtocolBufferException e) {
            log.warn("Ignored an undecodable Corvus score message: " + e.getMessage());
            return Outcome.INVALID;
        }
        Optional<ScoreStage> stage = stage(message.getStage());
        if (stage.isEmpty()) {
            return Outcome.IGNORED_STAGE;
        }
        Optional<UUID> player = directory.lookup(message.getPlayerPseudonym().toByteArray());
        if (player.isEmpty()) {
            return Outcome.IGNORED_OFFLINE;
        }
        long scoredAtMillis = message.getScoredAtUnixMillis();
        PlayerScore score;
        try {
            score = new PlayerScore(player.get(), requireText(message.getGameContext()),
                    requireText(message.getDomain()), message.getScore(), message.getScoreSmoothed(),
                    (int) Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE, Integer.toUnsignedLong(message.getWindows())),
                    message.getModelName(), message.getModelVersion(), stage.get(),
                    scoredAtMillis > 0 ? Instant.ofEpochMilli(scoredAtMillis) : clock.instant());
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            log.warn("Ignored an invalid Corvus score message: " + e.getMessage());
            return Outcome.INVALID;
        }
        return registry.update(score) ? Outcome.ACCEPTED : Outcome.STALE;
    }

    private static String requireText(String value) {
        if (value.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("game_context and domain must not be blank");
        }
        return value;
    }

    /** Shadow, unspecified and unknown stages are not exposed. */
    static Optional<ScoreStage> stage(Score.Stage stage) {
        return switch (stage) {
            case STAGE_CANARY -> Optional.of(ScoreStage.CANARY);
            case STAGE_ENFORCE -> Optional.of(ScoreStage.ENFORCE);
            default -> Optional.empty();
        };
    }
}

```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/score/ScoreRegistry.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.api.CorvusApi;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.api.PlayerScore;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.api.ScoreListener;

import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;
import java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.LongAdder;

/**
 * Implementation of {@link CorvusApi}: keeps the latest score per (player, game context, domain) and fires the
 * registered listeners on the given executor. The executor must be bounded; when it rejects work the listener
 * call is dropped and counted, the caller (the NATS dispatcher) is never blocked. A throwing listener is caught,
 * logged rate-limited and does not affect other listeners.
 */
public final class ScoreRegistry implements CorvusApi {

    private record Key(String gameContext, String domain) {
    }

    private final ConcurrentHashMap<UUID, ConcurrentHashMap<Key, PlayerScore>> latest = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final CopyOnWriteArrayList<ScoreListener> listeners = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private final Executor executor;
    private final RateLimitedLog log;
    private final LongAdder listenerErrors = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder dispatchRejected = new LongAdder();

    public ScoreRegistry(Executor executor, RateLimitedLog log) {
        this.executor = executor;
        this.log = log;
    }

    /**
     * Stores {@code score} unless a newer one for the same (player, game context, domain) is already known, and
     * notifies the listeners when it was stored.
     *
     * @return true if the score became the latest one
     */
    public boolean update(PlayerScore score) {
        ConcurrentHashMap<Key, PlayerScore> perPlayer = latest.computeIfAbsent(score.player(),
                p -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>());
        PlayerScore kept = perPlayer.merge(new Key(score.gameContext(), score.domain()), score,
                (old, fresh) -> fresh.scoredAt().isBefore(old.scoredAt()) ? old : fresh);
        if (kept != score) {
            return false;
        }
        for (ScoreListener listener : listeners) {
            dispatch(listener, score);
        }
        return true;
    }

    private void dispatch(ScoreListener listener, PlayerScore score) {
        try {
            executor.execute(() -> {
                try {
                    listener.onScore(score);
                } catch (Throwable t) {
                    listenerErrors.increment();
                    log.warn("A Corvus score listener threw " + t + " (" + listener.getClass().getName() + ")");
                }
            });
        } catch (RejectedExecutionException e) {
            dispatchRejected.increment();
            log.warn("Corvus score listener queue is full, dropped a score update");
        }
    }

    /** Forgets all scores of a player that went offline. */
    public void evict(UUID player) {
        latest.remove(player);
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<PlayerScore> latestScore(UUID player, String gameContext) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(gameContext, "gameContext");
        var perPlayer = latest.get(Objects.requireNonNull(player, "player"));
        if (perPlayer == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return perPlayer.values().stream()
                .filter(s -> s.gameContext().equals(gameContext))
                .max(Comparator.comparing(PlayerScore::scoredAt));
    }

    @Override
    public Collection<PlayerScore> latestScores(UUID player) {
        var perPlayer = latest.get(Objects.requireNonNull(player, "player"));
        return perPlayer == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(perPlayer.values());
    }

    @Override
    public Registration registerScoreListener(ScoreListener listener) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(listener, "listener");
        listeners.add(listener);
        AtomicBoolean done = new AtomicBoolean();
        return () -> {
            if (done.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                listeners.remove(listener);
            }
        };
    }

    public long listenerErrors() {
        return listenerErrors.sum();
    }

    public long dispatchRejected() {
        return dispatchRejected.sum();
    }
}
```
