`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/tls/TlsTrust.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.tls;

import javax.net.ssl.SSLContext;
import javax.net.ssl.TrustManager;
import javax.net.ssl.TrustManagerFactory;
import javax.net.ssl.X509TrustManager;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.security.GeneralSecurityException;
import java.security.KeyStore;
import java.security.cert.CertificateException;
import java.security.cert.CertificateFactory;
import java.security.cert.X509Certificate;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Builds an {@link SSLContext} that trusts the JVM default CAs <em>and</em> an extra PEM bundle (for example a
 * private step-ca). The JVM-wide truststore is never touched; the context is only handed to the NATS and HTTP
 * clients of this plugin.
 */
public final class TlsTrust {

    /** The configured CA file is unreadable or holds no valid certificate. */
    public static final class TlsSetupException extends Exception {
        public TlsSetupException(String message, Throwable cause) {
            super(message, cause);
        }

        public TlsSetupException(String message) {
            super(message);
        }
    }

    private TlsTrust() {
    }

    /** Relative paths are resolved against the plugin data directory. */
    public static Path resolve(String caFile, Path dataDirectory) {
        Path path = Path.of(caFile);
        return path.isAbsolute() ? path : dataDirectory.resolve(path).normalize();
    }

    /** Empty {@code caFile} means JVM default trust only: no context is returned. */
    public static Optional<SSLContext> sslContext(String caFile, Path dataDirectory) throws TlsSetupException {
        if (caFile.isBlank()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Path path = resolve(caFile.trim(), dataDirectory);
        try {
            return Optional.of(sslContext(jvmDefaultTrustManager(), readCertificates(path)));
        } catch (GeneralSecurityException e) {
            throw new TlsSetupException("tls.ca_file " + path + " could not be used: " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    /** Context that accepts what {@code defaultTrust} accepts plus chains anchored in {@code extra}. */
    public static SSLContext sslContext(X509TrustManager defaultTrust, List<X509Certificate> extra)
            throws GeneralSecurityException {
        X509TrustManager composite = composite(defaultTrust, trustManagerOf(extra));
        SSLContext context = SSLContext.getInstance("TLS");
        context.init(null, new TrustManager[]{composite}, null);
        return context;
    }

    public static X509TrustManager composite(X509TrustManager first, X509TrustManager second) {
        return new CompositeTrustManager(first, second);
    }

    static List<X509Certificate> readCertificates(Path path) throws TlsSetupException {
        List<X509Certificate> certificates = new ArrayList<>();
        try (InputStream in = Files.newInputStream(path)) {
            for (java.security.cert.Certificate c : CertificateFactory.getInstance("X.509").generateCertificates(in)) {
                if (c instanceof X509Certificate x509) {
                    certificates.add(x509);
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException | CertificateException e) {
            throw new TlsSetupException("tls.ca_file " + path + " is unreadable or not a PEM certificate bundle: "
                    + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
        if (certificates.isEmpty()) {
            throw new TlsSetupException("tls.ca_file " + path + " contains no PEM certificate");
        }
        return certificates;
    }

    private static X509TrustManager trustManagerOf(List<X509Certificate> certificates) throws GeneralSecurityException {
        KeyStore store = KeyStore.getInstance(KeyStore.getDefaultType());
        try {
            store.load(null, null);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new GeneralSecurityException(e);
        }
        int index = 0;
        for (X509Certificate certificate : certificates) {
            store.setCertificateEntry("corvus-ca-" + index++, certificate);
        }
        return x509(store);
    }

    private static X509TrustManager jvmDefaultTrustManager() throws GeneralSecurityException {
        return x509(null);
    }

    private static X509TrustManager x509(KeyStore store) throws GeneralSecurityException {
        TrustManagerFactory factory = TrustManagerFactory.getInstance(TrustManagerFactory.getDefaultAlgorithm());
        factory.init(store);
        for (TrustManager tm : factory.getTrustManagers()) {
            if (tm instanceof X509TrustManager x509) {
                return x509;
            }
        }
        throw new GeneralSecurityException("no X509TrustManager available");
    }

    private record CompositeTrustManager(X509TrustManager first, X509TrustManager second)
            implements X509TrustManager {

        @Override
        public void checkServerTrusted(X509Certificate[] chain, String authType) throws CertificateException {
            try {
                first.checkServerTrusted(chain, authType);
            } catch (CertificateException primary) {
                try {
                    second.checkServerTrusted(chain, authType);
                } catch (CertificateException secondary) {
                    primary.addSuppressed(secondary);
                    throw primary;
                }
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void checkClientTrusted(X509Certificate[] chain, String authType) throws CertificateException {
            try {
                first.checkClientTrusted(chain, authType);
            } catch (CertificateException primary) {
                try {
                    second.checkClientTrusted(chain, authType);
                } catch (CertificateException secondary) {
                    primary.addSuppressed(secondary);
                    throw primary;
                }
            }
        }

        @Override
        public X509Certificate[] getAcceptedIssuers() {
            X509Certificate[] a = first.getAcceptedIssuers();
            X509Certificate[] b = second.getAcceptedIssuers();
            X509Certificate[] all = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(a, a.length + b.length);
            System.arraycopy(b, 0, all, a.length, b.length);
            return all;
        }
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/main/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/velocity/CorvusCommand.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.velocity;

import com.velocitypowered.api.command.SimpleCommand;
import com.velocitypowered.api.proxy.Player;
import com.velocitypowered.api.proxy.ProxyServer;
import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.api.CorvusApi;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.StatsReporter;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score.ScoreFormatter;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.function.Supplier;

/** {@code /corvus stats} and {@code /corvus score <player>}, permission {@code corvus.admin}. */
final class CorvusCommand implements SimpleCommand {

    static final String PERMISSION = "corvus.admin";

    private final StatsReporter reporter;

    private final ProxyServer proxy;
    private final CorvusApi api;
    private final boolean scoresEnabled;
    private final Supplier<String> blocklistStatus;

    CorvusCommand(StatsReporter reporter, ProxyServer proxy, CorvusApi api, boolean scoresEnabled,
                  Supplier<String> blocklistStatus) {
        this.blocklistStatus = blocklistStatus;
        this.reporter = reporter;
        this.proxy = proxy;
        this.api = api;
        this.scoresEnabled = scoresEnabled;
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(Invocation invocation) {
        String[] args = invocation.arguments();
        if (args.length == 1 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("stats")) {
            invocation.source().sendMessage(Component.text("[corvus] " + reporter.sample() + " " + blocklistStatus.get()));
        } else if (args.length == 2 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("score")) {
            score(invocation, args[1]);
        } else {
            invocation.source().sendMessage(Component.text("Usage: /corvus stats | /corvus score <player>"));
        }
    }

    private void score(Invocation invocation, String name) {
        if (!scoresEnabled) {
            invocation.source().sendMessage(Component.text("[corvus] scores are not enabled (scores.enabled)"));
            return;
        }
        Optional<Player> player = proxy.getPlayer(name);
        if (player.isEmpty()) {
            invocation.source().sendMessage(Component.text("[corvus] " + name + " is not online"));
            return;
        }
        for (String line : ScoreFormatter.lines(player.get().getUsername(),
                api.latestScores(player.get().getUniqueId()), Instant.now())) {
            invocation.source().sendMessage(Component.text(line));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> suggest(Invocation invocation) {
        String[] args = invocation.arguments();
        if (args.length <= 1) {
            return List.of("stats", "score");
        }
        if (args.length == 2 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("score")) {
            String prefix = args[1].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            return proxy.getAllPlayers().stream().map(Player::getUsername)
                    .filter(n -> n.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith(prefix)).toList();
        }
        return List.of();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasPermission(Invocation invocation) {
        return invocation.source().hasPermission(PERMISSION);
    }
}
```

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.velocity;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.PacketEvents;
import com.google.inject.Inject;
import com.velocitypowered.api.command.CommandMeta;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.Subscribe;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.connection.DisconnectEvent;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.player.ServerPostConnectEvent;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.connection.PostLoginEvent;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.proxy.ProxyInitializeEvent;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.proxy.ProxyShutdownEvent;
import com.velocitypowered.api.plugin.Dependency;
import com.velocitypowered.api.plugin.Plugin;
import com.velocitypowered.api.plugin.annotation.DataDirectory;
import com.velocitypowered.api.proxy.Player;
import com.velocitypowered.api.proxy.ProxyServer;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.api.CorvusProvider;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.BuildConstants;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.blocklist.HttpBlocklistClient;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.blocklist.JdkHttpTransport;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.blocklist.SyncedBlocklist;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.blocklist.TokenLoader;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.ByteBoundedQueue;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.CaptureEngine;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.CaptureWriter;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.EnvelopeTransport;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.FileTransport;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.NatsTransport;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.GameContextMapper;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.Metrics;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.StatsReporter;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.WriterThread;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.config.CorvusConfig;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.nats.JetStreamEnvelopePublisher;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.nats.ScoreSubscriber;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.tls.TlsTrust;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score.PseudonymDirectory;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score.RateLimitedLog;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score.ScoreProcessor;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score.ScoreRegistry;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.pe.CorvusPacketListener;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.KeyLoader;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PayloadMode;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PlayerFilter;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PseudonymKey;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.Pseudonymizer;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.time.NanoClock;
import org.slf4j.Logger;

import javax.net.ssl.SSLContext;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.InstantSource;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.ArrayBlockingQueue;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

@Plugin(
        id = "corvus",
        name = "Corvus",
        version = BuildConstants.VERSION,
        description = "Passive packet capture for ML anti-cheat research",
        authors = {"OneLiteFeather"},
        dependencies = {@Dependency(id = "packetevents")})
public final class CorvusPlugin {

    private static final int REGISTER_ATTEMPTS = 120;

    private final ProxyServer proxy;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final Path dataDirectory;

    private CaptureEngine engine;
    private WriterThread writerThread;
    private CorvusPacketListener listener;
    private ScoreRegistry scoreRegistry;
    private ThreadPoolExecutor scoreExecutor;
    private PseudonymDirectory pseudonyms;
    private ScoreSubscriber scoreSubscriber;
    private volatile SyncedBlocklist blocklist;
    private ScheduledExecutorService blocklistExecutor;

    @Inject
    public CorvusPlugin(ProxyServer proxy, Logger logger, @DataDirectory Path dataDirectory) {
        this.proxy = proxy;
        this.logger = logger;
        this.dataDirectory = dataDirectory;
    }

    @Subscribe
    public void onProxyInitialize(ProxyInitializeEvent event) {
        try {
            start();
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            // never let Corvus break the proxy start
            logger.error("Corvus failed to start, capture is DISABLED", t);
        }
    }

    private void start() throws IOException {
        Files.createDirectories(dataDirectory);
        Path configFile = dataDirectory.resolve("config.toml");
        if (!Files.exists(configFile)) {
            Files.writeString(configFile, CorvusConfig.DEFAULT_TOML, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            logger.info("Wrote default config to {}", configFile);
        }
        CorvusConfig config = CorvusConfig.parse(Files.readString(configFile, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

        if (config.payloadMode() == PayloadMode.ALL) {
            logger.warn("capture.raw_payloads = \"all\": payloads of clientbound packets that may contain names "
                    + "and UUIDs of other players are recorded. Use for local debugging only, never for data "
                    + "that reaches the data lake.");
        }

        Optional<PseudonymKey> key = KeyLoader.load(System::getenv, config.keyFile(), dataDirectory,
                config.keyId(), logger::warn);

        NanoClock nano = NanoClock.system();
        if (key.isPresent()) {
            Pseudonymizer pseudonymizer = new Pseudonymizer(key.get());
            pseudonyms = new PseudonymDirectory(pseudonymizer::pseudonym);
            for (Player online : proxy.getAllPlayers()) {
                pseudonyms.add(online.getUniqueId());
            }
        }
        Optional<SSLContext> sslContext = Optional.empty();
        boolean tlsFailed = false;
        try {
            sslContext = TlsTrust.sslContext(config.tls().caFile(), dataDirectory);
            sslContext.ifPresent(c -> logger.info("Corvus trusts the extra CA bundle {} in addition to the JVM "
                    + "default CAs", TlsTrust.resolve(config.tls().caFile(), dataDirectory)));
        } catch (TlsTrust.TlsSetupException e) {
            tlsFailed = true;
            logger.error("{}. The NATS sink, scores and blocklist sync are NOT started; fix tls.ca_file and "
                    + "restart the proxy.", e.getMessage());
        }
        SSLContext tls = sslContext.orElse(null);
        boolean natsBlocked = tlsFailed && (config.sinkType() == CorvusConfig.SinkType.NATS
                || config.scores().enabled());
        if (!tlsFailed) {
            startBlocklistSync(config, nano, tls);
        }
        Metrics metrics = new Metrics();
        ByteBoundedQueue queue = new ByteBoundedQueue(config.queueMaxBytes());
        SecureRandom random = new SecureRandom();
        engine = new CaptureEngine(
                new CaptureEngine.Settings(config.payloadMode(), config.maxPayloadBytes(), config.proxyId(),
                        BuildConstants.VERSION),
                natsBlocked && config.sinkType() == CorvusConfig.SinkType.NATS ? null
                        : key.map(Pseudonymizer::new).orElse(null),
                new PlayerFilter(config.listMode(), config.allowlist(), config.blocklist(), this::syncedBlocked),
                new GameContextMapper(config.serverContexts(), config.defaultGameContext(),
                        config.stripInstanceSuffix()),
                queue, nano, InstantSource.system(),
                () -> {
                    byte[] id = new byte[16];
                    random.nextBytes(id);
                    return id;
                },
                metrics, logger::info);

        if (!natsBlocked) {
            startScores(config, key, nano, tls);
        }

        StatsReporter commandStats = new StatsReporter(metrics, queue, engine, nano);
        CommandMeta meta = proxy.getCommandManager().metaBuilder("corvus").plugin(this).build();
        proxy.getCommandManager().register(meta,
                new CorvusCommand(commandStats, proxy, scoreRegistry, scoreSubscriber != null,
                        () -> blocklist == null ? "blocklist_sync=off" : blocklist.status()));

        if (!engine.isCapturing()) {
            logger.warn("Corvus is loaded but NOT capturing ({}). Players are unaffected.",
                    natsBlocked ? "tls.ca_file is invalid and the sink is NATS" : "no valid pseudonym key");
            return;
        }

        EnvelopeTransport transport;
        if (config.sinkType() == CorvusConfig.SinkType.NATS) {
            CorvusConfig.Nats nats = config.nats();
            logger.info("Corvus sink: NATS JetStream {} -> {}.{}.<partition> (connecting in the background)",
                    nats.urls(), nats.subjectPrefix(), config.proxyId());
            transport = new NatsTransport(new JetStreamEnvelopePublisher(nats, tls, logger::info, logger::warn),
                    nats.subjectPrefix(), config.proxyId(), nats.partitions(), nats.maxInFlightBytes(), nano, metrics,
                    logger::warn);
        } else {
            transport = new FileTransport(dataDirectory.resolve("captures"));
        }
        CaptureWriter writer = new CaptureWriter(transport, queue, config.batchSize(),
                config.flushIntervalMillis(), nano, metrics, logger::warn);
        writerThread = new WriterThread(writer);
        writerThread.start();

        StatsReporter logStats = new StatsReporter(metrics, queue, engine, nano);
        proxy.getScheduler().buildTask(this, () -> logger.info("stats {}", logStats.sample()))
                .delay(Duration.ofSeconds(60)).repeat(Duration.ofSeconds(60)).schedule();

        listener = new CorvusPacketListener(engine);
        registerListener(0);
    }

    /** Score subscription and API; independent of capture, but needs the pseudonym key to map players. */
    private void startScores(CorvusConfig config, Optional<PseudonymKey> key, NanoClock nano, SSLContext tls) {
        CorvusConfig.Scores scores = config.scores();
        AtomicInteger threadNumber = new AtomicInteger();
        scoreExecutor = new ThreadPoolExecutor(scores.listenerThreads(), scores.listenerThreads(), 0L,
                TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS, new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(scores.listenerQueueSize()), runnable -> {
                    Thread t = new Thread(runnable, "corvus-score-listener-" + threadNumber.incrementAndGet());
                    t.setDaemon(true);
                    return t;
                });
        RateLimitedLog log = new RateLimitedLog(nano, logger::warn, RateLimitedLog.DEFAULT_INTERVAL_NANOS);
        scoreRegistry = new ScoreRegistry(scoreExecutor, log);
        // The API is always available; without scoring it simply never has scores.
        CorvusProvider.register(scoreRegistry);
        if (!scores.enabled()) {
            return;
        }
        if (key.isEmpty()) {
            logger.warn("scores.enabled but there is no pseudonym key: scores cannot be mapped to players");
            return;
        }
        ScoreProcessor processor = new ScoreProcessor(pseudonyms, scoreRegistry, InstantSource.system(), log);
        scoreSubscriber = new ScoreSubscriber(config.nats(), tls, scores.subject(), processor::onMessage, logger::info,
                logger::warn);
        logger.info("Corvus scores: subscribing to {} (connecting in the background)", scores.subject());
    }

    /** Cheap (cached pseudonym, one hash lookup); runs on Netty threads. */
    private boolean syncedBlocked(UUID player) {
        SyncedBlocklist current = blocklist;
        PseudonymDirectory directory = pseudonyms;
        return current != null && directory != null && current.size() > 0 && current.contains(directory.hexOf(player));
    }

    /** Periodic blocklist fetch on its own daemon thread, never on Netty or Velocity event threads. */
    private void startBlocklistSync(CorvusConfig config, NanoClock nano, SSLContext tls) {
        CorvusConfig.BlocklistSync sync = config.blocklistSync();
        if (!sync.enabled()) {
            return;
        }
        if (pseudonyms == null) {
            logger.warn("blocklist_sync.enabled but there is no pseudonym key: pseudonyms cannot be matched. "
                    + "Blocklist sync is DISABLED.");
            return;
        }
        Optional<String> token = TokenLoader.load(System::getenv, sync.tokenFile(), dataDirectory, logger::warn);
        if (token.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        Duration timeout = Duration.ofSeconds(sync.timeoutSeconds());
        RateLimitedLog log = new RateLimitedLog(nano, logger::warn, RateLimitedLog.DEFAULT_INTERVAL_NANOS);
        blocklist = new SyncedBlocklist(
                new HttpBlocklistClient(sync.url(), token.get(), timeout, new JdkHttpTransport(timeout, tls)),
                InstantSource.system(), log, () -> {
                    CaptureEngine current = engine;
                    int ended = current == null ? 0 : current.endBlockedSessions();
                    logger.info("Blocklist changed, {} session(s) ended", ended);
                });
        blocklistExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(runnable -> {
            Thread t = new Thread(runnable, "corvus-blocklist-sync");
            t.setDaemon(true);
            return t;
        });
        SyncedBlocklist target = blocklist;
        blocklistExecutor.scheduleWithFixedDelay(target::syncOnce, 0L, sync.intervalSeconds(), TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        logger.info("Corvus blocklist sync: {} every {} s", sync.url(), sync.intervalSeconds());
    }

    /** PacketEvents initialises itself in its own ProxyInitializeEvent handler; wait until it is ready. */
    private void registerListener(int attempt) {
        try {
            if (PacketEvents.getAPI() != null && PacketEvents.getAPI().isInitialized()) {
                PacketEvents.getAPI().getEventManager().registerListener(listener);
                logger.info("Corvus capture listener registered (MONITOR, read-only)");
                return;
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            logger.debug("PacketEvents not ready yet", t);
        }
        if (attempt >= REGISTER_ATTEMPTS) {
            logger.error("PacketEvents did not initialise in time, capture is DISABLED");
            return;
        }
        proxy.getScheduler().buildTask(this, () -> registerListener(attempt + 1))
                .delay(500, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS).schedule();
    }

    @Subscribe
    public void onServerPostConnect(ServerPostConnectEvent event) {
        try {
            Player player = event.getPlayer();
            String server = player.getCurrentServer().map(c -> c.getServerInfo().getName()).orElse(null);
            if (engine != null) {
                engine.onBackendConnected(player.getUniqueId(), server, player.getClientBrand());
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            logger.debug("Corvus ignored a segment event failure", t);
        }
    }

    @Subscribe
    public void onPostLogin(PostLoginEvent event) {
        try {
            if (pseudonyms != null) {
                pseudonyms.add(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId());
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            logger.debug("Corvus ignored a pseudonym cache failure", t);
        }
    }

    @Subscribe
    public void onDisconnect(DisconnectEvent event) {
        try {
            if (pseudonyms != null) {
                pseudonyms.remove(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId());
            }
            if (scoreRegistry != null) {
                scoreRegistry.evict(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId());
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            logger.debug("Corvus ignored a score eviction failure", t);
        }
        try {
            if (engine != null) {
                engine.onDisconnect(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId());
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            logger.debug("Corvus ignored a disconnect failure", t);
        }
    }

    @Subscribe
    public void onProxyShutdown(ProxyShutdownEvent event) {
        if (blocklistExecutor != null) {
            blocklistExecutor.shutdownNow();
        }
        if (scoreSubscriber != null) {
            scoreSubscriber.close(Duration.ofSeconds(2));
        }
        if (scoreRegistry != null) {
            CorvusProvider.unregister(scoreRegistry);
        }
        if (scoreExecutor != null) {
            scoreExecutor.shutdownNow();
        }
        try {
            if (listener != null) {
                PacketEvents.getAPI().getEventManager().unregisterListener(listener);
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            // PacketEvents may already be terminated
        }
        if (engine != null) {
            engine.shutdown();
        }
        if (writerThread != null) {
            writerThread.stop();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.vocab;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketType;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketTypeCommon;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.ConnectionState;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Direction;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Corvus' own, version-stable packet vocabulary. Ids are APPEND-ONLY: never renumber, never reuse an id,
 * never delete an entry (see VOCABULARY.md). 0 means "unmapped".
 * Ranges: 1-99 serverbound play, 100-199 clientbound play, 200-299 configuration.
 */
public enum CorvusPacket {
    // serverbound play
    C_TELEPORT_CONFIRM(1, PacketType.Play.Client.TELEPORT_CONFIRM),
    C_CLIENT_STATUS(2, PacketType.Play.Client.CLIENT_STATUS),
    C_CLIENT_SETTINGS(3, PacketType.Play.Client.CLIENT_SETTINGS),

    C_CLICK_WINDOW_BUTTON(5, PacketType.Play.Client.CLICK_WINDOW_BUTTON),
    C_CLICK_WINDOW(6, PacketType.Play.Client.CLICK_WINDOW),
    C_CLOSE_WINDOW(7, PacketType.Play.Client.CLOSE_WINDOW),
    C_PLUGIN_MESSAGE(8, PacketType.Play.Client.PLUGIN_MESSAGE),
    C_INTERACT_ENTITY(9, PacketType.Play.Client.INTERACT_ENTITY),
    C_KEEP_ALIVE(10, PacketType.Play.Client.KEEP_ALIVE),
    C_PLAYER_POSITION(11, PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_POSITION),
    C_PLAYER_POSITION_AND_ROTATION(12, PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_POSITION_AND_ROTATION),
    C_PLAYER_ROTATION(13, PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_ROTATION),
    C_PLAYER_FLYING(14, PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_FLYING),
    C_VEHICLE_MOVE(15, PacketType.Play.Client.VEHICLE_MOVE),
    C_STEER_BOAT(16, PacketType.Play.Client.STEER_BOAT),
    C_PLAYER_ABILITIES(17, PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_ABILITIES),
    C_PLAYER_DIGGING(18, PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_DIGGING),
    C_ENTITY_ACTION(19, PacketType.Play.Client.ENTITY_ACTION),
    C_STEER_VEHICLE(20, PacketType.Play.Client.STEER_VEHICLE),
    C_PONG(21, PacketType.Play.Client.PONG),
    C_HELD_ITEM_CHANGE(22, PacketType.Play.Client.HELD_ITEM_CHANGE),
    C_CREATIVE_INVENTORY_ACTION(23, PacketType.Play.Client.CREATIVE_INVENTORY_ACTION),
    C_ANIMATION(24, PacketType.Play.Client.ANIMATION),
    C_PLAYER_BLOCK_PLACEMENT(25, PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_BLOCK_PLACEMENT),
    C_USE_ITEM(26, PacketType.Play.Client.USE_ITEM),
    C_CLIENT_TICK_END(27, PacketType.Play.Client.CLIENT_TICK_END),
    C_PLAYER_INPUT(28, PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_INPUT),
    C_ATTACK(29, PacketType.Play.Client.ATTACK),

    C_SPECTATE(31, PacketType.Play.Client.SPECTATE),
    C_PICK_ITEM(32, PacketType.Play.Client.PICK_ITEM),
    C_CONFIGURATION_ACK(33, PacketType.Play.Client.CONFIGURATION_ACK),
    C_CHUNK_BATCH_ACK(34, PacketType.Play.Client.CHUNK_BATCH_ACK),
    C_RESOURCE_PACK_STATUS(35, PacketType.Play.Client.RESOURCE_PACK_STATUS),
    C_PLAYER_LOADED(36, PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_LOADED),
    // text-bearing types: recorded without payload (see PayloadPolicy)
    C_EDIT_BOOK(37, PacketType.Play.Client.EDIT_BOOK),
    C_NAME_ITEM(38, PacketType.Play.Client.NAME_ITEM),
    C_UPDATE_COMMAND_BLOCK(39, PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_COMMAND_BLOCK),
    C_UPDATE_COMMAND_BLOCK_MINECART(40, PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_COMMAND_BLOCK_MINECART),
    C_UPDATE_STRUCTURE_BLOCK(41, PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_STRUCTURE_BLOCK),
    C_UPDATE_JIGSAW_BLOCK(42, PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_JIGSAW_BLOCK),

    C_COOKIE_RESPONSE(44, PacketType.Play.Client.COOKIE_RESPONSE),
    C_SET_TEST_BLOCK(45, PacketType.Play.Client.SET_TEST_BLOCK),
    C_TEST_INSTANCE_BLOCK_ACTION(46, PacketType.Play.Client.TEST_INSTANCE_BLOCK_ACTION),
    C_CUSTOM_CLICK_ACTION(47, PacketType.Play.Client.CUSTOM_CLICK_ACTION),
    C_SET_GAME_RULE(48, PacketType.Play.Client.SET_GAME_RULE),
    // privacy-dropped types (never recorded; ids exist so the analyzer can deny them)
    C_CHAT_PREVIEW(49, PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_PREVIEW),
    C_CHAT_MESSAGE(50, PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_MESSAGE),

    CFG_C_CLIENT_SETTINGS(200, PacketType.Configuration.Client.CLIENT_SETTINGS),
    CFG_C_PLUGIN_MESSAGE(201, PacketType.Configuration.Client.PLUGIN_MESSAGE),
    CFG_C_CONFIGURATION_END_ACK(202, PacketType.Configuration.Client.CONFIGURATION_END_ACK),

    CFG_S_REGISTRY_DATA(225, PacketType.Configuration.Server.REGISTRY_DATA),
    CFG_S_UPDATE_TAGS(226, PacketType.Configuration.Server.UPDATE_TAGS),
    CFG_S_SELECT_KNOWN_PACKS(227, PacketType.Configuration.Server.SELECT_KNOWN_PACKS),
    CFG_S_RESET_CHAT(228, PacketType.Configuration.Server.RESET_CHAT);

    private static final Map<PacketTypeCommon, CorvusPacket> BY_TYPE = new HashMap<>();

    static {
        for (CorvusPacket p : values()) {
            BY_TYPE.put(p.type, p);
        }
    }

    private final int id;
    private final PacketTypeCommon type;

    CorvusPacket(int id, PacketTypeCommon type) {
        this.id = id;
        this.type = type;
    }

    public int id() {
        return id;
    }

    public PacketTypeCommon packetEventsType() {
        return type;
    }

    /** Direction of the packet as seen from the proxy: serverbound = sent by the client. */
    public Direction direction() {
        return type instanceof PacketType.Play.Client || type instanceof PacketType.Configuration.Client
                ? Direction.DIRECTION_SERVERBOUND : Direction.DIRECTION_CLIENTBOUND;
    }

    /** Connection state of the packet (play or configuration). */
    public ConnectionState state() {
        return type instanceof PacketType.Configuration.Client || type instanceof PacketType.Configuration.Server
                ? ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_CONFIGURATION : ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_PLAY;
    }

    /** @return the stable id of the given type, or 0 if unmapped. */
    public static int idOf(PacketTypeCommon type) {
        CorvusPacket p = BY_TYPE.get(type);
        return p == null ? 0 : p.id;
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/blocklist/HttpBlocklistClientTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.blocklist;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URI;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;

class HttpBlocklistClientTest {

    /** Records requests and answers with a canned response; no network. */
    private static final class FakeTransport implements HttpTransport {
        final List<URI> uris = new ArrayList<>();
        final List<Map<String, String>> headers = new ArrayList<>();
        Response response = new Response(200, "{\"version\":\"v\",\"blocked\":[],\"allowed\":[]}");

        @Override
        public Response get(URI uri, Map<String, String> headers, Duration timeout) {
            uris.add(uri);
            this.headers.add(headers);
            return response;
        }
    }

    private final FakeTransport transport = new FakeTransport();

    private HttpBlocklistClient client(String base) {
        return new HttpBlocklistClient(base, "secret-token", Duration.ofSeconds(3), transport);
    }

    @Test
    void sendsTheBearerTokenToTheFeedEndpoint() throws IOException {
        client("https://api.example/").fetchBlocked();

        assertEquals(URI.create("https://api.example/api/v1/plugin/blocklist"), transport.uris.get(0));
        assertEquals("Bearer secret-token", transport.headers.get(0).get("Authorization"));
    }

    @Test
    void parsesTheBlockedArrayAndIgnoresAllowed() throws IOException {
        transport.response = new HttpTransport.Response(200,
                "{\"version\":\"v\",\"blocked\":[\"AB12\",\"cd34\"],\"allowed\":[\"ef56\"]}");

        Set<String> blocked = client("https://api.example").fetchBlocked();

        assertEquals(Set.of("ab12", "cd34"), blocked, "entries are lower-cased, allowed is not used");
    }

    @Test
    void anErrorStatusIsAFailure() {
        transport.response = new HttpTransport.Response(401, "{}");

        IOException e = assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> client("https://api.example").fetchBlocked());

        assertEquals("blocklist feed answered HTTP 401", e.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    void aMalformedBodyIsAFailure() {
        transport.response = new HttpTransport.Response(200, "<html>proxy error</html>");

        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> client("https://api.example").fetchBlocked());
    }

    @Test
    void aBodyWithoutBlockedArrayIsAFailure() {
        transport.response = new HttpTransport.Response(200, "{\"version\":\"v\"}");

        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> client("https://api.example").fetchBlocked());
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/blocklist/SyncedBlocklistTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.blocklist;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score.RateLimitedLog;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.InstantSource;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class SyncedBlocklistTest {

    private static final class FakeClient implements BlocklistClient {
        Set<String> next = Set.of();
        IOException failure;

        @Override
        public Set<String> fetchBlocked() throws IOException {
            if (failure != null) {
                throw failure;
            }
            return next;
        }
    }

    private final FakeClient client = new FakeClient();
    private final List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
    private final AtomicInteger changes = new AtomicInteger();
    private final SyncedBlocklist blocklist = new SyncedBlocklist(client,
            InstantSource.fixed(Instant.parse("2026-10-15T12:00:00Z")),
            new RateLimitedLog(() -> 0L, warnings::add, 60_000_000_000L), changes::incrementAndGet);

    @Test
    void beforeTheFirstSyncNothingIsBlockedAndStatusSaysNever() {
        assertFalse(blocklist.contains("aa"));
        assertEquals("blocklist_size=0 blocklist_last_sync=never blocklist_last_result=\"never synced\"",
                blocklist.status());
    }

    @Test
    void successfulSyncReplacesTheSet() {
        client.next = Set.of("aa", "bb");
        blocklist.syncOnce();
        client.next = Set.of("cc");
        blocklist.syncOnce();

        assertTrue(blocklist.contains("cc"));
        assertFalse(blocklist.contains("aa"), "an entry removed upstream is no longer blocked");
        assertEquals(1, blocklist.size());
        assertEquals(2, changes.get());
    }

    @Test
    void unchangedSetDoesNotNotify() {
        client.next = Set.of("aa");
        blocklist.syncOnce();
        blocklist.syncOnce();

        assertEquals(1, changes.get());
    }

    @Test
    void failedSyncKeepsTheLastGoodSetAndLogs() {
        client.next = Set.of("aa");
        blocklist.syncOnce();
        client.failure = new IOException("connection refused");
        blocklist.syncOnce();

        assertTrue(blocklist.contains("aa"));
        assertEquals(1, changes.get(), "a failure is not a change");
        assertEquals(1, warnings.size());
        assertTrue(blocklist.status().contains("blocklist_size=1"));
        assertTrue(blocklist.status().contains("failed at 2026-10-15T12:00:00Z: connection refused"));
        assertTrue(blocklist.status().contains("blocklist_last_sync=2026-10-15T12:00:00Z"));
    }

    @Test
    void failureOnFirstStartLeavesTheSetEmpty() {
        client.failure = new IOException("timeout");
        blocklist.syncOnce();

        assertEquals(0, blocklist.size());
        assertEquals(0, changes.get());
        assertTrue(blocklist.status().contains("blocklist_last_sync=never"));
    }

    @Test
    void repeatedFailuresAreRateLimited() {
        client.failure = new IOException("down");
        blocklist.syncOnce();
        blocklist.syncOnce();
        blocklist.syncOnce();

        assertEquals(1, warnings.size());
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/blocklist/TokenLoaderTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.blocklist;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class TokenLoaderTest {

    private final List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();

    @Test
    void environmentVariableWins(@TempDir Path dir) throws IOException {
        Files.writeString(dir.resolve("token"), "from-file\n");

        Optional<String> token = TokenLoader.load(Map.of(TokenLoader.ENV_VAR, " from-env ")::get, "token", dir,
                warnings::add);

        assertEquals(Optional.of("from-env"), token);
    }

    @Test
    void fileIsUsedWithoutEnvironmentVariable(@TempDir Path dir) throws IOException {
        Files.writeString(dir.resolve("token"), "from-file\n");

        assertEquals(Optional.of("from-file"), TokenLoader.load(k -> null, "token", dir, warnings::add));
    }

    @Test
    void missingTokenDisablesWithAWarning(@TempDir Path dir) {
        assertTrue(TokenLoader.load(k -> null, "", dir, warnings::add).isEmpty());
        assertTrue(TokenLoader.load(k -> null, "absent", dir, warnings::add).isEmpty());
        assertEquals(2, warnings.size());
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/CaptureEngineTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketType;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.config.CorvusConfig;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PlayerFilter;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PayloadMode;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.support.EngineFixture;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.support.FakePacketView;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.support.RecordingSink;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.vocab.CorvusPacket;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Frame;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.blocklist.SyncedBlocklist;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.Pseudonymizer;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score.PseudonymDirectory;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score.RateLimitedLog;

import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class CaptureEngineTest {

    private static final UUID OTHER = UUID.fromString("99999999-8888-7777-6666-555555555555");

    @Test
    void listenerNeverThrowsWhenSinkThrows() {
        CaptureSink throwingSink = new CaptureSink() {
            @Override
            public boolean offer(WriteItem item) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("sink down");
            }

            @Override
            public void offerControl(WriteItem item) {
            }
        };
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(throwingSink);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());

        assertEquals(1, f.metrics.listenerErrors.sum(), "the failure must be counted");
    }

    @Test
    void listenerNeverThrowsWhenPayloadCopyThrows() {
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(new RecordingSink());

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().payloadCopyFails(new IllegalStateException("buffer released")));

        assertEquals(1, f.metrics.listenerErrors.sum());
    }

    @Test
    void listenerNeverThrowsWhenViewItselfIsBroken() {
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(new RecordingSink());
        PacketView broken = new FakePacketView() {
            @Override
            public java.util.UUID playerId() {
                throw new IllegalStateException("no user");
            }
        };

        f.engine.onPacket(broken);

        assertEquals(1, f.metrics.listenerErrors.sum());
    }

    @Test
    void frameIsKeptWithoutEventWhenDecoderThrows() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(sink);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().decodeFails(new IllegalArgumentException("bad wrapper")));

        assertEquals(1, sink.frames.size(), "raw frame survives a decode failure");
        Frame frame = ((WriteItem.FrameItem) sink.frames.get(0)).frame();
        assertEquals(Frame.EventCase.EVENT_NOT_SET, frame.getEventCase());
        assertEquals(1, f.metrics.listenerErrors.sum());
    }

    @Test
    void framesAreDroppedAndCountedWhenQueueIsFull() {
        ByteBoundedQueue tinyQueue = new ByteBoundedQueue(100);
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(tinyQueue);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().payload(new byte[500]));
        long bytesAfterFirstDrop = tinyQueue.bytes();
        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().payload(new byte[500]));

        assertEquals(2, f.metrics.droppedQueueFull.sum());
        assertEquals(0, f.metrics.framesCaptured.sum());
        assertEquals(bytesAfterFirstDrop, tinyQueue.bytes(), "a rejected frame must not hold queue bytes");
    }

    @Test
    void queueRejectsOfferThatWouldExceedByteBound() {
        ByteBoundedQueue queue = new ByteBoundedQueue(300); // session start (128) + one 164-byte frame
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(queue);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().payload(new byte[100]));
        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().payload(new byte[100]));

        assertEquals(1, f.metrics.framesCaptured.sum());
        assertEquals(1, f.metrics.droppedQueueFull.sum());
    }

    @Test
    void sequenceNumberGapsMarkDroppedFrames() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(sink);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());
        sink.acceptFrames = false;
        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());
        sink.acceptFrames = true;
        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());

        assertEquals(0, ((WriteItem.FrameItem) sink.frames.get(0)).frame().getSeq());
        assertEquals(2, ((WriteItem.FrameItem) sink.frames.get(1)).frame().getSeq(), "dropped frame leaves a gap");
    }

    @Test
    void nothingIsCapturedWithoutPseudonymKey() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withoutKey(sink);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());

        assertFalse(f.engine.isCapturing());
        assertEquals(0, sink.frames.size());
        assertEquals(0, sink.controls.size(), "no session may be started without a key");
        assertEquals(0, f.metrics.listenerErrors.sum());
    }

    @Test
    void allowlistModeCapturesOnlyListedPlayers() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        PlayerFilter filter = new PlayerFilter(CorvusConfig.ListMode.ALLOWLIST, Set.of(FakePacketView.PLAYER), Set.of());
        EngineFixture f = new EngineFixture().build(sink, EngineFixture.KEY, PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, 2048, filter);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().player(OTHER));
        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());

        assertEquals(1, sink.frames.size());
        assertEquals(1, f.engine.activeSessions());
    }

    @Test
    void blocklistExcludesPlayerInAllMode() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        PlayerFilter filter = new PlayerFilter(CorvusConfig.ListMode.ALL, Set.of(), Set.of(OTHER));
        EngineFixture f = new EngineFixture().build(sink, EngineFixture.KEY, PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, 2048, filter);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().player(OTHER));

        assertEquals(0, sink.frames.size());
        assertEquals(0, f.engine.activeSessions(), "a blocked player never gets a session");
    }

    @Test
    void rawPayloadIsOmittedInModeNone() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = new EngineFixture().build(sink, EngineFixture.KEY, PayloadMode.NONE, 2048);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().payload(new byte[]{9, 9}));

        Frame frame = ((WriteItem.FrameItem) sink.frames.get(0)).frame();
        assertTrue(frame.getPayload().isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void payloadIsTruncatedToConfiguredMaximum() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = new EngineFixture().build(sink, EngineFixture.KEY, PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, 4);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().payload(new byte[100]));

        assertEquals(4, ((WriteItem.FrameItem) sink.frames.get(0)).frame().getPayload().size());
    }

    private Frame onlyFrame(RecordingSink sink) {
        return ((WriteItem.FrameItem) sink.frames.get(0)).frame();
    }

    @Test
    void clientboundScoreboardPayloadIsStrippedButTheFrameIsKept() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(sink);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().type(PacketType.Play.Server.TEAMS).clientbound().payload(new byte[]{1}));

        assertTrue(onlyFrame(sink).getPayload().isEmpty());
        assertEquals(0, onlyFrame(sink).getPayloadOriginalSize());
    }

    @Test
    void clientboundMotionPayloadIsRecordedInDefaultMode() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(sink);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().type(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_VELOCITY).clientbound()
                .payload(new byte[]{1, 2}));

        assertEquals(2, onlyFrame(sink).getPayload().size());
    }

    @Test
    void signUpdatePayloadIsStrippedButTheFrameIsKept() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(sink);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().type(PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_SIGN).payload(new byte[]{1, 2}));

        assertTrue(onlyFrame(sink).getPayload().isEmpty());
        assertEquals(CorvusPacket.C_UPDATE_SIGN.id(), onlyFrame(sink).getPacketType());
    }

    @Test
    void modeAllRecordsClientboundPayloadForDebugging() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = new EngineFixture().build(sink, EngineFixture.KEY, PayloadMode.ALL, 2048);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().type(PacketType.Play.Server.TEAMS).clientbound().payload(new byte[]{1}));

        assertEquals(1, onlyFrame(sink).getPayload().size());
    }

    @Test

        assertEquals(CorvusPacket.C_CLIENT_TICK_END.id(), second.getPacketType());

    @Test
    void sessionStartCarriesPseudonymAndNoRawUuid() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(sink);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());

        var start = ((WriteItem.Start) sink.controls.get(0)).envelope().getSessionStart();
        assertEquals(32, start.getPlayerPseudonym().size());
        assertEquals("k1", start.getPseudonymKeyId());
        assertEquals(16, start.getSessionId().size());
        assertFalse(f.logs.stream().anyMatch(l -> l.contains(FakePacketView.PLAYER.toString())),
                "logs must not contain the player UUID");
    }

    @Test
    void backendConnectStartsSegmentWithMappedGameContext() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(sink);
        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());

        f.engine.onBackendConnected(FakePacketView.PLAYER, "Lobby", "vanilla");
        f.engine.onBackendConnected(FakePacketView.PLAYER, "skyblock", null);

        var first = ((WriteItem.Segment) sink.controls.get(1)).envelope().getSegmentStart();
        var second = ((WriteItem.Segment) sink.controls.get(2)).envelope().getSegmentStart();
        assertEquals("lobby", first.getGameContext());
        assertEquals("vanilla", first.getClientBrand());
        assertEquals(1, first.getSegment());
        assertEquals("unknown", second.getGameContext());
        assertEquals(2, second.getSegment());
    }

    @Test
    void disconnectEndsSessionExactlyOnce() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(sink);
        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());

        f.engine.onDisconnect(FakePacketView.PLAYER);
        f.engine.onDisconnect(FakePacketView.PLAYER);

        long ends = sink.controls.stream().filter(i -> i instanceof WriteItem.End).count();
        assertEquals(1, ends);
        assertEquals(0, f.engine.activeSessions());
    }

    @Test
    void sessionFedByTwoChannelsIsReported() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(sink);

        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().channel("client-channel"));
        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().channel("backend-channel"));
        f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().channel("backend-channel"));

        assertEquals(1, f.metrics.sessionsWithMultipleChannels.sum(), "reported once per session");
    }

    /** Real pseudonym directory and synced blocklist, fake feed; the engine is notified like in the plugin. */
    private final class SyncedSetup {
        final RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        final PseudonymDirectory directory = new PseudonymDirectory(new Pseudonymizer(EngineFixture.KEY)::pseudonym);
        Set<String> feed = Set.of();
        EngineFixture fixture;
        final SyncedBlocklist blocklist = new SyncedBlocklist(() -> feed, java.time.InstantSource.system(),
                new RateLimitedLog(() -> 0L, m -> { }, 1L), () -> fixture.engine.endBlockedSessions());

        SyncedSetup() {
            PlayerFilter filter = new PlayerFilter(CorvusConfig.ListMode.ALL, Set.of(), Set.of(),
                    uuid -> blocklist.contains(directory.hexOf(uuid)));
            fixture = new EngineFixture().build(sink, EngineFixture.KEY, PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, 2048, filter);
        }

        String hexOf(UUID uuid) {
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(new Pseudonymizer(EngineFixture.KEY).pseudonym(uuid));
        }
    }

    @Test
    void pseudonymOnTheSyncedBlocklistIsNeverCaptured() {
        SyncedSetup setup = new SyncedSetup();
        setup.feed = Set.of(setup.hexOf(OTHER));
        setup.blocklist.syncOnce();

        setup.fixture.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().player(OTHER));

        assertEquals(0, setup.sink.frames.size());
        assertEquals(0, setup.sink.controls.size(), "no SessionStart for a blocked pseudonym");
        assertEquals(0, setup.fixture.engine.activeSessions());
    }

    @Test
    void onlinePlayerBecomingBlockedEndsTheSessionAndFurtherFramesAreIgnored() {
        SyncedSetup setup = new SyncedSetup();
        setup.fixture.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());
        setup.fixture.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().player(OTHER));
        assertEquals(2, setup.fixture.engine.activeSessions());

        setup.feed = Set.of(setup.hexOf(FakePacketView.PLAYER));
        setup.blocklist.syncOnce();
        setup.fixture.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());

        assertEquals(1, setup.fixture.engine.activeSessions(), "only the unblocked player keeps a session");
        assertEquals(2, setup.sink.frames.size(), "no frame after the block");
        assertEquals(1, setup.sink.controls.stream().filter(c -> c instanceof WriteItem.End).count(),
                "the blocked player's session gets a SessionEnd");
    }

    @Test
    void playerStaysCapturedWhenTheFeedOnlyListsOthers() {
        SyncedSetup setup = new SyncedSetup();
        setup.fixture.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());

        setup.feed = Set.of(setup.hexOf(OTHER));
        setup.blocklist.syncOnce();
        setup.fixture.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());

        assertEquals(1, setup.fixture.engine.activeSessions());
        assertEquals(2, setup.sink.frames.size());
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/CaptureWriterTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketType;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.support.EngineFixture;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.support.FakePacketView;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Envelope;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Frame;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Stream;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class CaptureWriterTest {

    private record Setup(EngineFixture fixture, CaptureWriter writer, Path captures) {
    }

    private Setup setup(Path dir, int batchSize) {
        ByteBoundedQueue queue = new ByteBoundedQueue(1 << 20);
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(queue);
        Path captures = dir.resolve("captures");
        CaptureWriter writer = new CaptureWriter(captures, queue, batchSize, 5_000, f.nanos::get, f.metrics, f.logs::add);
        return new Setup(f, writer, captures);
    }

    private static List<Envelope> readAll(Path file) throws IOException {
        List<Envelope> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try (InputStream in = Files.newInputStream(file)) {
            Envelope e;
            while ((e = Envelope.parseDelimitedFrom(in)) != null) {
                out.add(e);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static Path onlyCaptureFile(Path captures) throws IOException {
        try (Stream<Path> files = Files.walk(captures)) {
            List<Path> found = files.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".cvc")).toList();
            assertEquals(1, found.size(), "exactly one file per session");
            return found.get(0);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void writerProducesParseableDelimitedEnvelopesInOrder(@TempDir Path dir) throws IOException {
        Setup s = setup(dir, 200);
        s.fixture.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().payload(new byte[]{1, 2, 3}));
        s.fixture.engine.onBackendConnected(FakePacketView.PLAYER, "lobby", "vanilla");
        s.fixture.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().type(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_VELOCITY).clientbound());
        s.fixture.engine.onDisconnect(FakePacketView.PLAYER);

        s.writer.drain(100);
        s.writer.closeAll();

        List<Envelope> envelopes = readAll(onlyCaptureFile(s.captures));
        List<Envelope.BodyCase> kinds = envelopes.stream().map(Envelope::getBodyCase).toList();
        assertEquals(List.of(Envelope.BodyCase.SESSION_START, Envelope.BodyCase.BATCH,
                Envelope.BodyCase.SEGMENT_START, Envelope.BodyCase.BATCH, Envelope.BodyCase.SESSION_END), kinds);
        Frame first = envelopes.get(1).getBatch().getFrames(0);
        assertEquals(0, envelopes.get(1).getBatch().getSegment(), "pre-backend frames belong to segment 0");
        assertEquals(1, envelopes.get(3).getBatch().getSegment());
        assertEquals(3, first.getPayload().size());
    }

    @Test
    void fileIsPlacedUnderDateDirectoryNamedBySessionIdHex(@TempDir Path dir) throws IOException {
        Setup s = setup(dir, 200);
        s.fixture.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());
        s.fixture.engine.onDisconnect(FakePacketView.PLAYER);

        s.writer.drain(100);
        s.writer.closeAll();

        Path file = onlyCaptureFile(s.captures);
        assertEquals("2026-10-15", file.getParent().getFileName().toString());
        assertEquals("00000000000000000000000000000001.cvc", file.getFileName().toString());
    }

    @Test
    void batchesAreCutAtConfiguredSizeAndCarryCounters(@TempDir Path dir) throws IOException {
        Setup s = setup(dir, 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            s.fixture.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());
        }
        s.fixture.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView().type(PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_MESSAGE));
        s.fixture.engine.onDisconnect(FakePacketView.PLAYER);

        s.writer.drain(100);
        s.writer.closeAll();

        List<Envelope> envelopes = readAll(onlyCaptureFile(s.captures));
        long batches = envelopes.stream().filter(Envelope::hasBatch).count();
        assertEquals(3, batches, "5 frames with batch size 2 give 2 + 2 + 1");
        long dropped = envelopes.stream()
                .mapToLong(e -> e.hasBatch() ? e.getBatch().getCounters().getDroppedPrivacy()
                        : e.hasSessionEnd() ? e.getSessionEnd().getCounters().getDroppedPrivacy() : 0)
                .sum();
        assertEquals(1, dropped, "privacy drop is reported exactly once across batches and end");
    }

    @Test
    void pendingFramesAreFlushedOnceTheIntervalHasElapsedWithoutWaiting(@TempDir Path dir) throws IOException {
        Setup s = setup(dir, 200);
        s.fixture.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());
        s.writer.drain(100);
        long sizeBeforeFlush = Files.size(onlyCaptureFile(s.captures));

        s.fixture.nanos.addAndGet(6_000L * 1_000_000L);
        s.writer.flushDue();

        assertTrue(Files.size(onlyCaptureFile(s.captures)) > sizeBeforeFlush, "batch must be on disk after flushDue");
        s.writer.closeAll();
    }

    @Test
    void shutdownClosesOpenSessionFilesWithSessionEnd(@TempDir Path dir) throws IOException {
        Setup s = setup(dir, 200);
        s.fixture.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());

        s.fixture.engine.shutdown();
        s.writer.closeAll();

        List<Envelope> envelopes = readAll(onlyCaptureFile(s.captures));
        assertEquals(Envelope.BodyCase.SESSION_END, envelopes.get(envelopes.size() - 1).getBodyCase());
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/FakeEnvelopePublisher.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletionStage;

/** Records publishes; each returns a future the test completes (or fails) by hand, or completes at once. */
final class FakeEnvelopePublisher implements EnvelopePublisher {

    record Published(String subject, Map<String, String> headers, byte[] body, CompletableFuture<Void> ack) {
    }

    final List<Published> published = new ArrayList<>();
    boolean autoAck = true;
    RuntimeException throwOnPublish;
    Duration closedWith;
    boolean ready = true;

    @Override
    public boolean isReady() {
        return ready;
    }

    @Override
    public CompletionStage<Void> publish(String subject, Map<String, String> headers, byte[] body) {
        if (throwOnPublish != null) {
            throw throwOnPublish;
        }
        CompletableFuture<Void> ack = new CompletableFuture<>();
        published.add(new Published(subject, headers, body, ack));
        if (autoAck) {
            ack.complete(null);
        }
        return ack;
    }

    @Override
    public void close(Duration timeout) {
        closedWith = timeout;
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/GameContextMapperTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class GameContextMapperTest {

    private static GameContextMapper mapper(boolean strip, Map<String, String> servers) {
        return new GameContextMapper(servers, "unknown", strip);
    }

    @Test
    void exactMatchWinsOverStrippedMatch() {
        var m = mapper(true, Map.of("lobby-1", "special", "lobby", "lobby"));
        assertEquals("special", m.contextFor("Lobby-1"));
    }

    @Test
    void instanceSuffixIsStrippedToTheTaskContext() {
        var m = mapper(true, Map.of("lobby", "lobby"));
        assertEquals("lobby", m.contextFor("Lobby-2"));
    }

    @Test
    void hyphenatedTaskNamesKeepTheirInnerHyphens() {
        var m = mapper(true, Map.of("team-build", "build", "voyager-setup", "setup"));
        assertEquals("build", m.contextFor("Team-Build-1"));
        assertEquals("setup", m.contextFor("Voyager-Setup-1"));
    }

    @Test
    void nameWithoutSuffixIsLookedUpUnchanged() {
        var m = mapper(true, Map.of("lobby", "lobby"));
        assertEquals("lobby", m.contextFor("lobby"));
        assertEquals("unknown", m.contextFor("survival"));
    }

    @Test
    void trailingHyphenOrNonDigitSuffixIsNotStripped() {
        var m = mapper(true, Map.of("foo", "foo"));
        assertEquals("unknown", m.contextFor("Foo-"));
        assertEquals("unknown", m.contextFor("Foo-1a"));
    }

    @Test
    void onlyOneSuffixIsStripped() {
        var m = mapper(true, Map.of("a", "a", "a-1", "a1"));
        assertEquals("a1", m.contextFor("A-1-2"));
        assertEquals("unknown", mapper(true, Map.of("a", "a")).contextFor("A-1-2"));
    }

    @Test
    void lookupIsCaseInsensitive() {
        var m = mapper(true, Map.of("elytrarace", "race"));
        assertEquals("race", m.contextFor("ElytraRace-1"));
        assertEquals("race", m.contextFor("ELYTRARACE"));
    }

    @Test
    void disabledOptionTurnsStrippingOff() {
        var m = mapper(false, Map.of("lobby", "lobby"));
        assertEquals("unknown", m.contextFor("Lobby-2"));
        assertEquals("lobby", m.contextFor("Lobby"));
    }

    @Test
    void nullServerNameYieldsDefault() {
        assertEquals("unknown", mapper(true, Map.of()).contextFor(null));
    }
}
```
