`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/NatsTransportTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import com.google.protobuf.ByteString;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.support.EngineFixture;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.support.FakePacketView;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.CaptureBatch;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.CaptureCounters;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Envelope;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Frame;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.SessionStart;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class NatsTransportTest {

    private static final CaptureCounters NONE = CaptureCounters.getDefaultInstance();

    private final FakeEnvelopePublisher publisher = new FakeEnvelopePublisher();
    private final Metrics metrics = new Metrics();
    private final AtomicLong nanos = new AtomicLong(1_000);
    private final List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();

    private NatsTransport transport(long budget) {
        return new NatsTransport(publisher, "corvus.capture.v1", "proxy-a", 16, budget, nanos::get, metrics,
                warnings::add);
    }

    private static SessionState session(int n) {
        byte[] id = new byte[16];
        id[0] = (byte) 0xab;
        id[15] = (byte) n;
        return new SessionState(id, 0, 0, new Object());
    }

    private static Envelope start(SessionState s) {
        return Envelope.newBuilder().setSessionStart(SessionStart.newBuilder().setSessionId(s.idBytes())).build();
    }

    private static Envelope batch(SessionState s, int frames, int payload, CaptureCounters counters) {
        CaptureBatch.Builder b = CaptureBatch.newBuilder().setSessionId(s.idBytes()).setCounters(counters);
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            b.addFrames(Frame.newBuilder().setSeq(i).setPayload(ByteString.copyFrom(new byte[payload])));
        }
        return Envelope.newBuilder().setBatch(b).build();
    }

    @Test
    void publishesToPrefixDotProxyIdWithSchemaAndMsgIdHeaders() throws Exception {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(1 << 20);

        t.begin(s, start(s));

        FakeEnvelopePublisher.Published p = publisher.published.get(0);
        assertEquals("corvus.capture.v1.proxy-a.00", p.subject());
        assertEquals("capture.v1", p.headers().get("Corvus-Schema"));
        assertEquals(s.idHex() + "-0", p.headers().get("Nats-Msg-Id"));
        assertEquals(start(s), Envelope.parseFrom(p.body()), "body is the bare envelope without length prefix");
    }

    @Test
    void msgIdCounterIsMonotonicPerSession() {
        SessionState a = session(1);
        SessionState b = session(2);
        NatsTransport t = transport(1 << 20);

        t.begin(a, start(a));
        t.begin(b, start(b));
        t.send(a, batch(a, 1, 10, NONE), 1);
        t.send(a, batch(a, 1, 10, NONE), 1);
        t.send(b, batch(b, 1, 10, NONE), 1);

        List<String> ids = publisher.published.stream().map(p -> p.headers().get("Nats-Msg-Id")).toList();
        assertEquals(List.of(a.idHex() + "-0", b.idHex() + "-0", a.idHex() + "-1", a.idHex() + "-2",
                b.idHex() + "-1"), ids);
    }

    @Test
    void counterAdvancesForDroppedEnvelopesSoIdsAreNeverReused() {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(1 << 20);
        t.begin(s, start(s));
        publisher.autoAck = false;
        t.send(s, batch(s, 1, 10, NONE), 1);
        publisher.published.get(1).ack().completeExceptionally(new RuntimeException("timeout"));

        publisher.autoAck = true;
        t.send(s, batch(s, 1, 10, NONE), 1);

        assertEquals(s.idHex() + "-2", publisher.published.get(2).headers().get("Nats-Msg-Id"));
    }

    @Test
    void oversizedBatchIsSplitIntoEnvelopesBelow512KiB() throws Exception {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(64L << 20);
        t.begin(s, start(s));

        t.send(s, batch(s, 600, 2048, NONE), 600);

        List<FakeEnvelopePublisher.Published> parts = publisher.published.subList(1, publisher.published.size());
        assertTrue(parts.size() >= 3, "1.2 MB of frames needs at least three envelopes, got " + parts.size());
        int frames = 0;
        for (FakeEnvelopePublisher.Published p : parts) {
            assertTrue(p.body().length < 512 * 1024, "envelope of " + p.body().length + " bytes is too large");
            frames += Envelope.parseFrom(p.body()).getBatch().getFramesCount();
        }
        assertEquals(600, frames, "no frame is lost by splitting");
    }

    @Test
    void splittingKeepsFrameOrderAndCountersOnlyOnTheFirstPart() throws Exception {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(64L << 20);
        t.begin(s, start(s));
        CaptureCounters counters = CaptureCounters.newBuilder().setDroppedPrivacy(7).build();

        t.send(s, batch(s, 400, 2048, counters), 400);

        long drops = 0;
        long next = 0;
        for (FakeEnvelopePublisher.Published p : publisher.published.subList(1, publisher.published.size())) {
            CaptureBatch b = Envelope.parseFrom(p.body()).getBatch();
            drops += b.getCounters().getDroppedPrivacy();
            for (Frame f : b.getFramesList()) {
                assertEquals(next++, f.getSeq(), "frames stay in order across parts");
            }
        }
        assertEquals(7, drops, "counters are reported exactly once");
    }

    @Test
    void smallBatchIsNotSplit() {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(1 << 20);
        t.begin(s, start(s));

        t.send(s, batch(s, 10, 100, NONE), 10);

        assertEquals(2, publisher.published.size());
    }

    @Test
    void failedPublishCountsFramesAsDroppedTransportAndReportsThemInTheNextBatch() {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(1 << 20);
        t.begin(s, start(s));
        publisher.autoAck = false;

        t.send(s, batch(s, 5, 10, NONE), 5);
        publisher.published.get(1).ack().completeExceptionally(new IllegalStateException("ack timeout"));

        assertEquals(5, metrics.droppedTransport.sum());
        assertEquals(5, s.takeCounters().getDroppedTransport(), "reported with the next batch or session end");
        assertEquals(0, s.takeCounters().getDroppedTransport(), "and only once");
    }

    @Test
    void synchronousPublisherExceptionIsADropNotACrash() {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(1 << 20);
        t.begin(s, start(s));
        publisher.throwOnPublish = new IllegalStateException("closed");

        t.send(s, batch(s, 3, 10, NONE), 3);

        assertEquals(3, metrics.droppedTransport.sum());
        assertEquals(0, t.inFlightBytes(), "the reserved budget is released");
    }

    @Test
    void droppedBatchGivesItsCountersBackToTheSession() {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(1 << 20);
        t.begin(s, start(s));
        publisher.throwOnPublish = new IllegalStateException("closed");
        CaptureCounters taken = CaptureCounters.newBuilder().setDroppedQueueFull(4).setListenerErrors(2).build();

        t.send(s, batch(s, 3, 10, taken), 3);

        CaptureCounters next = s.takeCounters();
        assertEquals(4, next.getDroppedQueueFull());
        assertEquals(2, next.getListenerErrors());
        assertEquals(3, next.getDroppedTransport());
    }

    @Test
    void exhaustedBudgetDropsTheBatchWithoutPublishingOrBlocking() {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(5_000);
        t.begin(s, start(s));
        publisher.autoAck = false;
        t.send(s, batch(s, 2, 1500, NONE), 2);
        int publishedBefore = publisher.published.size();

        t.send(s, batch(s, 2, 1500, NONE), 2);
        t.send(s, batch(s, 2, 1500, NONE), 2);

        assertEquals(publishedBefore, publisher.published.size(), "over-budget batches never reach the broker");
        assertEquals(4, metrics.droppedTransport.sum());
        assertEquals(4, s.takeCounters().getDroppedTransport());
    }

    @Test
    void budgetIsReleasedWhenAnAckArrives() {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(5_000);
        t.begin(s, start(s));
        publisher.autoAck = false;
        t.send(s, batch(s, 2, 1500, NONE), 2);
        assertTrue(t.inFlightBytes() > 3_000);

        publisher.published.get(1).ack().complete(null);

        assertEquals(0, t.inFlightBytes());
        t.send(s, batch(s, 2, 1500, NONE), 2);
        assertEquals(0, metrics.droppedTransport.sum());
    }

    @Test
    void lifecycleEnvelopesAreNotDroppedByAnExhaustedBudget() {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(2_000);
        t.begin(s, start(s));
        publisher.autoAck = false;
        t.send(s, batch(s, 1, 1900, NONE), 1);

        t.send(s, Envelope.newBuilder().setSegmentStart(
                net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.SegmentStart.newBuilder().setSessionId(s.idBytes()))
                .build(), 0);

        assertEquals(3, publisher.published.size());
        assertEquals(0, metrics.transportFailures.sum());
    }

    private static Envelope segment(SessionState s) {
        return Envelope.newBuilder().setSegmentStart(
                net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.SegmentStart.newBuilder().setSessionId(s.idBytes()))
                .build();
    }

    private static Envelope end(SessionState s) {
        return Envelope.newBuilder().setSessionEnd(
                net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.SessionEnd.newBuilder().setSessionId(s.idBytes()))
                .build();
    }

    @Test
    void sessionStartBeforeConnectIsPublishedFirstAndInOrderAfterConnect() throws Exception {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(1 << 20);
        publisher.ready = false;

        t.begin(s, start(s));
        t.send(s, segment(s), 0);
        assertEquals(0, publisher.published.size(), "nothing is published without a connection");

        publisher.ready = true;
        t.poll();

        assertEquals(2, publisher.published.size());
        assertEquals(Envelope.BodyCase.SESSION_START, Envelope.parseFrom(publisher.published.get(0).body()).getBodyCase());
        assertEquals(s.idHex() + "-0", publisher.published.get(0).headers().get("Nats-Msg-Id"));
        assertEquals(s.idHex() + "-1", publisher.published.get(1).headers().get("Nats-Msg-Id"));
    }

    @Test
    void batchWhileSessionStartIsUnpublishedIsDroppedAndCounted() {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(1 << 20);
        publisher.ready = false;
        t.begin(s, start(s));

        t.send(s, batch(s, 4, 10, NONE), 4);

        assertEquals(0, publisher.published.size(), "a batch is never sent ahead of its SessionStart");
        assertEquals(4, metrics.droppedTransport.sum());
        assertEquals(4, s.takeCounters().getDroppedTransport());

        publisher.ready = true;
        t.poll();
        t.send(s, batch(s, 1, 10, NONE), 1);
        assertEquals(2, publisher.published.size(), "start, then the new batch");
    }

    @Test
    void failedSessionStartIsRetriedAndBatchesAreDroppedMeanwhile() {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(1 << 20);
        publisher.autoAck = false;
        t.begin(s, start(s));
        publisher.published.get(0).ack().completeExceptionally(new RuntimeException("no ack"));

        t.send(s, batch(s, 2, 10, NONE), 2);
        assertEquals(2, metrics.droppedTransport.sum());

        publisher.autoAck = true;
        t.poll();
        assertEquals(2, publisher.published.size(), "the start is published again with the same id");
        assertEquals(publisher.published.get(0).headers().get("Nats-Msg-Id"),
                publisher.published.get(1).headers().get("Nats-Msg-Id"));
    }

    @Test
    void backlogOverflowDropsOldestSessionEndThenSegmentButNeverASessionStart() {
        NatsTransport t = new NatsTransport(publisher, "corvus.capture.v1", "proxy-a", 16, 1 << 20, 4, 1 << 20,
                nanos::get, metrics, warnings::add);
        publisher.ready = false;
        SessionState a = session(1);
        SessionState b = session(2);
        t.begin(a, start(a));
        t.send(a, end(a), 0);
        t.begin(b, start(b));
        t.send(b, segment(b), 0);

        t.begin(session(3), start(session(3)));
        assertEquals(1, metrics.lifecycleDropped.sum(), "the SessionEnd goes first");
        t.begin(session(4), start(session(4)));
        assertEquals(2, metrics.lifecycleDropped.sum(), "then the SegmentStart");
        t.begin(session(5), start(session(5)));
        assertEquals(2, metrics.lifecycleDropped.sum(), "SessionStarts are kept even beyond the bound");

        publisher.ready = true;
        t.poll();
        assertEquals(5, publisher.published.size());
    }

    @Test
    void backlogIsBoundedByBytesToo() {
        NatsTransport t = new NatsTransport(publisher, "corvus.capture.v1", "proxy-a", 16, 1 << 20, 100, 40,
                nanos::get, metrics, warnings::add);
        publisher.ready = false;
        SessionState a = session(1);
        t.begin(a, start(a));
        t.send(a, end(a), 0);
        t.send(a, end(a), 0);

        assertTrue(metrics.lifecycleDropped.sum() >= 1, "ends are dropped once the byte bound is hit");
    }

    @Test
    void failuresWarnOncePerMinuteAndHintAtAMissingStream() {
        SessionState s = session(1);
        NatsTransport t = transport(1 << 20);
        t.begin(s, start(s));
        publisher.throwOnPublish = new IllegalStateException("503 No responders available for request");

        t.send(s, batch(s, 1, 10, NONE), 1);
        t.send(s, batch(s, 1, 10, NONE), 1);
        assertEquals(1, warnings.size(), "second failure within the minute is suppressed");
        assertTrue(warnings.get(0).contains("CORVUS_CAPTURE"), warnings.get(0));

        nanos.addAndGet(61_000_000_000L);
        t.send(s, batch(s, 1, 10, NONE), 1);
        assertEquals(2, warnings.size());
        assertTrue(warnings.get(1).contains("1 more"), warnings.get(1));
    }

    @Test
    void closeFlushesWithAShortBoundedTimeout() {
        transport(1 << 20).close();

        assertEquals(Duration.ofSeconds(3), publisher.closedWith);
    }

    @Test
    void writerBatchingFeedsTheNatsTransport() throws Exception {
        ByteBoundedQueue queue = new ByteBoundedQueue(1 << 20);
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(queue);
        NatsTransport t = new NatsTransport(publisher, "corvus.capture.v1", "proxy-test", 16, 1 << 20, f.nanos::get,
                f.metrics, f.logs::add);
        CaptureWriter writer = new CaptureWriter(t, queue, 2, 5_000, f.nanos::get, f.metrics, f.logs::add);
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            f.engine.onPacket(new FakePacketView());
        }
        f.engine.onDisconnect(FakePacketView.PLAYER);

        writer.drain(100);
        writer.closeAll();

        List<Envelope.BodyCase> kinds = new ArrayList<>();
        for (FakeEnvelopePublisher.Published p : publisher.published) {
            kinds.add(Envelope.parseFrom(p.body()).getBodyCase());
        }
        assertEquals(List.of(Envelope.BodyCase.SESSION_START, Envelope.BodyCase.BATCH, Envelope.BodyCase.BATCH,
                Envelope.BodyCase.BATCH, Envelope.BodyCase.SESSION_END), kinds);
        assertEquals(Duration.ofSeconds(3), publisher.closedWith);
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/PartitionerTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;

class PartitionerTest {

    private static byte[] id(int b0, int b1, int b2, int b3) {
        byte[] id = new byte[16];
        id[0] = (byte) b0;
        id[1] = (byte) b1;
        id[2] = (byte) b2;
        id[3] = (byte) b3;
        id[15] = (byte) 0x7f; // bytes beyond the first four must not matter
        return id;
    }

    @Test
    void firstFourBytesBigEndianModSixteen() {
        Partitioner p = new Partitioner(16);

        assertEquals(0, p.partition(id(0, 0, 0, 0)));
        assertEquals(1, p.partition(id(0, 0, 0, 1)));
        assertEquals(15, p.partition(id(0, 0, 0, 0x1f)));
        assertEquals(0x0123_4567 % 16, p.partition(id(0x01, 0x23, 0x45, 0x67)));
    }

    @Test
    void highBitIsTreatedAsUnsigned() {
        // 0xffffffff = 4294967295; mod 16 = 15, mod 10 = 5 (a signed int would give negative values)
        assertEquals(15, new Partitioner(16).partition(id(0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff)));
        assertEquals(5, new Partitioner(10).partition(id(0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff)));
        assertEquals(2868903936L % 7, new Partitioner(7).partition(id(0xab, 0, 0, 0)));
    }

    @Test
    void tokenHasTwoDigitsByDefault() {
        Partitioner p = new Partitioner(16);

        assertEquals("00", p.token(id(0, 0, 0, 0)));
        assertEquals("09", p.token(id(0, 0, 0, 9)));
        assertEquals("15", p.token(id(0, 0, 0, 15)));
    }

    @Test
    void tokenWidthStaysTwoUpToOneHundredPartitions() {
        assertEquals("99", new Partitioner(100).token(id(0, 0, 0, 99)));
    }

    @Test
    void tokenWidthGrowsBeyondOneHundredPartitions() {
        Partitioner p = new Partitioner(128);

        assertEquals("000", p.token(id(0, 0, 0, 0)));
        assertEquals("007", p.token(id(0, 0, 0, 7)));
        assertEquals("127", p.token(id(0, 0, 0, 127)));
    }

    @Test
    void singlePartitionIsAlwaysZeroZero() {
        assertEquals("00", new Partitioner(1).token(id(0xde, 0xad, 0xbe, 0xef)));
    }

    @Test
    void subjectJoinsPrefixProxyAndToken() {
        assertEquals("corvus.capture.v1.proxy-a.03",
                new Partitioner(16).subject("corvus.capture.v1", "proxy-a", id(0, 0, 0, 3)));
    }

    @Test
    void shortIdsAreZeroPaddedOnTheRight() {
        // {0, 1, 0} is read as 0x00010000 = 65536; 65536 mod 7 = 2
        assertEquals(2, new Partitioner(7).partition(new byte[] {0, 1, 0}));
        assertEquals(0, new Partitioner(16).partition(new byte[0]));
    }

    @Test
    void nonPositivePartitionCountIsRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new Partitioner(0));
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/PayloadCopierTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf;
import io.netty.buffer.Unpooled;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertArrayEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

class PayloadCopierTest {

    private ByteBuf bufferWithPacketIdConsumed() {
        ByteBuf buf = Unpooled.buffer();
        buf.writeByte(0x1A); // packet id, already consumed by PacketEvents
        buf.writeBytes(new byte[]{10, 20, 30, 40});
        buf.readerIndex(1);
        return buf;
    }

    @Test
    void readerAndWriterIndexAreUnchangedAfterCopy() {
        ByteBuf buf = bufferWithPacketIdConsumed();
        int readerBefore = buf.readerIndex();
        int writerBefore = buf.writerIndex();

        PayloadCopier.copyReadable(buf, 1024);

        assertEquals(readerBefore, buf.readerIndex(), "reader index must not move");
        assertEquals(writerBefore, buf.writerIndex(), "writer index must not move");
        buf.release();
    }

    @Test
    void referenceCountIsUnchangedAfterCopy() {
        ByteBuf buf = bufferWithPacketIdConsumed();

        PayloadCopier.copyReadable(buf, 1024);

        assertEquals(1, buf.refCnt(), "ownership stays with the caller");
        buf.release();
    }

    @Test
    void copyContainsOnlyBytesAfterThePacketId() {
        ByteBuf buf = bufferWithPacketIdConsumed();

        byte[] copy = PayloadCopier.copyReadable(buf, 1024);

        assertArrayEquals(new byte[]{10, 20, 30, 40}, copy);
        buf.release();
    }

    @Test
    void copyIsTruncatedToMaximumAndOriginalIsStillIntact() {
        ByteBuf buf = bufferWithPacketIdConsumed();

        byte[] copy = PayloadCopier.copyReadable(buf, 2);

        assertArrayEquals(new byte[]{10, 20}, copy);
        assertEquals(4, buf.readableBytes());
        buf.release();
    }

    @Test
    void mutatingTheCopyDoesNotChangeTheBuffer() {
        ByteBuf buf = bufferWithPacketIdConsumed();

        PayloadCopier.copyReadable(buf, 1024)[0] = 99;

        assertEquals(10, buf.getByte(buf.readerIndex()));
        buf.release();
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/capture/PrivacyDropTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketType;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketTypeCommon;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.support.EngineFixture;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.support.FakePacketView;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.support.RecordingSink;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.ConnectionState;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

class PrivacyDropTest {

    private void assertDroppedAndCounted(FakePacketView view, String what) {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(sink);

        f.engine.onPacket(view);

        assertEquals(0, sink.frames.size(), what + " must not be recorded");
        assertEquals(1, f.metrics.droppedPrivacy.sum(), what + " must be counted as dropped_privacy");
        assertEquals(0, f.metrics.listenerErrors.sum(), what + " must not raise listener errors");
    }

    private FakePacketView serverbound(PacketTypeCommon type) {
        return new FakePacketView().type(type);
    }

    private FakePacketView clientbound(PacketTypeCommon type) {
        return new FakePacketView().type(type).clientbound();
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundChatMessageIsDroppedAndCounted() {
        assertDroppedAndCounted(serverbound(PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_MESSAGE), "chat message");
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundSignedAndUnsignedCommandsAreDroppedAndCounted() {
        assertDroppedAndCounted(serverbound(PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_COMMAND), "signed command");
        assertDroppedAndCounted(serverbound(PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_COMMAND_UNSIGNED), "unsigned command");
    }

    @Test
    void chatSessionUpdateAndMessageAcknowledgementAreDroppedAndCounted() {
        assertDroppedAndCounted(serverbound(PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_SESSION_UPDATE), "chat session update");
        assertDroppedAndCounted(serverbound(PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_ACK), "message acknowledgement");
    }

    @Test
    void chatPreviewsAreDroppedAndCounted() {
        assertDroppedAndCounted(serverbound(PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_PREVIEW), "client chat preview");
        assertDroppedAndCounted(clientbound(PacketType.Play.Server.CHAT_PREVIEW_PACKET), "server chat preview");
        assertDroppedAndCounted(clientbound(PacketType.Play.Server.DISPLAY_CHAT_PREVIEW), "display chat preview");
    }

    @Test
    void systemPlayerAndDisguisedChatAreDroppedAndCounted() {
        assertDroppedAndCounted(clientbound(PacketType.Play.Server.SYSTEM_CHAT_MESSAGE), "system chat");
        assertDroppedAndCounted(clientbound(PacketType.Play.Server.CHAT_MESSAGE), "player chat");
        assertDroppedAndCounted(clientbound(PacketType.Play.Server.DISGUISED_CHAT), "disguised chat");
        assertDroppedAndCounted(clientbound(PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_CHAT_HEADER), "player chat header");
        assertDroppedAndCounted(clientbound(PacketType.Play.Server.DELETE_CHAT), "delete chat");
    }

    @Test
    void chatResetInConfigurationStateIsDroppedAndCounted() {
        assertDroppedAndCounted(clientbound(PacketType.Configuration.Server.RESET_CHAT)
                .state(ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_CONFIGURATION), "configuration chat reset");
    }

    @Test
    void tabCompletionAndCommandTreeAreDroppedAndCounted() {
        assertDroppedAndCounted(serverbound(PacketType.Play.Client.TAB_COMPLETE), "tab complete request");
        assertDroppedAndCounted(clientbound(PacketType.Play.Server.TAB_COMPLETE), "tab complete response");
        assertDroppedAndCounted(clientbound(PacketType.Play.Server.DECLARE_COMMANDS), "command tree");
        assertDroppedAndCounted(clientbound(PacketType.Play.Server.CUSTOM_CHAT_COMPLETIONS), "chat completions");
    }

    @Test
    void playerInfoPacketsCarryingNamesAndUuidsAreDroppedAndCounted() {
        assertDroppedAndCounted(clientbound(PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_INFO_UPDATE), "player info update");
        assertDroppedAndCounted(clientbound(PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_INFO_REMOVE), "player info remove");
    }

    @Test
    void loginAndHandshakeStatePacketsAreDroppedAndCounted() {
        assertDroppedAndCounted(serverbound(PacketType.Login.Client.LOGIN_START)
                .state(ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_LOGIN), "login start");
        assertDroppedAndCounted(serverbound(PacketType.Handshaking.Client.HANDSHAKE)
                .state(ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_HANDSHAKING), "handshake");
    }

    @Test
    void movementPacketIsRecordedAndNotCountedAsPrivacyDrop() {
        RecordingSink sink = new RecordingSink();
        EngineFixture f = EngineFixture.withSink(sink);

        f.engine.onPacket(serverbound(PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_POSITION));

        assertEquals(1, sink.frames.size(), "movement must be recorded");
        assertEquals(0, f.metrics.droppedPrivacy.sum());
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/config/CorvusConfigTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.config;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PayloadMode;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class CorvusConfigTest {

    @Test
    void defaultConfigParsesWithDocumentedDefaults() {
        CorvusConfig c = CorvusConfig.parse(CorvusConfig.DEFAULT_TOML);

        assertEquals(CorvusConfig.ListMode.ALL, c.listMode());
        assertEquals(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, c.payloadMode());
        assertEquals(64L * 1024 * 1024, c.queueMaxBytes());
        assertEquals("unknown", c.defaultGameContext());
        assertEquals("lobby", c.serverContexts().get("lobby"));
        assertEquals("k1", c.keyId());
    }

    @Test
    void allowlistAndBlocklistUuidsAreParsed() {
        UUID a = UUID.randomUUID();
        UUID b = UUID.randomUUID();
        CorvusConfig c = CorvusConfig.parse("[players]\nmode = \"allowlist\"\nallowlist = [\"" + a
                + "\"]\nblocklist = [\"" + b + "\"]\n");

        assertEquals(CorvusConfig.ListMode.ALLOWLIST, c.listMode());
        assertTrue(c.allowlist().contains(a));
        assertTrue(c.blocklist().contains(b));
    }

    @Test
    void rawPayloadsStringIsParsed() {
        assertEquals(PayloadMode.ALL, CorvusConfig.parse("[capture]\nraw_payloads = \"all\"\n").payloadMode());
        assertEquals(PayloadMode.NONE, CorvusConfig.parse("[capture]\nraw_payloads = \"none\"\n").payloadMode());
    }

    @Test
    void legacyBooleanTrueMeansServerbound() {
        assertEquals(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, CorvusConfig.parse("[capture]\nraw_payloads = true\n").payloadMode());
    }

    @Test
    void legacyBooleanFalseMeansNone() {
        assertEquals(PayloadMode.NONE, CorvusConfig.parse("[capture]\nraw_payloads = false\n").payloadMode());
    }

    @Test
    void missingRawPayloadsKeyDefaultsToServerbound() {
        assertEquals(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, CorvusConfig.parse("proxy_id = \"x\"\n").payloadMode());
    }

    @Test
    void unknownRawPayloadsValueIsRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> CorvusConfig.parse("[capture]\nraw_payloads = \"clientbound\"\n"));
    }

    @Test
    void unknownListModeIsRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> CorvusConfig.parse("[players]\nmode = \"everyone\"\n"));
    }

    @Test
    void sinkDefaultsToFileAndNatsDefaultsAreDocumented() {
        CorvusConfig c = CorvusConfig.parse("proxy_id = \"p\"\n");

        assertEquals(CorvusConfig.SinkType.FILE, c.sinkType());
        assertTrue(c.nats().urls().isEmpty(), "no implicit localhost default");
        assertEquals(8L * 1024 * 1024, c.nats().reconnectBufferBytes());
        assertEquals("", c.nats().credsFile());
        assertEquals("corvus.capture.v1", c.nats().subjectPrefix());
        assertEquals(32L * 1024 * 1024, c.nats().maxInFlightBytes());
        assertEquals(5_000L, c.nats().publishTimeoutMillis());
    }

    @Test
    void natsSinkWithUrlListAndCredsIsParsed() {
        CorvusConfig c = CorvusConfig.parse("""
                [sink]
                type = "NATS"
                [nats]
                url = ["nats://a:4222", "nats://b:4222"]
                creds_file = "/etc/corvus.creds"
                subject_prefix = "x.y"
                max_in_flight_bytes = 1048576
                publish_timeout_seconds = 2
                """);

        assertEquals(CorvusConfig.SinkType.NATS, c.sinkType());
        assertEquals(List.of("nats://a:4222", "nats://b:4222"), c.nats().urls());
        assertEquals("/etc/corvus.creds", c.nats().credsFile());
        assertEquals("x.y", c.nats().subjectPrefix());
        assertEquals(1_048_576L, c.nats().maxInFlightBytes());
        assertEquals(2_000L, c.nats().publishTimeoutMillis());
    }

    @Test
    void singleStringUrlIsAccepted() {
        CorvusConfig c = CorvusConfig.parse("[nats]\nurl = \"nats://only:4222\"\n");

        assertEquals(List.of("nats://only:4222"), c.nats().urls());
    }

    @Test
    void natsSinkWithoutUrlIsAConfigError() {
        IllegalArgumentException missing = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> CorvusConfig.parse("[sink]\ntype = \"nats\"\n"));
        IllegalArgumentException empty = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> CorvusConfig.parse("[sink]\ntype = \"nats\"\n[nats]\nurl = []\n"));

        assertTrue(missing.getMessage().contains("nats.url"), missing.getMessage());
        assertTrue(empty.getMessage().contains("nats.url"), empty.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    void reconnectBufferIsConfigurable() {
        CorvusConfig c = CorvusConfig.parse("[nats]\nreconnect_buffer_bytes = 1048576\n");

        assertEquals(1_048_576L, c.nats().reconnectBufferBytes());
    }

    @Test
    void invalidSinkTypeIsRejected() {
        IllegalArgumentException e = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> CorvusConfig.parse("[sink]\ntype = \"kafka\"\n"));

        assertTrue(e.getMessage().contains("sink.type"), e.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    void natsPartitionsDefaultToSixteenAndAreConfigurable() {
        assertEquals(16, CorvusConfig.parse("").nats().partitions());
        assertEquals(64, CorvusConfig.parse("[nats]\npartitions = 64\n").nats().partitions());
        assertEquals(1, CorvusConfig.parse("[nats]\npartitions = 0\n").nats().partitions());
    }

    @Test
    void scoresAreOffForTheFileSinkAndOnForTheNatsSink() {
        assertEquals(false, CorvusConfig.parse("").scores().enabled());
        assertEquals(true, CorvusConfig.parse("[sink]\ntype = \"nats\"\n[nats]\nurl = \"nats://a:4222\"\n")
                .scores().enabled());
    }

    @Test
    void explicitScoresEnabledOverridesTheSinkDefault() {
        CorvusConfig on = CorvusConfig.parse("[scores]\nenabled = true\n[nats]\nurl = \"nats://a:4222\"\n");
        CorvusConfig off = CorvusConfig.parse(
                "[sink]\ntype = \"nats\"\n[scores]\nenabled = false\n[nats]\nurl = \"nats://a:4222\"\n");

        assertEquals(true, on.scores().enabled());
        assertEquals(false, off.scores().enabled());
    }

    @Test
    void scoresEnabledWithoutNatsUrlIsAConfigError() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> CorvusConfig.parse("[scores]\nenabled = true\n"));
    }

    @Test
    void scoresDefaultsAreDocumented() {
        CorvusConfig.Scores scores = CorvusConfig.parse("").scores();

        assertEquals("corvus.score.v1.>", scores.subject());
        assertEquals(2, scores.listenerThreads());
        assertEquals(1024, scores.listenerQueueSize());
    }

    @Test
    void blocklistSyncIsOffByDefault() {
        CorvusConfig.BlocklistSync sync = CorvusConfig.parse(CorvusConfig.DEFAULT_TOML).blocklistSync();

        assertFalse(sync.enabled());
        assertEquals(300, sync.intervalSeconds());
    }

    @Test
    void blocklistSyncSettingsAreParsed() {
        CorvusConfig.BlocklistSync sync = CorvusConfig.parse("[blocklist_sync]\nenabled = true\n"
                + "url = \"https://api.example\"\ntoken_file = \"api.token\"\ninterval_seconds = 60\n"
                + "timeout_seconds = 4\n").blocklistSync();

        assertTrue(sync.enabled());
        assertEquals("https://api.example", sync.url());
        assertEquals("api.token", sync.tokenFile());
        assertEquals(60, sync.intervalSeconds());
        assertEquals(4, sync.timeoutSeconds());
    }

    @Test
    void enabledBlocklistSyncWithoutUrlIsRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> CorvusConfig.parse("[blocklist_sync]\nenabled = true\n"));
    }

    @Test
    void tlsCaFileDefaultsToEmpty() {
        assertEquals("", CorvusConfig.parse("").tls().caFile());
        assertEquals("", CorvusConfig.parse(CorvusConfig.DEFAULT_TOML).tls().caFile());
    }

    @Test
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/config/PilotConfigTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.config;

import com.moandjiezana.toml.Toml;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PayloadMode;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.TreeSet;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/** Keeps deploy/pilot/proxy/corvus-config.toml in line with what the plugin actually reads. */
class PilotConfigTest {

    private static String pilotToml() throws IOException {
        return Files.readString(Path.of(System.getProperty("corvus.pilot.config")), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private static Set<String> keys(String prefix, Map<String, Object> table) {
        Set<String> out = new TreeSet<>();
        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> e : table.entrySet()) {
            String path = prefix.isEmpty() ? e.getKey() : prefix + "." + e.getKey();
            if (e.getValue() instanceof Map<?, ?> nested && !path.equals("game_context.servers")) {
                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                Map<String, Object> child = (Map<String, Object>) nested;
                out.addAll(keys(path, child));
            } else {
                out.add(path);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    @Test
    void pilotConfigUsesOnlyKeysThePluginReads() throws IOException {
        Set<String> known = keys("", new Toml().read(CorvusConfig.DEFAULT_TOML).toMap());
        Set<String> used = keys("", new Toml().read(pilotToml()).toMap());

        Set<String> unknown = new TreeSet<>(used);
        unknown.removeAll(known);
        assertTrue(unknown.isEmpty(), "pilot config has keys the plugin ignores: " + unknown);
    }

    @Test
    void pilotConfigMapsBothBackendsToTheirContexts() throws IOException {
        CorvusConfig c = CorvusConfig.parse(pilotToml());

        assertEquals("lobby", c.serverContexts().get("lobby"));
        assertEquals("pvp", c.serverContexts().get("pvp"));
    }

    @Test
    void pilotConfigRecordsServerboundPayloadsOnly() throws IOException {
        assertEquals(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, CorvusConfig.parse(pilotToml()).payloadMode());
    }

    @Test
    void pilotConfigNamesItsPseudonymKeyVersion() throws IOException {
        assertEquals("pilot-1", CorvusConfig.parse(pilotToml()).keyId());
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/privacy/KeyLoaderTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class KeyLoaderTest {

    private static final String KEY_B64 = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString("0123456789abcdef0123".getBytes());

    @Test
    void noKeyAnywhereYieldsEmptyAndWarnsClearly(@TempDir Path dir) {
        List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();

        Optional<PseudonymKey> key = KeyLoader.load(Map.<String, String>of()::get, "", dir, "k1", warnings::add);

        assertTrue(key.isEmpty());
        assertEquals(1, warnings.size());
        assertTrue(warnings.get(0).contains("DISABLED"), warnings.get(0));
    }

    @Test
    void keyFromEnvironmentVariableIsLoaded(@TempDir Path dir) {
        Optional<PseudonymKey> key = KeyLoader.load(
                Map.of(KeyLoader.ENV_VAR, KEY_B64)::get, "", dir, "k7", w -> { });

        assertEquals("k7", key.orElseThrow().keyId());
    }

    @Test
    void keyFromFileIsLoadedWhenEnvIsUnset(@TempDir Path dir) throws IOException {
        Files.writeString(dir.resolve("pseudonym.key"), KEY_B64 + "\n");

        Optional<PseudonymKey> key = KeyLoader.load(
                Map.<String, String>of()::get, "pseudonym.key", dir, "k2", w -> { });

        assertEquals("k2", key.orElseThrow().keyId());
    }

    @Test
    void environmentWinsOverFile(@TempDir Path dir) throws IOException {
        Files.writeString(dir.resolve("pseudonym.key"), "!!!not base64!!!");

        Optional<PseudonymKey> key = KeyLoader.load(
                Map.of(KeyLoader.ENV_VAR, KEY_B64)::get, "pseudonym.key", dir, "k1", w -> { });

        assertTrue(key.isPresent());
    }

    @Test
    void invalidBase64FailsClosed(@TempDir Path dir) {
        List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();

        Optional<PseudonymKey> key = KeyLoader.load(
                Map.of(KeyLoader.ENV_VAR, "%%%")::get, "", dir, "k1", warnings::add);

        assertTrue(key.isEmpty());
        assertEquals(1, warnings.size());
    }

    @Test
    void tooShortKeyFailsClosed(@TempDir Path dir) {
        Optional<PseudonymKey> key = KeyLoader.load(
                Map.of(KeyLoader.ENV_VAR, Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(new byte[4]))::get, "", dir, "k1",
                w -> { });

        assertTrue(key.isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void missingKeyFileFailsClosed(@TempDir Path dir) {
        List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();

        Optional<PseudonymKey> key = KeyLoader.load(
                Map.<String, String>of()::get, "absent.key", dir, "k1", warnings::add);

        assertTrue(key.isEmpty());
        assertEquals(1, warnings.size());
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/privacy/PayloadPolicyTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketType;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketTypeCommon;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.ConnectionState;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Direction;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class PayloadPolicyTest {

    private static final Direction SB = Direction.DIRECTION_SERVERBOUND;
    private static final Direction CB = Direction.DIRECTION_CLIENTBOUND;
    private static final ConnectionState PLAY = ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_PLAY;
    private static final ConnectionState CONFIG = ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_CONFIGURATION;

    private static boolean records(PayloadMode mode, PacketTypeCommon type, Direction d, ConnectionState s) {
        return new PayloadPolicy(mode).recordsPayload(type, d, s);
    }

    @Test
    void modeNoneRecordsNoPayloadEvenForMovement() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.NONE, PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_POSITION, SB, PLAY));
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.NONE, PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_VELOCITY, CB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeRecordsServerboundMovement() {
        assertTrue(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_POSITION, SB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeStripsSignText() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_SIGN, SB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeStripsBookEdits() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Client.EDIT_BOOK, SB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeStripsAnvilItemNames() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Client.NAME_ITEM, SB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeStripsPluginMessages() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Client.PLUGIN_MESSAGE, SB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeStripsCommandBlocks() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_COMMAND_BLOCK, SB, PLAY));
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_COMMAND_BLOCK_MINECART, SB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeStripsStructureAndJigsawBlocks() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_STRUCTURE_BLOCK, SB, PLAY));
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_JIGSAW_BLOCK, SB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeStripsSpectateBecauseItCarriesATargetUuid() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Client.SPECTATE, SB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeStripsInventoryClicksBecauseItemsCanCarryNames() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Client.CLICK_WINDOW, SB, PLAY));
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Client.CREATIVE_INVENTORY_ACTION, SB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void everyStrippedTypeIsStrippedEvenInModeAll() {
        for (PacketTypeCommon type : PayloadPolicy.strippedServerboundTypes()) {
            assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.ALL, type, SB, PLAY), type.getName() + " must stay stripped in mode all");
            assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, type, SB, PLAY), type.getName() + " must be stripped");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeFailsClosedForUnmappedServerboundTypes() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Client.QUERY_BLOCK_NBT, SB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeRecordsAllowlistedClientboundMotion() {
        for (PacketTypeCommon type : PayloadPolicy.clientboundAllowlist()) {
            assertTrue(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, type, CB, PLAY), type.getName() + " is allowlisted");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void allowlistCoversExactlyTheDocumentedMotionTypes() {
        assertEquals(java.util.Set.of(
                PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_RELATIVE_MOVE,
                PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_RELATIVE_MOVE_AND_ROTATION,
                PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_ROTATION,
                PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_HEAD_LOOK,
                PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_TELEPORT,
                PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_VELOCITY,
                PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_POSITION_SYNC,
                PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_POSITION_AND_LOOK), PayloadPolicy.clientboundAllowlist());
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeStripsClientboundScoreboardAndTeams() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Server.TEAMS, CB, PLAY));
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Server.UPDATE_SCORE, CB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeStripsClientboundSpawnAndBossBar() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY, CB, PLAY));
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Server.BOSS_BAR, CB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeStripsSpawnPlayerBecauseItCarriesAnEntityUuid() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_PLAYER, CB, PLAY));
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY, CB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void serverboundModeStripsConfigurationPackets() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Configuration.Client.CLIENT_SETTINGS, SB, CONFIG));
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, PacketType.Configuration.Server.REGISTRY_DATA, CB, CONFIG));
    }

    @Test
    void modeAllRecordsClientbound() {
        assertTrue(records(PayloadMode.ALL, PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY, CB, PLAY));
        assertTrue(records(PayloadMode.ALL, PacketType.Configuration.Server.REGISTRY_DATA, CB, CONFIG));
    }

    @Test
    void modeAllStillExcludesPrivacyDroppedTypes() {
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.ALL, PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_MESSAGE, SB, PLAY));
        assertFalse(records(PayloadMode.ALL, PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_INFO_UPDATE, CB, PLAY));
    }

    @Test
    void levelOfClassifiesPrivateStrippedDefaultAndAllOnly() {
        assertEquals(PayloadPolicy.Level.FRAME_DROPPED,
                PayloadPolicy.levelOf(PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_COMMAND, SB, PLAY));
        assertEquals(PayloadPolicy.Level.STRIPPED, PayloadPolicy.levelOf(PacketType.Play.Client.UPDATE_SIGN, SB, PLAY));
        assertEquals(PayloadPolicy.Level.DEFAULT,
                PayloadPolicy.levelOf(PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_POSITION, SB, PLAY));
        assertEquals(PayloadPolicy.Level.ALL_ONLY,
                PayloadPolicy.levelOf(PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY, CB, PLAY));
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/privacy/PseudonymizerTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertArrayEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;

class PseudonymizerTest {

    private static final UUID PLAYER = UUID.fromString("11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555");

    private static PseudonymKey key(String material) {
        return new PseudonymKey(material.getBytes(), "k1");
    }

    @Test
    void sameKeyAndUuidGiveSamePseudonym() {
        byte[] a = new Pseudonymizer(key("0123456789abcdef")).pseudonym(PLAYER);
        byte[] b = new Pseudonymizer(key("0123456789abcdef")).pseudonym(PLAYER);

        assertArrayEquals(a, b);
        assertEquals(32, a.length, "HMAC-SHA-256 output");
    }

    @Test
    void differentKeysGiveDifferentPseudonyms() {
        byte[] a = new Pseudonymizer(key("0123456789abcdef")).pseudonym(PLAYER);
        byte[] b = new Pseudonymizer(key("fedcba9876543210")).pseudonym(PLAYER);

        assertFalse(Arrays.equals(a, b));
    }

    @Test
    void differentUuidsGiveDifferentPseudonyms() {
        Pseudonymizer p = new Pseudonymizer(key("0123456789abcdef"));

        assertFalse(Arrays.equals(p.pseudonym(PLAYER), p.pseudonym(UUID.randomUUID())));
    }

    @Test
    void pseudonymDoesNotContainRawUuidBytes() {
        byte[] uuidBytes = ByteBuffer.allocate(16)
                .putLong(PLAYER.getMostSignificantBits()).putLong(PLAYER.getLeastSignificantBits()).array();

        byte[] pseudonym = new Pseudonymizer(key("0123456789abcdef")).pseudonym(PLAYER);

        assertFalse(contains(pseudonym, uuidBytes), "raw uuid bytes must not appear");
        assertFalse(contains(pseudonym, Arrays.copyOf(uuidBytes, 8)), "half of the uuid must not appear");
    }

    @Test
    void keyShorterThanMinimumIsRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new PseudonymKey(new byte[8], "k1"));
    }

    @Test
    void keyMaterialIsNotPartOfToString() {
        assertEquals("PseudonymKey[k1]", key("0123456789abcdef").toString());
    }

    private static boolean contains(byte[] haystack, byte[] needle) {
        for (int i = 0; i + needle.length <= haystack.length; i++) {
            if (Arrays.equals(Arrays.copyOfRange(haystack, i, i + needle.length), needle)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/score/PseudonymDirectoryTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class PseudonymDirectoryTest {

    private static final UUID PLAYER = new UUID(3, 4);

    private final ScoreFixture f = new ScoreFixture();

    @Test
    void pseudonymOfAnOnlinePlayerResolvesToTheUuid() {
        f.directory.add(PLAYER);

        assertEquals(PLAYER, f.directory.lookup(f.pseudonymizer.pseudonym(PLAYER)).orElseThrow());
    }

    @Test
    void disconnectEvictsThePlayerFromBothDirections() {
        f.directory.add(PLAYER);

        f.directory.remove(PLAYER);

        assertTrue(f.directory.lookup(f.pseudonymizer.pseudonym(PLAYER)).isEmpty());
        assertEquals(0, f.directory.size());
    }

    @Test
    void unknownPseudonymIsEmpty() {
        assertTrue(f.directory.lookup(new byte[32]).isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void addingTwiceKeepsOneEntry() {
        f.directory.add(PLAYER);
        f.directory.add(PLAYER);

        assertEquals(1, f.directory.size());
    }

    @Test
    void removingAnUnknownPlayerIsHarmless() {
        f.directory.remove(PLAYER);

        assertEquals(0, f.directory.size());
    }

    @Test
    void hexOfComputesLazilyAndMatchesTheLookup() {
        String hex = f.directory.hexOf(PLAYER);

        assertEquals(java.util.HexFormat.of().formatHex(f.pseudonymizer.pseudonym(PLAYER)), hex);
        assertEquals(PLAYER, f.directory.lookup(f.pseudonymizer.pseudonym(PLAYER)).orElseThrow());
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/score/ScoreProcessorTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.api.PlayerScore;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.api.ScoreStage;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score.ScoreProcessor.Outcome;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.score.v1.Score;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class ScoreProcessorTest {

    private static final UUID PLAYER = new UUID(7, 8);

    private final ScoreFixture f = new ScoreFixture();

    @Test
    void enforceScoreOfAnOnlinePlayerIsDecodedAndMapped() {
        f.directory.add(PLAYER);

        Outcome outcome = f.processor.onMessage(f.message(PLAYER, Score.Stage.STAGE_ENFORCE, 1_000_000L, 0.8f));

        assertEquals(Outcome.ACCEPTED, outcome);
        PlayerScore s = f.registry.latestScore(PLAYER, "pvp").orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(new PlayerScore(PLAYER, "pvp", "combat", 0.8f, 0.4f, 4, "combat-gbm", "3",
                ScoreStage.ENFORCE, Instant.ofEpochMilli(1_000_000L)), s);
    }

    @Test
    void canaryStageIsExposedAsCanary() {
        f.directory.add(PLAYER);

        f.processor.onMessage(f.message(PLAYER, Score.Stage.STAGE_CANARY, 1_000L, 0.3f));

        assertEquals(ScoreStage.CANARY, f.registry.latestScore(PLAYER, "pvp").orElseThrow().stage());
    }

    @Test
    void shadowScoreIsIgnoredEvenForAnOnlinePlayer() {
        f.directory.add(PLAYER);

        Outcome outcome = f.processor.onMessage(f.message(PLAYER, Score.Stage.STAGE_SHADOW, 1_000L, 0.9f));

        assertEquals(Outcome.IGNORED_STAGE, outcome);
        assertTrue(f.registry.latestScores(PLAYER).isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void unspecifiedStageIsIgnored() {
        f.directory.add(PLAYER);

        assertEquals(Outcome.IGNORED_STAGE,
                f.processor.onMessage(f.message(PLAYER, Score.Stage.STAGE_UNSPECIFIED, 1_000L, 0.9f)));
    }

    @Test
    void scoreOfAPlayerWhoIsNotOnlineIsIgnored() {
        Outcome outcome = f.processor.onMessage(f.message(PLAYER, Score.Stage.STAGE_ENFORCE, 1_000L, 0.9f));

        assertEquals(Outcome.IGNORED_OFFLINE, outcome);
        assertTrue(f.registry.latestScores(PLAYER).isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void newerScoreWinsByTimestamp() {
        f.directory.add(PLAYER);
        f.processor.onMessage(f.message(PLAYER, Score.Stage.STAGE_ENFORCE, 2_000L, 0.2f));

        Outcome outcome = f.processor.onMessage(f.message(PLAYER, Score.Stage.STAGE_ENFORCE, 3_000L, 0.7f));

        assertEquals(Outcome.ACCEPTED, outcome);
        assertEquals(0.7f, f.registry.latestScore(PLAYER, "pvp").orElseThrow().score());
    }

    @Test
    void olderScoreArrivingLateDoesNotReplaceTheLatest() {
        f.directory.add(PLAYER);
        f.processor.onMessage(f.message(PLAYER, Score.Stage.STAGE_ENFORCE, 3_000L, 0.7f));

        Outcome outcome = f.processor.onMessage(f.message(PLAYER, Score.Stage.STAGE_ENFORCE, 2_000L, 0.2f));

        assertEquals(Outcome.STALE, outcome);
        assertEquals(0.7f, f.registry.latestScore(PLAYER, "pvp").orElseThrow().score());
    }

    @Test
    void missingTimestampFallsBackToTheInjectedClock() {
        f.directory.add(PLAYER);

        f.processor.onMessage(f.message(PLAYER, Score.Stage.STAGE_ENFORCE, 0L, 0.5f));

        assertEquals(ScoreFixture.NOW, f.registry.latestScore(PLAYER, "pvp").orElseThrow().scoredAt());
    }

    @Test
    void undecodableBytesAreInvalidAndWarnOnce() {
        Outcome first = f.processor.onMessage(new byte[] {(byte) 0xff, (byte) 0xff, (byte) 0xff});
        f.processor.onMessage(new byte[] {(byte) 0xff, (byte) 0xff, (byte) 0xff});

        assertEquals(Outcome.INVALID, first);
        assertEquals(1, f.warnings.size(), "warnings are rate limited");
        assertEquals(2, f.processor.count(Outcome.INVALID));
    }

    @Test
    void outOfRangeScoreIsInvalid() {
        f.directory.add(PLAYER);

        Outcome outcome = f.processor.onMessage(f.message(PLAYER, Score.Stage.STAGE_ENFORCE, 1_000L, 7f));

        assertEquals(Outcome.INVALID, outcome);
        assertTrue(f.registry.latestScores(PLAYER).isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void scoresForDifferentContextsAreKeptSeparately() throws Exception {
        f.directory.add(PLAYER);
        f.processor.onMessage(f.message(PLAYER, Score.Stage.STAGE_ENFORCE, 1_000L, 0.1f));
        byte[] lobby = Score.newBuilder().mergeFrom(f.message(PLAYER, Score.Stage.STAGE_ENFORCE, 1_000L, 0.6f))
                .setGameContext("lobby").build().toByteArray();

        f.processor.onMessage(lobby);

        assertEquals(2, f.registry.latestScores(PLAYER).size());
        assertEquals(0.6f, f.registry.latestScore(PLAYER, "lobby").orElseThrow().score());
        assertEquals(0.1f, f.registry.latestScore(PLAYER, "pvp").orElseThrow().score());
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/score/ScoreRegistryTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.score;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.api.CorvusApi;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.api.PlayerScore;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.api.ScoreStage;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class ScoreRegistryTest {

    private static final UUID PLAYER = new UUID(1, 1);

    private final ScoreFixture f = new ScoreFixture();

    private static PlayerScore score(String context, String domain, float value, long millis) {
        return new PlayerScore(PLAYER, context, domain, value, value, 1, "m", "1", ScoreStage.ENFORCE,
                Instant.ofEpochMilli(millis));
    }

    @Test
    void throwingListenerDoesNotAffectOtherListeners() {
        List<PlayerScore> received = new ArrayList<>();
        f.registry.registerScoreListener(s -> {
            throw new IllegalStateException("boom");
        });
        f.registry.registerScoreListener(received::add);

        f.registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.5f, 1_000));

        assertEquals(1, received.size());
        assertEquals(1, f.registry.listenerErrors());
        assertEquals(1, f.warnings.size(), "the failure is logged");
    }

    @Test
    void listenerFailuresAreLoggedRateLimited() {
        f.registry.registerScoreListener(s -> {
            throw new IllegalStateException("boom");
        });

        f.registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.1f, 1_000));
        f.registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.2f, 2_000));
        f.registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.3f, 3_000));
        f.nanos.set(61_000_000_000L);
        f.registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.4f, 4_000));

        assertEquals(4, f.registry.listenerErrors());
        assertEquals(2, f.warnings.size());
        assertTrue(f.warnings.get(1).contains("2 more"), f.warnings.get(1));
    }

    @Test
    void listenersRunOnTheExecutorNotOnTheCaller() {
        ArrayDeque<Runnable> queued = new ArrayDeque<>();
        ScoreRegistry registry = new ScoreRegistry(queued::add, f.log);
        List<PlayerScore> received = new ArrayList<>();
        registry.registerScoreListener(received::add);

        registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.5f, 1_000));

        assertTrue(received.isEmpty(), "update returned without running the listener");
        queued.poll().run();
        assertEquals(1, received.size());
    }

    @Test
    void fullExecutorQueueDropsTheUpdateWithoutThrowing() {
        ScoreRegistry registry = new ScoreRegistry(r -> {
            throw new RejectedExecutionException("queue full");
        }, f.log);
        registry.registerScoreListener(s -> { });

        registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.5f, 1_000));

        assertEquals(1, registry.dispatchRejected());
        assertEquals(1, registry.latestScores(PLAYER).size(), "the score is still stored");
    }

    @Test
    void staleUpdateDoesNotNotifyListeners() {
        List<PlayerScore> received = new ArrayList<>();
        f.registry.registerScoreListener(received::add);
        f.registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.5f, 2_000));

        boolean stored = f.registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.9f, 1_000));

        assertEquals(false, stored);
        assertEquals(1, received.size());
    }

    @Test
    void unregisteredListenerReceivesNothingMore() {
        List<PlayerScore> received = new ArrayList<>();
        CorvusApi.Registration registration = f.registry.registerScoreListener(received::add);
        f.registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.5f, 1_000));

        registration.unregister();
        registration.unregister();
        f.registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.6f, 2_000));

        assertEquals(1, received.size());
    }

    @Test
    void latestScoreForAContextPicksTheMostRecentDomain() {
        f.registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.1f, 1_000));
        f.registry.update(score("pvp", "movement", 0.2f, 5_000));
        f.registry.update(score("lobby", "movement", 0.3f, 9_000));

        assertEquals("movement", f.registry.latestScore(PLAYER, "pvp").orElseThrow().domain());
        assertEquals(3, f.registry.latestScores(PLAYER).size());
    }

    @Test
    void evictForgetsAllScoresOfThePlayer() {
        f.registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.1f, 1_000));

        f.registry.evict(PLAYER);

        assertTrue(f.registry.latestScores(PLAYER).isEmpty());
        assertTrue(f.registry.latestScore(PLAYER, "pvp").isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void returnedCollectionIsASnapshotThatCannotBeModified() {
        f.registry.update(score("pvp", "combat", 0.1f, 1_000));
        var snapshot = f.registry.latestScores(PLAYER);

        f.registry.update(score("pvp", "movement", 0.2f, 2_000));

        assertEquals(1, snapshot.size());
        assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException.class, snapshot::clear);
    }
}
```

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.support;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.CaptureEngine;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.CaptureSink;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.GameContextMapper;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.config.CorvusConfig;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PayloadMode;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PlayerFilter;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.InstantSource;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;

/** Builds a fresh engine with deterministic collaborators. One instance per test: no shared state. */
public final class EngineFixture {

    public static final PseudonymKey KEY = new PseudonymKey("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef".getBytes(), "k1");

    public final Metrics metrics = new Metrics();
    public final AtomicLong nanos = new AtomicLong(1_000);
    public final List<String> logs = new ArrayList<>();
    public final InstantSource wallClock = InstantSource.fixed(Instant.parse("2026-10-15T12:00:00Z"));
    private final AtomicLong sessionCounter = new AtomicLong();

    public CaptureSink sink;
    public CaptureEngine engine;

    public static EngineFixture withSink(CaptureSink sink) {
        return new EngineFixture().build(sink, KEY, PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, 2048);
    }

    public static EngineFixture withoutKey(CaptureSink sink) {
        return new EngineFixture().build(sink, null, PayloadMode.SERVERBOUND, 2048);
    }

    public EngineFixture build(CaptureSink sink, PseudonymKey key, PayloadMode payloadMode, int maxPayload) {
        return build(sink, key, payloadMode, maxPayload,
                new PlayerFilter(CorvusConfig.ListMode.ALL, Set.of(), Set.of()));
    }

    public EngineFixture build(CaptureSink sink, PseudonymKey key, PayloadMode payloadMode, int maxPayload,
                               PlayerFilter filter) {
        this.sink = sink;
        this.engine = new CaptureEngine(
                new CaptureEngine.Settings(payloadMode, maxPayload, "proxy-test", "0.0.0-test"),
                key == null ? null : new Pseudonymizer(key),
                filter,
                new GameContextMapper(Map.of("lobby", "lobby"), "unknown"),
                sink, nanos::get, wallClock,
                () -> {
                    byte[] id = new byte[16];
                    id[15] = (byte) sessionCounter.incrementAndGet();
                    return id;
                },
                metrics, logs::add);
        return this;
    }

    public static InstantSource utc(String iso) {
        return InstantSource.fixed(Instant.parse(iso).atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant());
    }
}
```

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.support;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketType;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketTypeCommon;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.PacketView;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.ConnectionState;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Direction;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Frame;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.SwingEvent;

import java.util.UUID;

/** Hand-written test double for {@link PacketView}; each test builds its own instance. */
public class FakePacketView implements PacketView {

    private static final Object DEFAULT_CHANNEL = new Object();
    public static final UUID PLAYER = UUID.fromString("11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555");

    private PacketTypeCommon type = PacketType.Play.Client.PLAYER_POSITION;
    private Direction direction = Direction.DIRECTION_SERVERBOUND;
    private ConnectionState state = ConnectionState.CONNECTION_STATE_PLAY;
    private UUID player = PLAYER;
    private Object channel = DEFAULT_CHANNEL;
    private byte[] payload = {1, 2, 3};
    private RuntimeException decodeFailure;
    private boolean decodesSwing;
    private RuntimeException payloadFailure;

    public FakePacketView type(PacketTypeCommon type) {
        this.type = type;
        return this;
    }

    public FakePacketView clientbound() {
        this.direction = Direction.DIRECTION_CLIENTBOUND;
        return this;
    }

    public FakePacketView state(ConnectionState state) {
        this.state = state;
        return this;
    }

    public FakePacketView player(UUID player) {
        this.player = player;
        return this;
    }

    public FakePacketView channel(Object channel) {
        this.channel = channel;
        return this;
    }

    public FakePacketView payload(byte[] payload) {
        this.payload = payload;
        return this;
    }

    public FakePacketView decodeFails(RuntimeException failure) {
        this.decodeFailure = failure;
        return this;
    }

    public FakePacketView payloadCopyFails(RuntimeException failure) {
        this.payloadFailure = failure;
        return this;
    }

    public FakePacketView decodesSwing() {
        this.decodesSwing = true;
        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public Direction direction() {
        return direction;
    }

    @Override
    public PacketTypeCommon packetType() {
        return type;
    }

    @Override
    public int wirePacketId() {
        return 42;
    }

    @Override
    public ConnectionState state() {
        return state;
    }

    @Override
    public UUID playerId() {
        return player;
    }

    @Override
    public Object channelKey() {
        return channel;
    }

    @Override
    public byte[] copyPayload(int maxBytes) {
        if (payloadFailure != null) {
            throw payloadFailure;
        }
        return payload.length <= maxBytes ? payload.clone() : java.util.Arrays.copyOf(payload, maxBytes);
    }

    @Override
    public int payloadSize() {
        return payload.length;
    }

    @Override
    public void decodeEvent(Frame.Builder target) {
        if (decodeFailure != null) {
            throw decodeFailure;
        }
        if (decodesSwing) {
            target.setSwing(SwingEvent.newBuilder().setOffHand(true));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public SessionInfo sessionInfo() {
        return new SessionInfo(767, 767, false, "test");
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/support/RecordingSink.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.support;

import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.CaptureSink;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.capture.WriteItem;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/** In-memory sink that records everything offered to it. */
public final class RecordingSink implements CaptureSink {

    public final List<WriteItem> frames = new ArrayList<>();
    public final List<WriteItem> controls = new ArrayList<>();
    public boolean acceptFrames = true;

    @Override
    public boolean offer(WriteItem item) {
        if (!acceptFrames) {
            return false;
        }
        frames.add(item);
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void offerControl(WriteItem item) {
        controls.add(item);
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/tls/TlsTrustTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.tls;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

import javax.net.ssl.X509TrustManager;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.security.cert.CertificateException;
import java.security.cert.CertificateFactory;
import java.security.cert.X509Certificate;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertDoesNotThrow;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class TlsTrustTest {

    @TempDir
    Path dir;

    private static String resource(String name) throws IOException {
        try (InputStream in = TlsTrustTest.class.getResourceAsStream("/tls/" + name)) {
            return new String(in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        }
    }

    private static X509Certificate cert(String name) throws Exception {
        try (InputStream in = TlsTrustTest.class.getResourceAsStream("/tls/" + name)) {
            return (X509Certificate) CertificateFactory.getInstance("X.509").generateCertificate(in);
        }
    }

    /** Stands in for the JVM default trust: accepts exactly the chains whose first certificate it knows. */
    private static final class FakeTrust implements X509TrustManager {
        private final List<X509Certificate> accepted;

        FakeTrust(X509Certificate... accepted) {
            this.accepted = List.of(accepted);
        }

        @Override
        public void checkClientTrusted(X509Certificate[] chain, String authType) throws CertificateException {
            checkServerTrusted(chain, authType);
        }

        @Override
        public void checkServerTrusted(X509Certificate[] chain, String authType) throws CertificateException {
            if (!accepted.contains(chain[0])) {
                throw new CertificateException("not trusted by fake default");
            }
        }

        @Override
        public X509Certificate[] getAcceptedIssuers() {
            return accepted.toArray(new X509Certificate[0]);
        }
    }

    private static X509TrustManager compositeOf(X509TrustManager defaults, String caResource) throws Exception {
        Path ca = Path.of(TlsTrustTest.class.getResource("/tls/" + caResource).toURI());
        var context = TlsTrust.sslContext(defaults, TlsTrust.readCertificates(ca));
        // The context hides its trust manager; rebuild the same composite for direct chain checks.
        return TlsTrust.composite(defaults, trustOf(TlsTrust.readCertificates(ca)));
    }

    private static X509TrustManager trustOf(List<X509Certificate> certs) throws Exception {
        var store = java.security.KeyStore.getInstance(java.security.KeyStore.getDefaultType());
        store.load(null, null);
        for (int i = 0; i < certs.size(); i++) {
            store.setCertificateEntry("c" + i, certs.get(i));
        }
        var factory = javax.net.ssl.TrustManagerFactory.getInstance(
                javax.net.ssl.TrustManagerFactory.getDefaultAlgorithm());
        factory.init(store);
        return (X509TrustManager) factory.getTrustManagers()[0];
    }

    @Test
    void emptyCaFileMeansJvmDefaultOnly() throws Exception {
        assertEquals(Optional.empty(), TlsTrust.sslContext("", dir));
        assertEquals(Optional.empty(), TlsTrust.sslContext("  ", dir));
    }

    @Test
    void relativePathResolvesAgainstDataDirectory() {
        assertEquals(dir.resolve("certs/ca.pem"), TlsTrust.resolve("certs/ca.pem", dir));
    }

    @Test
    void absolutePathIsKept() {
        Path absolute = dir.resolve("elsewhere/ca.pem").toAbsolutePath();
        assertEquals(absolute, TlsTrust.resolve(absolute.toString(), Path.of("/unused")));
    }

    @Test
    void validBundleYieldsContext() throws Exception {
        Files.writeString(dir.resolve("ca.pem"), resource("ca.pem") + resource("other-ca.pem"));

        Optional<javax.net.ssl.SSLContext> context = TlsTrust.sslContext("ca.pem", dir);

        assertTrue(context.isPresent(), "a readable bundle must produce an SSLContext");
    }

    @Test
    void missingFileIsReported() {
        var e = assertThrows(TlsTrust.TlsSetupException.class, () -> TlsTrust.sslContext("nope.pem", dir));
        assertTrue(e.getMessage().contains("nope.pem"), e.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    void fileWithoutCertificateIsReported() throws Exception {
        Files.writeString(dir.resolve("junk.pem"), "this is not a certificate\n");

        assertThrows(TlsTrust.TlsSetupException.class, () -> TlsTrust.sslContext("junk.pem", dir));
    }

    @Test
    void chainSignedByExtraCaIsAcceptedWhenDefaultRejectsIt() throws Exception {
        X509TrustManager trust = compositeOf(new FakeTrust(), "ca.pem");

        assertDoesNotThrow(() -> trust.checkServerTrusted(new X509Certificate[]{cert("leaf.pem")}, "RSA"));
    }

    @Test
    void chainTrustedByDefaultIsStillAccepted() throws Exception {
        X509Certificate leaf = cert("leaf.pem");
        X509TrustManager trust = compositeOf(new FakeTrust(leaf), "other-ca.pem");

        assertDoesNotThrow(() -> trust.checkServerTrusted(new X509Certificate[]{leaf}, "RSA"));
    }

    @Test
    void chainUnknownToBothIsRejected() throws Exception {
        X509TrustManager trust = compositeOf(new FakeTrust(), "other-ca.pem");

        assertThrows(CertificateException.class,
                () -> trust.checkServerTrusted(new X509Certificate[]{cert("leaf.pem")}, "RSA"));
    }

    @Test
    void acceptedIssuersCombineBoth() throws Exception {
        X509TrustManager trust = compositeOf(new FakeTrust(cert("other-ca.pem")), "ca.pem");

        assertEquals(2, trust.getAcceptedIssuers().length);
        assertFalse(List.of(trust.getAcceptedIssuers()).isEmpty());
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/vocab/CorvusPacketTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.vocab;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketType;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PayloadPolicy;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PrivacyFilter;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class CorvusPacketTest {

    @Test
    void vocabularyIdsAreUniqueAndPositive() {
        Set<Integer> seen = new HashSet<>();
        for (CorvusPacket p : CorvusPacket.values()) {
            assertTrue(p.id() > 0, p + " must have a positive id (0 is reserved for unmapped)");
            assertTrue(seen.add(p.id()), p + " reuses id " + p.id());
        }
    }

    @Test
    void eachPacketEventsTypeIsMappedOnlyOnce() {
        Set<Object> seen = new HashSet<>();
        for (CorvusPacket p : CorvusPacket.values()) {
            assertTrue(seen.add(p.packetEventsType()), p + " maps an already mapped PacketEvents type");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void lookupReturnsStableIdAndZeroForUnmapped() {
        assertEquals(CorvusPacket.C_CLIENT_TICK_END.id(), CorvusPacket.idOf(PacketType.Play.Client.CLIENT_TICK_END));
        assertEquals(0, CorvusPacket.idOf(PacketType.Play.Client.QUERY_BLOCK_NBT), "unmapped type");
    }

    @Test
    void everyPrivacyDroppedTypeHasAVocabularyId() {
        for (var type : PrivacyFilter.privateTypes()) {
            assertTrue(CorvusPacket.idOf(type) > 0, type.getName() + " is privacy-dropped but has no vocabulary id");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void everyPayloadStrippedOrAllowlistedTypeHasAVocabularyId() {
        for (var type : PayloadPolicy.strippedServerboundTypes()) {
            assertTrue(CorvusPacket.idOf(type) > 0, type.getName() + " is payload-stripped but has no vocabulary id");
        }
        for (var type : PayloadPolicy.clientboundAllowlist()) {
            assertTrue(CorvusPacket.idOf(type) > 0, type.getName() + " is allowlisted but has no vocabulary id");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void existingIdsKeepTheirValues() {
        // Append-only contract: these values are written into capture files and must never change.
        assertEquals(11, CorvusPacket.C_PLAYER_POSITION.id());
        assertEquals(27, CorvusPacket.C_CLIENT_TICK_END.id());
        assertEquals(100, CorvusPacket.S_ENTITY_RELATIVE_MOVE.id());
        assertEquals(105, CorvusPacket.S_ENTITY_VELOCITY.id());
    }
}
```
