`plugin/src/test/java/net/onelitefeather/corvus/plugin/vocab/VocabularyJsonTest.java`:

```java
package net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.vocab;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
import com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PayloadPolicy;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.plugin.privacy.PrivacyFilter;
import net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1.Direction;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * Keeps {@code proto/corvus/capture/v1/vocabulary.json} (read by the analyzer as its privacy denylist) in sync
 * with {@link CorvusPacket}, {@link PrivacyFilter} and {@link PayloadPolicy}. To regenerate after an intended
 * change run {@code ./gradlew :plugin:test --tests '*VocabularyJsonTest' -PupdateVocabulary}.
 */
class VocabularyJsonTest {

    private static final Gson GSON = new GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().disableHtmlEscaping().create();

    record Entry(int id, String name, String direction, String state, boolean isPrivate, String payloadPolicy) {
    }

    private static Path file;

    @BeforeAll
    static void locateFile() throws IOException {
        file = Path.of(System.getProperty("corvus.vocabulary.json"));
        if (Boolean.parseBoolean(System.getProperty("corvus.vocabulary.update"))) {
            Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());
            Files.writeString(file, render(fromJava()) + "\n", StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        }
    }

    private static List<Entry> fromJava() {
        List<Entry> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (CorvusPacket p : CorvusPacket.values()) {
            PayloadPolicy.Level level = PayloadPolicy.levelOf(p.packetEventsType(), p.direction(), p.state());
            out.add(new Entry(p.id(), p.name(),
                    p.direction() == Direction.DIRECTION_SERVERBOUND ? "serverbound" : "clientbound",
                    p.state().name().replace("CONNECTION_STATE_", "").toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT),
                    level == PayloadPolicy.Level.FRAME_DROPPED,
                    level.json()));
        }
        out.sort(Comparator.comparingInt(Entry::id));
        return out;
    }

    private static String render(List<Entry> entries) {
        List<java.util.Map<String, Object>> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Entry e : entries) {
            java.util.Map<String, Object> row = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
            row.put("id", e.id());
            row.put("name", e.name());
            row.put("direction", e.direction());
            row.put("state", e.state());
            row.put("private", e.isPrivate());
            row.put("payload_policy", e.payloadPolicy());
            rows.add(row);
        }
        return GSON.toJson(rows);
    }

    private static List<Entry> fromJson() throws IOException {
        List<java.util.Map<String, Object>> rows = GSON.fromJson(Files.readString(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
                new TypeToken<List<java.util.Map<String, Object>>>() { }.getType());
        List<Entry> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (java.util.Map<String, Object> r : rows) {
            out.add(new Entry(((Number) r.get("id")).intValue(), (String) r.get("name"),
                    (String) r.get("direction"), (String) r.get("state"), (Boolean) r.get("private"),
                    (String) r.get("payload_policy")));
        }
        return out;
    }

    @Test
    void committedJsonMatchesJavaVocabularyAndPolicies() throws IOException {
        assertEquals(fromJava(), fromJson(),
                "vocabulary.json is out of sync with CorvusPacket/PrivacyFilter/PayloadPolicy; regenerate with "
                        + "./gradlew :plugin:test --tests '*VocabularyJsonTest' -PupdateVocabulary");
    }

    @Test
    void everyPrivacyDroppedTypeIsMarkedPrivateInTheJson() throws IOException {
        List<Entry> json = fromJson();
        for (var type : PrivacyFilter.privateTypes()) {
            int id = CorvusPacket.idOf(type);
            Entry entry = json.stream().filter(e -> e.id() == id).findFirst().orElse(null);
            assertTrue(entry != null && entry.isPrivate(), type.getName() + " must be private in vocabulary.json");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void everyPayloadStrippedTypeIsMarkedStrippedInTheJson() throws IOException {
        List<Entry> json = fromJson();
        for (var type : PayloadPolicy.strippedServerboundTypes()) {
            int id = CorvusPacket.idOf(type);
            Entry entry = json.stream().filter(e -> e.id() == id).findFirst().orElse(null);
            assertTrue(entry != null && entry.payloadPolicy().equals("stripped"),
                    type.getName() + " must be stripped in vocabulary.json");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void jsonHasNoDuplicateIds() throws IOException {
        List<Entry> json = fromJson();
        assertEquals(json.size(), json.stream().map(Entry::id).distinct().count());
    }
}
```

`plugin/src/test/resources/tls/README.md`:

```md
Test fixtures for TlsTrustTest. Generated once with openssl (valid ~100 years, private keys discarded):

- ca.pem: self-signed test CA (CN=Corvus Test CA)
- other-ca.pem: unrelated self-signed CA (CN=Other Test CA)
- leaf.pem: server certificate (CN=nats.test) signed by ca.pem

```
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout ca.key -out ca.pem -days 36500 -subj "/CN=Corvus Test CA" \
  -addext basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE -addext keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign
openssl req -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout leaf.key -out leaf.csr -subj "/CN=nats.test"
openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr -CA ca.pem -CAkey ca.key -CAcreateserial -out leaf.pem -days 36500 -extfile ext

`proto/corvus/capture/v1/capture.proto`:

```proto
syntax = "proto3";

package corvus.capture.v1;

option java_multiple_files = true;
option java_package = "net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.capture.v1";

// Wire and file format of the capture stream produced by the Velocity plugin.
// A capture stream is a sequence of length-delimited Envelope messages.
// No message may carry a clear-text player UUID, player name, IP address or chat content.

message Envelope {
  oneof body {
    SessionStart session_start = 1;
    SegmentStart segment_start = 2;
    CaptureBatch batch = 3;
    SessionEnd session_end = 4;
  }
}

// Emitted once when a player's proxy connection reaches a capturable state.
message SessionStart {
  // Random per-connection id (16 bytes), never derived from the player UUID.
  bytes session_id = 1;
  // HMAC-SHA-256(key, player UUID); key is held outside the data lake.
  bytes player_pseudonym = 2;
  // Identifier of the HMAC key version, needed for key rotation.
  string pseudonym_key_id = 3;
  // Protocol version spoken by the client (native, before any translation).
  int32 client_protocol_version = 4;
  // Protocol version of the frames as observed by the plugin.
  int32 observed_protocol_version = 5;
  string proxy_id = 6;
  string plugin_version = 7;
  int64 started_at_unix_millis = 8;
}

// Emitted when the player connects to a backend server (first join and every switch).
message SegmentStart {
  bytes session_id = 1;
  uint32 segment = 2;
  string backend_server = 3;
  // Tag from the backend-server -> context mapping, e.g. "pvp", "survival", "lobby".
  string game_context = 4;
  // Client brand as reported by the client (e.g. "vanilla", "fabric"); may be empty.
  string client_brand = 5;
  int64 started_at_unix_millis = 6;
}

message SessionEnd {
  bytes session_id = 1;
  int64 ended_at_unix_millis = 2;
  CaptureCounters counters = 3;
}

message CaptureBatch {
  bytes session_id = 1;
  uint32 segment = 2;
  repeated Frame frames = 3;
  // Counters accumulated since the previous batch of this session.
  CaptureCounters counters = 4;
}

message CaptureCounters {
  // Frames dropped because the capture queue was full.
  uint64 dropped_queue_full = 1;
  // Frames intentionally not recorded (chat, commands, signing).
  uint64 dropped_privacy = 2;
  // Exceptions caught inside the listener.
  uint64 listener_errors = 3;
  // Frames lost because the transport (e.g. NATS) rejected or timed out the publish.
  uint64 dropped_transport = 4;
}

enum Direction {
  DIRECTION_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  DIRECTION_SERVERBOUND = 1;
  DIRECTION_CLIENTBOUND = 2;
}

enum ConnectionState {
  CONNECTION_STATE_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  CONNECTION_STATE_HANDSHAKING = 1;
  CONNECTION_STATE_STATUS = 2;
  CONNECTION_STATE_LOGIN = 3;
  CONNECTION_STATE_CONFIGURATION = 4;
  CONNECTION_STATE_PLAY = 5;
}

message Frame {
  // Monotonic per-session sequence number; gaps mean dropped frames.
  uint64 seq = 1;
  // Nanoseconds since SessionStart, from a monotonic clock.
  uint64 offset_nanos = 2;
  Direction direction = 3;
  ConnectionState state = 4;
  // Packet id as seen on the wire (version dependent).
  int32 wire_packet_id = 5;
  // Corvus' own version-stable packet vocabulary id (0 = unmapped).
  uint32 packet_type = 6;
  // Raw packet body after the packet id. Short retention only.
  bytes payload = 7;
  // Size in bytes of the readable payload before truncation to max_payload_bytes.
  // 0 if no payload was recorded for this frame. payload_original_size > payload.length
  // means the payload was truncated.
  uint32 payload_original_size = 8;

  // Decoded, version-independent event for the packet types relevant to the models.
  oneof event {
    MovementEvent movement = 10;
    InteractEntityEvent interact_entity = 11;
    SwingEvent swing = 12;
    DigEvent dig = 13;
    PlaceEvent place = 14;
    HeldItemEvent held_item = 15;
    EntityMotionEvent entity_motion = 16;
  }
}

message MovementEvent {
  bool has_position = 1;
  bool has_rotation = 2;
  double x = 3;
  double y = 4;
  double z = 5;
  float yaw = 6;
  float pitch = 7;
  bool on_ground = 8;
}

message InteractEntityEvent {
  int32 entity_id = 1;
  enum Action {
    ACTION_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
    ACTION_INTERACT = 1;
    ACTION_ATTACK = 2;
    ACTION_INTERACT_AT = 3;
  }
  Action action = 2;
  bool sneaking = 3;
  bool off_hand = 4;
}

message SwingEvent {
  bool off_hand = 1;
}

message DigEvent {
  int32 status = 1;
  int32 x = 2;
  int32 y = 3;
  int32 z = 4;
  int32 face = 5;
}

message PlaceEvent {
  int32 x = 1;
  int32 y = 2;
  int32 z = 3;
  int32 face = 4;
  bool off_hand = 5;
}

message HeldItemEvent {
  int32 slot = 1;
}

// Clientbound movement of other entities; context for combat features.
message EntityMotionEvent {
  int32 entity_id = 1;
  enum Kind {
    KIND_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
    KIND_RELATIVE = 1;
    KIND_TELEPORT = 2;
    KIND_VELOCITY = 3;
    // Absolute position at entity spawn; x/y/z are the spawn position.
    KIND_SPAWN = 4;
  }
  Kind kind = 2;
  double x = 3;
  double y = 4;
  double z = 5;
}

```

`proto/corvus/score/v1/score.proto`:

```proto
syntax = "proto3";

package corvus.score.v1;

option java_multiple_files = true;
option java_package = "net.onelitefeather.corvus.proto.score.v1";

// A model's judgement of one context window of one player. Published on
// corvus.score.v1.<game_context>. Contains no clear-text player identity.
message Score {
  // HMAC pseudonym of the player (same as capture SessionStart.player_pseudonym).
  bytes player_pseudonym = 1;
  string pseudonym_key_id = 2;
  bytes session_id = 3;
  uint32 segment = 4;
  string game_context = 5;
  // Model domain, e.g. "movement", "combat", "interaction", "packet_anomaly".
  string domain = 6;
  string model_name = 7;
  string model_version = 8;
  enum Stage {
    STAGE_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
    STAGE_SHADOW = 1;
    STAGE_CANARY = 2;
    STAGE_ENFORCE = 3;
  }
  Stage stage = 9;
  // Probability-like score in [0, 1]; higher means more likely cheating.
  float score = 10;
  // Smoothed score over the player's recent windows in this segment.
  float score_smoothed = 11;
  // Number of windows behind score_smoothed.
  uint32 windows = 12;
  uint64 window_start_offset_nanos = 13;
  uint64 window_end_offset_nanos = 14;
  int64 scored_at_unix_millis = 15;
  // Optional explanation: names of the most influential features, most important first.
  repeated string top_features = 16;
}

```

`services/Dockerfile`:

```
# Build context is the repository root (the proto sources live in ./proto):
#   docker build -f services/Dockerfile -t corvus-services .
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.12.24 AS uv

FROM python:3.13-slim AS build
COPY --from=uv /uv /usr/local/bin/uv
# The venv is built at the path it runs from: console-script shebangs and the pyvenv.cfg
# point into it, so copying a venv built elsewhere would break corvus-ingest and friends.
ENV UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=1 UV_LINK_MODE=copy UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/opt/venv
# corvus-ml is a uv path dependency (../ml, serve extra only: onnxruntime, no torch/scikit-learn).
COPY ml/pyproject.toml ml/README.md /build/ml/
COPY ml/src /build/ml/src
WORKDIR /build/services
COPY services/pyproject.toml services/uv.lock services/README.md ./
# Dependencies (incl. corvus-ml) plus protoc (proto group) first, for layer caching.
RUN uv sync --frozen --no-dev --group proto --no-install-project
COPY proto /build/proto
COPY services/scripts scripts
COPY services/src src
# Generate the protobuf bindings at build time, then install the project without the proto group.
RUN PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH" scripts/gen_proto.sh \
 && uv sync --frozen --no-dev --no-editable

FROM python:3.13-slim
RUN groupadd --system --gid 10001 corvus \
 && useradd --system --uid 10001 --gid corvus --no-create-home corvus
COPY --from=build /opt/venv /opt/venv
COPY services/migrations /app/migrations
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH" \
    CORVUS_MIGRATIONS_DIR=/app/migrations \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
USER 10001:10001
# corvus-ingest and corvus-score export metrics and /healthz on 9464; corvus-score also needs a
# writable model cache (CORVUS_SCORE_MODELS_DIR, default /tmp/corvus-score/models).
EXPOSE 9464
CMD ["corvus-ingest"]

```

`services/README.md`:

```md
# corvus-services

Backend services for the Corvus capture pipeline: `corvus-ingest` (NATS JetStream to Parquet lake and
PostgreSQL catalog), `corvus-score` (online scoring with ONNX Runtime, see `docs/how-to/run-scoring-locally.md`),
`corvus-migrate` (catalog migrations), `corvus-housekeeping` (lake cleanup, one-shot) and `corvus-api` (control-plane
API for the management UI, see `docs/reference/control-plane-api.md`).

The contract is `docs/reference/data-lake.md`. Local run: `docs/how-to/run-ingest-locally.md`.

    uv sync --group proto --group dev
    uv run --group proto scripts/gen_proto.sh
    uv run pytest

```

`services/migrations/0001_catalog.sql`:

```sql
-- Catalog schema v1, see docs/reference/data-lake.md section 4. Never edit after release.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS corvus;

CREATE TABLE corvus.players (
    pseudonym   bytea       PRIMARY KEY,
    key_id      text        NOT NULL,
    first_seen  timestamptz NOT NULL,
    last_seen   timestamptz NOT NULL,
    erased_at   timestamptz
);

CREATE TABLE corvus.player_keys (
    pseudonym   bytea       PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES corvus.players (pseudonym) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    dek_wrapped bytea       NOT NULL,
    kek_id      text        NOT NULL,
    created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE corvus.sessions (
    session_id         bytea       PRIMARY KEY CHECK (octet_length(session_id) = 16),
    -- NULL only for orphan sessions: batches whose SessionStart never arrived (no pseudonym, no DEK,
    -- events rows only). A late SessionStart adopts the row and clears the flag.
    pseudonym          bytea       REFERENCES corvus.players (pseudonym),
    orphan             boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    proxy_id           text        NOT NULL,
    client_protocol    integer     NOT NULL,
    observed_protocol  integer     NOT NULL,
    plugin_version     text        NOT NULL,
    started_at         timestamptz NOT NULL,
    ended_at           timestamptz,
    dropped_queue_full bigint      NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (dropped_queue_full >= 0),
    dropped_privacy    bigint      NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (dropped_privacy >= 0),
    listener_errors    bigint      NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (listener_errors >= 0),
    dropped_transport  bigint      NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (dropped_transport >= 0),
    CHECK (orphan OR pseudonym IS NOT NULL)
);

CREATE INDEX sessions_started_at_idx ON corvus.sessions (started_at);
CREATE INDEX sessions_pseudonym_idx ON corvus.sessions (pseudonym);

CREATE TABLE corvus.segments (
    session_id     bytea       NOT NULL REFERENCES corvus.sessions (session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    segment        integer     NOT NULL CHECK (segment >= 0),
    backend_server text        NOT NULL,
    game_context   text        NOT NULL,
    client_brand   text        NOT NULL,
    started_at     timestamptz NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (session_id, segment)
);

CREATE INDEX segments_game_context_idx ON corvus.segments (game_context);

CREATE TABLE corvus.lake_files (
    id             bigserial   PRIMARY KEY,
    s3_key         text        NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    table_name     text        NOT NULL CHECK (table_name IN ('events', 'raw')),
    date           date        NOT NULL,
    row_count      bigint      NOT NULL CHECK (row_count >= 0),
    size_bytes     bigint      NOT NULL CHECK (size_bytes >= 0),
    schema_version integer     NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    deleted_at     timestamptz
);

CREATE INDEX lake_files_table_date_idx ON corvus.lake_files (table_name, date);

-- No FK to sessions on purpose: compaction and erasure may remove sessions while files still exist.
CREATE TABLE corvus.lake_file_sessions (
    file_id    bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES corvus.lake_files (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    session_id bytea  NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(session_id) = 16),
    PRIMARY KEY (file_id, session_id)
);

CREATE INDEX lake_file_sessions_session_idx ON corvus.lake_file_sessions (session_id);

-- Ingest bookkeeping (not part of the lake contract): one row per envelope whose counters were
-- applied. Makes counter updates idempotent against JetStream redelivery. Pruned by housekeeping.
CREATE TABLE corvus.session_batches (
    session_id  bytea       NOT NULL,
    msg_id      text        NOT NULL,
    received_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (session_id, msg_id)
);

CREATE INDEX session_batches_received_at_idx ON corvus.session_batches (received_at);

```

`services/migrations/0002_control_plane.sql`:

```sql
-- Control-plane schema v1, see docs/reference/control-plane-api.md. Never edit after release.

-- Declarative pool definitions: the filter is stored as JSON and translated to parameterised SQL.
CREATE TABLE corvus.pools (
    id          uuid        PRIMARY KEY,
    name        text        NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    description text        NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    definition  jsonb       NOT NULL,
    created_by  text        NOT NULL,
    created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL,
    updated_at  timestamptz NOT NULL
);

-- Immutable dataset snapshots. No FK to pools: deleting a pool must not touch snapshots.
CREATE TABLE corvus.dataset_snapshots (
    id            uuid        PRIMARY KEY,
    pool_id       uuid        NOT NULL,
    pool_name     text        NOT NULL,
    manifest      jsonb       NOT NULL,
    sha256        text        NOT NULL CHECK (sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    session_count integer     NOT NULL CHECK (session_count >= 0),
    file_count    integer     NOT NULL CHECK (file_count >= 0),
    created_by    text        NOT NULL,
    created_at    timestamptz NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX dataset_snapshots_pool_idx ON corvus.dataset_snapshots (pool_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE FUNCTION corvus.reject_snapshot_mutation() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'dataset snapshots are immutable' USING ERRCODE = 'integrity_constraint_violation';
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER dataset_snapshots_immutable
    BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON corvus.dataset_snapshots
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION corvus.reject_snapshot_mutation();

CREATE TABLE corvus.labels (
    id           uuid             PRIMARY KEY,
    subject_type text             NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN ('pseudonym', 'session')),
    pseudonym    bytea            CHECK (pseudonym IS NULL OR octet_length(pseudonym) = 32),
    session_id   bytea            CHECK (session_id IS NULL OR octet_length(session_id) = 16),
    label        text             NOT NULL CHECK (label IN ('legit', 'cheat')),
    source       text             NOT NULL
                                  CHECK (source IN ('honeypot', 'staff_verdict', 'ban_import', 'weak_rule')),
    confidence   double precision NOT NULL CHECK (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1),
    valid_from   timestamptz,
    valid_to     timestamptz,
    note         text             NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(note) <= 2000),
    created_by   text             NOT NULL,
    created_at   timestamptz      NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((subject_type = 'pseudonym' AND pseudonym IS NOT NULL AND session_id IS NULL)
        OR (subject_type = 'session' AND session_id IS NOT NULL AND pseudonym IS NULL)),
    CHECK (valid_from IS NULL OR valid_to IS NULL OR valid_from < valid_to)
);

CREATE INDEX labels_pseudonym_idx ON corvus.labels (pseudonym) WHERE pseudonym IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX labels_session_idx ON corvus.labels (session_id) WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX labels_created_idx ON corvus.labels (created_at DESC, id DESC);

-- Opt-out / erasure blocklist and explicit allowlist, one row per pseudonym.
CREATE TABLE corvus.blocklist (
    pseudonym  bytea       PRIMARY KEY CHECK (octet_length(pseudonym) = 32),
    kind       text        NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('block', 'allow')),
    source     text        NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('manual', 'erasure')),
    reason     text        NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(reason) <= 500),
    created_by text        NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE corvus.erasure_requests (
    id                 uuid        PRIMARY KEY,
    pseudonym          bytea       NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(pseudonym) = 32),
    requested_by       text        NOT NULL,
    requested_at       timestamptz NOT NULL,
    status             text        NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('completed')),
    player_known       boolean     NOT NULL,
    key_deleted        boolean     NOT NULL,
    compaction_pending boolean     NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX erasure_requests_pseudonym_idx ON corvus.erasure_requests (pseudonym);
CREATE INDEX erasure_requests_compaction_idx ON corvus.erasure_requests (requested_at)
    WHERE compaction_pending;

CREATE TABLE corvus.models (
    id             uuid        PRIMARY KEY,
    name           text        NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    version        text        NOT NULL CHECK (length(version) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
    candidate_type text        NOT NULL,
    game_context   text        NOT NULL,
    domain         text        NOT NULL,
    snapshot_id    uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES corvus.dataset_snapshots (id),
    metrics        jsonb       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    onnx_key       text        NOT NULL,
    stage          text        NOT NULL
                               CHECK (stage IN ('registered', 'shadow', 'canary', 'enforce', 'archived')),
    created_by     text        NOT NULL,
    created_at     timestamptz NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (name, version)
);

CREATE INDEX models_enforce_scope_idx ON corvus.models (snapshot_id, game_context) WHERE stage = 'enforce';
CREATE INDEX models_created_idx ON corvus.models (created_at DESC, id DESC);

CREATE TABLE corvus.model_transitions (
    id         uuid        PRIMARY KEY,
    model_id   uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES corvus.models (id),
    from_stage text        NOT NULL,
    to_stage   text        NOT NULL,
    actor      text        NOT NULL,
    reason     text        NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    gate       jsonb,
    at         timestamptz NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX model_transitions_model_idx ON corvus.model_transitions (model_id, at);

CREATE TABLE corvus.jobs (
    id          uuid        PRIMARY KEY,
    type        text        NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('build_features', 'evaluate', 'train')),
    snapshot_id uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES corvus.dataset_snapshots (id),
    params      jsonb       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    status      text        NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed')),
    runner      text        NOT NULL,
    runner_ref  text,
    message     text        NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_by  text        NOT NULL,
    created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL,
    updated_at  timestamptz NOT NULL,
    finished_at timestamptz
);

CREATE INDEX jobs_created_idx ON corvus.jobs (created_at DESC, id DESC);

```

```sql
-- Online scoring (docs/reference/data-lake.md section 6). Never edit after release.

-- Latest score per player, game context, domain and model; upserted by corvus-score.
CREATE TABLE corvus.scores_latest (
    pseudonym     bytea            NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(pseudonym) = 32),
    game_context  text             NOT NULL,
    domain        text             NOT NULL,
    model_name    text             NOT NULL,
    model_version text             NOT NULL,
    stage         text             NOT NULL CHECK (stage IN ('shadow', 'canary', 'enforce')),
    score         double precision NOT NULL CHECK (score >= 0 AND score <= 1),
    smoothed      double precision NOT NULL CHECK (smoothed >= 0 AND smoothed <= 1),
    windows       integer          NOT NULL CHECK (windows >= 1),
    session_id    bytea            NOT NULL,
    segment       integer          NOT NULL,
    updated_at    timestamptz      NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (pseudonym, game_context, domain, model_name)
);

-- Append-only score history, pruned by corvus-housekeeping (CORVUS_SCORE_HISTORY_RETENTION_DAYS).
CREATE TABLE corvus.score_history (
    id                        bigserial        PRIMARY KEY,
    pseudonym                 bytea            NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(pseudonym) = 32),
    session_id                bytea            NOT NULL,
    segment                   integer          NOT NULL,
    game_context              text             NOT NULL,
    domain                    text             NOT NULL,
    model_name                text             NOT NULL,
    model_version             text             NOT NULL,
    stage                     text             NOT NULL CHECK (stage IN ('shadow', 'canary', 'enforce')),
    score                     double precision NOT NULL,
    smoothed                  double precision NOT NULL,
    windows                   integer          NOT NULL,
    window_start_offset_nanos bigint           NOT NULL,
    window_end_offset_nanos   bigint           NOT NULL,
    scored_at                 timestamptz      NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX score_history_pseudonym_idx ON corvus.score_history (pseudonym, scored_at DESC, id DESC);
CREATE INDEX score_history_scored_at_idx ON corvus.score_history (scored_at);
```

`services/migrations/0005_compaction.sql`:

```sql
-- Compaction after player erasure (corvus-compact), see docs/reference/data-lake.md section 7.

ALTER TABLE corvus.erasure_requests ADD COLUMN compacted_at timestamptz;

-- A compacted file is replaced by a new file (replaced_by) or, if nothing remained, by none.
-- purge_pending: the file row is marked deleted but its object still has to be removed from the
-- lake; compaction retries this until it succeeds (housekeeping treats the key as known).
ALTER TABLE corvus.lake_files ADD COLUMN replaced_by bigint REFERENCES corvus.lake_files (id);
ALTER TABLE corvus.lake_files ADD COLUMN purge_pending boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

CREATE INDEX lake_files_purge_pending_idx ON corvus.lake_files (id) WHERE purge_pending;

-- Sessions of erased players. Snapshots are immutable and keep listing them; readers skip them.
CREATE VIEW corvus.erased_sessions AS
SELECT s.session_id, s.pseudonym, p.erased_at
FROM corvus.sessions s
JOIN corvus.players p ON p.pseudonym = s.pseudonym
WHERE p.erased_at IS NOT NULL;

```

`services/migrations/0006_derived_artifacts.sql`:

```sql
-- Derived artefacts of raw payloads (tokenised raw-byte features), see docs/reference/data-lake.md
-- section 7. They are personal data derived from `raw`: erasure and retention have to reach them.

-- One row per prefix a job wrote below the lake bucket and registered through the API.
-- contains_raw: the prefix holds tokenised payload content (the packet table), not only aggregates.
CREATE TABLE corvus.derived_artifacts (
    id            uuid        PRIMARY KEY,
    snapshot_id   uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES corvus.dataset_snapshots (id),
    job_id        uuid        REFERENCES corvus.jobs (id),
    kind          text        NOT NULL CHECK (kind ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,39}$'),
    s3_prefix     text        NOT NULL CHECK (s3_prefix ~ '^(features|tokenizers)/.+/$'
                                              AND s3_prefix !~ '(^|/)\.\.?(/|$)'),
    contains_raw  boolean     NOT NULL,
    created_at    timestamptz NOT NULL,
    deleted_at    timestamptz,
    deleted_reason text       CHECK (deleted_reason IN ('erasure', 'retention')),
    UNIQUE (snapshot_id, s3_prefix),
    CHECK ((deleted_at IS NULL) = (deleted_reason IS NULL))
);

CREATE INDEX derived_artifacts_live_raw_idx ON corvus.derived_artifacts (snapshot_id)
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND contains_raw;

-- Mutable state next to the immutable dataset_snapshots (its trigger rejects every UPDATE):
-- needs_rebuild is set when erasure deleted a snapshot's raw-derived artefacts. A rebuild by a job
-- that started after needs_rebuild_at clears it.
CREATE TABLE corvus.snapshot_state (
    snapshot_id      uuid        PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES corvus.dataset_snapshots (id),
    needs_rebuild    boolean     NOT NULL,
    needs_rebuild_at timestamptz,
    reason           text        NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);

```

`services/migrations/0007_pool_raw_retention.sql`:

```sql
-- Per-pool retention of raw payloads (NFR-018). NULL: the deployment default
-- (CORVUS_RAW_RETENTION_DAYS, 21). The upper limit is enforced by the API
-- (CORVUS_API_RAW_RETENTION_MAX_DAYS) and clamped by housekeeping; the CHECK only keeps nonsense out.
ALTER TABLE corvus.pools
    ADD COLUMN raw_retention_days integer
    CHECK (raw_retention_days IS NULL OR raw_retention_days BETWEEN 1 AND 3650);

```

`services/scripts/gen_proto.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generate the capture and score protobuf bindings into src/corvus_services/_gen (gitignored).
# Needs the "proto" dependency group (grpcio-tools): uv run --group proto scripts/gen_proto.sh
set -euo pipefail

here="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
proto_root="${CORVUS_PROTO_DIR:-$here/../proto}"
out="$here/src/corvus_services/_gen"

rm -rf "$out"
mkdir -p "$out"
python -m grpc_tools.protoc \
  --proto_path="$proto_root" \
  --python_out="$out" \
  "$proto_root/corvus/capture/v1/capture.proto" \
  "$proto_root/corvus/score/v1/score.proto"
```

`services/src/corvus_services/api/app.py`:

```py
"""FastAPI application factory and the ``corvus-api`` entry point."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import time
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

import uvicorn
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, Response
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from ..clock import system_clock
from .auth import build_authenticator
from .deps import Deps
from .jobs import build_runner
from .pg import open_repos
from .problems import install_problem_handlers
from .pseudonym import Pseudonymizer
from .routes import (
    artifacts,
    jobs,
    labels,
    me,
    models,
    players,
    pools,
    scores,
    snapshot_data,
    system,
)
from .settings import ApiSettings

log = logging.getLogger("corvus.api")

API_PREFIX = "/api/v1"

_DESCRIPTION = """\
Control plane of Corvus: pool definitions, dataset snapshots, labels, players and erasure,
blocklist, model registry and training jobs. Corvus never sanctions players itself.

Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`). Authenticate with an OIDC bearer
token; roles are `admin`, `data_scientist`, `staff` and `viewer` (`admin` may do everything).
"""


async def _default_deps(settings: ApiSettings) -> Deps:
    clock = system_clock
    authenticator = build_authenticator(settings, clock)
    if not authenticator.configured:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "no authentication configured: set CORVUS_API_OIDC_ISSUER, CORVUS_API_OIDC_AUDIENCE and "
            "CORVUS_API_OIDC_JWKS_URL (or, for local development only, CORVUS_API_DEV_TOKEN)"
        )
    return Deps(
        settings=settings,
        repos=await open_repos(settings.pg_dsn, settings.pg_pool_max),
        authenticator=authenticator,
        runner=build_runner(settings),
        pseudonymizer=Pseudonymizer(settings.pseudonym_key_bytes(), settings.pseudonym_key_id),
        plugin_tokens=settings.plugin_token_list(),
        clock=clock,
    )


def create_app(settings: ApiSettings | None = None, deps: Deps | None = None) -> FastAPI:
    """``deps`` is injected by tests; production builds them from the settings on startup."""
    cfg = settings or (deps.settings if deps else ApiSettings())

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app: FastAPI) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
        owned = deps is None
        app.state.deps = deps if deps is not None else await _default_deps(cfg)
        if not app.state.deps.pseudonymizer.available:
            log.warning(
                "CORVUS_PSEUDONYM_KEY is not set: player lookup and UUID erasure are disabled"
            )
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            if owned:
                for close in app.state.deps.repos.closers:
                    await close()

    app = FastAPI(
        title="Corvus control plane",
        version="1",
        description=_DESCRIPTION,
        lifespan=lifespan,
        docs_url="/docs",
        openapi_url="/openapi.json",
    )
    if deps is not None:
        app.state.deps = deps
    install_problem_handlers(app)

    @app.middleware("http")
    async def observe(
        request: Request, call_next: Callable[[Request], Awaitable[Response]]
    ) -> Response:
        started = time.perf_counter()
        status = 500
        try:
            response = await call_next(request)
            status = response.status_code
            return response
        finally:
            route = request.scope.get("route")
            template = getattr(route, "path", None) or "unmatched"
            if route is not None and request.url.path.startswith(API_PREFIX + "/"):
                template = API_PREFIX + template  # included routers report the path without prefix
            m = request.app.state.deps.metrics
            m.requests.labels(template, request.method, str(status)).inc()
            m.latency.labels(template, request.method).observe(time.perf_counter() - started)

    origins = cfg.cors_origin_list()
    if origins:
        # Bearer tokens travel in a header, never in cookies: credentials stay off.
        app.add_middleware(
            CORSMiddleware,
            allow_origins=origins,
            allow_credentials=False,
            allow_methods=["GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"],
            allow_headers=["Authorization", "Content-Type"],
            expose_headers=[],  # pagination is part of the JSON body
            max_age=600,
        )

    for router in (me.router, pools.router, labels.router, players.router, players.plugin_router,
                   models.router, jobs.router, scores.router, snapshot_data.router,
                   artifacts.router):  # fmt: skip
        app.include_router(router, prefix=API_PREFIX)
    app.include_router(system.router)
    return app


def main() -> None:
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s %(message)s")
    settings = ApiSettings()
    uvicorn.run(create_app(settings), host=settings.host, port=settings.port, log_config=None)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`services/src/corvus_services/api/auth.py`:

```py
"""Authentication (OIDC bearer tokens, optional dev token, proxy API tokens) and role-based authorization."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import logging
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Any, Protocol
from uuid import UUID

import httpx
import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, Request
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer

from ..clock import Clock
from .problems import ProblemError
from .settings import ApiSettings

log = logging.getLogger("corvus.api.auth")

_ALG_KTY = {"RS256": "RSA", "ES256": "EC"}


class Role(StrEnum):
    ADMIN = "admin"
    DATA_SCIENTIST = "data_scientist"
    STAFF = "staff"
    VIEWER = "viewer"


READERS: tuple[Role, ...] = (Role.VIEWER, Role.STAFF, Role.DATA_SCIENTIST)
"""Roles allowed on read-only endpoints (admin is always allowed)."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Principal:
    subject: str
    roles: frozenset[Role]
    display_name: str | None = None
    job: str | None = None
    """Name of the machine token (``CORVUS_API_JOB_TOKENS``); ``None`` for people."""

    @property
    def is_job(self) -> bool:
        return self.job is not None


class AuthError(Exception):
    """The credentials are missing or invalid; the message is safe to show to the caller."""


class JwksSource(Protocol):
    async def fetch(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return the JWKS document (``{"keys": [...]}``)."""
        ...


class HttpJwksSource:
    def __init__(self, url: str, timeout_s: float = 5.0) -> None:
        self._url = url
        self._timeout = timeout_s

    async def fetch(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=self._timeout) as client:
            resp = await client.get(self._url, headers={"Accept": "application/json"})
            resp.raise_for_status()
            doc = resp.json()
        if not isinstance(doc, dict) or not isinstance(doc.get("keys"), list):
            raise ValueError("JWKS document has no keys")
        return doc


class JwksCache:
    """Caches the JWKS for ``ttl_s``; an unknown ``kid`` triggers one refetch per ``min_refresh_s``."""

    def __init__(
        self, source: JwksSource, clock: Clock, ttl_s: float, min_refresh_s: float
    ) -> None:
        self._source = source
        self._clock = clock
        self._ttl = ttl_s
        self._min_refresh = min_refresh_s
        self._keys: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self._fetched_at: float | None = None
        self._last_attempt: float | None = None

    def _now(self) -> float:
        return self._clock().timestamp()

    def _can_attempt(self) -> bool:
        return self._last_attempt is None or self._now() - self._last_attempt >= self._min_refresh

    async def _refresh(self) -> None:
        self._last_attempt = self._now()
        try:
            doc = await self._source.fetch()
        except Exception as e:
            # Keep serving the old keys; the caller decides whether the kid is still unknown.
            log.warning("JWKS fetch failed (%s)", type(e).__name__)
            return
        self._keys = {
            str(k["kid"]): k for k in doc.get("keys", []) if isinstance(k, dict) and "kid" in k
        }
        self._fetched_at = self._now()

    async def get(self, kid: str | None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        stale = self._fetched_at is None or self._now() - self._fetched_at >= self._ttl
        if stale and self._can_attempt():
            await self._refresh()
        key = self._lookup(kid)
        if key is None and self._can_attempt():
            await self._refresh()
            key = self._lookup(kid)
        return key

    def _lookup(self, kid: str | None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if kid is not None:
            return self._keys.get(kid)
        return next(iter(self._keys.values())) if len(self._keys) == 1 else None


class TokenVerifier:
    """Validates signature, ``iss``, ``aud``, ``exp`` and ``nbf`` of OIDC access tokens."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        jwks: JwksCache,
        *,
        issuer: str,
        audience: str,
        algorithms: Sequence[str],
        roles_claim: str,
        role_mapping: dict[str, str],
        clock: Clock,
        leeway_s: int = 30,
        display_name_claim: str = "name",
    ) -> None:
        self._jwks = jwks
        self._issuer = issuer
        self._audience = audience
        self._algorithms = list(algorithms)
        self._roles_claim = roles_claim
        self._role_mapping = role_mapping
        self._clock = clock
        self._leeway = leeway_s
        self._display_name_claim = display_name_claim

    async def verify(self, token: str) -> Principal:
        try:
            header = jwt.get_unverified_header(token)
        except jwt.PyJWTError as e:
            raise AuthError("malformed token") from e
        alg = header.get("alg")
        if alg not in self._algorithms:
            raise AuthError("token algorithm is not allowed")
        jwk = await self._jwks.get(header.get("kid"))
        if jwk is None:
            raise AuthError("unknown signing key")
        if jwk.get("kty") != _ALG_KTY.get(str(alg)):
            raise AuthError("signing key does not match the token algorithm")
        try:
            key = jwt.PyJWK.from_dict(jwk).key
            claims = jwt.decode(
                token,
                key,
                algorithms=[str(alg)],
                audience=self._audience,
                issuer=self._issuer,
                # exp/nbf are checked below against the injected clock.
                options={
                    "require": ["exp", "iss", "aud", "sub"],
                    "verify_exp": False,
                    "verify_nbf": False,
                    "verify_iat": False,
                },
            )
        except jwt.InvalidAudienceError as e:
            raise AuthError("wrong audience") from e
        except jwt.InvalidIssuerError as e:
            raise AuthError("wrong issuer") from e
        except jwt.PyJWTError as e:
            raise AuthError("invalid token") from e
        now = self._clock().timestamp()
        exp, nbf = claims.get("exp"), claims.get("nbf")
        if not isinstance(exp, int | float) or now - self._leeway >= exp:
            raise AuthError("token expired")
        if nbf is not None and (not isinstance(nbf, int | float) or now + self._leeway < nbf):
            raise AuthError("token not yet valid")
        return Principal(str(claims["sub"]), self._roles(claims), self._display_name(claims))

    def _display_name(self, claims: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
        for claim in (self._display_name_claim, "preferred_username"):
            value = claims.get(claim)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
                return value.strip()[:200]
        return None

    def _roles(self, claims: dict[str, Any]) -> frozenset[Role]:
        value: Any = claims
        for part in self._roles_claim.split("."):
            value = value.get(part) if isinstance(value, dict) else None
        raw = value.split() if isinstance(value, str) else value
        if not isinstance(raw, list):
            return frozenset()
        return frozenset(r for r in map(self._map_role, raw) if r is not None)

    def _map_role(self, external: Any) -> Role | None:
        name = (
            self._role_mapping.get(str(external), str(external))
            if self._role_mapping
            else str(external)
        )
        try:
            return Role(name)
        except ValueError:
            return None


def token_digest(token: str) -> str:
    """Hex SHA-256 of a machine token, the form configured in ``CORVUS_API_JOB_TOKENS``."""
    return hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest()


class Authenticator:
    """Dev token (only if explicitly configured) first, then job tokens, then OIDC."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        verifier: TokenVerifier | None,
        dev_token: str | None = None,
        dev_roles: Sequence[Role] = (Role.ADMIN,),
        job_tokens: Sequence[tuple[str, str]] = (),
    ) -> None:
        self._verifier = verifier
        self._dev_token = dev_token
        self._dev_roles = frozenset(dev_roles)
        self._job_tokens = list(job_tokens)
        if dev_token:
            log.warning(
                "CORVUS_API_DEV_TOKEN is set: a static bearer token grants roles %s. "
                "NEVER enable this outside local development.",
                ", ".join(sorted(r.value for r in self._dev_roles)),
            )

    @property
    def configured(self) -> bool:
        return self._verifier is not None or bool(self._dev_token) or bool(self._job_tokens)

    def _job_principal(self, token: str) -> Principal | None:
        """Constant-time comparison of the presented token's hash against every configured hash."""
        presented = token_digest(token).encode()
        matched: str | None = None
        for digest, name in self._job_tokens:
            if hmac.compare_digest(presented, digest.encode()):
                matched = name
        if matched is None:
            return None
        return Principal(f"job:{matched}", frozenset({Role.DATA_SCIENTIST}), job=matched)

    async def authenticate(self, token: str) -> Principal:
        if self._dev_token and hmac.compare_digest(token.encode(), self._dev_token.encode()):
            return Principal("dev", self._dev_roles)
        job = self._job_principal(token) if self._job_tokens else None
        if job is not None:
            return job
        if self._verifier is None:
            raise AuthError("invalid token")
        return await self._verifier.verify(token)


def build_authenticator(
    settings: ApiSettings, clock: Clock, source: JwksSource | None = None
) -> Authenticator:
    verifier: TokenVerifier | None = None
    if settings.oidc_issuer and settings.oidc_audience and (settings.oidc_jwks_url or source):
        src = source or HttpJwksSource(str(settings.oidc_jwks_url))
        verifier = TokenVerifier(
            JwksCache(src, clock, settings.jwks_cache_ttl_s, settings.jwks_min_refresh_s),
            issuer=settings.oidc_issuer,
            audience=settings.oidc_audience,
            algorithms=settings.oidc_algorithms,
            roles_claim=settings.roles_claim,
            role_mapping=settings.role_mapping,
            clock=clock,
            leeway_s=settings.oidc_leeway_s,
            display_name_claim=settings.display_name_claim,
        )
    dev = settings.dev_token.get_secret_value() if settings.dev_token else None
    dev_roles = [Role(r) for r in settings.dev_token_roles]
    return Authenticator(verifier, dev or None, dev_roles, settings.job_token_list())


_bearer = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False, description="OIDC access token")
_plugin_bearer = HTTPBearer(
    auto_error=False, description="Proxy API token", scheme_name="ProxyToken"
)


def _unauthorized(reason: str) -> ProblemError:
    return ProblemError(
        401,
        reason,
        slug="unauthorized",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": 'Bearer error="invalid_token"'},
    )


JOB_ID_HEADER = "X-Corvus-Job-Id"


def require(*roles: Role, allow_jobs: bool = False) -> Callable[..., Awaitable[Principal]]:
    """Dependency factory: the caller needs one of ``roles`` (``admin`` always passes).

    Job tokens (machine principals with role ``data_scientist``) are refused unless ``allow_jobs``.
    """
    allowed = frozenset(roles) | {Role.ADMIN}

    async def dependency(
        request: Request,
        creds: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(_bearer),
    ) -> Principal:
        if creds is None:
            raise _unauthorized("missing bearer token")
        authenticator: Authenticator = request.app.state.deps.authenticator
        try:
            principal = await authenticator.authenticate(creds.credentials)
        except AuthError as e:
            raise _unauthorized(str(e)) from e
        if principal.is_job and not allow_jobs:
            raise ProblemError(
                403, "job tokens are not accepted on this endpoint", slug="forbidden"
            )
        if not (principal.roles & allowed):
            raise ProblemError(
                403,
                "insufficient role",
                slug="forbidden",
                required=sorted(r.value for r in roles),
            )
        request.state.principal = principal
        return principal

    return dependency


def enforce_job_scope(principal: Principal, job_id: UUID, header: str | None) -> None:
    """A job principal may touch only the job named in ``X-Corvus-Job-Id`` and in the path."""
    if not principal.is_job:
        return
    try:
        declared = UUID(header) if header else None
    except ValueError:
        declared = None
    if declared != job_id:
        raise ProblemError(
            403,
            f"job tokens may only act on their own job: send {JOB_ID_HEADER} equal to the job id",
            slug="forbidden",
        )


async def authenticated(
    request: Request,
    creds: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(_bearer),
) -> Principal:
    """Any valid token, whatever its roles (used by ``GET /me``)."""
    if creds is None:
        raise _unauthorized("missing bearer token")
    authenticator: Authenticator = request.app.state.deps.authenticator
    try:
        principal = await authenticator.authenticate(creds.credentials)
    except AuthError as e:
        raise _unauthorized(str(e)) from e
    if principal.is_job:
        raise ProblemError(403, "job tokens are not accepted on this endpoint", slug="forbidden")
    request.state.principal = principal
    return principal


async def require_proxy_token(
    request: Request,
    creds: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(_plugin_bearer),
) -> None:
    """Machine auth for proxies. Constant-time comparison against every configured token."""
    if creds is None:
        raise _unauthorized("missing bearer token")
    presented = creds.credentials.encode()
    tokens: list[str] = request.app.state.deps.plugin_tokens
    matched = False
    for token in tokens:
        matched |= hmac.compare_digest(presented, token.encode())
    if not matched:
        raise _unauthorized("invalid token")
```

```py
"""Application dependencies: one container on ``app.state.deps``, injectable in tests."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from fastapi import Depends, Query, Request
from prometheus_client import CollectorRegistry

from ..clock import Clock, system_clock
from .auth import Authenticator
from .jobs import JobRunner
from .metrics import ApiMetrics
from .pagination import Cursor, PageRequest
from .ports import Repos
from .pseudonym import Pseudonymizer
from .settings import ApiSettings


@dataclass
class Deps:
    settings: ApiSettings
    repos: Repos
    authenticator: Authenticator
    runner: JobRunner
    pseudonymizer: Pseudonymizer
    plugin_tokens: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    clock: Clock = system_clock
    new_id: Callable[[], UUID] = uuid4
    metrics: ApiMetrics = field(default_factory=lambda: ApiMetrics(CollectorRegistry()))


def get_deps(request: Request) -> Deps:
    deps: Deps = request.app.state.deps
    return deps


def get_page(
    deps: Deps = Depends(get_deps),
    limit: int | None = Query(default=None, ge=1, description="Page size (server maximum applies)"),
    cursor: str | None = Query(default=None, description="Opaque cursor from `next_cursor`"),
) -> PageRequest:
    s = deps.settings
    size = min(limit if limit is not None else s.default_page_size, s.max_page_size)
    return PageRequest(size, Cursor.decode(cursor) if cursor else None)
```

`services/src/corvus_services/api/erasure.py`:

```py
"""Player erasure (GDPR): crypto-shredding plus blocklist, in one transaction."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import datetime
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from .ports import BlockEntry, ErasureRequest, ErasureStore


async def erase_player(
    store: ErasureStore,
    pseudonym: bytes,
    *,
    requested_by: str,
    now: datetime,
    new_id: Callable[[], UUID] = uuid4,
) -> ErasureRequest:
    """Steps, all or nothing:

    1. delete the ``player_keys`` row (the player's ``raw`` payloads become unreadable),
    2. set ``players.erased_at`` (ingest then stops storing data for the pseudonym),
    3. add the pseudonym to the blocklist (the plugin stops capturing),
    4. delete the player's rows in ``scores_latest`` and ``score_history``,
    5. record the audit row with ``compaction_pending`` (the ``events`` rewrite is a later job).

    A pseudonym that was never captured is still blocklisted and audited.
    """
    async with store.transaction() as tx:
        player = await tx.lock_player(pseudonym)
        key_deleted = await tx.delete_player_key(pseudonym) if player is not None else False
        if player is not None:
            await tx.mark_erased(pseudonym, now)
        await tx.block(
            BlockEntry(pseudonym, "block", "erasure", "erasure request", requested_by, now)
        )
        await tx.delete_scores(pseudonym)
        request = ErasureRequest(
            id=new_id(),
            pseudonym=pseudonym,
            requested_by=requested_by,
            requested_at=now,
            status="completed",
            player_known=player is not None,
            key_deleted=key_deleted,
            compaction_pending=True,
        )
        await tx.record_request(request)
    return request

```

`services/src/corvus_services/api/jobs.py`:

```py
"""Jobs: the runner port, its two adapters (local subprocess, Kubernetes batch/v1 Job) and the use cases.

Contract with the job process (same for both adapters): the arguments are
``<command...> <job type>``; the environment carries ``CORVUS_JOB_ID``, ``CORVUS_JOB_TYPE``,
``CORVUS_JOB_SNAPSHOT_ID`` and ``CORVUS_JOB_PARAMS`` (JSON). Params must not contain secrets.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import logging
import os
import re
import subprocess
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Any, Protocol
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from .ports import JobRecord, JobRepo, SnapshotRepo
from .settings import ApiSettings

log = logging.getLogger("corvus.api.jobs")


class JobType(StrEnum):
    BUILD_FEATURES = "build_features"
    EVALUATE = "evaluate"
    TRAIN = "train"


class JobState(StrEnum):
    QUEUED = "queued"
    RUNNING = "running"
    SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
    FAILED = "failed"


TERMINAL = frozenset({JobState.SUCCEEDED, JobState.FAILED})


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class JobSpec:
    job_id: UUID
    type: JobType
    snapshot_id: UUID
    params: dict[str, Any]

    def env(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return {
            "CORVUS_JOB_ID": str(self.job_id),
            "CORVUS_JOB_TYPE": self.type.value,
            "CORVUS_JOB_SNAPSHOT_ID": str(self.snapshot_id),
            "CORVUS_JOB_PARAMS": json.dumps(self.params, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")),
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RunnerStatus:
    state: JobState
    message: str = ""


class JobRunner(Protocol):
    name: str

    async def submit(self, spec: JobSpec) -> str:
        """Start the job; returns the runner reference (process key, Kubernetes job name)."""
        ...

    async def status(self, ref: str) -> RunnerStatus: ...


# --- local (subprocess) -------------------------------------------------------------------------


class ProcessHandle(Protocol):
    def poll(self) -> int | None: ...


class ProcessLauncher(Protocol):
    def launch(self, argv: Sequence[str], env: Mapping[str, str]) -> ProcessHandle: ...


_SECRET_ENV = re.compile(r"^(CORVUS_API_.*|CORVUS_PSEUDONYM_KEY.*|CORVUS_KEK)$")
_JOB_API_ENV = frozenset({"CORVUS_API_URL", "CORVUS_API_TOKEN"})
"""How a job reaches the API; the token is the job's own machine token, not the API's secret."""


def child_environment(parent: Mapping[str, str], extra: Mapping[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    """The environment of a job process: the parent's, minus the API's own secrets, plus ``extra``."""
    env = {k: v for k, v in parent.items() if k in _JOB_API_ENV or not _SECRET_ENV.match(k)}
    env.update(extra)
    return env


class SubprocessLauncher:
    """Starts a detached child without a shell. The API's own secrets are not passed on."""

    def launch(self, argv: Sequence[str], env: Mapping[str, str]) -> ProcessHandle:
        child_env = child_environment(os.environ, env)
        return subprocess.Popen(  # noqa: S603 - argv is a list, no shell
            list(argv),
            env=child_env,
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            close_fds=True,
            start_new_session=True,
        )


class LocalRunner:
    """For standalone setups. Handles live in memory: after an API restart a running job is reported
    as failed because its exit status can no longer be observed."""

    name = "local"

    def __init__(self, command: Sequence[str], launcher: ProcessLauncher) -> None:
        if not command:
            raise ValueError("local job command must not be empty")
        self._command = list(command)
        self._launcher = launcher
        self._handles: dict[str, ProcessHandle] = {}

    async def submit(self, spec: JobSpec) -> str:
        ref = str(spec.job_id)
        argv = [*self._command, spec.type.value]
        self._handles[ref] = await asyncio.to_thread(self._launcher.launch, argv, spec.env())
        return ref

    async def status(self, ref: str) -> RunnerStatus:
        handle = self._handles.get(ref)
        if handle is None:
            return RunnerStatus(JobState.FAILED, "process handle lost (API restarted)")
        code = handle.poll()
        if code is None:
            return RunnerStatus(JobState.RUNNING)
        if code == 0:
            return RunnerStatus(JobState.SUCCEEDED)
        return RunnerStatus(JobState.FAILED, f"exit code {code}")


# --- kubernetes ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class BatchApi(Protocol):
    """The subset of ``kubernetes.client.BatchV1Api`` that is used."""

    def create_namespaced_job(self, namespace: str, body: Any) -> Any: ...
    def read_namespaced_job_status(self, name: str, namespace: str) -> Any: ...


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class K8sJobConfig:
    namespace: str
    image: str
    command: Sequence[str]
    cpu_request: str
    cpu_limit: str
    memory_request: str
    memory_limit: str
    ttl_after_finished_s: int
    active_deadline_s: int
    backoff_limit: int
    service_account: str | None = None
    env_secret: str | None = None
    scratch_size_limit: str = "20Gi"


SCRATCH_MOUNT = "/scratch"


class KubernetesRunner:
    name = "kubernetes"

    def __init__(self, api: BatchApi, config: K8sJobConfig) -> None:
        if not config.image:
            raise ValueError("CORVUS_API_JOB_K8S_IMAGE is required for the kubernetes runner")
        self._api = api
        self._cfg = config

    @staticmethod
    def job_name(spec: JobSpec) -> str:
        return f"corvus-{spec.type.value.replace('_', '-')}-{spec.job_id.hex[:8]}"

    def build_job(self, spec: JobSpec) -> dict[str, Any]:
        c = self._cfg
        name = self.job_name(spec)
        labels = {
            "app.kubernetes.io/name": "corvus-job",
            "app.kubernetes.io/part-of": "corvus",
            "app.kubernetes.io/managed-by": "corvus-api",
            "corvus.onelitefeather.net/job-type": spec.type.value.replace("_", "-"),
            "corvus.onelitefeather.net/job-id": str(spec.job_id),
        }
        container: dict[str, Any] = {
            "name": "job",
            "image": c.image,
            "command": list(c.command),
            "args": [spec.type.value],
            "env": [
                {"name": k, "value": v}
                for k, v in {
                    **spec.env(),
                    "CORVUS_JOB_SCRATCH_DIR": SCRATCH_MOUNT,
                    "TMPDIR": SCRATCH_MOUNT,
                }.items()
            ],
            "volumeMounts": [{"name": "scratch", "mountPath": SCRATCH_MOUNT}],
            "resources": {
                "requests": {"cpu": c.cpu_request, "memory": c.memory_request},
                "limits": {"cpu": c.cpu_limit, "memory": c.memory_limit},
            },
            "securityContext": {
                "allowPrivilegeEscalation": False,
                "capabilities": {"drop": ["ALL"]},
            },
        }
        if c.env_secret:
            container["envFrom"] = [{"secretRef": {"name": c.env_secret}}]
        pod_spec: dict[str, Any] = {
            "restartPolicy": "Never",
            "containers": [container],
            # Feature builds can be large: scratch space on a sized emptyDir, not the image layer.
            "volumes": [{"name": "scratch", "emptyDir": {"sizeLimit": c.scratch_size_limit}}],
            "securityContext": {"runAsNonRoot": True, "seccompProfile": {"type": "RuntimeDefault"}},
        }
        if c.service_account:
            pod_spec["serviceAccountName"] = c.service_account
        return {
            "apiVersion": "batch/v1",
            "kind": "Job",
            "metadata": {"name": name, "namespace": c.namespace, "labels": labels},
            "spec": {
                "ttlSecondsAfterFinished": c.ttl_after_finished_s,
                "activeDeadlineSeconds": c.active_deadline_s,
                "backoffLimit": c.backoff_limit,
                "template": {"metadata": {"labels": labels}, "spec": pod_spec},
            },
        }

    async def submit(self, spec: JobSpec) -> str:
        body = self.build_job(spec)
        await asyncio.to_thread(self._api.create_namespaced_job, self._cfg.namespace, body)
        return str(body["metadata"]["name"])

    async def status(self, ref: str) -> RunnerStatus:
        job = await asyncio.to_thread(
            self._api.read_namespaced_job_status, ref, self._cfg.namespace
        )
        st = getattr(job, "status", None)
        for cond in getattr(st, "conditions", None) or []:
            if getattr(cond, "status", None) != "True":
                continue
            if cond.type == "Complete":
                return RunnerStatus(JobState.SUCCEEDED)
            if cond.type == "Failed":
                return RunnerStatus(JobState.FAILED, str(getattr(cond, "reason", None) or "failed"))
        if getattr(st, "active", None):
            return RunnerStatus(JobState.RUNNING)
        if getattr(st, "succeeded", None):
            return RunnerStatus(JobState.SUCCEEDED)
        return RunnerStatus(JobState.QUEUED)


def build_runner(settings: ApiSettings) -> JobRunner:
    if settings.job_runner == "local":
        return LocalRunner(settings.job_local_command, SubprocessLauncher())
    from kubernetes import client, config  # imported lazily: only needed on this path

    try:
        config.load_incluster_config()
    except config.ConfigException:
        config.load_kube_config()
    cfg = K8sJobConfig(
        namespace=settings.job_k8s_namespace,
        image=settings.job_k8s_image,
        command=settings.job_k8s_command,
        cpu_request=settings.job_k8s_cpu_request,
        cpu_limit=settings.job_k8s_cpu_limit,
        memory_request=settings.job_k8s_memory_request,
        memory_limit=settings.job_k8s_memory_limit,
        ttl_after_finished_s=settings.job_k8s_ttl_after_finished_s,
        active_deadline_s=settings.job_k8s_active_deadline_s,
        backoff_limit=settings.job_k8s_backoff_limit,
        service_account=settings.job_k8s_service_account,
        env_secret=settings.job_k8s_env_secret,
        scratch_size_limit=settings.job_k8s_scratch_size_limit,
    )
    return KubernetesRunner(client.BatchV1Api(), cfg)


# --- use cases ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class SnapshotMissingError(Exception):
    pass


async def create_job(
    jobs: JobRepo,
    snapshots: SnapshotRepo,
    runner: JobRunner,
    *,
    job_type: JobType,
    snapshot_id: UUID,
    params: dict[str, Any],
    actor: str,
    now: datetime,
    new_id: Callable[[], UUID] = uuid4,
) -> JobRecord:
    if await snapshots.get(snapshot_id) is None:
        raise SnapshotMissingError(str(snapshot_id))
    job_id = new_id()
    record = JobRecord(
        job_id, job_type.value, snapshot_id, params, JobState.QUEUED.value, runner.name,
        None, "", actor, now, now,
    )  # fmt: skip
    await jobs.create(record)
    try:
        ref = await runner.submit(JobSpec(job_id, job_type, snapshot_id, params))
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("job %s submission failed (%s)", job_id, type(e).__name__)
        return await jobs.update(
            job_id,
            status=JobState.FAILED.value,
            runner_ref=None,
            message=f"submission failed: {type(e).__name__}",
            now=now,
            finished=True,
        )
    return await jobs.update(
        job_id, status=JobState.RUNNING.value, runner_ref=ref, message="", now=now, finished=False
    )


class JobFinishedError(Exception):
    """The job already reached a final status that differs from the reported one."""


REPORTABLE = (JobState.RUNNING, JobState.SUCCEEDED, JobState.FAILED)


async def report_job(
    jobs: JobRepo,
    job: JobRecord,
    *,
    status: JobState,
    message: str,
    result: dict[str, Any] | None,
    now: datetime,
) -> JobRecord:
    """Apply a status report from the job process. Final statuses are final; repeating the same
    report is accepted (retries after a lost response)."""
    if JobState(job.status) in TERMINAL:
        if status.value == job.status and message == job.message and result in (None, job.result):
            return job
        raise JobFinishedError(job.status)
    return await jobs.update(
        job.id,
        status=status.value,
        runner_ref=None,
        message=message,
        now=now,
        finished=status in TERMINAL,
        result=result,
    )


async def refresh_job(jobs: JobRepo, runner: JobRunner, job: JobRecord, now: datetime) -> JobRecord:
    """Pulls the runner status into the stored job. Runner errors leave the stored status unchanged."""
    if JobState(job.status) in TERMINAL or job.runner_ref is None or job.runner != runner.name:
        return job
    try:
        st = await runner.status(job.runner_ref)
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("job %s status refresh failed (%s)", job.id, type(e).__name__)
        return job
    if st.state.value == job.status and (st.message == job.message or not st.message):
        return job  # a message the job itself reported is not overwritten by an empty one
    return await jobs.update(
        job.id,
        status=st.state.value,
        runner_ref=job.runner_ref,
        message=st.message,
        now=now,
        finished=st.state in TERMINAL,
    )
```

`services/src/corvus_services/api/labels.py`:

```py
"""Labels: validation and CSV import."""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, ValidationError, field_validator, model_validator

from .pseudonym import parse_pseudonym

LabelValue = Literal["legit", "cheat"]
LabelSource = Literal["honeypot", "staff_verdict", "ban_import", "weak_rule"]
SubjectType = Literal["pseudonym", "session"]

CSV_COLUMNS = (
    "subject_type",
    "subject",
    "label",
    "source",
    "confidence",
    "valid_from",
    "valid_to",
    "note",
)
_REQUIRED = ("subject_type", "subject", "label", "source", "confidence")


class LabelIn(BaseModel):
    """``subject`` is the pseudonym (64 hex chars) or the session id (32 hex chars)."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    subject_type: SubjectType
    subject: str
    label: LabelValue
    source: LabelSource
    confidence: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    valid_from: datetime | None = None
    valid_to: datetime | None = None
    note: str = Field(default="", max_length=2000)

    @field_validator("valid_from", "valid_to")
    @classmethod
    def _aware(cls, v: datetime | None) -> datetime | None:
        if v is not None and v.tzinfo is None:
            raise ValueError("timestamps must carry a UTC offset")
        return v

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _consistent(self) -> LabelIn:
        if self.valid_from and self.valid_to and self.valid_from >= self.valid_to:
            raise ValueError("valid_from must be before valid_to")
        try:
            if self.subject_type == "pseudonym":
                parse_pseudonym(self.subject)
            else:
                if len(self.subject) != 32:
                    raise ValueError("session id must be 32 hex characters")
                bytes.fromhex(self.subject)
        except ValueError as e:
            raise ValueError(str(e)) from None
        return self

    def subject_bytes(self) -> bytes:
        return bytes.fromhex(self.subject)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RowError:
    row: int
    message: str


class CsvError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str, errors: list[RowError] | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.errors = errors or []


def parse_csv(text: str, max_rows: int) -> list[LabelIn]:
    """Parses and validates all rows; any invalid row rejects the whole file (nothing is imported)."""
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text, newline=""))
    header = reader.fieldnames or []
    missing = [c for c in _REQUIRED if c not in header]
    unknown = [c for c in header if c not in CSV_COLUMNS]
    if missing or unknown:
        raise CsvError(
            "bad header"
            + (f", missing: {', '.join(missing)}" if missing else "")
            + (f", unknown: {', '.join(unknown)}" if unknown else "")
        )
    rows: list[LabelIn] = []
    errors: list[RowError] = []
    for index, raw in enumerate(reader, start=2):  # line 1 is the header
        if len(rows) + len(errors) >= max_rows:
            raise CsvError(f"too many rows (limit {max_rows})")
        data = {k: v for k, v in raw.items() if k is not None and v not in (None, "")}
        try:
            rows.append(LabelIn.model_validate(data))
        except ValidationError as e:
            first = e.errors()[0]
            loc = ".".join(str(p) for p in first["loc"]) or "row"
            # No input echo: notes and subjects can be sensitive.
            errors.append(RowError(index, f"{loc}: {first['msg']}"))
    if errors:
        raise CsvError("invalid rows", errors)
    if not rows:
        raise CsvError("file contains no rows")
    return rows

```

`services/src/corvus_services/api/pagination.py`:

```py
"""Keyset pagination: ``limit`` plus an opaque ``cursor`` over (created_at, id), newest first."""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime

from .problems import ProblemError


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Cursor:
    created_at: datetime
    id: str

    def encode(self) -> str:
        raw = json.dumps([self.created_at.isoformat(), self.id], separators=(",", ":"))
        return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw.encode()).decode().rstrip("=")

    @classmethod
    def decode(cls, token: str) -> Cursor:
        try:
            padded = token + "=" * (-len(token) % 4)
            created, ident = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(padded.encode()))
            return cls(datetime.fromisoformat(created), str(ident))
        except (ValueError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e:
            raise ProblemError(400, "invalid cursor", slug="invalid-cursor") from e


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PageRequest:
    limit: int
    cursor: Cursor | None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Page[T]:
    items: list[T]
    next_cursor: str | None


def paginate[T](
    rows: Sequence[T], req: PageRequest, key: Callable[[T], tuple[datetime, str]]
) -> Page[T]:
    """In-memory keyset pagination (used by fakes; the Postgres adapter does it in SQL)."""
    ordered = sorted(rows, key=key, reverse=True)
    if req.cursor is not None:
        bound = (req.cursor.created_at, req.cursor.id)
        ordered = [r for r in ordered if key(r) < bound]
    return page_of(ordered[: req.limit + 1], req.limit, key)


def page_of[T](rows: list[T], limit: int, key: Callable[[T], tuple[datetime, str]]) -> Page[T]:
    """``rows`` holds up to ``limit + 1`` rows; the extra row signals a next page."""
    items = rows[:limit]
    if len(rows) > limit:
        created_at, ident = key(items[-1])
        return Page(items, Cursor(created_at, ident).encode())
    return Page(items, None)

```

```py
"""PostgreSQL adapters of the control-plane ports (psycopg 3 async pool, parameterised SQL only).

Every statement is a constant string; values are always bound parameters. The only f-strings assemble
constant fragments (column lists, WHERE conjunctions built from constants).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Callable
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Literal, cast
from uuid import UUID

import psycopg
from psycopg.errors import UniqueViolation
from psycopg.types.json import Jsonb
from psycopg_pool import AsyncConnectionPool

from .pagination import Page, PageRequest, page_of
from .pools import (
    LABEL_MATCH,
    FileShare,
    PoolFilter,
    RawPreview,
    build_pool_query,
    preview_statements,

    SnapshotRecord,

)
```
