```py
type Pool = AsyncConnectionPool[Any]

_READ_ONLY_RR = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY"


async def open_pool(dsn: str, max_size: int) -> Pool:
    pool: Pool = AsyncConnectionPool(dsn, min_size=1, max_size=max_size, open=False)
    await pool.open(wait=True, timeout=30)
    return pool


async def _list_page[R](
    pool: Pool,
    select_sql: str,
    where: list[str],
    params: dict[str, Any],
    req: PageRequest,
    *,
    id_col: str,
    id_param_sql: str,
    to_record: Callable[[tuple[Any, ...]], R],
    key: Callable[[R], tuple[datetime, str]],
    time_col: str = "created_at",
) -> Page[R]:
    """Keyset pagination, newest first. ``select_sql`` ends before WHERE; all parts are constants."""
    args = dict(params, limit=req.limit + 1)
    if req.cursor is not None:
        args["cursor_at"] = req.cursor.created_at
        args["cursor_id"] = req.cursor.id
    sql = list_sql(
        select_sql,
        where,
        id_col=id_col,
        id_param_sql=id_param_sql,
        time_col=time_col,
        with_cursor=req.cursor is not None,
    )
    async with pool.connection() as conn:
        cur = await conn.execute(sql.encode(), args)
        rows = await cur.fetchall()
    return page_of([to_record(tuple(r)) for r in rows], req.limit, key)


# --- pools --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

_POOL_COLS = (
    "id, name, description, definition, created_by, created_at, updated_at, raw_retention_days"
)


def _pool(r: tuple[Any, ...]) -> PoolRecord:
    return PoolRecord(r[0], r[1], r[2], PoolFilter.model_validate(r[3]), r[4], r[5], r[6], r[7])


def _pool_key(p: PoolRecord) -> tuple[datetime, str]:
    return p.created_at, str(p.id)


class PgPoolRepo:
    def __init__(self, pool: Pool) -> None:
        self._pool = pool

    async def create(self, pool: PoolRecord) -> None:
        try:
            async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
                await conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO corvus.pools (id, name, description, definition, created_by,"
                    " created_at, updated_at, raw_retention_days)"
                    " VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)",
                    (
                        pool.id,
                        pool.name,
                        pool.description,
                        Jsonb(pool.filter.model_dump(mode="json")),
                        pool.created_by,
                        pool.created_at,
                        pool.updated_at,
                        pool.raw_retention_days,
                    ),
                )
        except UniqueViolation as e:
            raise DuplicateError("pool name already exists") from e

    async def get(self, pool_id: UUID) -> PoolRecord | None:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                f"SELECT {_POOL_COLS} FROM corvus.pools WHERE id = %s".encode(), (pool_id,)
            )
            row = await cur.fetchone()
        return _pool(tuple(row)) if row else None

    async def list_page(self, req: PageRequest) -> Page[PoolRecord]:
        return await _list_page(
            self._pool,
            f"SELECT {_POOL_COLS} FROM corvus.pools",
            [],
            {},
            req,
            id_col="id",
            id_param_sql="%(cursor_id)s::uuid",
            to_record=_pool,
            key=_pool_key,
        )

    async def update(self, pool: PoolRecord) -> bool:
        try:
            async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
                cur = await conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE corvus.pools SET name = %s, description = %s, definition = %s,"
                    " updated_at = %s, raw_retention_days = %s WHERE id = %s",
                    (
                        pool.name,
                        pool.description,
                        Jsonb(pool.filter.model_dump(mode="json")),
                        pool.updated_at,
                        pool.raw_retention_days,
                        pool.id,
                    ),
                )
                return bool(cur.rowcount > 0)
        except UniqueViolation as e:
            raise DuplicateError("pool name already exists") from e

    async def delete(self, pool_id: UUID) -> bool:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute("DELETE FROM corvus.pools WHERE id = %s", (pool_id,))
            return bool(cur.rowcount > 0)


class PgPoolCatalog:
    def __init__(self, pool: Pool) -> None:
        self._pool = pool

    async def preview(self, pool_filter: PoolFilter) -> RawPreview:
        q = build_pool_query(pool_filter)
        stmts = preview_statements(q)
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn, conn.transaction():
            await conn.execute(_READ_ONLY_RR)
            counts: dict[str, int] = {}
            for name in ("sessions", "segments", "players"):
                cur = await conn.execute(stmts[name].encode(), q.params)
                row = await cur.fetchone()
                counts[name] = int(row[0]) if row else 0
            cur = await conn.execute(stmts["labels"].encode(), q.params)
            labels = {str(r[0]): int(r[1]) for r in await cur.fetchall()}
            cur = await conn.execute(stmts["files"].encode(), q.params)
            files = [FileShare(int(r[0]), int(r[1]), int(r[2])) for r in await cur.fetchall()]
        return RawPreview(counts["sessions"], counts["segments"], counts["players"], labels, files)

    async def snapshot_material(self, pool_filter: PoolFilter) -> SnapshotMaterial:
        q = build_pool_query(pool_filter)
        stmts = snapshot_statements(q)
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn, conn.transaction():
            await conn.execute(_READ_ONLY_RR)
            cur = await conn.execute(stmts["sessions"].encode(), q.params)
            sessions = [bytes(r[0]) for r in await cur.fetchall()]
            cur = await conn.execute(stmts["files"].encode(), q.params)
            files = [LakeFileRef(int(r[0]), str(r[1])) for r in await cur.fetchall()]
        return SnapshotMaterial(sessions, files)


# --- snapshots ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

_NEEDS_REBUILD = (
    "COALESCE((SELECT x.needs_rebuild FROM corvus.snapshot_state x"
    " WHERE x.snapshot_id = dataset_snapshots.id), false)"
)
_SNAP_COLS = (
    "id, pool_id, pool_name, manifest, sha256, session_count, file_count, created_by, created_at,"
    f" {_NEEDS_REBUILD}"
)


def _snapshot(r: tuple[Any, ...]) -> SnapshotRecord:
    return SnapshotRecord(r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5], r[6], r[7], r[8], bool(r[9]))


# Sessions of a manifest with pseudonym, start, segments, applicable labels and the erased flag,
# ascending by id (hex order equals byte order), keyset on the id.
SESSIONS_PAGE_SQL = (
    "SELECT sid.session_id, s.pseudonym, s.started_at,"
    " COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('segment', g.segment,"
    "  'game_context', g.game_context) ORDER BY g.segment)"
    "  FROM corvus.segments g WHERE g.session_id = sid.session_id), '[]'::jsonb),"
    " COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', l.label, 'source', l.source,"
    "  'confidence', l.confidence, 'valid_from', l.valid_from, 'valid_to', l.valid_to)"
    "  ORDER BY l.created_at, l.id)"
    f"  FROM corvus.labels l WHERE {LABEL_MATCH}), '[]'::jsonb),"
    " EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM corvus.erased_sessions x WHERE x.session_id = sid.session_id),"
    " s.client_protocol"
    " FROM corvus.dataset_snapshots d,"
    " LATERAL (SELECT decode(e.value, 'hex') AS session_id"
    "  FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(d.manifest -> 'sessions') AS e(value)) sid"
    " LEFT JOIN corvus.sessions s ON s.session_id = sid.session_id"
    " WHERE d.id = %(snapshot_id)s"
    " AND (%(after)s::bytea IS NULL OR sid.session_id > %(after)s::bytea)"
    " AND (NOT %(exclude_erased)s OR NOT EXISTS"
    "  (SELECT 1 FROM corvus.erased_sessions x WHERE x.session_id = sid.session_id))"
    " ORDER BY sid.session_id LIMIT %(limit)s"
)

# Follows lake_files.replaced_by from every events file of the manifest to the live successor.
CURRENT_FILES_SQL = (
    "WITH RECURSIVE manifest_files AS ("
    " SELECT (e.value ->> 'id')::bigint AS id"
    " FROM corvus.dataset_snapshots d,"
    " jsonb_array_elements(d.manifest -> 'files' -> 'events') AS e(value)"
    " WHERE d.id = %(snapshot_id)s),"
    " chain AS ("
    " SELECT f.id AS origin, f.id, f.s3_key, f.replaced_by, f.deleted_at"
    " FROM corvus.lake_files f JOIN manifest_files m ON m.id = f.id"
    " UNION ALL"
    " SELECT c.origin, n.id, n.s3_key, n.replaced_by, n.deleted_at"
    " FROM chain c JOIN corvus.lake_files n ON n.id = c.replaced_by)"
    " SELECT origin, id, s3_key FROM chain WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY origin, id"
)


# Live raw files with payloads of the manifest's sessions. The manifest lists events files only; raw
# files are found through lake_file_sessions, where compaction already moved the sessions to the
# replacement file, so no replaced_by chain has to be followed.
CURRENT_RAW_FILES_SQL = (
    "SELECT DISTINCT f.id, f.s3_key"
    " FROM corvus.dataset_snapshots d,"
    " LATERAL (SELECT decode(e.value, 'hex') AS session_id"
    "  FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(d.manifest -> 'sessions') AS e(value)) sid"
    " JOIN corvus.lake_file_sessions fs ON fs.session_id = sid.session_id"
    " JOIN corvus.lake_files f ON f.id = fs.file_id"
    " WHERE d.id = %(snapshot_id)s AND f.table_name = 'raw' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL"
    " ORDER BY f.id"
)

# Insert or revive the artefact of (snapshot, prefix). Revival (deleted_at back to NULL) is the
# rebuild of a prefix that erasure or retention had removed; created_at restarts with it.
UPSERT_ARTIFACT_SQL = (
    "INSERT INTO corvus.derived_artifacts (id, snapshot_id, job_id, kind, s3_prefix,"
    " contains_raw, created_at)"
    " VALUES (%(id)s, %(snapshot_id)s, %(job_id)s, %(kind)s, %(s3_prefix)s, %(contains_raw)s,"
    " %(created_at)s)"
    " ON CONFLICT (snapshot_id, s3_prefix) DO UPDATE SET"
    " job_id = EXCLUDED.job_id, kind = EXCLUDED.kind, contains_raw = EXCLUDED.contains_raw,"
    " created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, deleted_at = NULL, deleted_reason = NULL"
    " RETURNING id, snapshot_id, job_id, kind, s3_prefix, contains_raw, created_at,"
    " (xmax = 0) AS inserted"
)

SNAPSHOT_REBUILD_SQL = (
    "SELECT needs_rebuild, needs_rebuild_at FROM corvus.snapshot_state"
    " WHERE snapshot_id = %(snapshot_id)s FOR UPDATE"
)

CLEAR_REBUILD_SQL = (
    "UPDATE corvus.snapshot_state SET needs_rebuild = false, reason = ''"
    " WHERE snapshot_id = %(snapshot_id)s"
)

LIST_ARTIFACTS_SQL = (
    "SELECT id, snapshot_id, job_id, kind, s3_prefix, contains_raw, created_at"
    " FROM corvus.derived_artifacts WHERE snapshot_id = %(snapshot_id)s AND deleted_at IS NULL"
    " ORDER BY s3_prefix"
)


def _snapshot_session(r: tuple[Any, ...]) -> SnapshotSession:
    return SnapshotSession(
        session_id=bytes(r[0]),
        pseudonym=bytes(r[1]) if r[1] is not None else None,
        started_at=r[2],
        segments=[SessionSegment(int(g["segment"]), str(g["game_context"])) for g in r[3]],
        labels=[
            SessionLabel(
                str(lb["label"]),
                str(lb["source"]),
                float(lb["confidence"]),
                _opt_dt(lb["valid_from"]),
                _opt_dt(lb["valid_to"]),
            )
            for lb in r[4]
        ],
        erased=bool(r[5]),
        client_protocol=int(r[6]) if r[6] is not None else None,
    )


def _opt_dt(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
    return datetime.fromisoformat(value) if value else None


class PgSnapshotRepo:
    def __init__(self, pool: Pool) -> None:
        self._pool = pool

    async def insert(self, snapshot: SnapshotRecord) -> None:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO corvus.dataset_snapshots (id, pool_id, pool_name, manifest, sha256,"
                " session_count, file_count, created_by, created_at)"
                " VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)",
                (
                    snapshot.id,
                    snapshot.pool_id,
                    snapshot.pool_name,
                    Jsonb(snapshot.manifest),
                    snapshot.sha256,
                    snapshot.session_count,
                    snapshot.file_count,
                    snapshot.created_by,
                    snapshot.created_at,
                ),
            )

    async def get(self, snapshot_id: UUID) -> SnapshotRecord | None:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                f"SELECT {_SNAP_COLS} FROM corvus.dataset_snapshots WHERE id = %s".encode(),
                (snapshot_id,),
            )
            row = await cur.fetchone()
        return _snapshot(tuple(row)) if row else None

    async def list_page(self, req: PageRequest, pool_id: UUID | None) -> Page[SnapshotRecord]:
        # The list view omits the (large) manifest: it is replaced by an empty object.
        where, params = (
            ([], {}) if pool_id is None else (["pool_id = %(pool_id)s"], {"pool_id": pool_id})
        )
        return await _list_page(
            self._pool,
            "SELECT id, pool_id, pool_name, '{}'::jsonb, sha256, session_count, file_count,"
            f" created_by, created_at, {_NEEDS_REBUILD} FROM corvus.dataset_snapshots",
            where,
            params,
            req,
            id_col="id",
            id_param_sql="%(cursor_id)s::uuid",
            to_record=_snapshot,
            key=lambda s: (s.created_at, str(s.id)),
        )

    async def sessions_page(
        self, snapshot_id: UUID, after: bytes | None, limit: int, exclude_erased: bool
    ) -> list[SnapshotSession]:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                SESSIONS_PAGE_SQL.encode(),
                {
                    "snapshot_id": snapshot_id,
                    "after": after,
                    "limit": limit,
                    "exclude_erased": exclude_erased,
                },
            )
            return [_snapshot_session(tuple(r)) for r in await cur.fetchall()]

    async def current_files(self, snapshot_id: UUID) -> list[CurrentFile]:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(CURRENT_FILES_SQL.encode(), {"snapshot_id": snapshot_id})
            return [CurrentFile(int(r[0]), int(r[1]), r[2]) for r in await cur.fetchall()]

    async def current_raw_files(self, snapshot_id: UUID) -> list[CurrentFile]:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(CURRENT_RAW_FILES_SQL.encode(), {"snapshot_id": snapshot_id})
            return [CurrentFile(int(r[0]), int(r[0]), r[1]) for r in await cur.fetchall()]

    async def register_artifact(
        self, artifact: ArtifactRecord, job_started_at: datetime | None
    ) -> tuple[ArtifactRecord, bool]:
        params = {
            "id": artifact.id,
            "snapshot_id": artifact.snapshot_id,
            "job_id": artifact.job_id,
            "kind": artifact.kind,
            "s3_prefix": artifact.s3_prefix,
            "contains_raw": artifact.contains_raw,
            "created_at": artifact.created_at,
        }
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn, conn.transaction():
            cur = await conn.execute(SNAPSHOT_REBUILD_SQL.encode(), params)
            state = await cur.fetchone()
            invalidated_at = state[1] if state is not None and state[0] else None
            if invalidated_at is not None and artifact.contains_raw:
                if job_started_at is None or job_started_at < invalidated_at:
                    raise StaleBuildError(invalidated_at.isoformat())
                await conn.execute(CLEAR_REBUILD_SQL.encode(), params)
            cur = await conn.execute(UPSERT_ARTIFACT_SQL.encode(), params)
            row = await cur.fetchone()
        assert row is not None
        return _artifact(tuple(row)), bool(row[7])

    async def list_artifacts(self, snapshot_id: UUID) -> list[ArtifactRecord]:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(LIST_ARTIFACTS_SQL.encode(), {"snapshot_id": snapshot_id})
            return [_artifact(tuple(r)) for r in await cur.fetchall()]


def _artifact(r: tuple[Any, ...]) -> ArtifactRecord:
    return ArtifactRecord(r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5], r[6])


# --- labels -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

_LABEL_COLS = (
    "id, subject_type, pseudonym, session_id, label, source, confidence, valid_from, valid_to,"
    " note, created_by, created_at"
)


def _label(r: tuple[Any, ...]) -> LabelRecord:
    subject = bytes(r[2] if r[1] == "pseudonym" else r[3]).hex()
    return LabelRecord(
        r[0], cast(Literal["pseudonym", "session"], r[1]), subject, r[4], r[5], r[6], r[7], r[8],
        r[9], r[10], r[11],
    )  # fmt: skip


class PgLabelRepo:
    def __init__(self, pool: Pool) -> None:
        self._pool = pool

    async def add_many(self, labels: list[LabelRecord]) -> None:
        rows = [
            (
                lb.id,
                lb.subject_type,
                bytes.fromhex(lb.subject) if lb.subject_type == "pseudonym" else None,
                bytes.fromhex(lb.subject) if lb.subject_type == "session" else None,
                lb.label,
                lb.source,
                lb.confidence,
                lb.valid_from,
                lb.valid_to,
                lb.note,
                lb.created_by,
                lb.created_at,
            )
            for lb in labels
        ]
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn, conn.transaction(), conn.cursor() as cur:
            await cur.executemany(
                "INSERT INTO corvus.labels (id, subject_type, pseudonym, session_id, label, source,"
                " confidence, valid_from, valid_to, note, created_by, created_at)"
                " VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)",
                rows,
            )

    async def list_page(
        self, req: PageRequest, subject_type: str | None, subject: bytes | None
    ) -> Page[LabelRecord]:
        where: list[str] = []
        params: dict[str, Any] = {}
        if subject_type == "pseudonym":
            where.append("subject_type = 'pseudonym'")
            if subject is not None:
                where.append("pseudonym = %(subject)s")
        elif subject_type == "session":
            where.append("subject_type = 'session'")
            if subject is not None:
                where.append("session_id = %(subject)s")
        if subject is not None:
            params["subject"] = subject
        return await _list_page(
            self._pool,
            f"SELECT {_LABEL_COLS} FROM corvus.labels",
            where,
            params,
            req,
            id_col="id",
            id_param_sql="%(cursor_id)s::uuid",
            to_record=_label,
            key=lambda lb: (lb.created_at, str(lb.id)),
        )


# --- players, erasure, blocklist ----------------------------------------------------------------


def _player(r: tuple[Any, ...]) -> PlayerInfo:
    return PlayerInfo(bytes(r[0]), r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4])


class PgPlayerRepo:
    def __init__(self, pool: Pool) -> None:
        self._pool = pool

    async def get(self, pseudonym: bytes) -> PlayerInfo | None:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                "SELECT pseudonym, key_id, first_seen, last_seen, erased_at"
                " FROM corvus.players WHERE pseudonym = %s",
                (pseudonym,),
            )
            row = await cur.fetchone()
        return _player(tuple(row)) if row else None


class PgErasureTx:
    def __init__(self, conn: psycopg.AsyncConnection[Any]) -> None:
        self._conn = conn

    async def lock_player(self, pseudonym: bytes) -> PlayerInfo | None:
        cur = await self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT pseudonym, key_id, first_seen, last_seen, erased_at"
            " FROM corvus.players WHERE pseudonym = %s FOR UPDATE",
            (pseudonym,),
        )
        row = await cur.fetchone()
        return _player(tuple(row)) if row else None

    async def delete_player_key(self, pseudonym: bytes) -> bool:
        cur = await self._conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM corvus.player_keys WHERE pseudonym = %s", (pseudonym,)
        )
        return cur.rowcount > 0

    async def delete_scores(self, pseudonym: bytes) -> int:
        latest = await self._conn.execute(DELETE_SCORES_LATEST, (pseudonym,))
        history = await self._conn.execute(DELETE_SCORE_HISTORY, (pseudonym,))
        return int(latest.rowcount) + int(history.rowcount)

    async def mark_erased(self, pseudonym: bytes, at: datetime) -> None:
        await self._conn.execute(
            "UPDATE corvus.players SET erased_at = COALESCE(erased_at, %s) WHERE pseudonym = %s",
            (at, pseudonym),
        )

    async def block(self, entry: BlockEntry) -> None:
        await _put_block(self._conn, entry)

    async def record_request(self, request: ErasureRequest) -> None:
        await self._conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO corvus.erasure_requests (id, pseudonym, requested_by, requested_at, status,"
            " player_known, key_deleted, compaction_pending) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)",
            (
                request.id,
                request.pseudonym,
                request.requested_by,
                request.requested_at,
                request.status,
                request.player_known,
                request.key_deleted,
                request.compaction_pending,
            ),
        )


_ERASURE_COLS = (
    "id, pseudonym, requested_by, requested_at, status, player_known, key_deleted,"
    " compaction_pending, compacted_at"
)


def _erasure(r: tuple[Any, ...]) -> ErasureRequest:
    return ErasureRequest(r[0], bytes(r[1]), r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5], r[6], r[7], r[8])


class PgErasureStore:
    def __init__(self, pool: Pool) -> None:
        self._pool = pool

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def transaction(self) -> AsyncIterator[ErasureTx]:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn, conn.transaction():
            yield PgErasureTx(conn)

    async def get_request(self, request_id: UUID) -> ErasureRequest | None:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                f"SELECT {_ERASURE_COLS} FROM corvus.erasure_requests WHERE id = %s".encode(),
                (request_id,),
            )
            row = await cur.fetchone()
        return _erasure(tuple(row)) if row else None

    async def list_requests(self, req: PageRequest, status: str | None) -> Page[ErasureRequest]:
        where, params = (
            ([], {}) if status is None else (["status = %(status)s"], {"status": status})
        )
        return await _list_page(
            self._pool,
            f"SELECT {_ERASURE_COLS} FROM corvus.erasure_requests",
            where,
            params,
            req,
            id_col="id",
            id_param_sql="%(cursor_id)s::uuid",
            to_record=_erasure,
            key=lambda e: (e.requested_at, str(e.id)),
            time_col="requested_at",
        )


async def _put_block(conn: psycopg.AsyncConnection[Any], e: BlockEntry) -> None:
    await conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO corvus.blocklist (pseudonym, kind, source, reason, created_by, created_at)"
        " VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)"
        " ON CONFLICT (pseudonym) DO UPDATE SET kind = EXCLUDED.kind, source = EXCLUDED.source,"
        " reason = EXCLUDED.reason, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at",
        (e.pseudonym, e.kind, e.source, e.reason, e.created_by, e.created_at),
    )


def _block(r: tuple[Any, ...]) -> BlockEntry:
    return BlockEntry(bytes(r[0]), r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5])


_BLOCK_COLS = "pseudonym, kind, source, reason, created_by, created_at"


class PgBlocklistRepo:
    def __init__(self, pool: Pool) -> None:
        self._pool = pool

    async def get(self, pseudonym: bytes) -> BlockEntry | None:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                f"SELECT {_BLOCK_COLS} FROM corvus.blocklist WHERE pseudonym = %s".encode(),
                (pseudonym,),
            )
            row = await cur.fetchone()
        return _block(tuple(row)) if row else None

    async def list_page(self, req: PageRequest, kind: str | None) -> Page[BlockEntry]:
        where, params = ([], {}) if kind is None else (["kind = %(kind)s"], {"kind": kind})
        return await _list_page(
            self._pool,
            f"SELECT {_BLOCK_COLS} FROM corvus.blocklist",
            where,
            params,
            req,
            id_col="pseudonym",
            id_param_sql="decode(%(cursor_id)s, 'hex')",
            to_record=_block,
            key=lambda b: (b.created_at, b.pseudonym.hex()),
        )

    async def put(self, entry: BlockEntry) -> None:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            await _put_block(conn, entry)

    async def delete(self, pseudonym: bytes) -> bool:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM corvus.blocklist WHERE pseudonym = %s", (pseudonym,)
            )
            return bool(cur.rowcount > 0)

    async def all_pseudonyms(self) -> tuple[list[bytes], list[bytes]]:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                "SELECT pseudonym, kind FROM corvus.blocklist ORDER BY pseudonym"
            )
            rows = await cur.fetchall()
        blocked = [bytes(r[0]) for r in rows if r[1] == "block"]
        allowed = [bytes(r[0]) for r in rows if r[1] == "allow"]
        return blocked, allowed


# --- models -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

_MODEL_COLS = (
    "id, name, version, candidate_type, game_context, domain, snapshot_id, metrics, onnx_key,"
    " stage, created_by, created_at"
)


def _model(r: tuple[Any, ...]) -> ModelRecord:
    return ModelRecord(*r)


def _transition(r: tuple[Any, ...]) -> TransitionRecord:
    return TransitionRecord(*r)


class PgModelRepo:
    def __init__(self, pool: Pool) -> None:
        self._pool = pool

    async def create(self, model: ModelRecord) -> None:
        try:
            async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
                await conn.execute(
                    f"INSERT INTO corvus.models ({_MODEL_COLS})"
                    " VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)".encode(),
                    (
                        model.id,
                        model.name,
                        model.version,
                        model.candidate_type,
                        model.game_context,
                        model.domain,
                        model.snapshot_id,
                        Jsonb(model.metrics),
                        model.onnx_key,
                        model.stage,
                        model.created_by,
                        model.created_at,
                    ),
                )
        except UniqueViolation as e:
            raise DuplicateError("model name and version already exist") from e

    async def get(self, model_id: UUID) -> ModelRecord | None:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                f"SELECT {_MODEL_COLS} FROM corvus.models WHERE id = %s".encode(), (model_id,)
            )
            row = await cur.fetchone()
        return _model(tuple(row)) if row else None

    async def get_by_name_version(self, name: str, version: str) -> ModelRecord | None:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                f"SELECT {_MODEL_COLS} FROM corvus.models WHERE name = %s AND version = %s".encode(),
                (name, version),
            )
            row = await cur.fetchone()
        return _model(tuple(row)) if row else None

    async def list_page(self, req: PageRequest, flt: ModelFilter) -> Page[ModelRecord]:
        where, params = model_conditions(flt)
        return await _list_page(
            self._pool,
            f"SELECT {_MODEL_COLS} FROM corvus.models",
            where,
            params,
            req,
            id_col="id",
            id_param_sql="%(cursor_id)s::uuid",
            to_record=_model,
            key=lambda m: (m.created_at, str(m.id)),
        )

    async def enforced_in_scope(
        self, snapshot_id: UUID, game_context: str, exclude: UUID
    ) -> list[ModelRecord]:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                f"SELECT {_MODEL_COLS} FROM corvus.models WHERE stage = 'enforce'"
                " AND snapshot_id = %s AND game_context = %s AND id <> %s".encode(),
                (snapshot_id, game_context, exclude),
            )
            return [_model(tuple(r)) for r in await cur.fetchall()]

    async def apply_transition(
        self, model_id: UUID, expected_stage: str, transitions: list[TransitionRecord]
    ) -> ModelRecord:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn, conn.transaction():
            for t in transitions:
                cur = await conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE corvus.models SET stage = %s WHERE id = %s AND stage = %s",
                    (t.to_stage, t.model_id, t.from_stage),
                )
                if cur.rowcount != 1:
                    raise StaleError(str(t.model_id))
                await conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO corvus.model_transitions (id, model_id, from_stage, to_stage, actor,"
                    " reason, gate, at) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)",
                    (
                        t.id,
                        t.model_id,
                        t.from_stage,
                        t.to_stage,
                        t.actor,
                        t.reason,
                        Jsonb(t.gate) if t.gate is not None else None,
                        t.at,
                    ),
                )
            cur = await conn.execute(
                f"SELECT {_MODEL_COLS} FROM corvus.models WHERE id = %s".encode(), (model_id,)
            )
            row = await cur.fetchone()
        assert row is not None
        return _model(tuple(row))

    async def transitions(self, model_id: UUID) -> list[TransitionRecord]:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, model_id, from_stage, to_stage, actor, reason, gate, at"
                " FROM corvus.model_transitions WHERE model_id = %s ORDER BY at, id",
                (model_id,),
            )
            return [_transition(tuple(r)) for r in await cur.fetchall()]


# --- jobs ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

_JOB_COLS = (
    "id, type, snapshot_id, params, status, runner, runner_ref, message, created_by, created_at,"
    " updated_at, finished_at, result"
)


def _job(r: tuple[Any, ...]) -> JobRecord:
    return JobRecord(*r)


class PgJobRepo:
    def __init__(self, pool: Pool) -> None:
        self._pool = pool

    async def create(self, job: JobRecord) -> None:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            await conn.execute(
                f"INSERT INTO corvus.jobs ({_JOB_COLS})"
                " VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)".encode(),
                (
                    job.id,
                    job.type,
                    job.snapshot_id,
                    Jsonb(job.params),
                    job.status,
                    job.runner,
                    job.runner_ref,
                    job.message,
                    job.created_by,
                    job.created_at,
                    job.updated_at,
                    job.finished_at,
                    Jsonb(job.result) if job.result is not None else None,
                ),
            )

    async def get(self, job_id: UUID) -> JobRecord | None:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                f"SELECT {_JOB_COLS} FROM corvus.jobs WHERE id = %s".encode(), (job_id,)
            )
            row = await cur.fetchone()
        return _job(tuple(row)) if row else None

    async def list_page(self, req: PageRequest, status: str | None) -> Page[JobRecord]:
        where, params = (
            ([], {}) if status is None else (["status = %(status)s"], {"status": status})
        )
        return await _list_page(
            self._pool,
            f"SELECT {_JOB_COLS} FROM corvus.jobs",
            where,
            params,
            req,
            id_col="id",
            id_param_sql="%(cursor_id)s::uuid",
            to_record=_job,
            key=lambda j: (j.created_at, str(j.id)),
        )

    async def update(
        self,
        job_id: UUID,
        *,
        status: str,
        runner_ref: str | None,
        message: str,
        now: datetime,
        finished: bool,
        result: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> JobRecord:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                f"{UPDATE_JOB} WHERE id = %s RETURNING {_JOB_COLS}".encode(),
                (
                    status,
                    runner_ref,
                    message,
                    now,
                    finished,
                    now,
                    Jsonb(result) if result is not None else None,
                    job_id,
                ),
            )
            row = await cur.fetchone()
        assert row is not None
        return _job(tuple(row))


class PgScoreRepo:
    def __init__(self, pool: Pool) -> None:
        self._pool = pool

    async def latest(
        self, pseudonym: bytes, include_shadow: bool = False
    ) -> list[ScoreLatestRecord]:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                "SELECT game_context, domain, model_name, model_version, stage, score, smoothed,"
                " windows, updated_at FROM corvus.scores_latest WHERE pseudonym = %s"
                " AND (%s OR stage <> 'shadow')"
                " ORDER BY game_context, domain, model_name",
                (pseudonym, include_shadow),
            )
            return [ScoreLatestRecord(*r) for r in await cur.fetchall()]

    async def history(
        self,
        pseudonym: bytes,
        game_context: str | None,
        limit: int,
        include_shadow: bool = False,
    ) -> list[ScoreHistoryRecord]:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            cur = await conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, session_id, segment, game_context, domain, model_name, model_version,"
                " stage, score, smoothed, windows, window_start_offset_nanos,"
                " window_end_offset_nanos, scored_at FROM corvus.score_history"
                " WHERE pseudonym = %s AND (%s::text IS NULL OR game_context = %s)"
                " AND (%s OR stage <> 'shadow')"
                " ORDER BY scored_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT %s",
                (pseudonym, game_context, game_context, include_shadow, limit),
            )
            return [ScoreHistoryRecord(r[0], bytes(r[1]), *r[2:]) for r in await cur.fetchall()]


class PgSummaryRepo:
    def __init__(self, pool: Pool) -> None:
        self._pool = pool

    async def summary(self, recent: int) -> Summary:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn, conn.transaction():
            await conn.execute(_READ_ONLY_RR)
            counts: dict[str, int] = {}
            for name, sql in SUMMARY_COUNTS.items():
                cur = await conn.execute(sql.encode())
                row = await cur.fetchone()
                counts[name] = int(row[0]) if row else 0
            groups: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
            for name, sql in SUMMARY_GROUPS.items():
                cur = await conn.execute(sql.encode())
                groups[name] = {str(r[0]): int(r[1]) for r in await cur.fetchall()}
            cur = await conn.execute(SUMMARY_RECENT_JOBS.encode(), (recent,))
            jobs = [JobBrief(*r) for r in await cur.fetchall()]
            cur = await conn.execute(SUMMARY_RECENT_ERASURES.encode(), (recent,))
            erasures = [
                ErasureBrief(r[0], bytes(r[1]), r[2], r[3], r[4]) for r in await cur.fetchall()
            ]
        return Summary(
            pools=counts["pools"],
            snapshots=counts["snapshots"],
            jobs_by_status=groups["jobs_by_status"],
            models_by_stage=groups["models_by_stage"],
            labels_by_label=groups["labels_by_label"],
            pending_erasures=counts["pending_erasures"],
            recent_jobs=jobs,
            recent_erasures=erasures,
        )


class PgDatabase:
    def __init__(self, pool: Pool) -> None:
        self._pool = pool

    async def ping(self) -> None:
        async with self._pool.connection() as conn:
            await conn.execute("SELECT 1")


async def open_repos(dsn: str, max_size: int) -> Repos:
    pool = await open_pool(dsn, max_size)
    return Repos(
        pools=PgPoolRepo(pool),
        catalog=PgPoolCatalog(pool),
        snapshots=PgSnapshotRepo(pool),
        labels=PgLabelRepo(pool),
        players=PgPlayerRepo(pool),
        erasure=PgErasureStore(pool),
        blocklist=PgBlocklistRepo(pool),
        models=PgModelRepo(pool),
        jobs=PgJobRepo(pool),
        scores=PgScoreRepo(pool),
        summary=PgSummaryRepo(pool),
        db=PgDatabase(pool),
        closers=[pool.close],
    )
```

`services/src/corvus_services/api/pools.py`:

```py
"""Declarative pool definitions: the filter model, its translation to parameterised SQL, preview math.

The SQL builder only ever emits constant SQL fragments; every user-supplied value travels as a named
parameter (``%(name)s``) and identifiers never come from the filter.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, time, timedelta
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

MAX_LIST_ITEMS = 200


class _Strict(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


class ProtocolRange(_Strict):
    min: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    max: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _ordered(self) -> ProtocolRange:
        if self.min is not None and self.max is not None and self.min > self.max:
            raise ValueError("client_protocol.min must not exceed max")
        return self


class BrandFilter(_Strict):
    include: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=MAX_LIST_ITEMS)
    exclude: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=MAX_LIST_ITEMS)


class DateRange(_Strict):
    """Inclusive UTC calendar dates of the session start."""

    start: date | None = None
    end: date | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _ordered(self) -> DateRange:
        if self.start is not None and self.end is not None and self.start > self.end:
            raise ValueError("date_range.start must not be after end")
        return self


class LabelFilter(_Strict):
    value: Literal["legit", "cheat", "labeled", "unlabeled"]
    min_confidence: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)


class PoolFilter(_Strict):
    game_contexts: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=MAX_LIST_ITEMS)
    backend_servers: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=MAX_LIST_ITEMS)
    client_protocol: ProtocolRange = Field(default_factory=ProtocolRange)
    client_brand: BrandFilter = Field(default_factory=BrandFilter)
    date_range: DateRange = Field(default_factory=DateRange)
    label: LabelFilter | None = None
    min_session_duration_s: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    max_drop_rate: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=1)
    exclude_orphans: bool = True
    # Informational for retention jobs; it does not influence which sessions are selected.
    retention_days: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=3650)


class PoolIn(_Strict):
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=2000)
    filter: PoolFilter = Field(default_factory=PoolFilter)
    # NFR-018: how long raw payloads of the pool's sessions are kept (the upper limit is a setting
    # and is checked by the endpoint). null: the deployment default.
    raw_retention_days: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PoolQuery:
    """Two selections sharing one parameter dict: matching sessions and matching segments."""

    sessions_sql: str
    segments_sql: str
    params: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


# Labels that apply to session ``s``: directly, or through its pseudonym, valid at the session start.
LABEL_MATCH = (
    "(l.session_id = s.session_id OR l.pseudonym = s.pseudonym)"
    " AND (l.valid_from IS NULL OR l.valid_from <= s.started_at)"
    " AND (l.valid_to IS NULL OR l.valid_to > s.started_at)"
)

_DROPS = "(s.dropped_queue_full + s.dropped_privacy + s.dropped_transport)"
_EST_FRAMES = (
    "(SELECT coalesce(sum(f.row_count::float8 / n.cnt), 0)"
    " FROM corvus.lake_file_sessions x"
    " JOIN corvus.lake_files f ON f.id = x.file_id AND f.table_name = 'events' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL"
    " JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM corvus.lake_file_sessions y"
    " WHERE y.file_id = x.file_id) n ON true"
    " WHERE x.session_id = s.session_id)"
)


def _utc_start(d: date) -> datetime:
    return datetime.combine(d, time.min, tzinfo=UTC)


def build_pool_query(f: PoolFilter) -> PoolQuery:
    params: dict[str, Any] = {}

    seg: list[str] = []
    if f.game_contexts:
        seg.append("g.game_context = ANY(%(game_contexts)s)")
        params["game_contexts"] = list(f.game_contexts)
    if f.backend_servers:
        seg.append("g.backend_server = ANY(%(backend_servers)s)")
        params["backend_servers"] = list(f.backend_servers)
    if f.client_brand.include:
        seg.append("g.client_brand = ANY(%(brand_include)s)")
        params["brand_include"] = list(f.client_brand.include)
    if f.client_brand.exclude:
        seg.append("NOT (g.client_brand = ANY(%(brand_exclude)s))")
        params["brand_exclude"] = list(f.client_brand.exclude)

    # Never select data of erased players.
    where = [
        "(s.pseudonym IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM corvus.players p"
        " WHERE p.pseudonym = s.pseudonym AND p.erased_at IS NOT NULL))"
    ]
    if f.exclude_orphans:
        where.append("s.orphan = false")
    if seg:
        where.append(
            "EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM corvus.segments g WHERE g.session_id = s.session_id AND "
            + " AND ".join(seg)
            + ")"
        )
    if f.client_protocol.min is not None:
        where.append("s.client_protocol >= %(protocol_min)s")
        params["protocol_min"] = f.client_protocol.min
    if f.client_protocol.max is not None:
        where.append("s.client_protocol <= %(protocol_max)s")
        params["protocol_max"] = f.client_protocol.max
    if f.date_range.start is not None:
        where.append("s.started_at >= %(date_start)s")
        params["date_start"] = _utc_start(f.date_range.start)
    if f.date_range.end is not None:
        where.append("s.started_at < %(date_end)s")
        params["date_end"] = _utc_start(f.date_range.end + timedelta(days=1))
    if f.min_session_duration_s is not None:
        where.append(
            "s.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND s.ended_at - s.started_at >= make_interval(secs => %(min_duration_s)s)"
        )
        params["min_duration_s"] = f.min_session_duration_s
    if f.max_drop_rate is not None:
        where.append(
            f"({_DROPS} = 0 OR {_DROPS}::float8 / ({_DROPS} + {_EST_FRAMES}) <= %(max_drop_rate)s)"
        )
        params["max_drop_rate"] = f.max_drop_rate
    if f.label is not None:
        where.append(_label_condition(f.label, params))

    sessions_sql = "SELECT s.session_id FROM corvus.sessions s WHERE " + " AND ".join(where)
    seg_where = " AND ".join(["g.session_id IN (" + sessions_sql + ")", *seg])
    segments_sql = "SELECT g.session_id, g.segment FROM corvus.segments g WHERE " + seg_where
    return PoolQuery(sessions_sql, segments_sql, params)


def _label_condition(lf: LabelFilter, params: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    base = f"SELECT 1 FROM corvus.labels l WHERE {LABEL_MATCH}"
    if lf.value == "unlabeled":
        return f"NOT EXISTS ({base})"
    if lf.value == "labeled":
        params["label_min_confidence"] = lf.min_confidence
        return f"EXISTS ({base} AND l.confidence >= %(label_min_confidence)s)"
    params["label_value"] = lf.value
    params["label_min_confidence"] = lf.min_confidence
    return f"EXISTS ({base} AND l.label = %(label_value)s AND l.confidence >= %(label_min_confidence)s)"


def preview_statements(q: PoolQuery) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Aggregate statements for ``POST /pools/{id}/preview``; all share ``q.params``."""
    return {
        "sessions": f"SELECT count(*) FROM ({q.sessions_sql}) q",
        "segments": f"SELECT count(*) FROM ({q.segments_sql}) q",
        "players": (
            "SELECT count(DISTINCT s.pseudonym) FROM corvus.sessions s"
            f" WHERE s.session_id IN ({q.sessions_sql})"
        ),
        "labels": (
            "SELECT coalesce(l.label, 'unlabeled') AS label, count(*)"
            " FROM corvus.sessions s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ("
            f"SELECT l.label FROM corvus.labels l WHERE {LABEL_MATCH}"
            " ORDER BY l.confidence DESC, l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true"
            f" WHERE s.session_id IN ({q.sessions_sql}) GROUP BY 1"
        ),
        "files": (
            "WITH sel AS (SELECT lfs.file_id, count(*) AS n FROM corvus.lake_file_sessions lfs"
            f" WHERE lfs.session_id IN ({q.sessions_sql}) GROUP BY lfs.file_id),"
            " tot AS (SELECT lfs.file_id, count(*) AS n FROM corvus.lake_file_sessions lfs"
            " WHERE lfs.file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM sel) GROUP BY lfs.file_id)"
            " SELECT f.row_count, tot.n, sel.n FROM corvus.lake_files f"
            " JOIN sel ON sel.file_id = f.id JOIN tot ON tot.file_id = f.id"
            " WHERE f.table_name = 'events' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL"
        ),
    }


def snapshot_statements(q: PoolQuery) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Selections that materialise a snapshot (run in one repeatable-read transaction)."""
    return {
        "sessions": f"{q.sessions_sql} ORDER BY 1",
        "files": (
            "SELECT f.id, f.s3_key FROM corvus.lake_files f"
            " WHERE f.table_name = 'events' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.id IN ("
            "SELECT lfs.file_id FROM corvus.lake_file_sessions lfs"
            f" WHERE lfs.session_id IN ({q.sessions_sql})) ORDER BY f.id"
        ),
    }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FileShare:
    """One ``events`` file: its rows, the sessions it holds and how many of them are selected."""

    row_count: int
    total_sessions: int
    selected_sessions: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RawPreview:
    sessions: int
    segments: int
    players: int
    labels: dict[str, int]
    files: list[FileShare]


class PreviewOut(BaseModel):
    sessions: int
    segments: int
    distinct_players: int
    events_files: int
    total_frames_estimate: int = Field(
        description="Approximation: each file's row count weighted by the share of its sessions that are selected."
    )
    label_distribution: dict[str, int]


def compute_preview(raw: RawPreview) -> PreviewOut:
    frames = 0.0
    for f in raw.files:
        if f.total_sessions > 0:
            frames += f.row_count * min(f.selected_sessions, f.total_sessions) / f.total_sessions
    dist = {"legit": 0, "cheat": 0, "unlabeled": 0}
    dist.update(raw.labels)
    return PreviewOut(
        sessions=raw.sessions,
        segments=raw.segments,
        distinct_players=raw.players,
        events_files=len(raw.files),
        total_frames_estimate=round(frames),
        label_distribution=dist,
    )
```

```py
class DuplicateError(Exception):
    """A unique constraint is violated."""

    """The row changed since it was read (optimistic concurrency)."""
```

`services/src/corvus_services/api/problems.py`:

```py
"""RFC 9457 problem details (``application/problem+json``).

Validation errors never echo the offending input: it may contain clear player UUIDs, tokens or notes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException

log = logging.getLogger("corvus.api")

PROBLEM_JSON = "application/problem+json"
_TYPE_BASE = "https://docs.onelitefeather.net/corvus/problems/"

_TITLES = {
    400: "Bad request",
    401: "Unauthorized",
    403: "Forbidden",
    404: "Not found",
    405: "Method not allowed",
    409: "Conflict",
    413: "Payload too large",
    422: "Unprocessable content",
    500: "Internal server error",
    503: "Service unavailable",
}


class ProblemError(Exception):
    """Raise anywhere in a request to produce a problem response."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        status: int,
        detail: str,
        *,
        slug: str | None = None,
        headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        **extensions: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(detail)
        self.status = status
        self.detail = detail
        self.slug = slug
        self.headers = headers
        self.extensions = extensions


def problem_body(
    status: int, detail: str, slug: str | None = None, instance: str | None = None, **ext: Any
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body: dict[str, Any] = {
        "type": _TYPE_BASE + slug if slug else "about:blank",
        "title": _TITLES.get(status, "Error"),
        "status": status,
        "detail": detail,
    }
    if instance:
        body["instance"] = instance
    body.update(ext)
    return body


def _response(
    status: int, body: dict[str, Any], headers: dict[str, str] | None = None
) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse(body, status_code=status, media_type=PROBLEM_JSON, headers=headers)


def install_problem_handlers(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    @app.exception_handler(ProblemError)
    async def _problem(request: Request, exc: ProblemError) -> JSONResponse:
        body = problem_body(exc.status, exc.detail, exc.slug, request.url.path, **exc.extensions)
        return _response(exc.status, body, exc.headers)

    @app.exception_handler(StarletteHTTPException)
    async def _http(request: Request, exc: StarletteHTTPException) -> JSONResponse:
        detail = exc.detail if isinstance(exc.detail, str) else "request failed"
        body = problem_body(exc.status_code, detail, None, request.url.path)
        return _response(exc.status_code, body, dict(exc.headers) if exc.headers else None)

    @app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError)
    async def _validation(request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError) -> JSONResponse:
        errors = [
            {
                "loc": [str(p) for p in e.get("loc", ())],
                "msg": str(e.get("msg", "invalid")),
                "type": str(e.get("type", "")),
            }
            for e in exc.errors()
        ]
        body = problem_body(
            422, "request validation failed", "validation", request.url.path, errors=errors
        )
        return _response(422, body)

    @app.exception_handler(Exception)
    async def _unhandled(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> JSONResponse:
        # Log the type only: messages of driver errors can contain parameter values.
        log.error("unhandled %s on %s %s", type(exc).__name__, request.method, request.url.path)
        body = problem_body(500, "internal error", None, request.url.path)
        return _response(500, body)

```

`services/src/corvus_services/api/pseudonym.py`:

```py
"""Player pseudonyms, bit-for-bit identical to the plugin.

Mirrors ``Pseudonymizer.java``: ``HMAC-SHA-256(key, uuid as 16 big-endian bytes)`` where the key is the
base64-decoded ``CORVUS_PSEUDONYM_KEY``. The test vector is in docs/reference/pseudonym-test-vector.md.
Clear UUIDs live only in request memory; they are never stored or logged.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import uuid

PSEUDONYM_BYTES = 32


class PseudonymKeyMissingError(Exception):
    """No pseudonym key is configured, so UUIDs cannot be resolved."""


class Pseudonymizer:
    def __init__(self, key: bytes | None, key_id: str) -> None:
        self._key = key
        self.key_id = key_id

    @property
    def available(self) -> bool:
        return self._key is not None

    def pseudonym(self, player: uuid.UUID) -> bytes:
        if self._key is None:
            raise PseudonymKeyMissingError("CORVUS_PSEUDONYM_KEY is not configured")
        return hmac.new(self._key, player.bytes, hashlib.sha256).digest()


def parse_pseudonym(value: str) -> bytes:
    """Hex form (64 chars, any case) to bytes."""
    if len(value) != PSEUDONYM_BYTES * 2:
        raise ValueError("pseudonym must be 64 hex characters")
    try:
        return bytes.fromhex(value)
    except ValueError as e:
        raise ValueError("pseudonym must be hexadecimal") from e
```

`services/src/corvus_services/api/queries.py`:

```py
"""Constant SQL fragments of the control-plane adapters that are worth testing without a database.

Everything here is pure: statements are constants, filters become named parameters, identifiers
never come from callers.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from .ports import ModelFilter


def list_sql(
    select_sql: str,
    conds: list[str],
    *,
    id_col: str,
    id_param_sql: str,
    time_col: str = "created_at",
    with_cursor: bool = False,
) -> str:
    """Keyset page, newest first. ``select_sql`` ends before WHERE; all parts are constants."""
    all_conds = list(conds)
    if with_cursor:
        all_conds.append(f"({time_col}, {id_col}) < (%(cursor_at)s, {id_param_sql})")
    sql = select_sql
    if all_conds:
        sql += " WHERE " + " AND ".join(all_conds)
    return sql + f" ORDER BY {time_col} DESC, {id_col} DESC LIMIT %(limit)s"


_MODEL_FILTER_ATTRS = ("name", "version", "game_context", "domain", "stage")


def model_conditions(flt: ModelFilter) -> tuple[list[str], dict[str, Any]]:
    where: list[str] = []
    params: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for attr in _MODEL_FILTER_ATTRS:
        value = getattr(flt, attr)
        if value is not None:
            where.append(f"{attr} = %(f_{attr})s")
            params[f"f_{attr}"] = value
    return where, params


# --- summary ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SUMMARY_COUNTS: dict[str, str] = {
    "pools": "SELECT count(*) FROM corvus.pools",
    "snapshots": "SELECT count(*) FROM corvus.dataset_snapshots",
    "pending_erasures": "SELECT count(*) FROM corvus.erasure_requests WHERE compaction_pending",
}

SUMMARY_GROUPS: dict[str, str] = {
    "jobs_by_status": "SELECT status, count(*) FROM corvus.jobs GROUP BY status",
    "models_by_stage": "SELECT stage, count(*) FROM corvus.models GROUP BY stage",
    "labels_by_label": "SELECT label, count(*) FROM corvus.labels GROUP BY label",
}

SUMMARY_RECENT_JOBS = (
    "SELECT id, type, status, snapshot_id, created_at, updated_at, finished_at"
    " FROM corvus.jobs ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT %s"
)

SUMMARY_RECENT_ERASURES = (
    "SELECT id, pseudonym, requested_at, status, compaction_pending"
    " FROM corvus.erasure_requests ORDER BY requested_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT %s"
)

# --- erasure and jobs ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DELETE_SCORES_LATEST = "DELETE FROM corvus.scores_latest WHERE pseudonym = %s"
DELETE_SCORE_HISTORY = "DELETE FROM corvus.score_history WHERE pseudonym = %s"

UPDATE_JOB = (
    "UPDATE corvus.jobs SET status = %s, runner_ref = COALESCE(%s, runner_ref),"
    " message = %s, updated_at = %s,"
    " finished_at = CASE WHEN %s THEN %s ELSE finished_at END,"
    " result = COALESCE(%s, result)"
)
```

`services/src/corvus_services/api/registry.py`:

```py
"""Model registry: stage machine, promotion quality gate and the transition use case."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from .ports import ModelRecord, ModelRepo, TransitionRecord

RECALL_METRIC = "recall_at_fpr_0_1pct"
LATENCY_METRIC = "p99_latency_ms"


class Stage(StrEnum):
    REGISTERED = "registered"
    SHADOW = "shadow"
    CANARY = "canary"
    ENFORCE = "enforce"
    ARCHIVED = "archived"


_FORWARD = {
    Stage.REGISTERED: Stage.SHADOW,
    Stage.SHADOW: Stage.CANARY,
    Stage.CANARY: Stage.ENFORCE,
}


def is_allowed_transition(current: Stage, target: Stage) -> bool:
    """registered -> shadow -> canary -> enforce; any non-archived stage -> archived."""
    if current == Stage.ARCHIVED:
        return False
    return target == Stage.ARCHIVED or _FORWARD.get(current) == target


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GateResult:
    passed: bool
    reasons: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    details: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


def _number(metrics: dict[str, Any], name: str) -> float | None:
    v = metrics.get(name)
    return float(v) if isinstance(v, int | float) and not isinstance(v, bool) else None


def evaluate_gate(
    candidate: ModelRecord, incumbents: list[ModelRecord], max_p99_latency_ms: float
) -> GateResult:
    """Promotion to ``enforce``.

    - ``p99_latency_ms`` must be below the configured limit.
    - ``recall_at_fpr_0_1pct`` must be at least that of every model currently enforced on the same
      snapshot and game context (no incumbent: no recall comparison).
    """
    reasons: list[str] = []
    details: dict[str, Any] = {"max_p99_latency_ms": max_p99_latency_ms}

    p99 = _number(candidate.metrics, LATENCY_METRIC)
    details[LATENCY_METRIC] = p99
    if p99 is None:
        reasons.append(f"metric {LATENCY_METRIC} is missing")
    elif p99 >= max_p99_latency_ms:
        reasons.append(f"{LATENCY_METRIC} {p99} must be below {max_p99_latency_ms}")

    recall = _number(candidate.metrics, RECALL_METRIC)
    details[RECALL_METRIC] = recall
    if incumbents and recall is None:
        reasons.append(f"metric {RECALL_METRIC} is missing")
    for inc in incumbents:
        base = _number(inc.metrics, RECALL_METRIC)
        details["incumbent"] = {"id": str(inc.id), RECALL_METRIC: base}
        if base is None:
            reasons.append(f"current enforce model {inc.id} has no {RECALL_METRIC} to compare with")
        elif recall is not None and recall < base:
            reasons.append(f"{RECALL_METRIC} {recall} is below the current enforce model's {base}")
    return GateResult(not reasons, reasons, details)


class TransitionError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str, reasons: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.reasons = reasons or []


class ModelNotFoundError(Exception):
    pass


async def transition_model(
    repo: ModelRepo,
    model_id: UUID,
    target: Stage,
    *,
    actor: str,
    reason: str,
    now: datetime,
    max_p99_latency_ms: float,
    new_id: Callable[[], UUID] = uuid4,
) -> ModelRecord:
    """Validates the transition and the gate, then applies it (and audits it) atomically.

    Promoting to ``enforce`` archives the models it replaces in the same transaction.
    """
    model = await repo.get(model_id)
    if model is None:
        raise ModelNotFoundError(str(model_id))
    current = Stage(model.stage)
    if not is_allowed_transition(current, target):
        raise TransitionError(f"transition {current.value} -> {target.value} is not allowed")

    gate: GateResult | None = None
    incumbents: list[ModelRecord] = []
    if target == Stage.ENFORCE:
        incumbents = await repo.enforced_in_scope(model.snapshot_id, model.game_context, model.id)
        gate = evaluate_gate(model, incumbents, max_p99_latency_ms)
        if not gate.passed:
            raise TransitionError("quality gate failed", gate.reasons)

    gate_json = (
        {"passed": gate.passed, "reasons": gate.reasons, **gate.details}
        if gate is not None
        else None
    )
    transitions = [
        TransitionRecord(
            new_id(), model.id, current.value, target.value, actor, reason, gate_json, now
        )
    ]
    transitions += [
        TransitionRecord(
            new_id(),
            inc.id,
            inc.stage,
            Stage.ARCHIVED.value,
            actor,
            f"replaced by model {model.id}",
            None,
            now,
        )
        for inc in incumbents
    ]
    return await repo.apply_transition(model.id, current.value, transitions)

```

`services/src/corvus_services/api/routes/artifacts.py`:

```py
"""Derived artefacts of a snapshot: prefixes a job wrote below the lake bucket.

Tokenised raw-byte features contain payload content and are personal data derived from ``raw``.
Jobs register every prefix they write here, so erasure (``corvus-compact``) and retention
(``corvus-housekeeping``) can find and delete it. Unregistered output is invisible to both.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Header, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from ..auth import JOB_ID_HEADER, Principal, Role, enforce_job_scope, require
from ..deps import Deps, get_deps
from ..ports import ArtifactRecord, JobRecord, StaleBuildError
from ..problems import ProblemError

router = APIRouter(tags=["artifacts"])
_DS_OR_JOB = Depends(require(Role.DATA_SCIENTIST, allow_jobs=True))

KIND = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,39}$")
_PREFIX_CHARS = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9._=/-]+$")
PREFIX_ROOTS = ("features", "tokenizers")


def check_prefix(prefix: str, snapshot_id: UUID) -> str | None:
    """None if ``prefix`` is acceptable, else the reason. A prefix must lie below
    ``features/<snapshot_id>/`` or ``tokenizers/<snapshot_id>/`` and end with ``/``: housekeeping
    deletes everything below a registered prefix, so it must never reach other data."""
    if not prefix.endswith("/") or not _PREFIX_CHARS.match(prefix):
        return "s3_prefix must end with / and use only letters, digits and . _ = / -"
    if "//" in prefix or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in prefix[:-1].split("/")):
        return "s3_prefix must not contain empty, . or .. segments"
    if not any(prefix.startswith(f"{root}/{snapshot_id}/") for root in PREFIX_ROOTS):
        return f"s3_prefix must start with features/{snapshot_id}/ or tokenizers/{snapshot_id}/"
    return None


class ArtifactIn(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    kind: str = Field(
        description="Lower-case identifier, e.g. `raw_features`, `aggregate_features`, `tokenizer`"
    )
    s3_prefix: str = Field(
        max_length=512,
        description="Below `features/<snapshot_id>/` or `tokenizers/<snapshot_id>/`, ends with `/`",
    )
    contains_raw: bool = Field(
        description="The prefix holds tokenised payload content (derived from `raw`)"
    )
    job_id: UUID | None = Field(
        default=None, description="The job that wrote it; a job token sends the header instead"
    )


class ArtifactOut(BaseModel):
    id: UUID
    snapshot_id: UUID
    job_id: UUID | None
    kind: str
    s3_prefix: str
    contains_raw: bool
    created_at: datetime

    @classmethod
    def of(cls, a: ArtifactRecord) -> ArtifactOut:
        return cls(
            id=a.id, snapshot_id=a.snapshot_id, job_id=a.job_id, kind=a.kind,
            s3_prefix=a.s3_prefix, contains_raw=a.contains_raw, created_at=a.created_at,
        )  # fmt: skip


class ArtifactsOut(BaseModel):
    items: list[ArtifactOut]


_RESPONSES: dict[int | str, dict[str, Any]] = {
    200: {"description": "Already registered: the row was updated (idempotent)"},
    403: {"description": f"A job token needs `{JOB_ID_HEADER}` of a job of this snapshot"},
    404: {"description": "Snapshot or job not found"},
    409: {
        "description": (
            "The job started before an erasure invalidated the snapshot's raw-derived artefacts: "
            "delete the prefix and rebuild with a new job"
        )
    },
}


async def _job_for(
    deps: Deps, who: Principal, snapshot_id: UUID, job_id: UUID | None, header: str | None
) -> JobRecord | None:
    if who.is_job:
        try:
            declared = UUID(header) if header else None
        except ValueError:
            declared = None
        if declared is None or (job_id is not None and job_id != declared):
            raise ProblemError(
                403, f"job tokens must send {JOB_ID_HEADER} with their own job id", slug="forbidden"
            )
        enforce_job_scope(who, declared, header)
        job_id = declared
    if job_id is None:
        return None
    job = await deps.repos.jobs.get(job_id)
    if job is None:
        raise ProblemError(404, "job not found", slug="not-found")
    if job.snapshot_id != snapshot_id:
        if who.is_job:
            raise ProblemError(403, "the job belongs to another snapshot", slug="forbidden")
        raise ProblemError(422, "the job belongs to another snapshot", slug="validation")
    return job


async def _register(
    deps: Deps, snapshot_id: UUID, body: ArtifactIn, job: JobRecord | None, response: Response
) -> ArtifactOut:
    if await deps.repos.snapshots.get(snapshot_id) is None:
        raise ProblemError(404, "snapshot not found", slug="not-found")
    if not KIND.match(body.kind):
        raise ProblemError(
            422, "kind must be lower case letters, digits and _ (at most 40)", slug="validation"
        )
    problem = check_prefix(body.s3_prefix, snapshot_id)
    if problem is not None:
        raise ProblemError(422, problem, slug="validation")
    record = ArtifactRecord(
        deps.new_id(), snapshot_id, job.id if job else None, body.kind, body.s3_prefix,
        body.contains_raw, deps.clock(),
    )  # fmt: skip
    try:
        stored, created = await deps.repos.snapshots.register_artifact(
            record, job.created_at if job else None
        )
    except StaleBuildError as e:
        raise ProblemError(
            409,
            "an erasure invalidated this snapshot's raw-derived artefacts after the job started; "
            "delete the prefix and rebuild with a new job",
            slug="conflict",
        ) from e
    response.status_code = 201 if created else 200
    return ArtifactOut.of(stored)


@router.post(
    "/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/artifacts",
    status_code=201,
    response_model=ArtifactOut,
    responses=_RESPONSES,
    summary="Register a prefix a job wrote for a snapshot (idempotent per snapshot and prefix)",
)
async def register_snapshot_artifact(
    snapshot_id: UUID,
    body: ArtifactIn,
    response: Response,
    who: Principal = _DS_OR_JOB,
    job_header: str | None = Header(default=None, alias=JOB_ID_HEADER),
    deps: Deps = Depends(get_deps),
) -> ArtifactOut:
    job = await _job_for(deps, who, snapshot_id, body.job_id, job_header)
    return await _register(deps, snapshot_id, body, job, response)


@router.post(
    "/jobs/{job_id}/artifacts",
    status_code=201,
    response_model=ArtifactOut,
    responses=_RESPONSES,
    summary="Register a prefix by job id (the snapshot is the job's snapshot)",
)
async def register_job_artifact(
    job_id: UUID,
    body: ArtifactIn,
    response: Response,
    who: Principal = _DS_OR_JOB,
    job_header: str | None = Header(default=None, alias=JOB_ID_HEADER),
    deps: Deps = Depends(get_deps),
) -> ArtifactOut:
    enforce_job_scope(who, job_id, job_header)
    job = await deps.repos.jobs.get(job_id)
    if job is None:
        raise ProblemError(404, "job not found", slug="not-found")
    if body.job_id is not None and body.job_id != job_id:
        raise ProblemError(422, "job_id in the body differs from the path", slug="validation")
    return await _register(deps, job.snapshot_id, body, job, response)


@router.get(
    "/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/artifacts",
    response_model=ArtifactsOut,
    responses={404: {"description": "Snapshot not found"}},
    summary="Live registered artefacts of a snapshot",
)
async def list_snapshot_artifacts(
    snapshot_id: UUID, _: Principal = _DS_OR_JOB, deps: Deps = Depends(get_deps)
) -> ArtifactsOut:
    if await deps.repos.snapshots.get(snapshot_id) is None:
        raise ProblemError(404, "snapshot not found", slug="not-found")
    items = await deps.repos.snapshots.list_artifacts(snapshot_id)
    return ArtifactsOut(items=[ArtifactOut.of(a) for a in items])
```

```py
"""Jobs (role: data_scientist)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Header, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator

from ..auth import JOB_ID_HEADER, Principal, Role, enforce_job_scope, require
from ..deps import Deps, get_deps, get_page
from ..jobs import (
    REPORTABLE,
    JobFinishedError,
    JobState,
    JobType,
    SnapshotMissingError,
    create_job,
    refresh_job,
    report_job,
)
from ..pagination import PageRequest
from ..problems import ProblemError
from ..schemas import JobOut, Paged

router = APIRouter(tags=["jobs"])
_DS = Depends(require(Role.DATA_SCIENTIST))
_DS_OR_JOB = Depends(require(Role.DATA_SCIENTIST, allow_jobs=True))
MAX_PARAMS_BYTES = 16 * 1024
MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS = 2000


class JobIn(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    type: JobType
    snapshot_id: UUID
    params: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Passed to the job as JSON (CORVUS_JOB_PARAMS); must not contain secrets",
    )

    @field_validator("params")
    @classmethod
    def _small(cls, v: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if len(json.dumps(v)) > MAX_PARAMS_BYTES:
            raise ValueError(f"params exceed {MAX_PARAMS_BYTES} bytes")
        return v


class JobReportIn(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    status: JobState
    message: str = Field(default="", max_length=MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS)
    result: dict[str, Any] | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Result document (metrics, artefact keys); must not contain secrets",
    )

    @field_validator("status")
    @classmethod
    def _reportable(cls, v: JobState) -> JobState:
        if v not in REPORTABLE:
            raise ValueError("status must be one of running, succeeded, failed")
        return v

    @field_validator("result")
    @classmethod
    def _small(cls, v: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if v is not None and len(json.dumps(v)) > MAX_PARAMS_BYTES:
            raise ValueError(f"result exceeds {MAX_PARAMS_BYTES} bytes")
        return v


@router.post(
    "/jobs",
    status_code=202,
    response_model=JobOut,
    responses={422: {"description": "Unknown snapshot or invalid parameters"}},
    summary="Submit a job",
)
async def submit_job(body: JobIn, who: Principal = _DS, deps: Deps = Depends(get_deps)) -> JobOut:
    try:
        job = await create_job(
            deps.repos.jobs,
            deps.repos.snapshots,
            deps.runner,
            job_type=body.type,
            snapshot_id=body.snapshot_id,
            params=body.params,
            actor=who.subject,
            now=deps.clock(),
            new_id=deps.new_id,
        )
    except SnapshotMissingError as e:
        raise ProblemError(422, "snapshot does not exist", slug="validation") from e
    deps.metrics.jobs.labels(body.type.value, deps.runner.name).inc()
    return JobOut.of(job)


@router.get("/jobs", response_model=Paged[JobOut], summary="List jobs, newest first")
async def list_jobs(
    status: JobState | None = Query(default=None),
    _: Principal = _DS,
    page: PageRequest = Depends(get_page),
    deps: Deps = Depends(get_deps),
) -> Paged[JobOut]:
    result = await deps.repos.jobs.list_page(page, status.value if status else None)
    return Paged[JobOut](items=[JobOut.of(j) for j in result.items], next_cursor=result.next_cursor)


@router.get(
    "/jobs/{job_id}",
    response_model=JobOut,
    responses={404: {"description": "Job not found"}},
    summary="Get a job; a running job's status is refreshed from the runner",
)
async def get_job(
    job_id: UUID,
    who: Principal = _DS_OR_JOB,
    job_header: str | None = Header(default=None, alias=JOB_ID_HEADER),
    deps: Deps = Depends(get_deps),
) -> JobOut:
    enforce_job_scope(who, job_id, job_header)
    job = await deps.repos.jobs.get(job_id)
    if job is None:
        raise ProblemError(404, "job not found", slug="not-found")
    return JobOut.of(await refresh_job(deps.repos.jobs, deps.runner, job, deps.clock()))


@router.patch(
    "/jobs/{job_id}",
    response_model=JobOut,
    responses={
        403: {"description": f"A job token needs `{JOB_ID_HEADER}` equal to the path id"},
        404: {"description": "Job not found"},
        409: {"description": "The job already finished with a different status"},
    },
    summary="Report status, message and result of a job",
    description=(
        "Called by the job process with its machine token (`CORVUS_API_URL`, `CORVUS_API_TOKEN`). "
        f"A job token may only update its own job: the header `{JOB_ID_HEADER}` (the job's "
        "`CORVUS_JOB_ID`) must equal the id in the path. `succeeded` and `failed` are final; "
        "repeating the identical report is accepted."
    ),
)
async def report_job_status(
    job_id: UUID,
    body: JobReportIn,
    who: Principal = _DS_OR_JOB,
    job_header: str | None = Header(default=None, alias=JOB_ID_HEADER),
    deps: Deps = Depends(get_deps),
) -> JobOut:
    enforce_job_scope(who, job_id, job_header)
    job = await deps.repos.jobs.get(job_id)
    if job is None:
        raise ProblemError(404, "job not found", slug="not-found")
    try:
        updated = await report_job(
            deps.repos.jobs,
            job,
            status=body.status,
            message=body.message,
            result=body.result,
            now=deps.clock(),
        )
    except JobFinishedError as e:
        raise ProblemError(409, f"the job already finished as {e}", slug="conflict") from e
    return JobOut.of(updated)
```
