`ui/app/components/m3/Combobox.vue`:

```vue
<template>
  <M3FieldFrame :for-id="id" :label="label" :hint="hint" floated>
    <div
      class="peer flex min-h-14 flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xs px-3 pt-4 pb-2"
      @click="focusInput"
    >
      <M3Chip
        v-for="(v, i) in modelValue"
        :key="`${v}-${i}`"
        small
        tone="secondary"
        removable
        :remove-label="`${removeLabel} ${v}`"
        @remove="removeAt(i)"
      >
        {{ v }}
      </M3Chip>
      <input
        :id="id"
        ref="input"
        v-model="draft"
        type="text"
        autocomplete="off"
        :aria-describedby="hint ? `${id}-support` : undefined"
        class="min-w-24 flex-1 bg-transparent py-1 text-body-large text-on-surface outline-none"
        @keydown="onKey"
        @blur="commit"
      >
    </div>
  </M3FieldFrame>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, useId } from 'vue'
import M3Chip from './Chip.vue'
import M3FieldFrame from './FieldFrame.vue'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  modelValue: readonly string[]
  label: string
  hint?: string
  removeLabel?: string
}>(), { hint: '', removeLabel: '' })
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [string[]] }>()

const id = useId()
const input = ref<HTMLInputElement>()
const draft = ref('')

function commit() {
  const v = draft.value.trim()
  draft.value = ''
  if (v && !props.modelValue.includes(v)) emit('update:modelValue', [...props.modelValue, v])
}
function removeAt(i: number) {
  emit('update:modelValue', props.modelValue.filter((_, n) => n !== i))
}
function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ',') {
    e.preventDefault()
    commit()
  }
  else if (e.key === 'Backspace' && !draft.value && props.modelValue.length) {
    removeAt(props.modelValue.length - 1)
  }
}
function focusInput() {
  input.value?.focus()
}
</script>
```

`ui/app/components/m3/DataTable.test.ts`:

```ts
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
import { mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import M3DataTable from './DataTable.vue'
import type { TableLabels } from './table-labels'

const labels: TableLabels = {
  loading: 'Loading', empty: 'Nothing here', select: 'Select row', sortBy: 'Sort by', rowsPerPage: 'Rows per page',
  previous: 'Previous page', next: 'Next page', range: '{from}-{to} of {total}',
}
const columns = [{ key: 'name', title: 'Name' }, { key: 'size', title: 'Size', align: 'end' as const }, { key: 'actions', title: '', sortable: false }]
const items = Array.from({ length: 23 }, (_, i) => ({ id: `r${i}`, name: `n${String(22 - i).padStart(2, '0')}`, size: i }))

const table = (props: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => mount(M3DataTable, { props: { columns, items, labels, ...props } })
const names = (w: ReturnType<typeof table>) => w.findAll('tbody tr').map(r => r.findAll('td')[0]!.text())

describe('M3DataTable', () => {
  it('shows the first page and the range', () => {
    const w = table()
    expect(w.findAll('tbody tr')).toHaveLength(10)
    expect(w.text()).toContain('1-10 of 23')
  })

  it('moves to the next and the previous page', async () => {
    const w = table()
    await w.get('button[aria-label="Next page"]').trigger('click')
    expect(w.text()).toContain('11-20 of 23')
    await w.get('button[aria-label="Previous page"]').trigger('click')
    expect(w.text()).toContain('1-10 of 23')
  })

  it('disables previous on the first page and next on the last', async () => {
    const w = table()
    expect(w.get('button[aria-label="Previous page"]').attributes('disabled')).toBeDefined()
    await w.get('button[aria-label="Next page"]').trigger('click')
    await w.get('button[aria-label="Next page"]').trigger('click')
    expect(w.text()).toContain('21-23 of 23')
    expect(w.get('button[aria-label="Next page"]').attributes('disabled')).toBeDefined()
  })

  it('changes the page size', async () => {
    const w = table()
    await w.get('select').setValue('25')
    expect(w.findAll('tbody tr')).toHaveLength(23)
  })

  it('sorts ascending, then descending, then back to the given order', async () => {
    const w = table({ items: items.slice(0, 3) })
    const sort = w.get('button[aria-label="Sort by Name"]')
    expect(w.findAll('th')[0]!.attributes('aria-sort')).toBe('none')
    await sort.trigger('click')
    expect(names(w)).toEqual(['n20', 'n21', 'n22'])
    expect(w.findAll('th')[0]!.attributes('aria-sort')).toBe('ascending')
    await sort.trigger('click')
    expect(names(w)).toEqual(['n22', 'n21', 'n20'])
    expect(w.findAll('th')[0]!.attributes('aria-sort')).toBe('descending')
    await sort.trigger('click')
    expect(names(w)).toEqual(['n22', 'n21', 'n20'])
    expect(w.findAll('th')[0]!.attributes('aria-sort')).toBe('none')
  })

  it('does not offer sorting for the actions column', () => {
    expect(table().findAll('th')[2]!.attributes('aria-sort')).toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('renders cell slots', () => {
    const w = mount(M3DataTable, { props: { columns, items: items.slice(0, 1), labels }, slots: { 'item.name': '<template #item.name="{ item }">[{{ item.name }}]</template>' } })
    expect(w.get('td').text()).toBe('[n22]')
  })

  it('shows the empty text and no pagination without rows', () => {
    const w = table({ items: [] })
    expect(w.text()).toContain('Nothing here')
    expect(w.find('select').exists()).toBe(false)
  })

  it('selects rows with a checkbox', async () => {
    const w = table({ selectable: true, items: items.slice(0, 3) })
    await w.findAll('tbody input[type=checkbox]')[1]!.setValue(true)
    expect(w.emitted('update:selected')?.[0]).toEqual([[items[1]]])
```

```vue
<template>
  <div class="overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-outline-variant bg-surface">
    <M3Progress v-if="loading" :label="labels.loading" class="!rounded-none" />
    <div class="overflow-x-auto">
      <table class="w-full border-collapse text-body-medium">
        <thead>
          <tr class="bg-surface-container text-on-surface-variant">
            <th v-if="selectable" scope="col" class="w-12 px-2">
              <span class="sr-only">{{ labels.select }}</span>
            </th>
            <th
              v-for="c in columns"
              :key="c.key"
              scope="col"
              :aria-sort="ariaSort(c)"
              :class="['h-12 whitespace-nowrap px-4 text-title-small', c.align === 'end' ? 'text-end' : 'text-start']"
            >
              <button
                v-if="c.sortable !== false && c.title"
                type="button"
                :class="['state-layer -mx-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-sm px-2 py-1', c.align === 'end' ? 'flex-row-reverse' : '']"
                :aria-label="`${labels.sortBy} ${c.title}`"
                @click="toggleSort(c.key)"
              >
                {{ c.title }}
                <M3Icon v-if="sortKey === c.key" :name="sortDesc ? 'mdi-arrow-down' : 'mdi-arrow-up'" :size="16" />
              </button>
              <template v-else>{{ c.title }}</template>
            </th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr v-for="row in pageRows" :key="String(val(row, rowKey))" class="border-t border-outline-variant hover:bg-on-surface/8">
            <td v-if="selectable" class="w-12 px-2">
              <M3Checkbox
                :model-value="isSelected(row)"
                :aria-label="labels.select"
                @update:model-value="toggleRow(row, $event)"
              />
            </td>
            <td v-for="c in columns" :key="c.key" :class="['px-4 py-3 align-middle', c.align === 'end' ? 'text-end' : 'text-start']">
              <slot :name="`item.${c.key}`" :item="row" :value="val(row, c.key)">{{ val(row, c.key) ?? '' }}</slot>
            </td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <M3EmptyState v-if="!items.length && !loading" :title="labels.empty" />
    </div>
    <div
      v-if="items.length > PAGE_SIZES[0]!"
      class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-x-6 gap-y-1 border-t border-outline-variant px-4 py-1 text-body-small text-on-surface-variant"
    >
      <label class="flex items-center gap-2">
        {{ labels.rowsPerPage }}
        <select
          v-model.number="pageSize"
          class="h-8 rounded-xs border border-outline-variant bg-transparent px-1 text-body-small text-on-surface"
        >
          <option v-for="n in PAGE_SIZES" :key="n" :value="n" class="bg-surface-container-high">{{ n }}</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <span aria-live="polite">{{ labels.range.replace('{from}', String(from)).replace('{to}', String(to)).replace('{total}', String(sorted.length)) }}</span>
      <span class="flex">
        <M3IconButton icon="mdi-chevron-left" :label="labels.previous" :disabled="page === 0" @click="page--" />
        <M3IconButton icon="mdi-chevron-right" :label="labels.next" :disabled="to >= sorted.length" @click="page++" />
      </span>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" generic="T extends object">
import { computed, inject, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import M3Checkbox from './Checkbox.vue'
import M3EmptyState from './EmptyState.vue'
import M3Icon from './Icon.vue'
import M3IconButton from './IconButton.vue'
import M3Progress from './Progress.vue'
import { TABLE_LABELS } from './table-labels'
import type { TableLabels } from './table-labels'

export interface Column {
  key: string
  title: string
  align?: 'start' | 'end'
  /** Defaults to true; the actions column sets false. */
  sortable?: boolean
}
const PAGE_SIZES = [10, 25, 50, 100]
const val = (row: object, key: string): unknown => (row as Record<string, unknown>)[key]

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  columns: readonly Column[]
  items: readonly T[]
  rowKey?: string
  loading?: boolean
  labels?: TableLabels
  selectable?: boolean
  selected?: readonly T[]
}>(), { rowKey: 'id', labels: undefined, selected: () => [] })
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:selected': [T[]] }>()

const injected = inject(TABLE_LABELS, undefined)
const labels = computed<TableLabels>(() => {
  const l = props.labels ?? injected?.value
  if (!l) throw new Error('M3DataTable needs labels: pass the labels prop or provide TABLE_LABELS')
  return l
})

const sortKey = ref('')
const sortDesc = ref(false)
const page = ref(0)
const pageSize = ref(PAGE_SIZES[0]!)

function toggleSort(key: string) {
  if (sortKey.value !== key) {
    sortKey.value = key
    sortDesc.value = false
  }
  else if (!sortDesc.value) {
    sortDesc.value = true
  }
  else {
    sortKey.value = ''
    sortDesc.value = false
  }
}
function ariaSort(c: Column): 'ascending' | 'descending' | 'none' | undefined {
  if (c.sortable === false || !c.title) return undefined
  return sortKey.value === c.key ? (sortDesc.value ? 'descending' : 'ascending') : 'none'
}

function compare(a: unknown, b: unknown): number {
  if (a == null && b == null) return 0
  if (a == null) return 1
  if (b == null) return -1
  if (typeof a === 'number' && typeof b === 'number') return a - b
  return String(a).localeCompare(String(b), undefined, { numeric: true })
}
const sorted = computed(() => {
  if (!sortKey.value) return [...props.items]
  const k = sortKey.value
  const dir = sortDesc.value ? -1 : 1
  return [...props.items].sort((x, y) => dir * compare(val(x, k), val(y, k)))
})

const from = computed(() => (sorted.value.length ? page.value * pageSize.value + 1 : 0))
const to = computed(() => Math.min(sorted.value.length, (page.value + 1) * pageSize.value))
const pageRows = computed(() => sorted.value.slice(page.value * pageSize.value, (page.value + 1) * pageSize.value))

// New data or a new page size can leave the current page past the end.
watch([() => props.items, pageSize], () => {
  const last = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(sorted.value.length / pageSize.value) - 1)
  if (page.value > last) page.value = last
})
watch(pageSize, () => (page.value = 0))

const isSelected = (row: T) => props.selected.some(s => val(s, props.rowKey) === val(row, props.rowKey))
function toggleRow(row: T, on: boolean) {
  const rest = props.selected.filter(s => val(s, props.rowKey) !== val(row, props.rowKey))
  emit('update:selected', on ? [...rest, row] : rest)
}
</script>
```

`ui/app/components/m3/Dialog.test.ts`:

```ts
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
import { mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import M3Dialog from './Dialog.vue'

const open = (props: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>
  mount(M3Dialog, {
    props: { modelValue: true, title: 'Add entry', ...props },
    slots: { default: '<input id="first">', actions: '<button>Save</button>' },
    attachTo: document.body,
  })

describe('M3Dialog', () => {
  it('opens as a modal dialog named by its title', async () => {
    const w = open()
    await w.vm.$nextTick()
    const d = w.get('dialog').element as HTMLDialogElement
    expect(d.open).toBe(true)
    expect(w.get('dialog').attributes('aria-modal')).toBe('true')
    expect(document.getElementById(w.get('dialog').attributes('aria-labelledby')!)?.textContent).toBe('Add entry')
    w.unmount()
  })

  it('asks to close on Esc', async () => {
    const w = open()
    await w.vm.$nextTick()
    await w.get('dialog').trigger('cancel')
    expect(w.emitted('update:modelValue')?.[0]).toEqual([false])
    w.unmount()
  })

  it('ignores Esc when persistent', async () => {
    const w = open({ persistent: true })
    await w.vm.$nextTick()
    await w.get('dialog').trigger('cancel')
    expect(w.emitted('update:modelValue')).toBeUndefined()
    w.unmount()
  })

  it('closes on a click on the scrim but not on the content', async () => {
    const w = open()
    await w.vm.$nextTick()
    await w.get('#first').trigger('click')
    expect(w.emitted('update:modelValue')).toBeUndefined()
    await w.get('dialog').trigger('click')
    expect(w.emitted('update:modelValue')?.[0]).toEqual([false])
    w.unmount()
  })

  it('closes the native dialog when the model turns false and reports afterLeave', async () => {
    const w = open()
    await w.vm.$nextTick()
    await w.setProps({ modelValue: false })
    expect((w.get('dialog').element as HTMLDialogElement).open).toBe(false)
    expect(w.emitted('afterLeave')).toBeTruthy()
    w.unmount()
  })

  it('does not render its content before the first open', () => {
    const w = open({ modelValue: false })
    expect(w.find('#first').exists()).toBe(false)
    w.unmount()
  })

  it('announces a destructive confirmation as an alert dialog', () => {
    const w = open({ alert: true })
    expect(w.get('dialog').attributes('role')).toBe('alertdialog')
    w.unmount()
  })
})
```

`ui/app/components/m3/Dialog.vue`:

```vue
<template>
  <dialog
    ref="el"
    :aria-labelledby="titleId"
    :aria-describedby="describedby || undefined"
    aria-modal="true"
    :role="alert ? 'alertdialog' : 'dialog'"
    :class="[
      'm-auto max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] w-[calc(100%-2rem)] flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-surface-container-high p-0',
      'text-on-surface shadow-elevation-3 open:flex backdrop:bg-scrim/32',
      WIDTHS[width],
    ]"
    @cancel.prevent="onCancel"
    @click="onBackdrop"
    @close="onClose"
  >
    <div v-if="rendered" class="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col">
      <h2 :id="titleId" class="px-6 pt-6 pb-4 text-headline-small">{{ title }}</h2>
      <div class="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 pb-2">
        <slot />
      </div>
      <div v-if="$slots.actions" class="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2 px-6 pt-4 pb-6">
        <slot name="actions" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </dialog>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { nextTick, onMounted, ref, useId, watch } from 'vue'

/**
 * Modal dialog on the native <dialog> element: the browser traps focus, marks the rest of the page inert,
 * closes on Esc and returns focus to the opener. `persistent` ignores Esc and a click on the scrim.
 */
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  modelValue: boolean
  title: string
  width?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  persistent?: boolean
  /** Destructive confirmation: announced as an alert dialog. */
  alert?: boolean
  describedby?: string
}>(), { width: 'md', describedby: '' })
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [boolean], 'afterLeave': [] }>()

const WIDTHS = { sm: 'max-w-[28rem]', md: 'max-w-[35rem]', lg: 'max-w-[56rem]' }
const el = ref<HTMLDialogElement>()
const titleId = useId()
// The content is created on first open and kept afterwards, so a closed dialog costs nothing.
const rendered = ref(props.modelValue)

async function sync(open: boolean) {
  const d = el.value
  if (!d) return
  if (open && !d.open) {
    rendered.value = true
    await nextTick()
    d.showModal()
  }
  else if (!open && d.open) {
    d.close()
  }
}

watch(() => props.modelValue, v => void sync(v))
onMounted(() => void sync(props.modelValue))

function onCancel() {
  if (!props.persistent) emit('update:modelValue', false)
}
function onBackdrop(e: MouseEvent) {
  if (e.target === el.value && !props.persistent) emit('update:modelValue', false)
}
function onClose() {
  if (props.modelValue) emit('update:modelValue', false)
  emit('afterLeave')
}
</script>
```

`ui/app/components/m3/IconButton.vue`:

```vue
<template>
  <component
    :is="link ?? 'button'"
    v-bind="$attrs"
    :to="to"
    :type="to ? undefined : 'button'"
    :disabled="!to && disabled ? true : undefined"
    :aria-label="label"
    :aria-pressed="pressed === undefined ? undefined : String(pressed)"
    :class="[
      'state-layer inline-flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full no-underline',

const VARIANTS = {
```

`ui/app/components/m3/Menu.vue`:

```vue
<template>
  <div ref="root" class="relative inline-block" @keydown.esc.stop="close(true)" @focusout="onFocusOut">
    <slot name="activator" :props="activatorProps" :open="open" :toggle="toggle" />
    <div
      v-if="open"
      :id="panelId"
      :role="menu ? 'menu' : 'group'"
      :aria-label="label"
      :class="[
        'absolute top-full z-50 mt-1 min-w-48 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] rounded-xs bg-surface-container text-on-surface shadow-elevation-2',
        align === 'end' ? 'right-0' : 'left-0',
      ]"
      @keydown="onKey"
    >
      <slot :close="() => close(true)" />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, useId } from 'vue'

/**
 * Popup anchored to its activator. With `menu` the panel is a menu (arrow keys move between the
 * role="menuitem" children); otherwise it is a plain popover for arbitrary content. Closes on Esc, outside
 * click and when focus leaves.
 */
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ label: string, align?: 'start' | 'end', menu?: boolean }>(), { align: 'end', menu: true })

const open = ref(false)
const root = ref<HTMLElement>()
const panelId = useId()
const activatorProps = computed(() => ({
  'aria-haspopup': props.menu ? 'menu' : 'dialog',
  'aria-expanded': String(open.value),
  'aria-controls': open.value ? panelId : undefined,
}))

async function toggle() {
  open.value = !open.value
  if (open.value) {
    await nextTick()
    focusables()[0]?.focus()
  }
}
function close(restoreFocus = false) {
  if (!open.value) return
  open.value = false
  if (restoreFocus) root.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[aria-haspopup]')?.focus()
}
function focusables(): HTMLElement[] {
  const panel = root.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[id="${panelId}"]`)
  return panel ? [...panel.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role^="menuitem"],a[href],button:not(:disabled),input,select')] : []
}
function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (!props.menu || (e.key !== 'ArrowDown' && e.key !== 'ArrowUp')) return
  e.preventDefault()
  const items = focusables()
  const i = items.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement)
  items[(i + (e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1) + items.length) % items.length]?.focus()
}
function onFocusOut(e: FocusEvent) {
  const next = e.relatedTarget as Node | null
  if (next && !root.value?.contains(next)) close()
}
function onOutside(e: PointerEvent) {
  if (open.value && !root.value?.contains(e.target as Node)) close()
}
onMounted(() => document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onOutside))
onBeforeUnmount(() => document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onOutside))
</script>

```

`ui/app/components/m3/NavDrawer.test.ts`:

```ts
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
import { mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import M3NavDrawer from './NavDrawer.vue'
import { visibleNav } from '../../lib/nav'
import { can } from '../../lib/roles'
import type { Role } from '../../types'

const NuxtLink = { props: ['to'], template: '<a :href="to"><slot /></a>' }
const entries = (role: Role) => visibleNav(a => can([role], a)).map(i => ({ to: i.to, icon: i.icon, label: i.key }))
const drawer = (role: Role, activePath = '/') =>
  mount(M3NavDrawer, { props: { items: entries(role), activePath, label: 'Main' }, global: { components: { NuxtLink } } })

describe('M3NavDrawer role gating', () => {
  it('shows only the dashboard to a viewer without further rights', () => {
    const labels = drawer('viewer').findAll('a').map(a => a.text())
    expect(labels).toContain('dashboard')
    expect(labels).not.toContain('blocklist')
    expect(labels).not.toContain('players')
  })

  it('shows blocklist and players to an admin', () => {
    const labels = drawer('admin').findAll('a').map(a => a.text())
    expect(labels).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['blocklist', 'players', 'models']))
  })

  it('marks the current page, including nested routes', () => {
    const w = drawer('admin', '/models/gbm/1.0')
    const current = w.findAll('a[aria-current="page"]')
    expect(current.map(a => a.text())).toEqual(['models'])
  })

  it('marks the dashboard only for the root path', () => {
    expect(drawer('admin', '/pools').findAll('a[aria-current="page"]').map(a => a.text())).toEqual(['pools'])
  })

  it('names the navigation landmark', () => {
    expect(drawer('admin').get('nav').attributes('aria-label')).toBe('Main')
  })
})
```

```vue
<template>
  <nav v-if="!modal" :aria-label="label" class="w-72 shrink-0 px-3 py-3">
    <ul class="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <li v-for="item in items" :key="item.to">
        <M3NavItem :item="item" :active="isActive(item.to)" />
      </li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
  <dialog
    v-else
    ref="el"
    :aria-label="label"
    class="fixed inset-y-0 left-0 m-0 h-dvh max-h-none w-[min(20rem,85vw)] flex-col rounded-r-xl bg-surface-container-low p-3 text-on-surface shadow-elevation-3 open:flex backdrop:bg-scrim/32"
    @cancel.prevent="$emit('update:open', false)"
    @click="onBackdrop"
    @close="$emit('update:open', false)"
  >
    <div class="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between px-2">
      <slot name="header" />
      <M3IconButton icon="mdi-close" :label="closeLabel" @click="$emit('update:open', false)" />
    </div>
    <nav :aria-label="label">
      <ul class="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <li v-for="item in items" :key="item.to">
          <M3NavItem :item="item" :active="isActive(item.to)" @click="$emit('update:open', false)" />
        </li>
      </ul>
    </nav>
  </dialog>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { nextTick, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import M3IconButton from './IconButton.vue'
import M3NavItem from './NavItem.vue'
import type { NavEntry } from './types'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  items: readonly NavEntry[]
  /** Current route path; the matching entry is marked with aria-current="page". */
  activePath: string
  label: string
  closeLabel?: string
  /** Modal sheet (small screens) instead of the permanent standard drawer. */
  modal?: boolean
  open?: boolean
}>(), { closeLabel: '', open: false })
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:open': [boolean] }>()

const el = ref<HTMLDialogElement>()

function isActive(to: string): boolean {
  return to === '/' ? props.activePath === '/' : props.activePath === to || props.activePath.startsWith(`${to}/`)
}

function sync(open: boolean) {
  const d = el.value
  if (!d) return
  if (open && !d.open) d.showModal()
  else if (!open && d.open) d.close()
}
watch(() => [props.open, props.modal], async () => {
  await nextTick()
  sync(props.open && !!props.modal)
})
onMounted(() => sync(props.open && !!props.modal))

function onBackdrop(e: MouseEvent) {
  if (e.target === el.value) emit('update:open', false)
}
</script>
```

`ui/app/components/m3/Select.vue`:

```vue
<template>
  <M3FieldFrame :class="$attrs.class as string" :style="$attrs.style as string" :for-id="id" :label="label" :error="error" :hint="hint" :required="required" :disabled="disabled" floated>
    <select
      :id="id"
      v-bind="inputAttrs()"
      :value="modelValue"
      :required="required"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :aria-invalid="error ? 'true' : undefined"
      :aria-describedby="error || hint ? `${id}-support` : undefined"
      class="peer block h-14 w-full appearance-none rounded-xs bg-transparent pr-12 pl-4 text-body-large text-on-surface outline-none"
      @change="onChange"
    >
      <option v-for="o in options" :key="String(o.value)" :value="o.value" class="bg-surface-container-high text-on-surface">
        {{ o.title }}
      </option>
    </select>
    <M3Icon name="mdi-chevron-down" class="pointer-events-none absolute top-4 right-3 text-on-surface-variant" />
  </M3FieldFrame>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" generic="V extends string | number">
import { computed, useAttrs, useId } from 'vue'
import M3FieldFrame from './FieldFrame.vue'
import M3Icon from './Icon.vue'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

// class and style belong to the whole field; every other attribute (autocomplete, min, step, ...) to the control.
const attrs = useAttrs()
// A function, not a computed: the attrs object is not reactive.
function inputAttrs() {
  const { class: _c, style: _s, ...rest } = attrs
  return rest
}

type Item = V | { value: V, title: string }
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  modelValue: V
  items: readonly Item[]
  label: string
  error?: string
  hint?: string
  required?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
}>(), { error: '', hint: '' })
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [V] }>()

const id = useId()
const options = computed(() => props.items.map((i): { value: V, title: string } => (typeof i === 'object' ? i : { value: i, title: String(i) })))

// The native select reports strings; hand back the original typed value (e.g. numeric limits).
function onChange(e: Event) {
  const raw = (e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value
  emit('update:modelValue', options.value.find(o => String(o.value) === raw)?.value ?? (raw as V))
}
</script>
```

`ui/app/components/m3/TextField.test.ts`:

```ts
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
import { mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import M3TextField from './TextField.vue'

const field = (props: Record<string, unknown> = {}, attrs: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>
  mount(M3TextField, { props: { label: 'Name', modelValue: '', ...props }, attrs })

describe('M3TextField', () => {
  it('associates the label with the input', () => {
    const w = field()
    const input = w.get('input')
    expect(w.get('label').attributes('for')).toBe(input.attributes('id'))
    expect(w.get('label').text()).toBe('Name')
  })

  it('marks an error on the input and links the message', () => {
    const w = field({ error: 'Required' })
    const input = w.get('input')
    expect(input.attributes('aria-invalid')).toBe('true')
    expect(w.get(`#${CSS.escape(input.attributes('aria-describedby')!)}`).text()).toBe('Required')
  })

  it('has no aria-invalid without an error', () => {
    expect(field().get('input').attributes('aria-invalid')).toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('emits the typed value', async () => {
    const w = field()
    await w.get('input').setValue('abc')
    expect(w.emitted('update:modelValue')?.[0]).toEqual(['abc'])
  })

  it('emits a number with the number modifier', async () => {
    const w = field({ modelModifiers: { number: true }, type: 'number' })
    await w.get('input').setValue('0.5')
    expect(w.emitted('update:modelValue')?.[0]).toEqual([0.5])
  })

  it('renders a textarea when multiline', () => {
    expect(field({ multiline: true }).find('textarea').exists()).toBe(true)
  })

  it('passes class to the field and other attributes to the control', () => {
    const w = field({}, { class: 'w-40', autocomplete: 'off' })
    expect(w.classes()).toContain('w-40')
    expect(w.get('input').attributes('autocomplete')).toBe('off')
    expect(w.get('input').classes()).not.toContain('w-40')
  })

  it('shows the counter', () => {
    expect(field({ modelValue: 'abcd', counter: 10 }).text()).toContain('4 / 10')
  })
})
```

`ui/app/components/m3/TextField.vue`:

```vue
<template>
  <M3FieldFrame
    :class="$attrs.class as string"
    :style="$attrs.style as string"
    :for-id="id"
    :label="label"
    :error="error"
    :hint="hint"
    :counter="counterText"
    :required="required"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :floated="alwaysFloated"
    :leading="!!leadingIcon"
  >
    <component
      :is="multiline ? 'textarea' : 'input'"
      :id="id"
      v-bind="inputAttrs()"
      :value="modelValue ?? ''"
      :type="multiline ? undefined : type"
      :rows="multiline ? rows : undefined"
      :required="required"
      :disabled="disabled"
      placeholder=" "
      :aria-invalid="error ? 'true' : undefined"
      :aria-describedby="error || hint || counterText ? `${id}-support` : undefined"
      :class="[
        'peer block w-full rounded-xs bg-transparent text-body-large text-on-surface outline-none',
        multiline ? 'min-h-14 resize-y px-4 py-4' : 'h-14 px-4',
        leadingIcon ? 'pl-12' : '',
        clearable ? 'pr-12' : '',
        disabled ? 'text-on-surface/38' : '',
        inputClass,
      ]"
      @input="onInput"
    />
    <M3Icon v-if="leadingIcon" :name="leadingIcon" class="pointer-events-none absolute top-4 left-3 text-on-surface-variant" />
    <M3IconButton
      v-if="clearable && modelValue !== '' && modelValue != null && !disabled"
      icon="mdi-close"
      :label="clearLabel"
      :size="18"
      class="absolute top-2 right-2"
      @click="clear"
    />
  </M3FieldFrame>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs, useId } from 'vue'
import M3FieldFrame from './FieldFrame.vue'
import M3Icon from './Icon.vue'
import M3IconButton from './IconButton.vue'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

// class and style belong to the whole field; every other attribute (autocomplete, min, step, ...) to the control.
const attrs = useAttrs()
// A function, not a computed: the attrs object is not reactive.
function inputAttrs() {
  const { class: _c, style: _s, ...rest } = attrs
  return rest
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  modelValue?: string | number | null
  modelModifiers?: { number?: boolean, trim?: boolean }
  label: string
  type?: string
  multiline?: boolean
  rows?: number
  error?: string
  hint?: string
  /** Maximum length; shows a "n / max" counter. */
  counter?: number
  required?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  clearable?: boolean
  clearLabel?: string
  leadingIcon?: string
  inputClass?: string
}>(), {
  modelValue: '', modelModifiers: () => ({}), type: 'text', rows: 3, error: '', hint: '', counter: undefined,
  clearLabel: '', leadingIcon: undefined, inputClass: '',
})
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [string | number] }>()

const id = useId()
// Date and time inputs show a format placeholder, so their label never rests inside the box.
const alwaysFloated = computed(() => ['date', 'datetime-local', 'time', 'month', 'week'].includes(props.type))
const counterText = computed(() => (props.counter ? `${String(props.modelValue ?? '').length} / ${props.counter}` : ''))

function onInput(e: Event) {
  let v: string | number = (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value
  if (props.modelModifiers.trim) v = v.trim()
  if (props.modelModifiers.number) {
    const n = Number.parseFloat(v)
    if (!Number.isNaN(n)) v = n
  }
  emit('update:modelValue', v)
}

function clear(e: Event) {
  emit('update:modelValue', '')
  const input = (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).parentElement?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('input,textarea')
  input?.focus()
}
</script>
```

`ui/app/composables/useAction.ts`:

```ts
import { ref } from 'vue'

/** Wraps a mutating call with pending and error state. Errors are kept in `error` for display; `run` then resolves to undefined. */
export function useAction<A extends unknown[], R>(fn: (...args: A) => Promise<R>) {
  const pending = ref(false)
  const error = ref<Error | null>(null)

  async function run(...args: A): Promise<R | undefined> {
    if (pending.value) return undefined
    pending.value = true
    error.value = null
    try {
      return await fn(...args)
    }
    catch (e) {
      error.value = e instanceof Error ? e : new Error(String(e))
      return undefined
    }
    finally {
      pending.value = false
    }
  }

  return { run, pending, error, reset: () => (error.value = null) }
}
```

`ui/app/composables/useAuth.ts`:

```ts
import { computed } from 'vue'
import type { Session } from '~/lib/auth'
import { can as canDo } from '~/lib/roles'
import type { Action } from '~/lib/roles'
import type { Role } from '~/types'

export function useAuth() {
  const { $corvus } = useNuxtApp()
  const session = useState<Session | null>('corvus.session', () => null)
  const roles = computed<Role[]>(() => session.value?.roles ?? [])

  return {
    session,
    roles,
    mode: $corvus.config.auth.mode,
    isAuthenticated: computed(() => session.value !== null),
    can: (action: Action) => canDo(roles.value, action),
    login: (returnTo = '/') => $corvus.auth.login(returnTo),
    loginWithToken: (token: string, selected: Role[], returnTo = '/') =>
      $corvus.auth.login(returnTo, { token, roles: selected }),
    completeLogin: async () => {
      const to = await $corvus.auth.completeLogin()
      session.value = await $corvus.auth.init()
      return to
    },
    logout: async () => {
      await $corvus.auth.logout()
      session.value = null
    },
  }
}
```

`ui/app/composables/useColorTheme.ts`:

```ts
import { parseTheme, resolveTheme, THEME_KEY } from '~/lib/theme'
import type { ThemeName } from '~/lib/theme'

function stored(): string | null {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY)
  }
  catch {
    return null
  }
}

/**
 * Light/dark theme. Without an explicit choice the page follows the system preference through CSS
 * (m3-tokens.css); the toggle writes the choice to the html element and to localStorage.
 */
export function useColorTheme() {
  const theme = useState<ThemeName>('corvus.theme', () => resolveTheme(stored(), window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches))
  const isDark = computed(() => theme.value === 'dark')

  function apply(next: ThemeName) {
    theme.value = next
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = next
  }
  function toggle() {
    const next: ThemeName = isDark.value ? 'light' : 'dark'
    apply(next)
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, next)
    }
    catch { /* storage unavailable: the choice just does not persist */ }
  }
  /** Restore an explicit choice made earlier (called once at startup). */
  function restore() {
    const choice = parseTheme(stored())
    if (choice) apply(choice)
  }
  return { theme, isDark, toggle, restore }
}
```

`ui/app/composables/useJobPolling.test.ts`:

```ts
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
import { mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { defineComponent, h, ref } from 'vue'
import { useJobPolling } from './useJobPolling'
import type { Job } from '~/types'

const job = (status: string): Job => ({
  id: 'j1', type: 'train', snapshot_id: 's1', params: {}, status, runner: 'local', message: '',
  created_by: 'me', created_at: '2026-10-15T10:00:00Z', updated_at: '2026-10-15T10:00:00Z', finished_at: null,
})

function mountPolling(statuses: string[], initial: string) {
  const jobRef = ref<Job | null>(job(initial))
  const queue = [...statuses]
  const fetchJob = vi.fn(async () => job(queue.shift() ?? 'failed'))
  let api!: ReturnType<typeof useJobPolling>
  const wrapper = mount(defineComponent({
    setup() {
      api = useJobPolling(jobRef, fetchJob)
      return () => h('div')
    },
  }))
  return { jobRef, fetchJob, api, wrapper }
}

describe('useJobPolling', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
  })
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.useRealTimers()
  })

  it('refreshes a running job with backoff and stops at the final status', async () => {
    const { jobRef, fetchJob, api } = mountPolling(['running', 'succeeded'], 'running')
    api.sync()
    expect(api.poller.running).toBe(true)

    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(2000)
    expect(fetchJob).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(jobRef.value?.status).toBe('running')

    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(3200)
    expect(fetchJob).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
    expect(jobRef.value?.status).toBe('succeeded')
    expect(api.poller.running).toBe(false)

    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(60_000)
    expect(fetchJob).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
  })

  it('does not poll a job that is already final', () => {
    const { api, fetchJob } = mountPolling([], 'succeeded')
    api.sync()
    expect(api.poller.running).toBe(false)
    expect(fetchJob).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('stops polling when the component unmounts', async () => {
    const { api, fetchJob, wrapper } = mountPolling(['running'], 'queued')
    api.sync()
    wrapper.unmount()
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(60_000)
    expect(fetchJob).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('keeps the last error and retries when a refresh fails', async () => {
    const jobRef = ref<Job | null>(job('running'))
    const fetchJob = vi.fn()
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('runner unreachable'))
      .mockResolvedValue(job('succeeded'))
    let api!: ReturnType<typeof useJobPolling>
    mount(defineComponent({
      setup() {
        api = useJobPolling(jobRef, fetchJob)
        return () => h('div')
      },
    }))
    api.sync()
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(2000)
    expect(api.lastError.value?.message).toBe('runner unreachable')
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(3200)
    expect(api.lastError.value).toBeNull()
    expect(jobRef.value?.status).toBe('succeeded')
  })
})
```

`ui/app/composables/useJobPolling.ts`:

```ts
import { onScopeDispose, ref } from 'vue'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import { createPoller, isFinalJobState } from '~/lib/polling'
import type { BackoffOptions } from '~/lib/polling'
import type { Job } from '~/types'

export interface JobPollingOptions {
  backoff?: BackoffOptions
  schedule?: (fn: () => void, ms: number) => unknown
  cancel?: (handle: unknown) => void
}

/**
 * Refreshes a job while it is queued or running, with growing delays. `GET /jobs/{id}` makes the API ask the
 * runner, so polling is what moves a job to its final status.
 */
export function useJobPolling(job: Ref<Job | null>, fetchJob: (id: string) => Promise<Job>, o: JobPollingOptions = {}) {
  const lastError = ref<Error | null>(null)

  const poller = createPoller({
    backoff: o.backoff,
    schedule: o.schedule ?? ((fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms)),
    cancel: o.cancel ?? (h => clearTimeout(h as ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>)),
    tick: async () => {
      const current = job.value
      if (!current) return false
      try {
        job.value = await fetchJob(current.id)
        lastError.value = null
      }
      catch (e) {
        lastError.value = e instanceof Error ? e : new Error(String(e))
        return true
      }
      return !isFinalJobState(job.value.status)
    },
  })

  /** Starts polling when the job is not final yet. */
  function sync() {
    poller.stop()
    if (job.value && !isFinalJobState(job.value.status)) poller.start()
  }

  onScopeDispose(() => poller.stop())

  return { sync, stop: () => poller.stop(), lastError, poller }
}
```

`ui/app/composables/useMediaQuery.ts`:

```ts
/** Reactive `window.matchMedia` result (the app is a client-only SPA, so `window` exists at setup). */
export function useMediaQuery(query: string) {
  const media = window.matchMedia(query)
  const matches = ref(media.matches)
  const update = () => { matches.value = media.matches }
  onMounted(() => media.addEventListener('change', update))
  onBeforeUnmount(() => media.removeEventListener('change', update))
  return matches
}
```

```ts
    const fetchPage = vi.fn(async (cursor: string | null) => (cursor ? page([3, 4], null) : page([1, 2], 'c1')))
    const list = usePagedList(fetchPage)
    await list.load()
    expect(list.items.value).toEqual([1, 2])
    expect(list.hasMore()).toBe(true)
    await list.loadMore()
    expect(fetchPage).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('c1')
    expect(list.items.value).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 4])
    expect(list.hasMore()).toBe(false)
  })

  it('does nothing on loadMore without a cursor', async () => {
    const fetchPage = vi.fn(async () => page([1], null))
    const list = usePagedList(fetchPage)
    await list.load()
    await list.loadMore()
    expect(fetchPage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })

  it('keeps items and exposes the problem when a later page fails', async () => {
    const err = new ApiError({ type: 'about:blank', title: 'Boom', status: 500 })

      .mockResolvedValueOnce(page([1], 'c'))
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(err)

    await list.load()
    await list.loadMore()
    expect(list.items.value).toEqual([1])
    expect(list.error.value).toBe(err)
    expect(list.loading.value).toBe(false)
  })

  it('ignores a stale response when a newer load started', async () => {
    let release!: (p: Paged<number>) => void
    const slow = new Promise<Paged<number>>((r) => {
      release = r
    })
    const fetchPage = vi.fn().mockReturnValueOnce(slow).mockResolvedValueOnce(page([9], null))
    const list = usePagedList(fetchPage)
    const first = list.load()
    await list.load()
    release(page([1], null))
    await first
    expect(list.items.value).toEqual([9])
  })
})
```

`ui/app/composables/usePagedList.ts`:

```ts
import { ref, shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { ApiError } from '~/lib/problem'
import type { Paged } from '~/types'

/** Keyset-paginated list: `load` replaces the items, `loadMore` appends the next page. */
export function usePagedList<T>(fetchPage: (cursor: string | null) => Promise<Paged<T>>) {
  const items = shallowRef<T[]>([])
  const nextCursor = ref<string | null>(null)
  const loading = ref(false)
  const error = ref<Error | null>(null)
  const loaded = ref(false)
  let generation = 0

  async function run(cursor: string | null, append: boolean) {
    const mine = ++generation
    loading.value = true
    error.value = null
    try {
      const page = await fetchPage(cursor)
      if (mine !== generation) return
      items.value = append ? [...items.value, ...page.items] : page.items
      nextCursor.value = page.next_cursor
      loaded.value = true
    }
    catch (e) {
      if (mine !== generation) return
      error.value = e instanceof Error ? e : new Error(String(e))
      if (!(e instanceof ApiError) && !append) items.value = []
    }
    finally {
      if (mine === generation) loading.value = false
    }
  }

  return {
    items,
    loading,
    error,
    loaded,
    hasMore: () => nextCursor.value !== null,
    nextCursor,
    load: () => run(null, false),
    loadMore: () => (nextCursor.value ? run(nextCursor.value, true) : Promise.resolve()),
  }
}
```

`ui/app/composables/useQueryState.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Binds a string filter to a URL query parameter, so a view can be shared and every browser tab keeps its own
 * state. An empty value removes the parameter.
 */
export function useQueryState(key: string, fallback = '') {
  const route = useRoute()
  const router = useRouter()
  return computed<string>({
    get: () => {
      const v = route.query[key]
      return (Array.isArray(v) ? v[0] : v) ?? fallback
    },
    set: (value) => {
      const { [key]: _old, ...rest } = route.query
      void router.replace({ query: !value || value === fallback ? rest : { ...rest, [key]: value } })
    },
  })
}
```

`ui/app/composables/useSnackbar.ts`:

```ts
const DURATION_MS = 5000
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined

/** App-wide transient message (one at a time). The M3Snackbar in the layouts shows it. */
export function useSnackbar() {
  const message = useState<string>('corvus.snackbar', () => '')

  function dismiss() {
    clearTimeout(timer)
    message.value = ''
  }
  function show(text: string) {
    clearTimeout(timer)
    message.value = text
    timer = setTimeout(dismiss, DURATION_MS)
  }
  return { message, show, dismiss }
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { buildUrl, createApiClient } from './api-client'
import { ApiError, NetworkError } from './problem'

function setup(respond: () => Response | Promise<Response>, token: string | null = 'tok') {
  const fetchFn = vi.fn(async (..._args: [string, RequestInit?]) => respond())
  const onUnauthorized = vi.fn()
  const client = createApiClient({ baseUrl: 'https://api.test/api/v1', fetch: fetchFn, getToken: () => token, onUnauthorized })
  return { client, fetchFn, onUnauthorized }
}

const json = (body: unknown, status = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } })
const problem = (body: Record<string, unknown>, status: number) =>
  new Response(JSON.stringify({ type: 'about:blank', title: 'Problem', status, ...body }), {
    status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/problem+json' },
  })

describe('buildUrl', () => {
  it('drops empty query values and encodes the rest', () => {
    expect(buildUrl('/api', '/x', { a: 'b c', e: '', n: undefined, z: 0, f: false })).toBe('/api/x?a=b+c&z=0&f=false')
  })

  it('has no question mark without parameters', () => {
    expect(buildUrl('/api', '/x')).toBe('/api/x')
  })
})

describe('request', () => {
  it('sends the bearer token and parses JSON', async () => {
    const { client, fetchFn } = setup(() => json({ items: [], next_cursor: null }))
    await expect(client.get('/pools', { query: { limit: 5 } })).resolves.toEqual({ items: [], next_cursor: null })
    const [url, init] = fetchFn.mock.calls[0]!
    expect(url).toBe('https://api.test/api/v1/pools?limit=5')
    expect((init!.headers as Record<string, string>).Authorization).toBe('Bearer tok')
  })

  it('omits Authorization without a token', async () => {
    const { client, fetchFn } = setup(() => json({}), null)
    await client.get('/x')
    expect((fetchFn.mock.calls[0]![1]!.headers as Record<string, string>).Authorization).toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('sends a JSON body with its content type', async () => {
    const { client, fetchFn } = setup(() => json({ ok: true }))
    await client.post('/players/lookup', { body: { uuid: 'u' } })
    const init = fetchFn.mock.calls[0]![1]!
    expect(init.method).toBe('POST')
    expect(init.body).toBe('{"uuid":"u"}')
    expect((init.headers as Record<string, string>)['Content-Type']).toBe('application/json')
  })

  it('sends a raw CSV body unchanged', async () => {

    const init = fetchFn.mock.calls[0]![1]!
    expect(init.body).toBe('a,b\n1,2\n')
    expect((init.headers as Record<string, string>)['Content-Type']).toBe('text/csv')
  })

    await expect(client.delete('/pools/1')).resolves.toBeUndefined()
  })
})

describe('problem details', () => {
  it('turns an RFC 9457 body into an ApiError with the quality-gate reasons', async () => {
    const reasons = ['p99_latency_ms 12.0 is not below 10', 'recall_at_fpr_0_1pct below the incumbent']
    const { client } = setup(() => problem({ title: 'Conflict', detail: 'gate failed', reasons }, 409))
    const err = await client.post('/models/1/stage', { body: {} }).catch((e: unknown) => e)
    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(ApiError)
    expect((err as ApiError).status).toBe(409)
    expect((err as ApiError).reasons).toEqual(reasons)
    expect((err as ApiError).message).toBe('gate failed')
  })

  it('exposes validation errors', async () => {
    const { client } = setup(() => problem({ errors: [{ loc: ['body', 'name'], msg: 'Field required' }] }, 422))
    const err = (await client.post('/pools', { body: {} }).catch((e: unknown) => e)) as ApiError
    expect(err.errors[0]?.msg).toBe('Field required')
  })

  it('maps a non-problem error body to a generic problem', async () => {
    const { client } = setup(() => new Response('<html>bad gateway</html>', { status: 502, statusText: 'Bad Gateway' }))
    const err = (await client.get('/x').catch((e: unknown) => e)) as ApiError
    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(ApiError)
    expect(err.status).toBe(502)
    expect(err.problem.title).toBe('Bad Gateway')
  })

  it('reports network failures as NetworkError', async () => {
    const { client } = setup(() => Promise.reject(new TypeError('failed to fetch')))
    await expect(client.get('/x')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NetworkError)
  })
})

describe('401 handling', () => {
  it('calls onUnauthorized once and still rejects', async () => {
    const { client, onUnauthorized } = setup(() => problem({ title: 'Unauthorized' }, 401))
    await expect(client.get('/pools')).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 401 })
    expect(onUnauthorized).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })

    await expect(client.get('/pools')).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 403 })
    expect(onUnauthorized).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })
```

`ui/app/lib/api-client.ts`:

```ts
import type { FetchLike } from './config'
import { NetworkError, problemFromResponse } from './problem'

export type QueryValue = string | number | boolean | null | undefined

export interface RequestOptions {
  query?: Record<string, QueryValue>
  /** JSON body. */
  body?: unknown
  /** Raw body with its own content type (CSV import). */
  rawBody?: { content: string, contentType: string }
  signal?: AbortSignal
}

export interface ApiClientOptions {
  baseUrl: string
  fetch: FetchLike
  getToken: () => string | null | Promise<string | null>
  /** Called once per 401 response; the client still rejects so callers stop their work. */
  onUnauthorized: () => void
}

export interface ApiClient {
  get: <T>(path: string, opts?: RequestOptions) => Promise<T>
  post: <T>(path: string, opts?: RequestOptions) => Promise<T>
  put: <T>(path: string, opts?: RequestOptions) => Promise<T>
  delete: <T = void>(path: string, opts?: RequestOptions) => Promise<T>
}

export function buildUrl(baseUrl: string, path: string, query?: Record<string, QueryValue>): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams()
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(query ?? {})) {
    if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') params.set(k, String(v))
  }
  const qs = params.toString()
  return `${baseUrl}${path}${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`
}

export function createApiClient(options: ApiClientOptions): ApiClient {
  async function request<T>(method: string, path: string, opts: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = { Accept: 'application/json, application/problem+json' }
    const token = await options.getToken()
    if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`

    let body: string | undefined
    if (opts.rawBody) {
      headers['Content-Type'] = opts.rawBody.contentType
      body = opts.rawBody.content
    }
    else if (opts.body !== undefined) {
      headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      body = JSON.stringify(opts.body)
    }

    let res: Response
    try {
      res = await options.fetch(buildUrl(options.baseUrl, path, opts.query), {
        method,
        headers,
        body,
        signal: opts.signal,
        // Responses can carry personal-data adjacent identifiers; never reuse them from a shared cache.
        cache: 'no-store',
      })
    }
    catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof DOMException && e.name === 'AbortError') throw e
      throw new NetworkError()
    }

    if (res.status === 401) options.onUnauthorized()
    if (!res.ok) throw await problemFromResponse(res)
    if (res.status === 204) return undefined as T
    return (await res.json()) as T
  }

  return {
    get: (path, opts) => request('GET', path, opts),
    post: (path, opts) => request('POST', path, opts),
    put: (path, opts) => request('PUT', path, opts),
    delete: (path, opts) => request('DELETE', path, opts),
  }
}
```

`ui/app/lib/auth.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { createTokenAuth, sessionFromUser } from './auth'
import type { User } from 'oidc-client-ts'

const memory = (): Storage => {
  const data = new Map<string, string>()
  return {
    getItem: k => data.get(k) ?? null,
    setItem: (k, v) => void data.set(k, v),
    removeItem: k => void data.delete(k),
    clear: () => data.clear(),
    key: i => [...data.keys()][i] ?? null,
    get length() {
      return data.size
    },
  }
}

describe('token login', () => {
  it('stores the session and restores it on init', async () => {
    const storage = memory()
    const auth = createTokenAuth(storage)
    expect(await auth.init()).toBeNull()
    await auth.login('/', { token: 'dev', roles: ['staff'] })
    expect(await createTokenAuth(storage).init()).toEqual({ token: 'dev', roles: ['staff'], subject: 'dev-token' })
  })

  it('notifies listeners on login and logout', async () => {
    const auth = createTokenAuth(memory())
    const seen = vi.fn()
    auth.onChange(seen)
    await auth.login('/', { token: 't', roles: ['admin'] })
    await auth.logout()
    expect(seen.mock.calls.map(c => (c[0] as { token: string } | null)?.token ?? null)).toEqual(['t', null])
  })

  it('drops unknown roles from a tampered session', async () => {
    const storage = memory()
    storage.setItem('corvus.dev.session', JSON.stringify({ token: 't', roles: ['admin', 'root'] }))
    expect((await createTokenAuth(storage).init())?.roles).toEqual(['admin'])
  })

  it('ignores corrupt storage', async () => {
    const storage = memory()
    storage.setItem('corvus.dev.session', '{nope')
    expect(await createTokenAuth(storage).init()).toBeNull()
  })
})

describe('sessionFromUser', () => {
  const cfg = { mode: 'oidc' as const, rolesClaim: 'roles', roleMapping: {} }
  const user = (over: Partial<User>) => ({
    access_token: 'a.b.c', expired: false, profile: { sub: 's1', roles: ['viewer'], preferred_username: 'kim' }, ...over,
  }) as unknown as User

  it('takes roles and name from the profile', () => {
    expect(sessionFromUser(user({}), cfg)).toEqual({ token: 'a.b.c', roles: ['viewer'], subject: 'kim' })
  })

  it('returns no session for an expired or missing user', () => {
    expect(sessionFromUser(user({ expired: true }), cfg)).toBeNull()
    expect(sessionFromUser(null, cfg)).toBeNull()
  })
})
```

`ui/app/lib/auth.ts`:

```ts
import { UserManager, WebStorageStateStore } from 'oidc-client-ts'
import type { User } from 'oidc-client-ts'
import type { AppConfig } from './config'
import { decodeJwtPayload, rolesFromClaims, ROLES } from './roles'
import type { Role } from '~/types'

export interface Session {
  token: string
  roles: Role[]
  subject: string
}

/** Login mechanism behind the UI. The API validates every token again; this only feeds the UI. */
export interface AuthProvider {
  /** Restores a stored session, if there is one. */
  init: () => Promise<Session | null>
  /** Starts a login. For OIDC this navigates away; the returned promise rarely resolves. */
  login: (returnTo: string, input?: { token?: string, roles?: Role[] }) => Promise<void>
  /** Finishes the redirect at /auth/callback and returns the path to continue at. */
  completeLogin: () => Promise<string>
  logout: () => Promise<void>
  /** Registers a listener for session changes made outside this tab (login, renewal, logout in another tab). */
  onChange: (cb: (s: Session | null) => void) => () => void
}

function join(basePath: string, path: string): string {
  return `${basePath.replace(/\/$/, '')}/${path.replace(/^\//, '')}`
}

export function sessionFromUser(user: User | null, cfg: AppConfig['auth']): Session | null {
  if (!user || user.expired || !user.access_token) return null
  const claims: Record<string, unknown> = {
    ...decodeJwtPayload(user.access_token),
    ...(user.profile as unknown as Record<string, unknown>),
  }
  return {
    token: user.access_token,
    roles: rolesFromClaims(claims, cfg.rolesClaim, cfg.roleMapping),
    subject: String(user.profile.preferred_username ?? user.profile.name ?? user.profile.sub ?? ''),
  }
}

/** Authorization Code + PKCE. The user is kept in localStorage so every tab shares the login. */
export function createOidcAuth(cfg: AppConfig, origin: string, basePath: string, storage: Storage): AuthProvider {
  const manager = new UserManager({
    authority: cfg.oidc.issuer,
    client_id: cfg.oidc.clientId,
    redirect_uri: `${origin}${join(basePath, 'auth/callback')}`,
    post_logout_redirect_uri: `${origin}${basePath}`,
    response_type: 'code',
    scope: cfg.oidc.scopes,
    automaticSilentRenew: true,
    userStore: new WebStorageStateStore({ store: storage }),
    stateStore: new WebStorageStateStore({ store: storage }),
  })

  return {
    async init() {
      return sessionFromUser(await manager.getUser(), cfg.auth)
    },
    async login(returnTo) {
      await manager.signinRedirect({ state: { returnTo } })
    },
    async completeLogin() {
      const user = await manager.signinRedirectCallback()
      const state = user.state as { returnTo?: unknown } | undefined
      const to = typeof state?.returnTo === 'string' ? state.returnTo : '/'
      // Only same-app paths; a crafted state must not turn the callback into an open redirect.
      return to.startsWith('/') && !to.startsWith('//') ? to : '/'
    },
    async logout() {
      await manager.signoutRedirect().catch(async () => {
        await manager.removeUser()
      })
    },
    onChange(cb) {
      const load = (u: User) => cb(sessionFromUser(u, cfg.auth))
      const unload = () => cb(null)
      manager.events.addUserLoaded(load)
      manager.events.addUserUnloaded(unload)
      manager.events.addAccessTokenExpired(unload)
      return () => {
        manager.events.removeUserLoaded(load)
        manager.events.removeUserUnloaded(unload)
        manager.events.removeAccessTokenExpired(unload)
      }
    },
  }
}

const TOKEN_KEY = 'corvus.dev.session'

/** Development login: paste the API's static dev token and say which roles the UI should assume. */
export function createTokenAuth(storage: Storage): AuthProvider {
  const listeners = new Set<(s: Session | null) => void>()
  const read = (): Session | null => {
    try {
      const raw = storage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY)
      if (!raw) return null
      const v = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<Session>
      if (typeof v.token !== 'string' || !Array.isArray(v.roles)) return null
      return { token: v.token, roles: v.roles.filter((r): r is Role => ROLES.includes(r)), subject: 'dev-token' }
    }
    catch {
      return null
    }
  }
  return {
    init: () => Promise.resolve(read()),
    login(_returnTo, input) {
      const session: Session = { token: input?.token ?? '', roles: input?.roles ?? [], subject: 'dev-token' }
      storage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, JSON.stringify(session))
      listeners.forEach(l => l(session))
      return Promise.resolve()
    },
    completeLogin: () => Promise.resolve('/'),
    logout() {
      storage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY)
      listeners.forEach(l => l(null))
      return Promise.resolve()
    },
    onChange(cb) {
      listeners.add(cb)
      return () => listeners.delete(cb)
    },
  }
}
```

`ui/app/lib/base.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Path the app is served under. nginx injects `<base href="/prefix/">` from CORVUS_UI_BASE_PATH; without that tag
 * (dev server, plain static hosting) the app lives at the root.
 */
export function readBasePath(doc: Pick<Document, 'querySelector'> | null = typeof document === 'undefined' ? null : document): string {
  const href = doc?.querySelector('base')?.getAttribute('href')
  if (!href) return '/'
  let path: string
  try {
    path = new URL(href, 'http://localhost').pathname
  }
  catch {
    return '/'
  }
  return path.endsWith('/') ? path : `${path}/`
}
```

```ts
  })
```

`ui/app/lib/config.ts`:

```ts
export interface AppConfig {
  /** Control-plane API root including the version prefix, e.g. https://corvus.example/api/v1 (no trailing slash). */
  apiBaseUrl: string
  /** Path the app is served under, e.g. "/" or "/corvus/". Always starts and ends with a slash. */
  basePath: string
  auth: {
    /** `oidc`: Authorization Code + PKCE. `token`: paste a bearer token (local development with the API dev token). */
    mode: 'oidc' | 'token'
    /** Claim that carries the roles (dotted paths such as realm_access.roles work). */
    rolesClaim: string
    /** Maps external role names to Corvus roles. */
    roleMapping: Record<string, string>
  }
  oidc: {
    issuer: string
    clientId: string
    scopes: string
  }
}

export class ConfigError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'ConfigError'
  }
}

function isRecord(v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v)
}

function str(v: unknown, field: string, required: boolean): string {
  if (v === undefined || v === null || v === '') {
    if (required) throw new ConfigError(`config.json: "${field}" is required`)
    return ''
  }
  if (typeof v !== 'string') throw new ConfigError(`config.json: "${field}" must be a string`)
  return v
}

export function normalizeBasePath(raw: string): string {
  let p = raw.trim()
  if (!p.startsWith('/')) p = `/${p}`
  if (!p.endsWith('/')) p = `${p}/`
  return p.replace(/\/{2,}/g, '/')
}

/** Validates the parsed config.json and fills in defaults. Throws ConfigError with a readable message. */
export function parseConfig(raw: unknown): AppConfig {
  if (!isRecord(raw)) throw new ConfigError('config.json must be a JSON object')

  const apiBaseUrl = str(raw.apiBaseUrl, 'apiBaseUrl', true).replace(/\/+$/, '')
  if (!/^(https?:\/\/|\/)/.test(apiBaseUrl)) {
    throw new ConfigError('config.json: "apiBaseUrl" must be an absolute URL or an absolute path')
  }

  const auth = isRecord(raw.auth) ? raw.auth : {}
  const mode = auth.mode ?? 'oidc'
  if (mode !== 'oidc' && mode !== 'token') {
    throw new ConfigError('config.json: "auth.mode" must be "oidc" or "token"')
  }
  const roleMapping: Record<string, string> = {}
  if (auth.roleMapping !== undefined) {
    if (!isRecord(auth.roleMapping)) throw new ConfigError('config.json: "auth.roleMapping" must be an object')
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(auth.roleMapping)) {
      if (typeof v === 'string') roleMapping[k] = v
    }
  }

  const oidcRaw = isRecord(raw.oidc) ? raw.oidc : {}
  const oidc = {
    issuer: str(oidcRaw.issuer, 'oidc.issuer', mode === 'oidc'),
    clientId: str(oidcRaw.clientId, 'oidc.clientId', mode === 'oidc'),
    scopes: str(oidcRaw.scopes, 'oidc.scopes', false) || 'openid profile',
  }

  return {
    apiBaseUrl,
    basePath: normalizeBasePath(str(raw.basePath, 'basePath', false) || '/'),
    auth: {
      mode,
      rolesClaim: str(auth.rolesClaim, 'auth.rolesClaim', false) || 'roles',
      roleMapping,
    },
    oidc,
  }
}

export type FetchLike = (input: string, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>

/** Fetches and validates config.json. The cache is bypassed so a changed mount takes effect on reload. */
export async function loadConfig(fetchFn: FetchLike, url: string): Promise<AppConfig> {
  let res: Response
  try {
    res = await fetchFn(url, { cache: 'no-store', headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } })
  }
  catch {
    throw new ConfigError(`config.json could not be loaded from ${url}`)
  }
  if (!res.ok) throw new ConfigError(`config.json could not be loaded (HTTP ${res.status})`)
  let body: unknown
  try {
    body = await res.json()
  }
  catch {
    throw new ConfigError('config.json is not valid JSON')
  }
  return parseConfig(body)
}
```

`ui/app/lib/debounce.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { debounce } from './debounce'

describe('debounce', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
  })
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.useRealTimers()
  })

  it('calls once with the last arguments after the quiet time', () => {
    const fn = vi.fn()
    const d = debounce(fn, 300)
    d('a')
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(200)
    d('b')
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(299)
    expect(fn).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(1)
    expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
    expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledWith('b')
  })

  it('drops a pending call on cancel', () => {
    const fn = vi.fn()
    const d = debounce(fn, 300)
    d()
    d.cancel()
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000)
    expect(fn).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('runs a pending call at once on flush and does nothing without one', () => {
    const fn = vi.fn()
    const d = debounce(fn, 300)
    d.flush()
    expect(fn).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    d('x')
    d.flush()
    expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledWith('x')
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000)
    expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
  })
})
```

`ui/app/lib/debounce.ts`:

```ts
export interface Debounced<A extends unknown[]> {
  (...args: A): void
  /** Drops a pending call. */
  cancel: () => void
  /** Runs a pending call now. */
  flush: () => void
}

/** Trailing-edge debounce on setTimeout, so fake timers drive it in tests. */
export function debounce<A extends unknown[]>(fn: (...args: A) => void, ms: number): Debounced<A> {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
  let pending: A | undefined
  const run = () => {
    timer = undefined
    const args = pending
    pending = undefined
    if (args) fn(...args)
  }
  const debounced = ((...args: A) => {
    pending = args
    if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer)
    timer = setTimeout(run, ms)
  }) as Debounced<A>
  debounced.cancel = () => {
    if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer)
    timer = undefined
    pending = undefined
  }
  debounced.flush = () => {
    if (timer === undefined) return
    clearTimeout(timer)
    run()
  }
  return debounced
}

```

```ts
const lookup = (tree: unknown, path: string): unknown =>
  path.split('.').reduce<unknown>((n, p) => (n && typeof n === 'object' ? (n as Record<string, unknown>)[p] : undefined), tree)

describe('enum translations', () => {
  for (const [prefix, values] of Object.entries(ENUMS)) {
    it.each(values)(`${prefix}.%s is translated in de and en`, (value) => {
      expect(typeof lookup(de, `${prefix}.${value}`)).toBe('string')
      expect(typeof lookup(en, `${prefix}.${value}`)).toBe('string')
    })
  }

  it('lists exactly the values of the API enums', () => {
    const s = openapi.components.schemas as Record<string, { enum?: string[], properties?: Record<string, { enum?: string[] }> }>
    expect([...ENUMS['jobs.type']].sort()).toEqual([...s.JobType!.enum!].sort())
    expect([...ENUMS['jobs.status']].sort()).toEqual([...s.JobState!.enum!].sort())
    expect([...ENUMS['models.stage']].sort()).toEqual([...s.Stage!.enum!].sort())
    expect([...ENUMS['blocklist.kinds']].sort()).toEqual([...s.BlockEntryOut!.properties!.kind!.enum!].sort())
    expect([...ENUMS['blocklist.sources']].sort()).toEqual([...s.BlockEntryOut!.properties!.source!.enum!].sort())
  })
})

describe('enumLabel', () => {
  const t = (k: string) => `T(${k})`
  it('uses the translation when there is one', () => {

  })
  it('humanises an unknown value instead of showing the key', () => {
```

`ui/app/lib/enums.ts`:

```ts
/** API enum values (see openapi.json); every value needs a translation under the given i18n prefix. */
export const ENUMS = {
  'jobs.type': ['build_features', 'evaluate', 'train'],
  'jobs.status': ['queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed'],
  'models.stage': ['registered', 'shadow', 'canary', 'enforce', 'archived'],
  'blocklist.kinds': ['block', 'allow'],
  'blocklist.sources': ['manual', 'erasure'],
} as const satisfies Record<string, readonly string[]>

/** "build_features" -> "Build features": shown for a value the interface has no translation for. */
export function humanize(value: string): string {
  const s = value.replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ').trim()
  return s ? s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1) : value
}

export function enumLabel(prefix: string, value: string, t: (key: string) => string, te: (key: string) => boolean): string {
  const key = `${prefix}.${value}`
  return te(key) ? t(key) : humanize(value)
}
```

`ui/app/lib/erasure.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { buildErasureRequest, ERASE_WORD, isErasureConfirmed, isPseudonym, isUuid, shortPseudonym } from './erasure'

const pseudonym = 'ab'.repeat(32)
const uuid = '069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5'

describe('erasure confirmation guard', () => {
  it('requires exactly the word ERASE', () => {
    expect(isErasureConfirmed(ERASE_WORD)).toBe(true)
    expect(isErasureConfirmed(' ERASE ')).toBe(true)
  })

  it.each(['', 'erase', 'Erase', 'ERASE!', 'DELETE', 'ERAS'])('rejects %j', (typed) => {
    expect(isErasureConfirmed(typed)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('builds no request while the word is wrong', () => {
    expect(buildErasureRequest(pseudonym, 'erase')).toBeNull()
    expect(buildErasureRequest(uuid, '')).toBeNull()
  })

  it('builds a pseudonym request once confirmed', () => {
    expect(buildErasureRequest(pseudonym.toUpperCase(), 'ERASE')).toEqual({ pseudonym })
  })

  it('builds a uuid request once confirmed', () => {
    expect(buildErasureRequest(uuid, 'ERASE')).toEqual({ uuid })
  })

  it('builds no request for a malformed identifier even when confirmed', () => {
    expect(buildErasureRequest('not-an-id', 'ERASE')).toBeNull()
    expect(buildErasureRequest('ab'.repeat(31), 'ERASE')).toBeNull()
  })
})

describe('identifier checks', () => {
  it('recognises uuids and pseudonyms', () => {
    expect(isUuid(uuid)).toBe(true)
    expect(isUuid(uuid.replaceAll('-', ''))).toBe(true)
    expect(isUuid('xyz')).toBe(false)
    expect(isPseudonym(pseudonym)).toBe(true)
    expect(isPseudonym(`${pseudonym}0`)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('shortens a pseudonym to the 12 characters the API logs', () => {
    expect(shortPseudonym(pseudonym)).toBe('abababababab')
  })
})
```

`ui/app/lib/erasure.ts`:

```ts
/** The word an admin has to type before an erasure request is sent. */
export const ERASE_WORD = 'ERASE'

const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-?[0-9a-f]{4}-?[0-9a-f]{4}-?[0-9a-f]{4}-?[0-9a-f]{12}$/i
const PSEUDONYM_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i

export function isUuid(v: string): boolean {
  return UUID_RE.test(v.trim())
}

export function isPseudonym(v: string): boolean {
  return PSEUDONYM_RE.test(v.trim())
}

/** Exact, case-sensitive match so that a stray "erase" or an autocomplete cannot confirm. */
export function isErasureConfirmed(typed: string): boolean {
  return typed.trim() === ERASE_WORD
}

export type ErasureTarget = { uuid: string, pseudonym?: undefined } | { pseudonym: string, uuid?: undefined }

/**
 * Builds the request body once the guard passes. Returns null while the confirmation word is wrong or the
 * identifier is malformed, so callers cannot send a request by accident.
 */
export function buildErasureRequest(identifier: string, typed: string): ErasureTarget | null {
  if (!isErasureConfirmed(typed)) return null
  const id = identifier.trim()
  if (isPseudonym(id)) return { pseudonym: id.toLowerCase() }
  if (isUuid(id)) return { uuid: id }
  return null
}

/** First 12 hex characters, the same truncation the API uses in its logs. */
export function shortPseudonym(p: string): string {
  return p.slice(0, 12)
}
```

`ui/app/lib/format.ts`:

```ts
export function formatDateTime(iso: string | null | undefined, locale = 'de'): string {
  if (!iso) return '–'
  const d = new Date(iso)
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }).format(d)
}

export function shortId(id: string): string {
  return id.slice(0, 8)
}

export function formatNumber(n: number | null | undefined, locale = 'de'): string {
  return n === null || n === undefined ? '–' : new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(n)
}

/** Count of a first page: "200+" when more pages exist. */
export function countLabel(count: number, hasMore: boolean): string {
  return hasMore ? `${count}+` : String(count)
}

export function stageColor(stage: string): string {
  switch (stage) {
    case 'enforce': return 'primary'
    case 'canary': return 'secondary'
    case 'shadow': return 'tertiary'
    default: return 'default'
  }
}

export function stageIcon(stage: string): string {
  switch (stage) {
    case 'enforce': return 'mdi-shield-check'
    case 'canary': return 'mdi-bird'
    case 'shadow': return 'mdi-ghost-outline'
    case 'archived': return 'mdi-archive-outline'
    default: return 'mdi-tray-full'
  }
}

export function jobColor(status: string): string {
  switch (status) {
    case 'succeeded': return 'primary'
    case 'running': return 'tertiary'
    case 'failed': return 'error'
    default: return 'default'
  }
}

export function jobIcon(status: string): string {
  switch (status) {
    case 'succeeded': return 'mdi-check-circle-outline'
    case 'running': return 'mdi-progress-clock'
    case 'failed': return 'mdi-alert-circle-outline'
    default: return 'mdi-timer-sand'
  }
}

export type ChipTone = 'neutral' | 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'tertiary' | 'error'

/** Maps the colour names of stageColor and jobColor to a chip tone. */
export function chipTone(color: string): ChipTone {
  return color === 'primary' || color === 'secondary' || color === 'tertiary' || color === 'error' ? color : 'neutral'
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { createApiClient } from './api-client'
import type { Session } from './auth'
import { withServerIdentity } from './identity'

const claimSession: Session = { token: 't', roles: ['viewer'], subject: 'claim-subject' }

function clientWith(respond: () => Response | Promise<Response>) {
  const fetch = vi.fn(async () => respond())
  const onUnauthorized = vi.fn()
  const client = createApiClient({ baseUrl: '/api/v1', fetch, getToken: () => 't', onUnauthorized })
  return { client, fetch }
}

const json = (body: unknown, status = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status })

describe('withServerIdentity', () => {
  it('takes roles and display name from /me instead of the token claims', async () => {
    const { client, fetch } = clientWith(() => json({ subject: 'sub-1', display_name: 'Zoe', roles: ['staff', 'admin'] }))
    const session = await withServerIdentity(client, claimSession)
    expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/api/v1/me', expect.anything())
    expect(session).toEqual({ token: 't', roles: ['staff', 'admin'], subject: 'Zoe' })
  })

  it('falls back to the subject when the token has no display name', async () => {
    const { client } = clientWith(() => json({ subject: 'sub-1', display_name: null, roles: ['viewer'] }))
    expect((await withServerIdentity(client, claimSession)).subject).toBe('sub-1')
  })

  it('ignores roles this UI does not know', async () => {
    const { client } = clientWith(() => json({ subject: 's', display_name: null, roles: ['admin', 'wizard'] }))
    expect((await withServerIdentity(client, claimSession)).roles).toEqual(['admin'])
  })

  it('keeps the token-claim roles when /me answers with an error', async () => {
    const { client } = clientWith(() => json({ title: 'Not Found', status: 404 }, 404))
    expect(await withServerIdentity(client, claimSession)).toEqual(claimSession)
  })

  it('keeps the token-claim roles when /me cannot be reached', async () => {
    const { client } = clientWith(() => Promise.reject(new TypeError('network down')))
    expect(await withServerIdentity(client, claimSession)).toEqual(claimSession)
  })
})
```

`ui/app/lib/identity.ts`:

```ts
import type { ApiClient } from './api-client'
import { ROLES } from './roles'
import type { Session } from './auth'
import type { Me, Role } from '~/types'

/**
 * The API is the source of truth for roles (GET /me, after its role mapping). The roles read from the token claim
 * stay as the fallback when /me cannot be reached, so the UI still works against an older API.
 */
export async function withServerIdentity(api: Pick<ApiClient, 'get'>, session: Session): Promise<Session> {
  try {
    const me = await api.get<Me>('/me')
    const roles = me.roles.filter((r): r is Role => (ROLES as readonly string[]).includes(r))
    return { ...session, roles, subject: me.display_name || me.subject || session.subject }
  }
  catch {
    return session
  }
}
```

`ui/app/lib/job-params.ts`:

```ts
export const JOB_PARAMS_MAX_BYTES = 16 * 1024

export type JobParamsResult =
  | { ok: true, value: Record<string, unknown> }
  | { ok: false, error: 'invalidJson' | 'notObject' | 'tooLarge' }

/** Parses the free-form job parameters. The API caps them at 16 KiB and forbids secrets (not checkable here). */
export function parseJobParams(text: string): JobParamsResult {
  const t = text.trim()
  if (!t) return { ok: true, value: {} }
  if (new TextEncoder().encode(t).length > JOB_PARAMS_MAX_BYTES) return { ok: false, error: 'tooLarge' }
  let parsed: unknown
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(t)
  }
  catch {
    return { ok: false, error: 'invalidJson' }
  }
  if (typeof parsed !== 'object' || parsed === null || Array.isArray(parsed)) return { ok: false, error: 'notObject' }
  return { ok: true, value: parsed as Record<string, unknown> }
}
```
