`ui/app/types/index.ts`:

```ts
import type { components } from './api'

// Aliases over the generated OpenAPI types (app/types/api.d.ts, `pnpm api:types`).
type S = components['schemas']

export type Pool = S['PoolOut']
export type PoolInput = S['PoolIn']
export type PoolFilter = S['PoolFilter']
export type Preview = S['PreviewOut']
export type Snapshot = S['SnapshotOut']
// Two API models are called LabelOut; FastAPI disambiguates them with the module path.
export type Label = S['corvus_services__api__schemas__LabelOut']
export type LabelInput = S['LabelIn']
export type PlayerLookup = S['PlayerLookupOut']
export type Erasure = S['ErasureOut']
export type BlockEntry = S['BlockEntryOut']
export type BlockInput = S['BlockIn']
export type Model = S['ModelOut']
export type ModelTransition = S['TransitionOut']
export type Job = S['JobOut']
export type JobInput = S['JobIn']
export type JobType = S['JobType']
export type JobState = S['JobState']

export type Me = S['MeOut']
export type Summary = S['SummaryOut']
export type ErasureBrief = S['ErasureBriefOut']
export type JobBrief = S['JobBriefOut']
export type ScoreLatest = S['ScoreLatestOut']
export type ScoreHistory = S['ScoreHistoryOut']

export type Role = 'admin' | 'data_scientist' | 'staff' | 'viewer'
export type Stage = 'registered' | 'shadow' | 'canary' | 'enforce' | 'archived'

export interface Paged<T> {
  items: T[]
  next_cursor: string | null
}

```

`ui/docker/15-corvus-ui.envsh`:

```envsh
#!/bin/sh
# Sourced (not run) by the nginx entrypoint before the template step: it must be named *.envsh and be
# executable, otherwise the entrypoint skips it, and a plain *.sh would run in a subshell and lose the exports.
# Turns the deployment settings into the variables used by default.conf.template.
#
#   CORVUS_UI_BASE_PATH     path the app is served under, default "/" (e.g. "/corvus/")
#   CORVUS_UI_API_ORIGIN    origin of the control-plane API, e.g. https://corvus.example.org (empty: same origin)
#   CORVUS_UI_OIDC_ORIGIN   origin of the OIDC issuer (and its token endpoint), e.g. https://sso.example.org
#   CORVUS_UI_API_UPSTREAM  optional upstream (e.g. http://api:8080) that /api/ is proxied to on the same origin
#   CORVUS_UI_EXTRA_CONNECT additional connect-src entries, space separated (optional)

base="${CORVUS_UI_BASE_PATH:-/}"
case "$base" in /*) ;; *) base="/$base" ;; esac
case "$base" in */) ;; *) base="$base/" ;; esac
export CORVUS_UI_BASE_PATH="$base"

# Only plain origins are accepted; anything else could break out of the header.
connect=""
for origin in ${CORVUS_UI_API_ORIGIN:-} ${CORVUS_UI_OIDC_ORIGIN:-} ${CORVUS_UI_EXTRA_CONNECT:-}; do
  case "$origin" in
    http://* | https://* | ws://* | wss://*)
      case "$origin" in
        *[!A-Za-z0-9.:/_-]*) echo "15-corvus-ui: ignoring invalid origin '$origin'" >&2 ;;
        *) connect="$connect $origin" ;;
      esac
      ;;
    *) echo "15-corvus-ui: ignoring invalid origin '$origin'" >&2 ;;
  esac
done
export CORVUS_UI_CONNECT_SRC="${connect# }"

# Optional: proxy /api/ to the API on the same origin, so no CORS and no extra connect-src entry is needed.
proxy=/tmp/corvus-api-proxy.conf
: > "$proxy"
if [ -n "${CORVUS_UI_API_UPSTREAM:-}" ]; then
  case "$CORVUS_UI_API_UPSTREAM" in
    http://* | https://*)
      case "$CORVUS_UI_API_UPSTREAM" in
        *[!A-Za-z0-9.:/_-]*) echo "15-corvus-ui: ignoring invalid upstream" >&2 ;;
        *)
          cat > "$proxy" <<CONF
location /api/ {
    proxy_pass ${CORVUS_UI_API_UPSTREAM};
    proxy_set_header Host \$host;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For \$remote_addr;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto \$scheme;
    proxy_read_timeout 60s;
}
CONF
          ;;
      esac
      ;;
    *) echo "15-corvus-ui: ignoring invalid upstream" >&2 ;;
  esac
fi

CORVUS_UI_SCRIPT_HASHES="$(cat /etc/corvus-ui/csp-script-hashes.txt)"
export CORVUS_UI_SCRIPT_HASHES

```

`ui/docker/default.conf.template`:

```template
# Rendered by the nginx entrypoint (envsubst) into /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf.
# Variables: CORVUS_UI_BASE_PATH, CORVUS_UI_CONNECT_SRC, CORVUS_UI_SCRIPT_HASHES (set by 15-corvus-ui.envsh).
server {
    listen 8080;
    server_name _;
    root /usr/share/nginx/html;
    index index.html;
    server_tokens off;
    absolute_redirect off;

    # The base path is injected into the shell, so the build does not depend on where it is served.
    sub_filter_once on;
    sub_filter '<head>' '<head><base href="${CORVUS_UI_BASE_PATH}">';

    add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' ${CORVUS_UI_SCRIPT_HASHES}; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ${CORVUS_UI_CONNECT_SRC}; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'" always;
    add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
    add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY" always;
    add_header Referrer-Policy "no-referrer" always;
    add_header Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()" always;
    add_header Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy "same-origin" always;

    # Optional same-origin proxy to the control-plane API (CORVUS_UI_API_UPSTREAM); empty when not configured.
    include /tmp/corvus-api-proxy.conf;

    location = /healthz {
        access_log off;
        default_type text/plain;
        return 200 "ok\n";
    }

    # Runtime configuration: never cached, so a changed mount takes effect on reload.
    location = /config.json {
        add_header Cache-Control "no-store" always;
        add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
        try_files $uri =404;
    }

    # Hashed build assets are immutable.
    location /_nuxt/ {
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" always;
        add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
        try_files $uri =404;
    }

    location = /logo.png {
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=86400" always;
        try_files $uri =404;
    }

    # SPA fallback: every other path is a client-side route (history mode).
    location / {
        add_header Cache-Control "no-store" always;
        add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' ${CORVUS_UI_SCRIPT_HASHES}; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ${CORVUS_UI_CONNECT_SRC}; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'" always;
        add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
        add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY" always;
        add_header Referrer-Policy "no-referrer" always;
        add_header Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()" always;
        add_header Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy "same-origin" always;
        try_files /index.html =404;
    }
}

```

`ui/docker/postprocess.mjs`:

```mjs
// Runs in the Docker build stage on .output/public.
//  1. Makes the asset references of the HTML shells relative ("/_nuxt/x.js" -> "./_nuxt/x.js"). nginx adds
//     <base href="<base path>"> at runtime, so the same build works at the root and under a path prefix.
//  2. Drops the prerendered per-route copies of the shell; nginx falls back to index.html for every route.
//  3. Writes the CSP hashes of the inline scripts (importmap, Nuxt config) to csp-script-hashes.txt.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, rmSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'

const root = process.argv[2] ?? '.output/public'
const keep = new Set(['index.html', '200.html', '404.html', '_nuxt', 'config.json', 'logo.png'])

for (const entry of readdirSync(root)) {
  if (!keep.has(entry) && statSync(join(root, entry)).isDirectory()) rmSync(join(root, entry), { recursive: true })
}

const hashes = new Set()
for (const file of ['index.html', '200.html', '404.html']) {
  const path = join(root, file)
  const html = readFileSync(path, 'utf8').replaceAll('"/_nuxt/', '"./_nuxt/')
  writeFileSync(path, html)
  for (const m of html.matchAll(/<script(?![^>]*\bsrc=)[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g)) {
    hashes.add(`'sha256-${createHash('sha256').update(m[1]).digest('base64')}'`)
  }
}
writeFileSync(join(root, '..', 'csp-script-hashes.txt'), `${[...hashes].join(' ')}\n`)
console.log(`postprocess: ${hashes.size} inline script hashes`)

```

`ui/scripts/dump-openapi.py`:

```py
"""Dump the control-plane OpenAPI schema to ui/openapi.json.

    uv run --project services python ui/scripts/dump-openapi.py
"""

import json
from pathlib import Path

from corvus_services.api.app import create_app
from corvus_services.api.settings import ApiSettings

# A dev token only satisfies the "auth configured" check; the schema does not depend on it.
settings = ApiSettings(dev_token="schema-dump")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
schema = create_app(settings).openapi()
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "openapi.json"
out.write_text(json.dumps(schema, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
print(f"wrote {out}")

```

`ui/scripts/m3-tokens.mjs`:

```mjs
// Generates app/assets/css/m3-tokens.css: every Material 3 colour role (--md-sys-color-*) for the light and
// the dark scheme, from one seed colour. Run `pnpm tokens` after changing SEED; the test in
// m3-tokens.test.ts fails when the committed file is stale.
//
// Seed: OLF blue #114cc8 (the blue of the feather mark). Vibrant keeps the seed chroma, so the primary stays recognisably OLF blue (#0051df) while the
// surfaces stay calm; the roles reach WCAG AA (on-* roles are 4.5:1 or better by construction). The
// error role stays red and never collides with the primary hue, which a magenta seed would not guarantee.
// Success and warning are not part of M3; they are tonal palettes of the OLF green and yellow with the same
// tone mapping the standard roles use.
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import {
  argbFromHex,
  Hct,
  hexFromArgb,
  MaterialDynamicColors,
  SchemeVibrant,
  TonalPalette,
} from '@material/material-color-utilities'

export const SEED = '#114cc8'
const GREEN = '#1bc755'
const YELLOW = '#f7cc2e'

const kebab = name => name.replace(/[A-Z]/g, c => `-${c.toLowerCase()}`)

// The roles of MaterialDynamicColors that are colours (the rest are helpers or palette key colours).
const ROLES = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(MaterialDynamicColors).filter(
  n => !/KeyColor$|^highestSurface$|^contentAccentToneDelta$/.test(n)
    && MaterialDynamicColors[n] && typeof MaterialDynamicColors[n].getArgb === 'function',
)

// Tones for [color, on-color, container, on-container].
const EXTRA = { light: [40, 100, 90, 10], dark: [80, 20, 30, 90] }

function scheme(dark) {
  const s = new SchemeVibrant(Hct.fromInt(argbFromHex(SEED)), dark, 0)
  const out = {}
  for (const role of ROLES) out[kebab(role)] = hexFromArgb(MaterialDynamicColors[role].getArgb(s))
  const tones = dark ? EXTRA.dark : EXTRA.light
  for (const [name, hex] of [['success', GREEN], ['warning', YELLOW]]) {
    const p = TonalPalette.fromInt(argbFromHex(hex))
    const [c, on, cont, onCont] = tones.map(t => hexFromArgb(p.tone(t)))
    out[name] = c
    out[`on-${name}`] = on
    out[`${name}-container`] = cont
    out[`on-${name}-container`] = onCont
  }
  return out
}

const block = (selector, vars, colorScheme, indent = '') =>
  `${indent}${selector} {\n${indent}  color-scheme: ${colorScheme};\n`
  + Object.entries(vars).map(([k, v]) => `${indent}  --md-sys-color-${k}: ${v};`).join('\n')
  + `\n${indent}}\n`

export function buildTokensCss() {
  const light = scheme(false)
  const dark = scheme(true)
  return `/* Generated by scripts/m3-tokens.mjs from seed ${SEED} (Vibrant). Do not edit; run \`pnpm tokens\`. */\n\n`
    + block(':root', light, 'light')
    + '\n/* Dark scheme: the system preference, unless the user picked a theme explicitly. */\n'
    + `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {\n${block(':root:not([data-theme="light"])', dark, 'dark', '  ')}}\n\n`
    + block(':root[data-theme="dark"]', dark, 'dark')
    + '\n/* Tailwind utilities: bg-primary, text-on-surface, border-outline-variant, ... */\n'
    + `@theme inline {\n${Object.keys(light).map(k => `  --color-${k}: var(--md-sys-color-${k});`).join('\n')}\n}\n`
}

export const TOKENS_PATH = fileURLToPath(new URL('../app/assets/css/m3-tokens.css', import.meta.url))

if (process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  writeFileSync(TOKENS_PATH, buildTokensCss())
  console.log(`wrote ${TOKENS_PATH}`)
}

```

`ui/scripts/m3-tokens.test.ts`:

```ts
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
// @ts-expect-error plain ESM script without type declarations
import { buildTokensCss, TOKENS_PATH } from './m3-tokens.mjs'

const css: string = buildTokensCss()

describe('m3 tokens', () => {
  it('matches the committed file (run pnpm tokens after changing the generator)', () => {
    expect(readFileSync(TOKENS_PATH, 'utf8')).toBe(css)
  })

  it.each(['primary', 'on-primary', 'primary-container', 'surface', 'surface-container-high', 'on-surface', 'outline-variant', 'error', 'inverse-surface', 'success', 'warning-container'])(
    'defines the %s role for both schemes',
    (role) => {
      const matches = css.match(new RegExp(`--md-sys-color-${role}:`, 'g')) ?? []
      // light + system-dark media query + explicit dark
      expect(matches.length).toBe(3)
    },
  )

  it('maps every role into the Tailwind theme', () => {
    expect(css).toContain('--color-primary-container: var(--md-sys-color-primary-container);')
  })
})
```
